sql: WITH prev_events AS (SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) AS prev_started_at FROM sessions), with_gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag FROM prev_events), sessionized AS (SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id FROM with_gaps) SELECT device, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', prev_started_at) AS year_start, MIN(prev_started_at) AS first_prev_started_at, MIN(prev_started_at) AS first_seen, GROUPING_ID() AS gid FROM sessionized GROUP BY CUBE (device, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', prev_started_at));
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

prev_events = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("year_start", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "prev_started_at"))
    .cube("device", "year_start")
    .agg(
        F.min("prev_started_at").alias("first_prev_started_at"),
        F.min("prev_started_at").alias("first_seen"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(temp_c AS INT) AS temp_c_int,
        TRIM(firmware) AS clean_firmware
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE humidity >= 58
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code,
    kpi,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        humidity
    FROM filtered
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR kpi IN (pressure AS PRESSURE_VAL, humidity AS HUMIDITY)
) u;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("humidity") >= 58)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("temp_c").cast("int").alias("temp_c_int"),
        F.trim("firmware").alias("clean_firmware"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        F.col("pressure").alias("PRESSURE_VAL"),
        F.col("humidity").alias("HUMIDITY"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "device_code"],
        values=["PRESSURE_VAL", "HUMIDITY"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Berlin")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        "city",

sql: with kept_keys as (select channel from orders intersect all select channel from orders where customer_id = 25), reconciled as (select s.* from orders s join kept_keys k on s.channel = k.channel) select s.id, s.customer_id, s.store_id, s.order_date, s.status, s.amount, s.shipping_fee, case when status rlike '^(COMPLETED|SHIPPED)$' then 'EXTENDED' when status rlike '^(PENDING|CANCELLED)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as status_zone, (select sum(x.revenue) from store_sales x where x.store_id = s.store_id) as sum_store_sale_revenue from reconciled s order by order_date nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

revenue_by_store_id = df_store_sales.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.sum("revenue").alias("sum_store_sale_revenue"))

kept_keys = (
    df_orders
    .select("channel")
    .intersectAll(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 25)
        .select("channel")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("k.channel")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .join(revenue_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(COMPLETED|SHIPPED)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("status").rlike("^(PENDING|CANCELLED)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("status_zone"),
        F.col("sum_store_sale_revenue"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_date").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM orders
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_date,
        s.status,
        s.amount,
        x.order_item_quantity
    FROM latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity AS order_item_quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.quantity DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_date,
        order_item_quantity,
        UPPER(status) AS status_upper
    FROM latest_match
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-07-26'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.paid_at,
        top1.amount
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.paid_at, c.amount
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    paid_at,
    amount,
    LEAD(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_item_quantity, id) AS next_amount,
    LAG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_item_quantity, id) AS prev_amount,
    LEAD(order_item_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY order_item_quantity, id) AS next_order_item_quantity,
    LAG(order_item_quantity) OVER (ORDER BY order_item_quantity, id) AS prev_order_item_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_item_quantity, id) AS event_seq,
    LAG(order_item_quantity, 1) OVER (ORDER BY order_date, id) AS prev_order_item_quantity_2
FROM with_latest
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w5 = Window.orderBy("order_item_quantity", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("order_date", "id")

ranked = (
    df_orders
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

latest_match = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.order_date",
        "s.status",
        "s.amount",
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("order_item_quantity"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    latest_match
    .filter(F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-26").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_date",
        "order_item_quantity",
        F.upper("status").alias("status_upper"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.paid_at"), F.col("c.amount"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at",
        "amount",
        F.lead("amount").over(w5).alias("next_amount"),
        F.lag("amount").over(w5).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.lead("order_item_quantity").over(w5).alias("next_order_item_quantity"),
        F.lag("order_item_quantity").over(w5).alias("prev_order_item_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lag("order_item_quantity", 1).over(w6).alias("prev_order_item_quantity_2"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS key, attr_value
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value,
        INITCAP(TRIM(key)) AS key_title,
        COALESCE(key, 'N/A') AS key_filled
    FROM exploded
    WHERE TO_DATE(log_ts) < '2023-09-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT *, STDDEV_SAMP(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_stddev_samp_latency_ms
    FROM base
    WHERE service = 'search'
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        key,
        key_title,
        key_filled,
        service_stddev_samp_latency_ms,
        CASE WHEN key = 'trace' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_trace
    FROM enriched
    WHERE key IS DISTINCT FROM 'region'
      AND latency_ms = 983
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        key,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service = 'auth') AS auth_rows,
        SUM(service_stddev_samp_latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE key = 'version') AS version_total_service_stddev_samp_latency_ms,
        COUNT(DISTINCT service) AS distinct_services
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    key,
    auth_rows,
    version_total_service_stddev_samp_latency_ms,
    distinct_services,
    CASE WHEN key RLIKE '^(trace|region)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' WHEN key RLIKE '^(version)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS key_zone
FROM daily
ORDER BY key_zone;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

base = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.to_date("log_ts") < "2023-09-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "key",
        "attr_value",
        F.initcap(F.trim("key")).alias("key_title"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("key_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("service") == "search")
    .withColumn("service_stddev_samp_latency_ms", F.stddev_samp("latency_ms").over(w))
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter((~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region"))) & (F.col("latency_ms") == 983))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        "key_title",
        "key_filled",
        "service_stddev_samp_latency_ms",
        F.when(F.col("key") == "trace", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_trace"),
    )
)

daily = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy("key")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", 1)).alias("auth_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("key") == "version", F.col("service_stddev_samp_latency_ms"))).alias("version_total_service_stddev_samp_latency_ms"),
        F.countDistinct("service").alias("distinct_services"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "key",
        "auth_rows",
        "version_total_service_stddev_samp_latency_ms",
        "distinct_services",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(trace|region)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("key").rlike("^(version)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("key_zone")
)

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS k, v
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        MAX(latency_ms) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS latency_ms_max_2h
    FROM exploded
    WHERE latency_ms BETWEEN 1101 AND 2245
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        latency_ms_max_2h,
        CASE WHEN k IN ('region', 'trace') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS k_group
    FROM scored
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        latency_ms_max_2h,
        k_group,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_min_latency_ms,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms_max_2h DESC) AS latency_ms_max_2h_percent_rank
    FROM base
),
scored_app_logs AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY k_min_latency_ms NULLS FIRST) AS k_min_latency_ms_rank,
        SUM(latency_ms) OVER w_recent AS latency_ms_sum_30m
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored_app_logs_2 AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms_sum_30m DESC) AS latency_ms_sum_30m_percent_rank,
        COUNT(latency_ms_max_2h) OVER w_running AS latency_ms_max_2h_count_15m,
        MAX(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_max_latency_ms,
        AVG(k_min_latency_ms_rank) OVER w_recent AS k_min_latency_ms_rank_avg_1h,
        ROUND(latency_ms_max_2h / SUM(latency_ms_max_2h) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS latency_ms_max_2h_share
    FROM scored_app_logs
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN service_max_latency_ms >= 2456 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS service_max_latency_ms_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
        SUM(CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN latency_ms_sum_30m_percent_rank ELSE 0 END) AS billing_latency_ms_sum_30m_percent_rank,
        AVG(latency_ms_max_2h_percent_rank) FILTER (WHERE service = 'search') AS search_avg_latency_ms_max_2h_percent_rank,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(service)) AS service_list,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(service)) AS num_services
    FROM scored_app_logs_2
    GROUP BY service_max_latency_ms_tier, activity_day
)
SELECT
    service_max_latency_ms_tier,
    activity_day,
    billing_latency_ms_sum_30m_percent_rank,
    search_avg_latency_ms_max_2h_percent_rank,
    service_list,
    num_services
FROM summary
ORDER BY service_max_latency_ms_tier DESC, activity_day
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_max_2h").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("k_min_latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_sum_30m").desc())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

scored = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(1101, 2245))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        F.max("latency_ms").over(w).alias("latency_ms_max_2h"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "latency_ms_max_2h",
        F.when(F.col("k").isin(["region", "trace"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("k_group"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "latency_ms_max_2h",
        "k_group",
        F.min("latency_ms").over(w2).alias("k_min_latency_ms"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("latency_ms_max_2h_percent_rank"),
    )
)

scored_app_logs = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("k_min_latency_ms_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_sum_30m", F.sum("latency_ms").over(w_recent))
)

scored_app_logs_2 = (
    scored_app_logs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("latency_ms_sum_30m_percent_rank"),
        F.count("latency_ms_max_2h").over(w_running).alias("latency_ms_max_2h_count_15m"),
        F.max("latency_ms").over(w8).alias("service_max_latency_ms"),
        F.avg("k_min_latency_ms_rank").over(w9).alias("k_min_latency_ms_rank_avg_1h"),

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        ROUND(duration_sec * 0.9, 2) AS duration_sec_adjusted,
        CONCAT(page, ' - ', event_type) AS page_event_type
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= DATE '2023-07-23'
      AND duration_sec BETWEEN 218 AND 257
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        duration_sec_adjusted,
        page_event_type,
        MONTH(event_time) AS event_time_month,
        TRIM(page) AS clean_page
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        duration_sec_adjusted - event_time_month AS duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        CAST(duration_sec AS DOUBLE) AS duration_sec_str,
        COALESCE(page, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_page
    FROM base
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        page_event_type,
        duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        duration_sec,
        page_event_type,
        duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        LAG(duration_sec) OVER w_recent AS prev_duration_sec,
        LAG(duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month) OVER w_recent AS prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        LEAD(duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month) OVER w_recent AS next_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS seq_no
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month_avg_5_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS seq_no_2
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month DESC, id)
),
scored_web_events AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        page_event_type,
        duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        prev_duration_sec,
        prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        AVG(duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month) OVER (ORDER BY next_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month_avg_5_prior_2,
        AVG(prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month_avg_3_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month, id) AS row_seq
    FROM enriched
    WHERE prev_duration_sec > 185
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    page,
    metric_name,
    reading
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month,
        duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month
    FROM scored_web_events
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (prev_duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month, duration_sec_adjusted_minus_event_time_month)
) long_rows;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        country,
        city,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        CASE WHEN is_active THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_active_label
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching session per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.credit_limit,
        s.age,
        x.session_browser
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.browser AS session_browser
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.country IN ('UK', 'TH')
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        age,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY age DESC, id ASC) AS age_bucket,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered AS credit_limit_percent_rank
    FROM eligible
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY credit_limit ASC NULLS LAST)
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.device IN ('mobile', 'tablet')
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        age,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no,
        AVG(credit_limit_percent_rank) OVER w_recent AS credit_limit_percent_rank_avg_5,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_grp AS age_bucket_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running AS age_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit_percent_rank DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no_2
    FROM kept
    WHERE age_bucket < 5
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY age DESC, id ASC), w_recent AS (ORDER BY age_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_running AS (ORDER BY age ASC NULLS FIRST)
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(age_cume_dist * 1.1, 2) AS age_cume_dist_scaled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE seq_no >= 6
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    seq_no,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(age_cume_dist_scaled, 0.95) AS age_cume_dist_scaled_p95,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no, 0.95) AS seq_no_p95,
    ROUND(AVG(credit_limit_percent_rank_avg_5), 2) AS avg_credit_limit_percent_rank_avg_5
FROM valid
GROUP BY seq_no
ORDER BY seq_no_p95 DESC NULLS LAST;

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        region,
        sqft,
        date_format(opened_date, 'yyyy-MM') as opened_date_label,
        concat_ws('-', region, city) as region_city_key,
        coalesce(region, 'NONE') as region_clean
    from stores
    where opened_date >= to_date('2023-06-26')
      and region is not null
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from valid s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders x
            where x.store_id = s.id
              and x.customer_id = 22
        )
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        round(sqft / sum(sqft) over (partition by region), 4) as sqft_share,
        lead(sqft, 1) over (partition by city order by sqft, id) as next_sqft,
        lead(sqft, 1) over w_hist as next_sqft_2
    from not_flagged
    where store_name like 'Old%'
    window w_hist as (order by sqft, id)
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from inventory x
            where x.store_id = s.id
              and x.product_id in (2, 5, 7)
        )
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        first_value(next_sqft) ignore nulls over (partition by region, city order by sqft_share, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_next_sqft,
        round(sqft / sum(sqft) over (partition by city), 4) as sqft_share_2
    from kept
),
grouped as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        region,
        round(sum(first_known_next_sqft) / nullif(count(case when city = 'Bangkok' then 1 end), 0), 2) as first_known_next_sqft_per_bangkok,
        bit_and(sqft) as sqft_bit_and,
        percentile_approx(next_sqft, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as next_sqft_quartiles,
        sum(sqft_share) filter (where city = 'Chiang Mai') as chiang_mai_total_sqft_share,
        round(sum(sqft_share) / nullif(count(case when city = 'Bangkok' then 1 end), 0), 2) as sqft_share_per_bangkok
    from enriched
    group by cube (region)
)
select
    region,
    first_known_next_sqft_per_bangkok,
    sqft_bit_and,
    next_sqft_quartiles,
    case when region rlike '^(South|North)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as region_zone
from grouped
order by sqft_bit_and desc, region

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("region")

w5 = Window.partitionBy("city")

valid = (

    )
)

not_flagged = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.customer_id") == 22), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (

)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN rating >= 4.1 THEN 'High' WHEN rating >= 2.4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS rating_level,
        LENGTH(country) AS country_length
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(supplier_name)) = 'global supply'
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.launch_date < '2024-08-22'
        )
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS rating_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(rating, TRUE) OVER w_ordered AS last_known_rating,
        AVG(country_length) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY country_length, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS country_length_avg_5_prior,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS rating_share_2
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY country_length DESC, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT city, id
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT city, id
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating >= 2.9
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(rating_share_2) OVER w_recent AS country_stddev_samp_rating_share_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY country_length_avg_5_prior NULLS FIRST) AS country_length_avg_5_prior_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rating NULLS FIRST) AS rating_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_length_avg_5_prior DESC NULLS FIRST) AS country_length_avg_5_prior_rank,
        MAX(rating_share) OVER w_recent AS country_max_rating_share
    FROM verified
    WHERE country_length_avg_5_prior > 70
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY country)
),
kept_suppliers AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.product_name LIKE 'Cof%'
        )
),
kept_suppliers_2 AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_suppliers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND UPPER(TRIM(x.product_name)) = 'DESK LAMP'
        )
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        city,
        country_max_rating_share
    FROM kept_suppliers_2
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(country_max_rating_share)
    FOR city IN ('New York' AS new_york, 'London' AS london, 'Chiang Mai' AS chiang_mai)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("country_length").desc(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("country_length", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("country_length_avg_5_prior").asc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("country_length_avg_5_prior").desc_nulls_first())

cleaned = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.lower(F.trim("supplier_name")) == "global supply")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 4.1, "High").when(F.col("rating") >= 2.4, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("rating_level"),
        F.length("country").alias("country_length"),
    )
)

kept = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.launch_date") < "2024-08-22"), "left_semi")
)

metrics = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w_ordered).alias("last_known_rating"),
        F.avg("country_length").over(w4).alias("country_length_avg_5_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w5)), 4).alias("rating_share_2"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("city", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("rating") >= 2.9)
        .select("city", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("country_length_avg_5_prior") > 70)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("rating_share_2").over(w5).alias("country_stddev_samp_rating_share_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("country_length_avg_5_prior_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("rating_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("country_length_avg_5_prior_rank"),
        F.max("rating_share").over(w5).alias("country_max_rating_share"),
    )
)

kept_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.product_name").like("Cof%")), "left_semi")
)

kept_suppliers_2 = (
    kept_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.upper(F.trim(F.col("x.product_name"))) == "DESK LAMP"), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers_2
    .groupBy("country")
    .pivot("city", ["New York", "London", "Chiang Mai"])
    .agg(F.max("country_max_rating_share"))
    .select(
        "country",
        F.col("New York").alias("new_york"),
        F.col("London").alias("london"),
        F.col("Chiang Mai").alias("chiang_mai"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', supplier_name, country) supplier_name_country_key,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') city_filled
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.city,
        s.city_filled,
        top1.cost,
        top1.product_stock_qty
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost, c.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, city
    FROM with_last
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating <= 2.6
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, city
    FROM reconciled
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country = 'TH'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        city,
        CASE WHEN cost >= 580 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cost_tier,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(product_stock_qty, 0.5) AS product_stock_qty_p50,
        SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN product_stock_qty ELSE 0 END) AS tokyo_product_stock_qty,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY APPROX_PERCENTILE(product_stock_qty, 0.5) DESC) AS product_stock_qty_p50_rank
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY city, CASE WHEN cost >= 580 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING tokyo_product_stock_qty < 1000000
)
SELECT
    city,
    cost_tier,
    product_stock_qty_p50,
    tokyo_product_stock_qty
FROM daily
ORDER BY city DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("product_stock_qty_p50").desc())

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "supplier_name", "country").alias("supplier_name_country_key"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("city_filled"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.city",
        "s.city_filled",
        F.col("c.cost"),
        F.col("c.stock_qty").alias("product_stock_qty"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_last
    .select("id", "city")
    .intersectAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("rating") <= 2.6)
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        CEIL(amount) AS amount_whole
    FROM orders
    WHERE amount BETWEEN 800 AND 870
      AND order_date >= DATE '2023-03-14'
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM filtered e
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON e.channel = pr.channel
       AND e.order_date >= pr.starts_on
       AND e.order_date < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.cost,
        latest.shipped_date
    FROM matched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost, c.shipped_date
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.delivered_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.order_date,
        e.discount,
        e.amount_whole,
        e.promo_id,
        e.promo_code,
        e.discount_pct,
        d.store_name,
        d.region,
        d.city
    FROM with_latest e
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON e.store_id = d.id
    WHERE d.sqft > 11756
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.store_id,
        src.amount_whole,
        src.promo_id,
        src.discount_pct,
        src.store_name,
        src.region,
        p.sqft
    FROM joined src
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON src.store_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    promo_id,
    store_name,
    region,
    sqft
FROM enriched

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-09-04'
      AND salary < 132000
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_max_salary,
        MIN(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_min_salary,
        AVG(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_avg_salary,
        COUNT(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_count_salary
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE level != 'L2'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY is_remote_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY is_remote_flag, id) AS seq_no,
        AVG(last4_avg_salary) OVER w_part AS last4_avg_salary_avg_3
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY last4_min_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        last4_avg_salary,
        last4_count_salary,
        seq_no,
        last4_avg_salary_avg_3,
        ROUND(last4_avg_salary / SUM(last4_avg_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS last4_avg_salary_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(level, TRUE) OVER w_part AS first_known_level
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY last4_max_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    seq_no,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Engineer') AS engineer_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(salary) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Manager' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS salary_per_manager
FROM enriched
GROUP BY seq_no
ORDER BY engineer_rows NULLS LAST;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        IF(is_active, 'Yes', 'No') AS is_active_label
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment IS DISTINCT FROM 'SMB'
      AND segment IN ('SMB', 'Consumer')
),
base_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(email)) AS email_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS resolved_city
    FROM base
    WHERE city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Singapore'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_customers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.status <> 'ACTIVE'
        )
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT country
    FROM eligible
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT country
    FROM customers
    WHERE city NOT IN ('Tokyo', 'Chiang Mai')
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.country = k.country
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY credit_limit) AS credit_limit_cume_dist,
        CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS corr_age_credit_limit
    FROM reconciled
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN country IN ('UK', 'JP') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS country_group
    FROM metrics
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2023-08-18'
      AND country <> 'JP'
)
SELECT
    id,
    email,
    country,
    city,
    signup_date,
    credit_limit,
    age,
    is_active_label,
    email_title,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Tokyo|London)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS city_zone
FROM filtered
ORDER BY country NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("credit_limit")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")

base = (
    df_customers
    .filter((~F.col("segment").eqNullSafe(F.lit("SMB"))) & F.col("segment").isin(["SMB", "Consumer"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.when(F.col("is_active"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_active_label"),
    )
)

base_customers = (
    base
    .filter(~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Singapore")))
    .withColumn("email_title", F.initcap(F.trim("email")))
    .withColumn("resolved_city", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

eligible = (
    base_customers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.status") != "ACTIVE"), "left_semi")
)

matched_keys = (
    eligible
    .select("country")
    .intersectAll(
        df_customers
        .filter(~F.col("city").isin(["Tokyo", "Chiang Mai"]))
        .select("country")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("credit_limit_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_age_credit_limit", F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w2))
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-18").cast("date")) & (F.col("country") != "JP"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("country").isin(["UK", "JP"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("country_group"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "country",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "is_active_label",
        "email_title",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Tokyo|London)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("city_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, SIZE(tags) AS tags_count
    FROM products
    WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
      AND brand IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Acme'
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.quantity = 6
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.product_name,
        s.category,
        s.brand,
        s.price,
        s.cost,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.tags_count,
        s.dedup_rank,
        latest.sale_date,
        latest.revenue
    FROM kept s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.sale_date, c.revenue
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        price,
        cost,
        tags_count,
        sale_date,
        revenue
    FROM latest_match
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        tags_count,
        revenue,
        LEAD(revenue, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY tags_count, id) AS next_revenue,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC, id) AS price_bucket,
        SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cost
    FROM ranked
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, price_bucket + running_cost AS price_bucket_plus_running_cost
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE revenue > 1100
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    category,
    metric_name,
    value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        revenue,
        next_revenue,
        price_bucket_plus_running_cost
    FROM base
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR metric_name IN (revenue, next_revenue, price_bucket_plus_running_cost)
)

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("signup_date").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-25"))) & (F.col("credit_limit") >= 13300))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("city_filled"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("segment")).alias("segment_title"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("N/A")).alias("segment_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("email").like("%@company.co"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("credit_limit").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_credit_limit"),
        F.count("credit_limit").over(w_recent).alias("running_count_credit_limit"),
        F.sum("credit_limit").over(w_recent).alias("running_sum_credit_limit"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "segment_clean",
        "rank_in_group",
        "running_count_credit_limit",
        "running_sum_credit_limit",
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("running_min_credit_limit").over(w4).alias("cumulative_running_min_credit_limit"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "segment_clean",
        "rank_in_group",
        "seq_no",
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        EXPLODE(discounts) AS val
    FROM price_tiers
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    plan,
    CASE WHEN val >= 81 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS val_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(val, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS val_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(val) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS val_per_starter,
    MAX(val) AS max_val
FROM exploded
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((plan, CASE WHEN val >= 81 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (plan))
ORDER BY val_per_starter DESC NULLS LAST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "effective_from", F.explode("discounts").alias("val"))
)

result = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("val_tier", F.when(F.col("val") >= 81, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets([["plan", "val_tier"], ["plan"]], "plan", "val_tier")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("val", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("val_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("val") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "starter", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("val_per_starter"),
        F.max("val").alias("max_val"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("val_per_starter").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id, dept_id
    FROM employees
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, dept_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE dept_id = 14
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.dept_id = k.dept_id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT a.*, d.dept_name
    FROM verified a
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON a.dept_id = d.id
    WHERE d.budget > 3145000
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.email,
        e.dept_id,
        e.manager_id,
        e.hire_date,
        e.is_remote,
        e.dept_name,
        d.level AS employee_level
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN employees d
        ON e.manager_id = d.id
),
with_dims_employees AS (
    SELECT
        s.email,
        s.dept_id,
        s.hire_date,
        s.dept_name,
        d.budget,
        d.location
    FROM with_dims s
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON s.dept_id = d.id
)
SELECT
    s.dept_id,
    s.hire_date,
    s.dept_name,
    s.budget,
    CASE WHEN dept_name RLIKE '^(Sales|HR)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN dept_name RLIKE '^(Engineering|Marketing)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS dept_name_zone,
    (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = s.dept_id) AS avg_employee_salary
FROM with_dims_employees s
ORDER BY dept_name_zone DESC NULLS FIRST, dept_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

salary_by_dept_id = df_employees.groupBy("dept_id").agg(F.avg("salary").alias("avg_employee_salary"))

remaining_keys = (
    df_employees
    .select("id", "dept_id")
    .subtract(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("dept_id") == 14)
        .select("id", "dept_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_employees
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.budget") > 3145000)
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.dept_name"))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_employees.alias("d"), F.col("e.manager_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.email",
        "e.dept_id",
        "e.manager_id",
        "e.hire_date",
        "e.is_remote",
        "e.dept_name",
        F.col("d.level").alias("employee_level"),
    )
)

with_dims_employees = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.email",
        "s.dept_id",
        "s.hire_date",
        "s.dept_name",
        F.col("d.budget"),
        F.col("d.location"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims_employees
    .join(salary_by_dept_id, on="dept_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "dept_id",
        "hire_date",
        "dept_name",
        "budget",
        F.when(F.col("dept_name").rlike("^(Sales|HR)$"), "PRIORITY").when(F.col("dept_name").rlike("^(Engineering|Marketing)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("dept_name_zone"),
        F.col("avg_employee_salary"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("dept_name_zone").desc_nulls_first(), "dept_id")
)

        id,
        service,
        host,

        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS key, attr_value

    WHERE row_num = 1

    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, host ORDER BY latency_ms NULLS FIRST, id, key) AS row_num_2
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE row_num_2 = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM deduped_app_logs
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY row_num_2, id, key) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    service,
    host,
    latency_ms,
    key,
    attr_value,
    row_num_2
FROM latest

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        TO_DATE(event_time) AS event_time_date
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_type <> 'click'
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_event_time
    FROM valid
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_time IS NULL OR event_time > prev_event_time + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        event_time_date,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN island_id >= 6 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS island_id_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(island_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/search' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS island_id_per_search,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_sec, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS duration_sec_quartiles,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_seen
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CASE WHEN island_id >= 6 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY island_id_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        case when monthly_fee >= 242 then 'High' when monthly_fee >= 76 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as monthly_fee_band,
        round(monthly_fee * 1.1, 2) as monthly_fee_scaled
    from subscriptions
    where customer_id in (36, 38, 40)
),
matched as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        s.*,
        sub.id as subscription_id,
        sub.plan as subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee as subscription_monthly_fee
    from valid s
    left join subscriptions sub
        on s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and s.end_date >= sub.start_date
       and s.end_date < sub.end_date + interval '7' day
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        a.*,
        c.name,
        c.segment
    from matched a
    left join customers c
        on a.customer_id <=> c.id
    where c.credit_limit < 15000
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee_scaled,
        subscription_id,
        subscription_monthly_fee,
        name,
        lead(monthly_fee_scaled) over w_recent as next_monthly_fee_scaled,
        lag(monthly_fee_scaled) over w_recent as prev_monthly_fee_scaled,
        lead(monthly_fee) over w_recent as next_monthly_fee,
        lag(monthly_fee) over w_recent as prev_monthly_fee,
        row_number() over w_recent as event_seq
    from joined
    window w_recent as (partition by customer_id order by monthly_fee, id, subscription_id)
)
select
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.plan,
    s.end_date,
    s.monthly_fee_scaled,
    s.subscription_id,
    s.subscription_monthly_fee,
    s.name,
    s.next_monthly_fee_scaled,
    (select min(s2.monthly_fee) from subscriptions s2 where s2.customer_id = s.customer_id) as min_subscription_monthly_fee
from metrics s
order by plan nulls last, subscription_id desc

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), delivered_date) AS days_since_delivered_date,
        LOWER(status) AS status_lower,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IN ('UPS', 'Flash', 'Kerry')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY days_since_delivered_date DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        COUNT(days_since_delivered_date) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date
    FROM cleaned
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        days_since_delivered_date,
        status_lower,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost,
        LEAD(order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date,
        FIRST_VALUE(days_since_delivered_date, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_days_since_delivered_date
    FROM enriched
),
cleaned_shipments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        days_since_delivered_date + first_known_days_since_delivered_date AS days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') AS carrier_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        cost,
        days_since_delivered_date,
        status_lower,
        cumulative_cost,
        next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date,
        first_known_days_since_delivered_date,
        carrier_clean,
        FLOOR(next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date) AS next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date_whole,
        FLOOR(days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date) AS days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date_whole
    FROM cleaned_shipments
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
      AND carrier IS DISTINCT FROM 'DHL'
),
cleaned_shipments_2 AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date_whole + next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date AS days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date_whole_plus_next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date,
        LEAST(days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date_whole, next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date_whole) AS least_days_since_delivered_date_plus_first_known_days_since_delivered_date_whole_next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE first_known_days_since_delivered_date >= 47
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(cost) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY next_order_id_count_days_since_delivered_date_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_2_prior

WITH enriched AS (

    SELECT
        a.*,
        o.channel,
        o.amount AS order_amount,
        o.order_date
    FROM payments a
    JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id <=> o.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, method ORDER BY order_amount DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM ranked
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        channel,
        order_amount,
        rank_in_group,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_sum_7d,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS amount_share
    FROM islands
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM scored e
    JOIN promotions pr
        ON e.channel = pr.channel
       AND e.paid_at >= pr.starts_on
       AND e.paid_at < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '7' DAY
)

    (SELECT MAX(t2.cost) FROM shipments t2 WHERE t2.order_id = s.order_id) AS max_shipment_cost
FROM matched s;

WITH metrics AS (

        CUME_DIST() OVER w_grp AS duration_sec_cume_dist

enriched AS (

        a.event_time,
        a.duration_sec,
        p.browser,
        p.device
    FROM metrics a

        ON a.session_id = p.id
),
metrics_web_events AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(duration_sec) OVER w_ordered AS prev_duration_sec,
        LEAD(duration_sec) OVER w_ordered AS next_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS duration_sec_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device, session_id ORDER BY event_time, id)
),
metrics_web_events_2 AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(next_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY device) AS device_sum_next_duration_sec,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, device ORDER BY next_duration_sec DESC, id) AS next_duration_sec_bucket,
        LAG(event_seq, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS prev_event_seq
    FROM metrics_web_events
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec,
        AVG(next_duration_sec) OVER w_hist AS next_duration_sec_avg_5_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec DESC NULLS FIRST) AS duration_sec_dense_rank
    FROM metrics_web_events_2
    WHERE prev_event_seq <> 3
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY prev_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN next_duration_sec_bucket >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS next_duration_sec_bucket_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time) AS week_start,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS device_list,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_time))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers,
    MAX(event_seq) FILTER (WHERE page = '/home') AS home_max_event_seq,
    MIN(next_duration_sec_avg_5_prior) AS min_next_duration_sec_avg_5_prior
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY duration_min NULLS FIRST

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        key,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) li AS key, value
),
lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        key,
        value,
        value_2
    FROM flattened
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) x AS value_2
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        value,
        CASE WHEN value_2 IN ('SPRING10', 'BUNDLE') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END value_2_group
    FROM lines
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-01'
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), created_at) days_since_created_at
    FROM valid
    WHERE HOUR(created_at) BETWEEN 8 AND 12
),
cleaned_carts AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(created_at AS DATE) created_at_day
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE created_at >= DATE '2025-03-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_created_at DESC NULLS FIRST) days_since_created_at_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_created_at ASC) days_since_created_at_rank,
        AVG(days_since_created_at) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days_since_created_at_avg_2h,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY days_since_created_at DESC) days_since_created_at_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned_carts
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN days_since_created_at >= 75 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS days_since_created_at_tier,
    MIN(created_at) AS started_at,
    MAX(created_at) AS ended_at,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(days_since_created_at, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS days_since_created_at_quartiles,
    SUM(days_since_created_at_rank) AS total_days_since_created_at_rank,

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_created_at").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy("days_since_created_at")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_created_at").desc())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

lines = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "key",
        "value",
        F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("value_2"),
    )
)

valid = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "value",
        F.when(F.col("value_2").isin(["SPRING10", "BUNDLE"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("value_2_group"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.hour("created_at").between(8, 12))
    .withColumn("days_since_created_at", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "created_at"))
)

cleaned_carts = (

    .filter(F.col("created_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.col("created_at").cast("date").alias("created_at_day"))
)

with_windows = (

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.session_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.page,
        s.event_time,
        s.duration_sec,
        p2.browser
    FROM web_events s
    JOIN sessions p2
        ON s.session_id = p2.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS next_duration_sec,
        LAG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS seq_no
    FROM enriched
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM scored
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
scored_web_events AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY prev_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS seq_no_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(next_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY prev_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_next_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS event_seq
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE duration_sec BETWEEN 157 AND 448
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT session_id, page
    FROM scored_web_events
    EXCEPT
    SELECT session_id, page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_type = 'search'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_web_events s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.session_id = k.session_id AND s.page = k.page
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_next_duration_sec >= 2202 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_next_duration_sec_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time) AS quarter_start,
    AVG(seq_no) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'purchase') AS purchase_avg_seq_no,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN 1 END) AS home_count
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING home_count > 1
ORDER BY purchase_avg_seq_no DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("prev_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("prev_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")

enriched = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p2"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("p2.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.session_id",
        "s.event_type",
        "s.page",
        "s.event_time",
        "s.duration_sec",
        F.col("p2.browser"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("next_duration_sec", F.lead("duration_sec").over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_duration_sec", F.lag("duration_sec").over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
)

flagged = (
    scored
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

scored_web_events = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec").between(157, 448))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("seq_no").over(w3).alias("seq_no_avg_6_prior"),
        F.sum("next_duration_sec").over(w4).alias("running_next_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    scored_web_events
    .select("session_id", "page")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_type") == "search")
        .select("session_id", "page")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")) & (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_next_duration_sec") >= 2202, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_next_duration_sec_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "event_time").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", F.col("seq_no"))).alias("purchase_avg_seq_no"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1)).alias("home_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("home_count") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("purchase_avg_seq_no").desc())
)

with with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        ntile(10) over (order by cost desc, id) as cost_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by carrier order by shipped_date desc, id) as row_seq,
        ntile(5) over (partition by status order by cost desc, id) as cost_bucket_2,
        rank() over (partition by order_id order by cost desc nulls last) as cost_rank,
        lead(cost, 1) over (partition by status order by cost, id) as next_cost
    from shipments
    where cost < 45
),
kept_keys as (
    select carrier, id
    from with_windows
    intersect
    select carrier, id
    from shipments
    where order_id is null
),
reconciled as (
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.carrier = k.carrier and s.id = k.id
),
with_windows_shipments as (
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by cost_bucket desc nulls first) as cost_bucket_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by cost) as cost_percent_rank,
        rank() over (partition by order_id order by next_cost nulls last) as next_cost_rank,
        dense_rank() over (partition by order_id order by cost_bucket_2 nulls first) as cost_bucket_2_dense_rank,
        round(cost_bucket / sum(cost_bucket) over (partition by carrier), 4) as cost_bucket_share
    from reconciled
),
with_windows_shipments_2 as (
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by cost_rank nulls first) as cost_rank_rank,
        percent_rank() over (partition by status order by cost_bucket_share desc) as cost_bucket_share_percent_rank,
        round(next_cost_rank / sum(next_cost_rank) over (partition by carrier), 4) as next_cost_rank_share
    from with_windows_shipments
)
select
    id,
    order_id,
    carrier,
    shipped_date,
    delivered_date,
    status,
    cost_bucket,
    row_seq,
    cost_bucket_2
from with_windows_shipments_2
order by delivered_date nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost_bucket").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy("cost")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("next_cost").asc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost_bucket_2").asc_nulls_first())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w12 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost_bucket_share").desc())

with_windows = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("cost") < 45)
    .withColumn("cost_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("cost_bucket_2", F.ntile(5).over(w3))
    .withColumn("cost_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost", 1).over(w5))
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("carrier", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull())
        .select("carrier", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows_shipments = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("cost_bucket_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("cost_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("next_cost_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w9).alias("cost_bucket_2_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("cost_bucket") / F.sum("cost_bucket").over(w10)), 4).alias("cost_bucket_share"),
    )
)

with_windows_shipments_2 = (
    with_windows_shipments
    .withColumn("cost_rank_rank", F.rank().over(w11))
    .withColumn("cost_bucket_share_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w12))
    .withColumn("next_cost_rank_share", F.round((F.col("next_cost_rank") / F.sum("next_cost_rank").over(w10)), 4))
)

result = (
    with_windows_shipments_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        "cost_bucket",
        "row_seq",
        "cost_bucket_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").asc_nulls_first())
)
