with enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(cost) over w_running last4_avg_cost,
        sum(cost) over w_running last4_sum_cost,
        count(cost) over w_running last4_count_cost
    from shipments
    where status in ('IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED')
    window w_running as (partition by status, carrier order by shipped_date asc, id asc rows between 3 preceding and current row)
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(cost / sum(cost) over (partition by status, carrier), 4) cost_share,
        sum(last4_count_cost) over (order by last4_sum_cost asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cumulative_last4_count_cost,
        first_value(carrier) ignore nulls over (partition by carrier, status order by delivered_date asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_carrier
    from enriched
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select carrier, id
    from scored
    intersect
    select carrier, id
    from shipments
    where status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.carrier = k.carrier and s.id = k.id
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by status order by last4_sum_cost desc nulls last) last4_sum_cost_dense_rank,
        max(cumulative_last4_count_cost) over (partition by carrier) carrier_max_cumulative_last4_count_cost,
        round(cost / sum(cost) over (partition by carrier), 4) cost_share_2,
        avg(cost_share) over (partition by status, order_id) status_avg_cost_share,
        round(last4_avg_cost / sum(last4_avg_cost) over (partition by status, order_id), 4) last4_avg_cost_share
    from kept_rows
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        last4_sum_cost_dense_rank / nullif(cost_share_2, 0) last4_sum_cost_dense_rank_per_cost_share_2,
        floor(cost_share_2) cost_share_2_whole
    from metrics
    where status in ('LOST', 'RETURNED')
)
select
    id,
    carrier,
    shipped_date,
    delivered_date,
    cost,
    status,
    last4_avg_cost,
    last4_sum_cost,
    cost_share
from valid
order by shipped_date desc nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier")
w3 = Window.orderBy("last4_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "status").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("last4_sum_cost").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id")

enriched = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["IN_TRANSIT", "DELIVERED"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost").over(w_running).alias("last4_avg_cost"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w_running).alias("last4_sum_cost"),
        F.count("cost").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_cost"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w2)), 4).alias("cost_share"),
        F.sum("last4_count_cost").over(w3).alias("cumulative_last4_count_cost"),
        F.first("carrier", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_carrier"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    scored
    .select("carrier", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("status") == "IN_TRANSIT")
        .select("carrier", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("last4_sum_cost_dense_rank"),
        F.max("cumulative_last4_count_cost").over(w6).alias("carrier_max_cumulative_last4_count_cost"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w6)), 4).alias("cost_share_2"),
        F.avg("cost_share").over(w7).alias("status_avg_cost_share"),
        F.round((F.col("last4_avg_cost") / F.sum("last4_avg_cost").over(w7)), 4).alias("last4_avg_cost_share"),
    )
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["LOST", "RETURNED"]))
    .withColumn("last4_sum_cost_dense_rank_per_cost_share_2", (F.col("last4_sum_cost_dense_rank") / F.nullif("cost_share_2", F.lit(0))))
    .withColumn("cost_share_2_whole", F.floor("cost_share_2"))
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "last4_avg_cost",
        "last4_sum_cost",
        "cost_share",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, attr_value
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) AS prev_log_ts
    FROM exploded
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_log_ts IS NULL OR log_ts > prev_log_ts + INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        k,
        attr_value,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        k,
        attr_value,
        session_id,
        FIRST_VALUE(k, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_k,
        SUM(session_id) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_sum_session_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY session_id DESC, id, k) AS session_id_bucket,
        MAX(session_id) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_max_2h
    FROM sessionized
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY session_id_max_2h) AS latest_rank
        FROM scored
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    id,
    k,
    attr_value,
    first_known_k,
    session_id_max_2h,
    latest_rank,
    MAX(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_max_session_id_bucket,
    SUM(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_session_id_bucket,
    MIN(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_min_session_id_bucket,
    AVG(session_id_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY session_id_bucket, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_avg_session_id_bucket,
    FIRST_VALUE(session_id_max_2h, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY session_id, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_session_id_max_2h
FROM deduped
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("session_id").desc(), "id", "k")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("session_id_max_2h")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("session_id_bucket", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("session_id", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

prev_events = exploded.withColumn("prev_log_ts", F.lag("log_ts").over(w))

flagged = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_log_ts").isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.col("prev_log_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

scored = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "session_id",
        F.first("k", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_k"),
        F.sum("session_id").over(w3).alias("k_sum_session_id"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w4).alias("session_id_bucket"),
        F.max("session_id").over(w5).alias("session_id_max_2h"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "first_known_k",
        "session_id_max_2h",
        "latest_rank",
        F.max("session_id_bucket").over(w7).alias("last7_max_session_id_bucket"),
        F.sum("session_id_bucket").over(w7).alias("last7_sum_session_id_bucket"),
        F.min("session_id_bucket").over(w7).alias("last7_min_session_id_bucket"),
        F.avg("session_id_bucket").over(w7).alias("last7_avg_session_id_bucket"),
        F.first("session_id_max_2h", ignorenulls=True).over(w8).alias("first_known_session_id_max_2h"),
    )
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        DATE_SUB(starts_on, 54) AS starts_on_minus_54d,
        CONCAT_WS('/', channel, promo_code) AS channel_promo_code_key
    FROM promotions
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-08-07'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on_minus_54d, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_cume_dist_2
    FROM deduped
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CONCAT(promo_code, ', ', channel) AS promo_code_channel
    FROM metrics
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND discount_pct >= 0.15
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        discount_pct,
        channel_promo_code_key,
        discount_pct_cume_dist,
        last_known_channel,
        discount_pct_cume_dist_2,
        promo_code_channel
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    discount_pct,
    channel_promo_code_key,
    discount_pct_cume_dist,
    last_known_channel,
    promo_code_channel
FROM latest
ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("starts_on", "id")

w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("starts_on_minus_54d", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())

    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-08-07").cast("date")) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())

        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.date_sub("starts_on", 54).alias("starts_on_minus_54d"),
        F.concat_ws("/", "channel", "promo_code").alias("channel_promo_code_key"),

    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")

        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("discount_pct_cume_dist_2"),
    )
)

    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull() & (F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.15))

        F.concat("promo_code", F.lit(", "), "channel").alias("promo_code_channel"),

    .select(

        "discount_pct",
        "channel_promo_code_key",
        "discount_pct_cume_dist",
        "last_known_channel",
        "discount_pct_cume_dist_2",
        "promo_code_channel",
    )
)

    .select(

        "discount_pct_cume_dist",
        "last_known_channel",

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

parsed = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "tier_prices",
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.transform("tier_prices", lambda p, i: F.round(p * F.col("tier_limits")[i], 2)).alias("tier_revenue_caps"),
    )
)

    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("entry_price") >= 32, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("entry_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(

        F.sum("entry_price").alias("total_entry_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("entry_price", 0.95).alias("entry_price_p95"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", F.col("entry_price")).otherwise(0)).alias("basic_entry_price"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("currency") == "USD", F.col("entry_price"))).alias("usd_max_entry_price"),
    )

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("status", "carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("last7_count_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-13").cast("date")) & (F.col("order_id") == 37))
    .withColumn("delivered_date_label", F.date_format("delivered_date", "yyyy-MM-dd"))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("cost").over(w_running).alias("last7_max_cost"),
        F.count("cost").over(w_running).alias("last7_count_cost"),
        F.min("cost").over(w_running).alias("last7_min_cost"),
    )
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.order_date") > "2024-06-30")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.status").alias("order_status"), F.col("p.amount"))
)

ranked = (
    joined
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("row_num_2", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num_2") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("last7_min_cost").over(w4).alias("order_id_min_last7_min_cost"),
        F.first("last7_min_cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_last7_min_cost"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .withColumn("last7_count_cost_tier", F.when(F.col("last7_count_cost") >= 18, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "delivered_date"))
    .rollup("last7_count_cost_tier", "order_id", "activity_month")
    .agg(
        F.avg("last7_count_cost").alias("avg_last7_count_cost"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("order_status") == "CANCELLED", 1)).alias("cancelled_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("order_status") == "COMPLETED", 1)).alias("completed_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx", 1)).alias("fedex_rows"),
        F.grouping("last7_count_cost_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_last7_count_cost") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("order_id").asc_nulls_first())
)

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        case when country = 'DE' then 1 else 0 end as is_de,
        coalesce(city, 'UNKNOWN') as city_filled
    from suppliers
    where country = 'JP'
),
deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from valid
    qualify rank() over (partition by country order by is_de nulls first) = 1
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select city, id
    from deduped
    intersect all
    select city, id
    from suppliers
    where country in ('TH', 'US')
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from deduped s
    join matched_keys k on s.city = k.city and s.id = k.id
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        supplier_name,
        city,
        rating,
        is_de,
        case when country = 'UK' then 1 else 0 end as is_uk
    from reconciled
    where rating >= 2.7
)
select
    supplier_name,
    city,
    rating,
    is_uk
from cleaned
order by rating nulls first;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("is_de").asc_nulls_first())

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "JP")
    .withColumn("is_de", F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("city_filled", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

matched_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("city", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("country").isin(["TH", "US"]))
        .select("city", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("rating") >= 2.7)
    .select(
        "supplier_name",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "is_de",
        F.when(F.col("country") == "UK", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_uk"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select("supplier_name", "city", "rating", "is_uk")
    .orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_first())
)

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        round(sqft, 2) as sqft_rounded,
        case when city = 'Singapore' then 1 else 0 end as is_singapore
    from stores
    where opened_date >= to_date('2023-04-30')
      and region is distinct from 'Central'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        last_value(region) ignore nulls over w_hist as last_known_region,
        first_value(is_singapore) ignore nulls over (order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_is_singapore,
        avg(sqft) over (partition by city order by sqft_rounded, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as sqft_avg_3_prior
    from base
    window w_hist as (partition by region order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
with_windows_stores as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(is_singapore) over w_hist as is_singapore_avg_5,
        lead(sqft_avg_3_prior, 2) over w_recent as next_sqft_avg_3_prior
    from with_windows
    where first_known_is_singapore > 57
    window w_hist as (partition by region order by sqft, id rows between 5 preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by region, city order by is_singapore, id)
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select city
    from with_windows_stores
    except all
    select city
    from stores
    where city = 'Berlin'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows_stores s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.city = k.city
),
kept as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from kept_rows s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from orders ch
            where ch.store_id = s.id
              and ch.order_date <= s.opened_date
        )
)
select
    id,
    store_name,
    city,
    region,
    opened_date,
    sqft,
    sqft_rounded,
    first_known_is_singapore,
    sqft_avg_3_prior
from kept
order by city desc nulls last, id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("is_singapore", "id")

base = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-30"))) & (~F.col("region").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Central"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("sqft", 2).alias("sqft_rounded"),
        F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_singapore"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("region", ignorenulls=True).over(w_hist).alias("last_known_region"),
        F.first("is_singapore", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_is_singapore"),
        F.avg("sqft").over(w3).alias("sqft_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

with_windows_stores = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("first_known_is_singapore") > 57)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("is_singapore").over(w4).alias("is_singapore_avg_5"),
        F.lead("sqft_avg_3_prior", 2).over(w_recent).alias("next_sqft_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows_stores
    .select("city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_stores
        .filter(F.col("city") == "Berlin")
        .select("city")
    )
)

    select

    from price_tiers
    lateral view outer explode(tier_limits) t as val

    from valid

),
matched_keys as (

    select currency
    from cleaned
    except
    select currency
    from price_tiers
    where plan not in ('basic', 'pro', 'enterprise')
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.currency = k.currency
)

    currency,
    val,
    currency_upper,
    case when currency rlike '^(THB|EUR)$' then 'PRIORITY' when currency rlike '^(USD)$' then 'EXTENDED' else 'GROUP_A' end as currency_zone
from reconciled

    FROM joined e

        ON e.store_id = p.id

latest AS (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")

    .select(

)

WITH eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM customers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date <= s.signup_date
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY credit_limit DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM eligible
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
deduped_customers AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        age
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching account per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.status,
        x.account_opened_date
    FROM deduped_customers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status, c.opened_date AS account_opened_date
            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.balance DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.started_at < '2024-10-01'
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    AVG(age) AS avg_age,
    STDDEV_SAMP(age) AS age_stddev,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'FROZEN') AS frozen_events
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY 1
HAVING distinct_ids > 1
ORDER BY distinct_ids DESC

WITH filtered AS (

latest AS (

    FROM enriched

),

    EXCEPT

    WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(tags, 'eco')

kept_rows AS (

    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.supplier_id = k.supplier_id
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c

        )
),
eligible AS (

    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.sale_date > '2024-12-01'

),
base AS (

    FROM eligible
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

    s.city,

    ROUND(AVG(a.price), 2) AS avg_price,

FROM base a
INNER JOIN suppliers s ON a.supplier_id = s.id

with latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status, plan order by end_date desc, id) as row_num
    from subscriptions
    qualify row_num = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        plan,
        status,
        last_value(monthly_fee, true) over (partition by customer_id order by start_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) last_known_monthly_fee,
        percent_rank() over (partition by customer_id, status order by monthly_fee desc nulls first) monthly_fee_percent_rank,
        sum(monthly_fee) over (order by end_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cumulative_monthly_fee,
        dense_rank() over (partition by plan, customer_id order by monthly_fee nulls first) monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        avg(monthly_fee) over (partition by customer_id order by monthly_fee, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) monthly_fee_avg_3
    from latest
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        min(monthly_fee_dense_rank) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_dense_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_min_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        avg(monthly_fee_dense_rank) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_dense_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        count(monthly_fee_dense_rank) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_dense_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_count_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        max(monthly_fee_dense_rank) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_dense_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        ntile(3) over (partition by status order by monthly_fee_avg_3, id) monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket
    from metrics
    where status in ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED')
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select status
    from with_windows
    except all
    select status
    from subscriptions
    where plan not in ('enterprise', 'basic')
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.status = k.status
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        plan,
        status,
        last_known_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_percent_rank,
        monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank,
        monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket,
        coalesce(running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank, 0) running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled,
        cast(monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket as string) monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket_num
    from verified
    where cumulative_monthly_fee != 853
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, avg(running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled) over (partition by status) status_avg_running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled
    from cleaned
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select
    plan,
    kpi,
    val
from (
    select
        plan,
        last_known_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_percent_rank,
        running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled,
        running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank
    from scored
) src
unpivot include nulls (
    val for kpi in (last_known_monthly_fee as LAST_KNOWN_MONTHLY_FEE, monthly_fee_percent_rank as MONTHLY_FEE_PERCENT_RANK_VAL, running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled, running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank as RUNNING_MAX_MONTHLY_FEE_DENSE_RANK)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("monthly_fee_dense_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("monthly_fee_avg_3", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("status")

latest = (
    df_subscriptions
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_monthly_fee"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("monthly_fee_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w4).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w6).alias("monthly_fee_avg_3"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["ACTIVE", "EXPIRED", "CANCELLED"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("monthly_fee_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("running_min_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.count("monthly_fee_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("running_count_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.max("monthly_fee_dense_rank").over(w7).alias("running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w8).alias("monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("status")
    .exceptAll(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(~F.col("plan").isin(["enterprise", "basic"]))
        .select("status")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("cumulative_monthly_fee") != 853)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "last_known_monthly_fee",
        "monthly_fee_percent_rank",
        "monthly_fee_dense_rank",
        "running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank",
        "monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket",
        F.coalesce("running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank", F.lit(0)).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled"),
        F.col("monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket").cast("string").alias("monthly_fee_avg_3_bucket_num"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled").over(w9).alias("status_avg_running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "plan",
        F.col("last_known_monthly_fee").alias("LAST_KNOWN_MONTHLY_FEE"),
        F.col("monthly_fee_percent_rank").alias("MONTHLY_FEE_PERCENT_RANK_VAL"),
        "running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled",
        F.col("running_max_monthly_fee_dense_rank").alias("RUNNING_MAX_MONTHLY_FEE_DENSE_RANK"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["plan"],
        values=["LAST_KNOWN_MONTHLY_FEE", "MONTHLY_FEE_PERCENT_RANK_VAL", "running_avg_monthly_fee_dense_rank_filled", "RUNNING_MAX_MONTHLY_FEE_DENSE_RANK"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        COALESCE(amount, 0) amount_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-04-26 04:00:00')
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IN ('bank_transfer', 'promptpay')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.order_id = k.order_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) status_sum_amount,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id), 4) amount_share
    FROM kept_rows
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        amount_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC) amount_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(amount_share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) status_stddev_samp_amount_share,
        SUM(status_sum_amount) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) status_sum_amount_sum_7d,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_avg_90d
    FROM enriched
    WHERE status = 'REFUNDED'
),
report AS (
    SELECT
        amount,
        paid_at,
        amount_share,
        amount_cume_dist,
        status_stddev_samp_amount_share
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    amount,
    paid_at,
    amount_cume_dist,
    status_stddev_samp_amount_share
FROM report
ORDER BY paid_at DESC

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_partner,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY is_partner DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY dedup_rank ASC) AS dedup_rank_2
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY dedup_rank_2 = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running row_seq,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount ASC, id ASC) amount_bucket
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY discount DESC, id ASC)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id, status
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, status
    FROM orders
    WHERE shipping_fee >= 20
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.status = k.status
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        row_seq,
        amount_bucket,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY row_seq ASC NULLS FIRST) row_seq_dense_rank,
        ROUND(amount_bucket / SUM(amount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) amount_bucket_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_bucket DESC NULLS LAST) amount_bucket_percent_rank
    FROM verified
),
enriched_orders AS (
    SELECT
        row_seq,
        amount_bucket,
        row_seq_dense_rank,
        amount_bucket_share,
        amount_bucket_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount_bucket_share ASC NULLS FIRST) amount_bucket_share_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY amount_bucket_percent_rank DESC NULLS LAST) amount_bucket_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount_bucket_share DESC NULLS LAST) amount_bucket_share_rank_2
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount_bucket_share_rank_2 >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_bucket_share_rank_2_tier,
    CASE WHEN row_seq_dense_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS row_seq_dense_rank_tier,
    AVG(amount_bucket_share_rank_2) AS avg_amount_bucket_share_rank_2,
    ROUND(AVG(amount_bucket_share), 2) AS avg_amount_bucket_share,
    SUM(amount_bucket_percent_rank) AS total_amount_bucket_percent_rank,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq), 2) AS avg_row_seq,
    MAX(amount_bucket_share_rank) AS max_amount_bucket_share_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN amount_bucket_share_rank_2 >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY ROUND(AVG(amount_bucket_share), 2) DESC) AS avg_amount_bucket_share_percent_rank
FROM enriched_orders
GROUP BY 1, 2;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy(F.col("is_partner").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy("dedup_rank")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount_bucket").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_bucket_share").asc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_bucket_percent_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_bucket_share").desc_nulls_last())
w11 = Window.partitionBy("amount_bucket_share_rank_2_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_amount_bucket_share").desc())

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_partner"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank_2", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("row_seq"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w4).alias("amount_bucket"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("id", "status")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 20)
        .select("id", "status")
    )
)

verified = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "row_seq",
        "amount_bucket",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("row_seq_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("amount_bucket") / F.sum("amount_bucket").over(w6)), 4).alias("amount_bucket_share"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("amount_bucket_percent_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_orders = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "row_seq",
        "amount_bucket",
        "row_seq_dense_rank",
        "amount_bucket_share",
        "amount_bucket_percent_rank",
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("amount_bucket_share_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w9).alias("amount_bucket_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w10).alias("amount_bucket_share_rank_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_orders
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount_bucket_share_rank_2") >= 9, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_bucket_share_rank_2_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("row_seq_dense_rank") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("row_seq_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("amount_bucket_share_rank_2").alias("avg_amount_bucket_share_rank_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount_bucket_share"), 2).alias("avg_amount_bucket_share"),
        F.sum("amount_bucket_percent_rank").alias("total_amount_bucket_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("row_seq"), 2).alias("avg_row_seq"),
        F.max("amount_bucket_share_rank").alias("max_amount_bucket_share_rank"),
    )
    .withColumn("avg_amount_bucket_share_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w11))

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        ROUND(units * 1.07, 2) AS units_adjusted
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= TO_DATE('2023-09-19')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) AS days_since_sale_date
    FROM valid
    WHERE units BETWEEN 17 AND 19
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(units) OVER w_part AS running_count_units,
        MIN(units) OVER w_part AS running_min_units,
        AVG(units) OVER w_part AS running_avg_units,
        MAX(units) OVER w_part AS running_max_units,
        LAST_VALUE(units, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY units_adjusted, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_units
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        units_adjusted,
        running_count_units,
        running_max_units,
        last_known_units,
        LAG(last_known_units, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date, id) AS prev_last_known_units,
        LEAD(running_avg_units, 1) OVER (ORDER BY running_count_units, id) AS next_running_avg_units,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last_known_units DESC NULLS FIRST) AS last_known_units_percent_rank,
        LEAD(running_avg_units, 2) OVER (ORDER BY running_avg_units, id) AS next_running_avg_units_2
    FROM with_windows
),
cleaned_store_sales AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(running_max_units) AS running_max_units_whole,
        ROUND(running_max_units / next_running_avg_units, 2) AS running_max_units_per_next_running_avg_units
    FROM scored
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-07-07'
      AND running_max_units <= 40
),
cleaned_store_sales_2 AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, units_adjusted * running_max_units AS units_adjusted_times_running_max_units
    FROM cleaned_store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-05-09'
      AND last_known_units_percent_rank <= 0.65
)
SELECT
    id,
    units_adjusted,
    running_count_units,
    running_max_units,
    last_known_units,
    next_running_avg_units,
    last_known_units_percent_rank,
    running_max_units_per_next_running_avg_units,
    units_adjusted_times_running_max_units
FROM cleaned_store_sales_2

)

cleaned_store_sales_2 = (

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(monthly_fee) AS monthly_fee_whole,
        INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS status_title
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE plan = 'standard'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status,
        status_title,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_monthly_fee,
        MAX(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_max_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_sum_monthly_fee
    FROM filtered
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, FLOOR(last3_sum_monthly_fee) AS last3_sum_monthly_fee_whole
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE status IN ('EXPIRED', 'ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.country,
    p.city,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    ROUND(SUM(e.last3_avg_monthly_fee), 2) AS total_last3_avg_monthly_fee,
    MIN(e.last3_sum_monthly_fee_whole) AS min_last3_sum_monthly_fee_whole
FROM kept_rows e
LEFT JOIN customers p ON e.customer_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.country, p.city
ORDER BY country NULLS LAST

    id,
    full_name,
    dept_id,
    job_title,
    salary,
    level,
    SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, level ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary,
    SUM(salary) OVER (ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_salary,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS seq_no,
    NTILE(4) OVER w_running_2 AS salary_bucket,
    FIRST_VALUE(job_title) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_job_title
FROM employees
WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY salary DESC, id), w_running_2 AS (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY salary, id);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w2 = Window.orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("salary", "id")

        SUM(units) OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_units,
        LEAD(units, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date, id) next_units,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units NULLS LAST) units_rank
    FROM store_sales
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    product_id,
    sale_date,
    units,

sql: WITH scored AS (SELECT id, dept_id, manager_id, job_title, salary, hire_date, is_remote, level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS seq_no, LAST_VALUE(job_title, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_job_title, SUM(salary) OVER w_recent_2 AS running_salary FROM employees WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY job_title, manager_id ORDER BY salary DESC, id), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY job_title, level ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT s.id, s.manager_id, s.job_title, s.salary, s.hire_date, s.is_remote, s.level, s.seq_no, s.last_known_job_title, CASE WHEN level RLIKE '^(L3|L4)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN level RLIKE '^(L1|L2)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS level_zone, (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.manager_id = s.manager_id) AS max_employee_salary FROM scored s ORDER BY level NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "manager_id").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "level").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

        "dept_id",

        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "level",

        F.last("job_title", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_job_title"),
        F.sum("salary").over(w_recent_2).alias("running_salary"),

result = (

    .join(salary_by_manager_id, on="manager_id", how="left")

    .orderBy(F.col("level").asc_nulls_last())

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, GREATEST(credit_limit, age) AS greatest_credit_limit_age
    FROM customers
    WHERE city = 'Bangkok'
      AND signup_date > DATE '2023-03-29'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(age) OVER w_recent AS last7_avg_age,
        SUM(age) OVER w_recent AS last7_sum_age,
        COUNT(age) OVER w_recent AS last7_count_age,
        AVG(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city, segment) AS city_avg_credit_limit
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY city, segment ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT city
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= '2024-05-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city
),
enriched_customers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        name,
        email,
        city,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        greatest_credit_limit_age,
        last7_sum_age,
        last7_count_age,
        city_avg_credit_limit,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY greatest_credit_limit_age NULLS LAST) AS greatest_credit_limit_age_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY city_avg_credit_limit DESC) AS city_avg_credit_limit_dense_rank
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE last7_sum_age > 280
),
stats AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date) AS week_start,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(greatest_credit_limit_age, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS greatest_credit_limit_age_quartiles
    FROM enriched_customers
    GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT week_start, city_list
FROM stats
ORDER BY week_start DESC
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("greatest_credit_limit_age").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("city_avg_credit_limit").desc())

base = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("city") == "Bangkok") & (F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-03-29").cast("date")))
    .withColumn("greatest_credit_limit_age", F.greatest("credit_limit", "age"))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .withColumn("last7_avg_age", F.avg("age").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last7_sum_age", F.sum("age").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("last7_count_age", F.count("age").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("city_avg_credit_limit", F.avg("credit_limit").over(w2))
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("city")
    .intersect(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("signup_date") >= "2024-05-01")
        .select("city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched_customers = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("last7_sum_age") > 280)
    .select(
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "signup_date",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "greatest_credit_limit_age",
        "last7_sum_age",
        "last7_count_age",
        "city_avg_credit_limit",
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("greatest_credit_limit_age_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("city_avg_credit_limit_dense_rank"),
    )
)

stats = (
    enriched_customers
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "signup_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("greatest_credit_limit_age", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("greatest_credit_limit_age_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("week_start", "city_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("week_start").desc())
    .limit(20)
)

sql: with ranked as (select * from (select *, row_number() over (partition by product_id order by quantity desc, id) as row_num from inventory) t where row_num = 1), joined as (select a.*, p.cost from ranked a left join products p on a.product_id = p.id), with_windows as (select id, store_id, product_id, cost, first_value(cost, true) over (partition by store_id order by last_restock, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_cost, sum(quantity) over (partition by product_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_quantity from joined), base as (select *, round(cost / first_known_cost, 2) as cost_per_first_known_cost, greatest(running_quantity, first_known_cost) as greatest_running_quantity_first_known_cost from with_windows where first_known_cost between 360 and 510), deduped as (select * from base qualify rank() over (partition by product_id order by cost desc nulls first) = 1), enriched as (select *, ntile(4) over (partition by store_id order by running_quantity, id) as running_quantity_bucket, sum(cost_per_first_known_cost) over w_ordered as running_cost_per_first_known_cost from deduped where cost between 240 and 670 window w_ordered as (partition by product_id order by cost_per_first_known_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)), with_dims as (select s.id, s.store_id, s.first_known_cost, s.running_quantity, s.cost_per_first_known_cost, s.running_quantity_bucket, b.city from enriched s left join stores b on s.store_id = b.id) select s.region, s.city as store_city, a.city as inventory_city, count(*) as num_rows, min(a.running_quantity_bucket) as min_running_quantity_bucket, max(a.cost_per_first_known_cost) as max_cost_per_first_known_cost from with_dims a left join stores s on a.store_id = s.id group by s.region, s.city, a.city order by num_rows desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("running_quantity", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("cost_per_first_known_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

ranked = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

joined = (
    ranked
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.cost"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "cost",
        F.first("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_cost"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w3).alias("running_quantity"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("first_known_cost").between(360, 510))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.col("first_known_cost")), 2).alias("cost_per_first_known_cost"),
        F.greatest("running_quantity", "first_known_cost").alias("greatest_running_quantity_first_known_cost"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("cost").between(240, 670))
    .withColumn("running_quantity_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w5))
    .withColumn("running_cost_per_first_known_cost", F.sum("cost_per_first_known_cost").over(w_ordered))
)

with_dims = (

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        MIN(element) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_min_element,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY element DESC NULLS LAST) AS element_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element DESC NULLS LAST) AS element_percent_rank
    FROM flattened
    WHERE effective_from <= '2023-08-01'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element_percent_rank NULLS FIRST) AS element_percent_rank_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element_percent_rank DESC) AS element_percent_rank_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element_percent_rank NULLS LAST) AS element_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY currency_min_element DESC NULLS FIRST) AS currency_min_element_cume_dist
    FROM scored
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CEIL(element_percent_rank_rank) AS element_percent_rank_rank_whole
    FROM scored_price_tiers
    WHERE element_cume_dist <= 0.39
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency_min_element,
        element_cume_dist,
        element_percent_rank,
        element_percent_rank_rank,
        currency_min_element_cume_dist,
        element_percent_rank_rank_whole,
        element_percent_rank_dense_rank - element_percent_rank_rank_whole AS element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE element_percent_rank >= 0.67
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole >= 62 THEN 'High' WHEN element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole >= 12 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole_level
    FROM base
    WHERE element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole >= 29
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    plan,
    CASE WHEN element_percent_rank >= 0.63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS element_percent_rank_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(element_cume_dist, 0.5) AS element_cume_dist_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(element_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_element_cume_dist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY ROUND(AVG(element_cume_dist), 2) DESC) AS avg_element_cume_dist_rank
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY plan, element_percent_rank_tier
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT plan) < 1000;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element_percent_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_percent_rank").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element_percent_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_min_element").desc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("avg_element_cume_dist").desc())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("tier_prices").alias("element"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") <= "2023-08-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        F.min("element").over(w).alias("currency_min_element"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("element_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("element_percent_rank"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select("*", F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("element_percent_rank_dense_rank"))
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("element_percent_rank_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("element_percent_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w7).alias("currency_min_element_cume_dist"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("element_cume_dist") <= 0.39)
    .withColumn("element_percent_rank_rank_whole", F.ceil("element_percent_rank_rank"))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("element_percent_rank") >= 0.67)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency_min_element",
        "element_cume_dist",
        "element_percent_rank",
        "element_percent_rank_rank",
        "currency_min_element_cume_dist",
        "element_percent_rank_rank_whole",
        (F.col("element_percent_rank_dense_rank") - F.col("element_percent_rank_rank_whole")).alias("element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole") >= 29)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole") >= 62, "High").when(F.col("element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole") >= 12, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("element_percent_rank_dense_rank_minus_element_percent_rank_rank_whole_level"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        "plan",
        F.when(F.col("element_percent_rank") >= 0.63, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("element_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("element_cume_dist", 0.5).alias("element_cume_dist_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("element_cume_dist"), 2).alias("avg_element_cume_dist"),
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_plans") < 1000)
    .withColumn("avg_element_cume_dist_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        TRIM(country) clean_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TO_DATE('2023-04-05')
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
eligible_sessions AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.session_id = 22
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_sessions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    browser,
    COUNT_IF(device = 'tablet') AS tablet_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_rows,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(started_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(started_at))) / 60 AS duration_min
FROM deduped
GROUP BY browser
ORDER BY tablet_events NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("started_at") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-05")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.trim("country").alias("clean_country"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") >= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

eligible_sessions = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.session_id") == 22), "left_anti")
)

deduped = (
    eligible_sessions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("browser")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("device") == "tablet").alias("tablet_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", 1)).alias("firefox_rows"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("started_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("started_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("tablet_events").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH parsed AS (

    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,

    ROUND(AVG(duration_sec), 2) AS avg_duration_sec
FROM parsed

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS key, attr_value
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value,
        ROUND(status_code, 0) AS status_code_rounded,
        HOUR(log_ts) AS log_ts_hour,
        COALESCE(key, 'N/A') AS key_clean
    FROM flattened
    WHERE log_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 11:00:00')
      AND log_ts < '2025-07-10'
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        latency_ms / NULLIF(log_ts_hour, 0) AS latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour,
        COALESCE(key, 'UNKNOWN') AS key_filled
    FROM base
    WHERE service = 'auth'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        status_code_rounded,
        log_ts_hour,
        latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour,
        key_filled,
        UPPER(host) AS host_upper
    FROM valid
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
base_app_logs AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        service,
        status_code_rounded,
        latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour,
        key_filled,
        COALESCE(latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour, 0) AS latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled,
        CONCAT_WS('-', service, key) AS service_key_key,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') AS key_filled_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
      AND latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour > 75
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        service,
        latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour,
        key_filled,
        service_key_key,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank
    FROM base_app_logs
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        service,
        key_filled,
        service_key_key,
        latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank,
        SUM(latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank) OVER w_ordered AS service_sum_latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank,
        SUM(latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour) OVER w_ordered AS service_sum_latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour
    FROM metrics
    WHERE latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank <= 7
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY service)
)
SELECT
    service,
    key_filled,
    latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank,
    service_sum_latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour,
    CASE WHEN service RLIKE '^(auth|billing)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS service_zone
FROM enriched
ORDER BY latency_ms_per_log_ts_hour_filled_rank NULLS FIRST

        *,
        age + credit_limit age_plus_credit_limit,
        CASE WHEN is_active THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END is_active_label
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-04-04'
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Bangkok'

with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        age_plus_credit_limit,
        is_active_label,
        MIN(age) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city) country_min_age,
        SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_credit_limit
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE country = 'UK'
),
cleaned_customers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        signup_date,
        country_min_age,
        cumulative_credit_limit,
        CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_new_york,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') city_filled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chiang Mai'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        country,
        country_min_age,
        cumulative_credit_limit,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_recent cumulative_credit_limit_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY is_new_york DESC NULLS LAST) is_new_york_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned_customers
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY cumulative_credit_limit ASC NULLS LAST)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    country,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM enriched
GROUP BY country;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        COALESCE(amount, 0) AS amount_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-10-26 12:00:00'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(status) AS status_lower,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 3) AS status_prefix
    FROM valid
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method, order_id ORDER BY amount ASC, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY dedup_rank ASC, id ASC) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
latest_payments AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount DESC, id ASC) AS row_num_2
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY row_num_2 = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        method,
        status,
        amount
    FROM latest_payments
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(amount) AS value_sum,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR status IN ('REFUNDED' AS refunded, 'SUCCESS' AS success)
)

      AND status IS NOT NULL

eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time >= '2025-09-01'
        )

valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        adjusted_balance,
        CASE WHEN balance >= 59000 THEN 'High' WHEN balance >= 6000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END balance_band,
        ROUND(adjusted_balance * 100, 2) adjusted_balance_adjusted
    FROM eligible
    WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2023-03-05'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        adjusted_balance,
        adjusted_balance_adjusted,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_balance,
        SUM(adjusted_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_adjusted_balance,
        FIRST_VALUE(adjusted_balance, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY adjusted_balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_adjusted_balance,
        SUM(adjusted_balance_adjusted) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_adjusted_balance_adjusted,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY adjusted_balance NULLS FIRST) adjusted_balance_rank
    FROM valid
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),
base_accounts AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LEAST(adjusted_balance_adjusted, balance) least_adjusted_balance_adjusted_balance
    FROM enriched
    WHERE opened_date >= TO_DATE('2023-09-08')
      AND first_known_adjusted_balance <= 25
),
valid_accounts AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults

        id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        adjusted_balance,
        adjusted_balance_adjusted,
        running_balance,
        running_adjusted_balance,
        cumulative_adjusted_balance_adjusted,
        adjusted_balance_rank,
        least_adjusted_balance_adjusted_balance,
        adjusted_balance + adjusted_balance_adjusted adjusted_balance_plus_adjusted_balance_adjusted
    FROM base_accounts
    WHERE adjusted_balance < 40
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_accounts s
    WHERE EXISTS (

    adjusted_balance_adjusted,
    running_balance,
    cumulative_adjusted_balance_adjusted,
    least_adjusted_balance_adjusted_balance,
    adjusted_balance_plus_adjusted_balance_adjusted
FROM not_flagged
ORDER BY opened_date;

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, attr_value
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY log_ts DESC) AS latest_rank
        FROM flattened
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN log_ts - LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts, id, key) > INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM deduped
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,
        attr_value,
        latest_rank,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(island_id) OVER w_hist AS next_island_id,
        LAG(island_id) OVER w_hist AS prev_island_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq
    FROM sessionized
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latest_rank, id, key)
),
deduped_app_logs AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key, level ORDER BY next_island_id, id, key) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    host,
    level,
    key,
    latest_rank,
    island_id,
    next_island_id,
    row_seq,
    CASE WHEN key RLIKE '^(trace|version)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN key RLIKE '^(region)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS key_zone
FROM deduped_app_logs;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        ABS(balance) AS abs_balance,
        COALESCE(status, 'DIRECT') AS status_filled
    FROM accounts
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-04-15'
      AND status IS NOT NULL
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM cleaned src
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND src.opened_date >= sub.start_date
       AND src.opened_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND HOUR(ch.txn_time) BETWEEN 7 AND 13
        )
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.txn_time >= s.opened_date
        )
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.txn_type = 'REFUND'
        )
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    abs_balance,
    status_filled,
    subscription_id,
    plan,
    LEAD(monthly_fee, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance, id, subscription_id) AS next_monthly_fee,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY abs_balance DESC, id, subscription_id) AS row_seq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY balance DESC, id, subscription_id) AS row_seq_2,
    NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance DESC, id, subscription_id) AS balance_bucket,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY monthly_fee, id, subscription_id) AS monthly_fee_bucket
FROM eligible
