WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, GREATEST(status_bits, temp_c) AS greatest_status_bits_temp_c
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE pressure > 993
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE humidity <= 62
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.device_code = k.device_code
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_dv_01
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 01:00:00'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        greatest_status_bits_temp_c,
        is_dv_01,
        MAX(greatest_status_bits_temp_c) OVER w_part AS device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pressure_sum_2h,
        AVG(pressure) OVER w_part AS device_code_avg_pressure,
        ROUND(humidity / SUM(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code), 4) AS humidity_share,
        COUNT(pressure) OVER w_running AS pressure_count_2h
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY device_code), w_running AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c >= 79 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c_tier,
    CASE WHEN humidity >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS humidity_tier,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    ROUND(AVG(is_dv_01), 2) AS avg_is_dv_01,
    COUNT(DISTINCT firmware) AS distinct_firmwares,
    STDDEV_SAMP(temp_c) AS temp_c_stddev,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c), 2) AS avg_temp_c,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(temp_c, 0.9) AS temp_c_p90
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c >= 79 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN humidity >= 81 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY avg_is_dv_01 DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("pressure") > 993)
    .withColumn("greatest_status_bits_temp_c", F.greatest("status_bits", "temp_c"))
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("id", "device_code")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("humidity") <= 62)
        .select("id", "device_code")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 01:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_dv_01"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "greatest_status_bits_temp_c",
        "is_dv_01",
        F.max("greatest_status_bits_temp_c").over(w_part).alias("device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c"),
        F.sum("pressure").over(w2).alias("pressure_sum_2h"),
        F.avg("pressure").over(w_part).alias("device_code_avg_pressure"),
        F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(w_part)), 4).alias("humidity_share"),
        F.count("pressure").over(w_running).alias("pressure_count_2h"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c") >= 79, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("device_code_max_greatest_status_bits_temp_c_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("humidity") >= 81, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("humidity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.round(F.avg("is_dv_01"), 2).alias("avg_is_dv_01"),
        F.countDistinct("firmware").alias("distinct_firmwares"),
        F.stddev_samp("temp_c").alias("temp_c_stddev"),
        F.round(F.avg("temp_c"), 2).alias("avg_temp_c"),
        F.percentile_approx("temp_c", 0.9).alias("temp_c_p90"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_is_dv_01").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SPLIT(LOWER(email), '@')[0] AS email_user,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS resolved_city
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment IS DISTINCT FROM 'Consumer'
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date <= s.signup_date
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        email_user,
        resolved_city
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY age DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM eligible
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching session per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.session_device
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.device AS session_device
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.started_at <= s.signup_date
            ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching account per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.name,
        s.segment,
        s.email_user,
        s.resolved_city,
        x.account_type,
        x.account_status
    FROM with_latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.account_type, c.status AS account_status
            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.balance DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    segment,
    resolved_city,
    account_type,
    account_status
FROM latest_match
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 10;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        country,
        segment,
        is_active,
        age,
        CAST(credit_limit AS INT) AS credit_limit_int,
        COALESCE(city, 'UNKNOWN') AS city_clean
    FROM customers
    WHERE email NOT LIKE '%@mail.co.th'
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching session per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.email,
        s.is_active,
        s.age,
        s.city_clean,
        x.session_browser
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.browser AS session_browser
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'RETURNED', 'SHIPPED')
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        is_active,
        city_clean,
        AVG(age) OVER w_running AS age_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY session_browser ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_age,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY session_browser ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC) AS age_bucket
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE session_browser = 'Chrome'
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY session_browser ORDER BY age ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
not_flagged_customers AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.customer_id IS NOT NULL
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM not_flagged_customers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date >= '2023-10-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged_customers s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    email,
    city_clean,
    age_avg_6_prior,
    running_age
FROM verified
ORDER BY running_age DESC

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS key, attr_value
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY latency_ms DESC) latency_ms_percent_rank,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) latency_ms_share,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level, key ORDER BY latency_ms) latency_ms_percent_rank_2
    FROM flattened
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_share DESC) latency_ms_share_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_percent_rank) latency_ms_percent_rank_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms_percent_rank_2 NULLS LAST) latency_ms_percent_rank_2_dense_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE key <> 'version'
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(key) key_length,
        UPPER(level) level_upper,
        COALESCE(key, 'OTHER') resolved_key
    FROM scored
    WHERE latency_ms_percent_rank_2_dense_rank >= 5
),
cleaned_app_logs AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN host IN ('h4', 'h3') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END host_group,
        COALESCE(key, 'N/A') resolved_key_2
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value,
        latency_ms_share_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_percent_rank_rank,
        resolved_key,
        STDDEV_SAMP(latency_ms_percent_rank_2_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY host, key) host_stddev_samp_latency_ms_percent_rank_2_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY key_length DESC) key_length_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key, host ORDER BY key_length DESC NULLS FIRST) key_length_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned_app_logs
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        level,
        key_length_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_share_cume_dist
    FROM metrics

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        job_title,
        level,
        FIRST_VALUE(level) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_level,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id), 4) AS salary_share,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, manager_id), 4) AS salary_share_2
    FROM employees
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        job_title,
        first_known_level,
        salary_share,
        salary_share_2,
        TRIM(job_title) AS clean_job_title,
        COALESCE(level, 'DIRECT') AS level_filled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows_employees AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(salary_share) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_share, id) AS next_salary_share,
        LAG(salary_share) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_share, id) AS prev_salary_share,
        LAG(salary_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_share, id) AS prev_salary_share_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary_share, id) AS row_seq
    FROM filtered
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_salary_share, id) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows_employees
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(row_num) AS row_num_whole,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'OTHER') AS resolved_job_title
    FROM latest
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(prev_salary_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_salary_share_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_salary_share_2_avg_5,
        ROUND(row_seq / SUM(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) AS row_seq_share,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_salary_share, id) AS prev_salary_share_bucket,
        AVG(prev_salary_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY row_num_whole, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior,
        LAG(prev_salary_share_2, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_salary_share_2, id) AS prev_prev_salary_share_2
    FROM base
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_salary_share_bucket >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_salary_share_bucket_tier,
        CASE WHEN prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior_tier,
        job_title,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list,
        ROUND(AVG(row_seq), 2) AS avg_row_seq,
        AVG(prev_salary_share_2) AS avg_prev_salary_share_2
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN prev_salary_share_bucket >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, job_title)
    HAVING avg_prev_salary_share_2 > 0
)
SELECT
    prev_salary_share_bucket_tier,
    prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior_tier,
    job_title,
    job_title_list,
    CASE WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Intern|Designer)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS job_title_zone
FROM stats
ORDER BY prev_salary_share_2_avg_3_prior_tier NULLS LAST

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        initcap(trim(supplier_name)) as supplier_name_title,
        coalesce(city, 'OTHER') as city_clean
    from suppliers
    where country = 'US'
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        count(rating) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_rating,
        min(rating) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_min_rating,
        avg(rating) over (partition by city order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_rating
    from base
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select city, id
    from scored
    intersect
    select city, id
    from suppliers
    where city = 'Bangkok'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.city = k.city and s.id = k.id
),
scored_suppliers as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        round(rating / sum(rating) over (partition by country, city), 4) as rating_share,
        cume_dist() over w_part as running_avg_rating_cume_dist
    from reconciled
    where country = 'TH'
    window w_part as (partition by city order by running_avg_rating desc)
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        round(running_count_rating / sum(running_count_rating) over (partition by country, city), 4) as running_count_rating_share,
        stddev_samp(rating) over w_hist as city_stddev_samp_rating,
        dense_rank() over (order by running_min_rating nulls first) as running_min_rating_dense_rank,
        rank() over (partition by country order by rating desc nulls first) as rating_rank,
        max(running_avg_rating_cume_dist) over w_recent as country_max_running_avg_rating_cume_dist
    from scored_suppliers
    window w_hist as (partition by city), w_recent as (partition by country)
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and c.supplier_id = 28
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    case when rating_share >= 0.61 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as rating_share_tier,
    case when rating >= 3.8 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as rating_tier,
    approx_percentile(rating, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as rating_quartiles,
    min(running_min_rating_dense_rank) as min_running_min_rating_dense_rank,
    avg(running_avg_rating_cume_dist) filter (where city = 'Tokyo') as tokyo_avg_running_avg_rating_cume_dist,
    avg(rating_rank) as avg_rating_rank,
    count_if(country = 'US') as us_events,
    percentile_approx(running_avg_rating_cume_dist, 0.5) as running_avg_rating_cume_dist_p50,
    dense_rank() over (partition by case when rating_share >= 0.61 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end order by avg(running_avg_rating_cume_dist) filter (where city = 'Tokyo') desc) as tokyo_avg_running_avg_rating_cume_dist_dense_rank
from kept
group by case when rating_share >= 0.61 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, case when rating >= 3.8 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by rating_tier nulls last;

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "US")
    .select(

        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",

    .select("s.*")
)

        F.avg("rating_rank").alias("avg_rating_rank"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.orderBy("is_page_view", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc())

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & F.col("session_id").isin([4, 9, 24, 37]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("event_type") == "page_view", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_page_view"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_gaps = (
    latest
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w2).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w2) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w3))

scored = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("is_page_view") <= 78)
    .withColumn("burst_id_avg_5", F.avg("burst_id").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("is_page_view_avg_7d", F.avg("is_page_view").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("duration_sec_avg_6", F.avg("duration_sec").over(w6))
    .withColumn("burst_id_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w7))
)

stats = (

    .groupBy(

        "burst_id",

    .agg(

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(discount_pct, 2) AS discount_pct_rounded,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS channel_filled
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct_rounded DESC, id) AS discount_pct_rounded_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS seq_no
    FROM base
    WHERE ends_on BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2025-04-01'
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        seq_no * discount_pct AS seq_no_times_discount_pct,
        seq_no - discount_pct_rounded_bucket AS seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct_rounded_bucket DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
deduped_promotions AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct_rounded_bucket DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket >= 69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket_tier,
    CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS seq_no_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS num_channels,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS channel_list,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no_times_discount_pct), 2) AS avg_seq_no_times_discount_pct,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS distinct_channels,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM deduped_promotions
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket >= 69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (CASE WHEN seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket >= 69 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END))

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_rounded").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_rounded_bucket").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("discount_pct_rounded", F.round("discount_pct", 2))
    .withColumn("channel_filled", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("ends_on").between("2023-08-01", "2025-04-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("discount_pct_rounded_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("seq_no_times_discount_pct", (F.col("seq_no") * F.col("discount_pct")))
    .withColumn("seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket", (F.col("seq_no") - F.col("discount_pct_rounded_bucket")))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

deduped_promotions = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped_promotions
    .withColumn("seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket_tier", F.when(F.col("seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket") >= 69, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("seq_no_tier", F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket_tier", "seq_no_tier"], ["seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket_tier"]],
        "seq_no_minus_discount_pct_rounded_bucket_tier",
        "seq_no_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.round(F.avg("seq_no_times_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_seq_no_times_discount_pct"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.countDistinct("channel").alias("distinct_channels"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

WITH metrics_long AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        kpi,
        reading
    FROM (
        SELECT
            id,
            category,
            cost,
            price
        FROM products
    ) src
    UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
        reading FOR kpi IN (cost, price)
    ) long_rows
)
SELECT
    kpi,
    CASE WHEN reading >= 71 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS reading_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'Fashion' THEN 1 END) AS fashion_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(kpi)) AS kpi_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN kpi = 'cost' THEN reading ELSE 0 END) AS cost_reading,
    COUNT_IF(kpi = 'cost') AS cost_events,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY kpi ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT id) DESC) AS distinct_ids_rank
FROM metrics_long
GROUP BY kpi, CASE WHEN reading >= 71 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY num_rows DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.carrier,
        a.delivered_date,
        a.status,
        d.shipping_fee
    FROM shipments a
    INNER JOIN orders d
        ON a.order_id <=> d.id
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, carrier
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT status, carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date > '2025-04-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.carrier = k.carrier
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.order_id,
        a.carrier,
        a.delivered_date,
        a.shipping_fee,
        o.status AS order_status,
        o.channel
    FROM reconciled a
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON a.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.amount BETWEEN 430 AND 870
),
enriched_shipments_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        order_id,
        order_status,
        channel,
        MIN(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS order_status_min_shipping_fee,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS shipping_fee_cume_dist
    FROM enriched_shipments
)
SELECT
    order_status,
    order_status_min_shipping_fee,
    shipping_fee_cume_dist
FROM enriched_shipments_2
ORDER BY order_status_min_shipping_fee NULLS FIRST, shipping_fee_cume_dist;

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(coupon_codes) AS tag
    FROM carts
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        TO_DATE(created_at) AS created_at_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS created_at_period
    FROM lines
    WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 17:00:00'
      AND tag IN ('VIP', 'WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE')
),
cleaned_carts AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        tag,
        created_at_date,
        created_at_period,
        ADD_MONTHS(created_at_date, 6) AS created_at_date_plus_months,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', created_at_period) AS created_at_period_period
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        c.city,
        c.credit_limit,
        c.name
    FROM cleaned_carts src
    INNER JOIN customers c
        ON src.customer_id = c.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at_date,
        created_at_period,
        created_at_date_plus_months,
        created_at_period_period,
        ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS credit_limit_share,
        MIN(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY tag, city) AS tag_min_credit_limit
    FROM joined
),

with filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        quantity * unit_price as line_total,
        round(quantity / unit_price, 2) as line_total_2
    from order_items
    where unit_price < 180
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        line_total_2,
        dense_rank() over (partition by order_id order by unit_price desc nulls last) as unit_price_dense_rank,
        ntile(4) over (partition by order_id order by line_total desc, id) as line_total_bucket
    from filtered
    where quantity <= 3
),
metrics_order_items as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        line_total_bucket,
        avg(line_total_2) over (order by unit_price_dense_rank, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_avg_line_total_2,
        min(line_total_2) over (order by unit_price_dense_rank, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_min_line_total_2,
        sum(line_total_2) over (order by unit_price_dense_rank, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_sum_line_total_2,
        max(line_total_2) over (order by unit_price_dense_rank, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_max_line_total_2
    from metrics
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (order by last3_sum_line_total_2 nulls last) as last3_sum_line_total_2_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by last3_avg_line_total_2 desc) as last3_avg_line_total_2_cume_dist,
        last_value(quantity) ignore nulls over w_part as last_known_quantity
    from metrics_order_items
    window w_part as (order by line_total_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        line_total_bucket,
        last3_avg_line_total_2,
        last3_min_line_total_2,
        last3_sum_line_total_2,
        last3_max_line_total_2,
        last3_sum_line_total_2_dense_rank,
        last3_avg_line_total_2_cume_dist,
        last_known_quantity,
        case when last_known_quantity >= 9 then 'High' when last_known_quantity >= 4 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as last_known_quantity_level
    from scored
    where last3_avg_line_total_2 between 24 and 43
)

    line_total_bucket,
    last3_avg_line_total_2,
    last3_min_line_total_2,
    last3_sum_line_total_2,
    last3_sum_line_total_2_dense_rank,
    last_known_quantity
from valid
order by id desc;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) days_start_date_to_end_date,
        DATE_FORMAT(end_date, 'yyyy-MM') end_date_label
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2025-06-01'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date BETWEEN '2024-05-01' AND '2025-09-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
),
filtered_subscriptions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        days_start_date_to_end_date,
        end_date_label,
        LENGTH(plan) plan_length
    FROM verified
    WHERE days_start_date_to_end_date >= 33
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        days_start_date_to_end_date,
        end_date_label,
        plan_length,
        COALESCE(monthly_fee, 0) monthly_fee_filled
    FROM filtered_subscriptions
    WHERE monthly_fee > 120
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) monthly_fee_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist monthly_fee_dense_rank
    FROM valid
    WHERE plan = 'basic'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY monthly_fee NULLS LAST)
)

    AVG(s.monthly_fee_share) AS avg_monthly_fee_share,
    MAX(s.plan_length) AS max_plan_length,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM scored s

GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.country, s.plan), (d.country))

WITH flattened_attrs AS (

    SUM(avg_tier_price) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY effective_from, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_tier_price
FROM flattened_attrs

with enriched as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        src.*,
        p.cost,
        p.stock_qty,
        p.launch_date
    from store_sales src
    left join products p
        on src.product_id = p.id
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select product_id, store_id
    from enriched
    intersect all
    select product_id, store_id
    from store_sales
    where product_id in (2, 9)
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.product_id = k.product_id and s.store_id = k.store_id
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        units,
        revenue,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        dense_rank() over w_recent as stock_qty_dense_rank
    from kept_rows
    window w_recent as (partition by store_id, product_id order by stock_qty nulls last)
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        launch_date,
        stock_qty_dense_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by units desc nulls last) as units_dense_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by stock_qty_dense_rank desc nulls last) as stock_qty_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by stock_qty_dense_rank desc) as stock_qty_dense_rank_dense_rank
    from metrics
),
enriched_store_sales as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        stock_qty_dense_rank,
        stock_qty_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        stock_qty_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        rank() over (order by units_dense_rank nulls last) as units_dense_rank_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by stock_qty_dense_rank_percent_rank desc nulls last) as stock_qty_dense_rank_percent_rank_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by stock_qty_dense_rank desc nulls last) as stock_qty_dense_rank_cume_dist
    from scored
    where stock_qty_dense_rank <= 5
)
select
    stock_qty_dense_rank,
    stock_qty_dense_rank_dense_rank,
    units_dense_rank_rank,
    stock_qty_dense_rank_percent_rank_dense_rank,
    stock_qty_dense_rank_cume_dist
from enriched_store_sales
order by stock_qty_dense_rank_dense_rank nulls first;

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sqft,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 4) AS sqft_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(region) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_region,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_sum_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft, id) AS event_seq,
        ROUND(sqft / SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS sqft_share_2
    FROM stores
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(sqft_share) OVER w_ordered AS last7_avg_sqft_share,
        MIN(sqft_share) OVER w_ordered AS last7_min_sqft_share,
        MAX(sqft_share) OVER w_ordered AS last7_max_sqft_share
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sqft,
        sqft_share,
        first_known_region,
        region_sum_sqft,
        event_seq,
        last7_avg_sqft_share,
        LEAST(sqft_share_2, region_sum_sqft) AS least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft,
        GREATEST(last7_min_sqft_share, region_sum_sqft) AS greatest_last7_min_sqft_share_region_sum_sqft
    FROM metrics
    WHERE sqft_share_2 IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sqft,
        region_sum_sqft,
        event_seq,
        last7_avg_sqft_share,
        least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft,
        greatest_last7_min_sqft_share_region_sum_sqft,
        ROUND(last7_avg_sqft_share, 1) AS last7_avg_sqft_share_rounded
    FROM base
    WHERE least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft < 36
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.store_id IN (4, 5, 6)
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT s.*, top1.store_sale_sale_date
    FROM eligible s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.sale_date AS store_sale_sale_date
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date <= s.store_sale_sale_date
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    sqft,
    region_sum_sqft,
    event_seq,
    last7_avg_sqft_share,
    least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft,
    store_sale_sale_date
FROM not_flagged
ORDER BY sqft NULLS FIRST, region_sum_sqft;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("region")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("sqft", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.sale_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

enriched = (
    df_stores
    .select(
        "id",
        "sqft",
        F.round((F.col("sqft") / F.sum("sqft").over(w)), 4).alias("sqft_share"),
        F.first("region", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_region"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w).alias("region_sum_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("sqft") / F.sum("sqft").over(w4)), 4).alias("sqft_share_2"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("sqft_share").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_avg_sqft_share"),
        F.min("sqft_share").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_min_sqft_share"),
        F.max("sqft_share").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_max_sqft_share"),
    )
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("sqft_share_2").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "sqft",
        "sqft_share",
        "first_known_region",
        "region_sum_sqft",
        "event_seq",
        "last7_avg_sqft_share",
        F.least("sqft_share_2", "region_sum_sqft").alias("least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft"),
        F.greatest("last7_min_sqft_share", "region_sum_sqft").alias("greatest_last7_min_sqft_share_region_sum_sqft"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft") < 36)
    .select(
        "id",
        "sqft",
        "region_sum_sqft",
        "event_seq",
        "last7_avg_sqft_share",
        "least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft",
        "greatest_last7_min_sqft_share_region_sum_sqft",
        F.round("last7_avg_sqft_share", 1).alias("last7_avg_sqft_share_rounded"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.store_id").isin([4, 5, 6])), "left_anti")
)

latest_match = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.sale_date").alias("store_sale_sale_date"))
)

not_flagged = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.order_date") <= F.col("s.store_sale_sale_date")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "sqft",
        "region_sum_sqft",
        "event_seq",
        "last7_avg_sqft_share",
        "least_sqft_share_2_region_sum_sqft",
        "store_sale_sale_date",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("sqft").asc_nulls_first(), "region_sum_sqft")
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        SUBSTRING(promo_code, 1, 3) AS promo_code_prefix,
        UPPER(channel) AS channel_upper
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'store'
),
valid_promotions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_code_prefix,
        channel_upper,
        CASE WHEN promo_code = 'BUNDLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_bundle
    FROM valid
    WHERE starts_on >= DATE '2023-05-20'
      AND channel != 'store'
),
valid_promotions_2 AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN promo_code IN ('SPRING10', 'BUNDLE') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS promo_code_group,
        FLOOR(is_bundle) AS is_bundle_whole,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS resolved_channel
    FROM valid_promotions
    WHERE promo_code IN ('WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE', 'VIP')
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM valid_promotions_2 src
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel = pr.channel
       AND src.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND src.starts_on <= DATE_ADD(pr.ends_on, 3)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        channel,
        promo_code,
        is_bundle_whole
    FROM with_window
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(is_bundle_whole)
    FOR promo_code IN ('VIP', 'BUNDLE')
);

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        ROUND(amount, 2) AS amount_rounded,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS method_clean
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > DATE '2023-08-12'
      AND order_id = 16
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS last_known_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount_rounded DESC NULLS LAST) AS amount_rounded_dense_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_amount_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE TO_DATE(paid_at) >= '2024-12-28'
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched_payments AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.shipping_fee,
        p.status AS order_status
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id <=> p.id
),
enriched_payments_2 AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.amount,
        s.paid_at,
        s.status,
        s.amount_rounded,
        s.last_known_amount,
        s.last_known_amount_2,
        s.shipping_fee,
        o.channel,
        o.shipping_fee AS order_shipping_fee
    FROM enriched_payments s
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON s.order_id = o.id
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM enriched_payments_2
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.discount,
        d.shipping_fee AS order_shipping_fee_2,
        d.status AS order_status
    FROM sessions_payments src

    s.status,
    s.discount,
    s.order_shipping_fee_2,
    (SELECT SUM(x.amount) FROM payments x WHERE x.order_id = s.order_id) AS sum_payment_amount
FROM with_dims_payments s;

with valid as (
    select *, concat_ws('-', supplier_name, country) supplier_name_country_key
    from suppliers
    where city is not distinct from 'Tokyo'
),
latest_match as (
    select
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.supplier_name_country_key,
        top1.product_stock_qty
    from valid s
    left join lateral (
            select c.stock_qty as product_stock_qty
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.stock_qty desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
not_flagged as (
    select s.*
    from latest_match s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products x
            where x.supplier_id = s.id
              and x.stock_qty < 144
        )
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        lead(product_stock_qty, 1) over w_hist next_product_stock_qty,
        row_number() over (order by product_stock_qty desc, id) seq_no,
        row_number() over w_hist row_seq,
        cume_dist() over (order by product_stock_qty desc nulls last) product_stock_qty_cume_dist,
        avg(product_stock_qty) over (order by product_stock_qty, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior
    from not_flagged
    window w_hist as (order by product_stock_qty, id)
)
select
    seq_no,
    case when next_product_stock_qty >= 331 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as next_product_stock_qty_tier,
    case when row_seq >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as row_seq_tier,
    sum(product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior) as total_product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior,
    min(product_stock_qty) as min_product_stock_qty,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids
from with_windows
group by seq_no, case when next_product_stock_qty >= 331 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when row_seq >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
order by distinct_ids desc
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.stock_qty").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w_hist = Window.orderBy("product_stock_qty", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_stock_qty").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_stock_qty").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy("product_stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Tokyo")))
    .withColumn("supplier_name_country_key", F.concat_ws("-", "supplier_name", "country"))
)

latest_match = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.supplier_name",
        "s.supplier_name_country_key",
        F.col("c.stock_qty").alias("product_stock_qty"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.stock_qty") < 144), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("product_stock_qty", 1).over(w_hist).alias("next_product_stock_qty"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("row_seq"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("product_stock_qty_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("product_stock_qty").over(w5).alias("product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        "seq_no",
        F.when(F.col("next_product_stock_qty") >= 331, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_product_stock_qty_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("row_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior").alias("total_product_stock_qty_avg_5_prior"),
        F.min("product_stock_qty").alias("min_product_stock_qty"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS started_at_period,
        CONCAT_WS('/', device, country) AS device_country_key,
        COALESCE(browser, 'NONE') AS browser_filled
    FROM sessions
    WHERE browser IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chrome'
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.web_event_duration_sec
    FROM valid s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.duration_sec AS web_event_duration_sec
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        started_at_period,
        device_country_key,
        browser_filled,
        web_event_duration_sec,
        CASE WHEN device IN ('tablet', 'desktop') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS device_group
    FROM with_last
    WHERE web_event_duration_sec = 286
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at_period) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at_period, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at_period > LAG(started_at_period) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at_period, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM cleaned
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT country, browser
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT
    SELECT country, browser
    FROM sessions
    WHERE device NOT IN ('mobile', 'desktop')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.country = k.country AND s.browser = k.browser
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        started_at_period,
        device_country_key,
        web_event_duration_sec,
        device_group,
        is_new_session,
        session_no,
        COALESCE(country, 'N/A') AS country_filled,
        LENGTH(browser) AS browser_length,
        COALESCE(country, 'NONE') AS country_clean
    FROM verified
    WHERE session_no = 8
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time < s.started_at
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    device,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at_period) AS quarter_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT device) AS distinct_devices
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((device, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at_period)), (device), ())
code:

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.event_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at_period", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(~F.col("browser").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Chrome")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.date_trunc("month", "started_at").alias("started_at_period"),
        F.concat_ws("/", "device", "country").alias("device_country_key"),
        F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("NONE")).alias("browser_filled"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.duration_sec").alias("web_event_duration_sec"))
)

cleaned = (
    with_last
    .filter(F.col("web_event_duration_sec") == 286)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "started_at_period",
        "device_country_key",
        "browser_filled",
        "web_event_duration_sec",
        F.when(F.col("device").isin(["tablet", "desktop"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("device_group"),
    )

gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at_period").over(w2).isNull() | (F.col("started_at_period") > F.lag("started_at_period").over(w2) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w3))

kept_keys = (

    .subtract(
        df_sessions
        .filter(~F.col("device").isin(["mobile", "desktop"]))

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, UPPER(carrier) AS carrier_upper
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_cost,
        MIN(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_cost,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_cost,
        MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status, carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_cost,
        LAG(cost, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS prev_cost
    FROM cleaned
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_count_cost NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.shipped_date,
        s.delivered_date,
        s.carrier_upper,
        s.running_count_cost,
        s.running_min_cost,
        s.prev_cost,
        s.rank_in_group,
        b.discount
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON s.order_id <=> b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier_upper,
        running_count_cost,
        rank_in_group,
        GREATEST(running_min_cost, discount) AS greatest_running_min_cost_discount
    FROM joined
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-02-21'
      AND discount BETWEEN 0.32 AND 0.37
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        greatest_running_min_cost_discount,
        LAG(running_count_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY greatest_running_min_cost_discount, id) AS prev_running_count_cost,
        LAG(greatest_running_min_cost_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY greatest_running_min_cost_discount, id) AS prev_greatest_running_min_cost_discount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY greatest_running_min_cost_discount, id) AS event_seq,
        AVG(running_count_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_count_cost_avg_3_prior
    FROM base
    WHERE order_id = 23
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN greatest_running_min_cost_discount >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS greatest_running_min_cost_discount_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(event_seq, 0.5) AS event_seq_p50,
    MIN(greatest_running_min_cost_discount) AS min_greatest_running_min_cost_discount
FROM enriched_shipments
GROUP BY greatest_running_min_cost_discount_tier;

    window w_ordered as (partition by order_id order by next_next_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_grp as (partition by status)

scored as (

        row_number() over (order by next_cost_2 desc, id) as row_seq_2,
        ntile(4) over (partition by carrier order by next_cost_2 desc, id) as next_cost_2_bucket

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        ROUND(monthly_fee * 1.15, 2) AS monthly_fee_adjusted
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2023-05-04'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share,
        MIN(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status) AS customer_id_min_monthly_fee
    FROM base
    WHERE monthly_fee BETWEEN 70 AND 160
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY customer_id_min_monthly_fee DESC, id) AS row_num
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(customer_id_min_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY row_num, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee_share DESC, id) AS monthly_fee_share_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(monthly_fee_share, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee_share, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_monthly_fee_share
    FROM deduped
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(monthly_fee_share_bucket, 2) AS monthly_fee_share_bucket_rounded,
        ROUND(row_num, 2) AS row_num_rounded
    FROM enriched
    WHERE end_date > DATE '2023-07-31'
      AND monthly_fee < 230
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee >= 1310 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(row_num_rounded, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS row_num_rounded_quartiles,
        MIN(first_known_monthly_fee_share) AS min_first_known_monthly_fee_share,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_count,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'standard') AS standard_events,
        GROUPING(CASE WHEN running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee >= 1310 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS grouping_level
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee >= 1310 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
    HAVING MIN(first_known_monthly_fee_share) < 1000000
)
SELECT
    running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier,
    row_num_rounded_quartiles,
    min_first_known_monthly_fee_share,
    standard_events,
    grouping_level
FROM stats
ORDER BY standard_events DESC NULLS LAST, grouping_level DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("customer_id_min_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_share").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee_share", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-05-04").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") * 1.15), 2).alias("monthly_fee_adjusted"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee").between(70, 160))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w)), 4).alias("monthly_fee_share"),
        F.min("monthly_fee").over(w2).alias("customer_id_min_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("customer_id_min_monthly_fee").over(w4).alias("running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w5).alias("monthly_fee_share_bucket"),
        F.first("monthly_fee_share", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_monthly_fee_share"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-07-31").cast("date")) & (F.col("monthly_fee") < 230))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("monthly_fee_share_bucket", 2).alias("monthly_fee_share_bucket_rounded"),
        F.round("row_num", 2).alias("row_num_rounded"),
    )
)

stats = (
    valid
    .withColumn("running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier", F.when(F.col("running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee") >= 1310, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("row_num_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("row_num_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.min("first_known_monthly_fee_share").alias("min_first_known_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1)).alias("active_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "standard").alias("standard_events"),
        F.grouping("running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_first_known_monthly_fee_share") < 1000000)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "running_customer_id_min_monthly_fee_tier",
        "row_num_rounded_quartiles",
        "min_first_known_monthly_fee_share",
        "standard_events",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("standard_events").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("grouping_level").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        ROUND(quantity * 0.85, 2) AS adjusted_quantity
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-03-13'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY adjusted_quantity DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM cleaned
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.last_restock,
        s.latest_rank,
        b.opened_date
    FROM latest s
    JOIN stores b
        ON s.store_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS quantity_dense_rank,
        COUNT(quantity) OVER w_running AS store_id_count_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        MIN(quantity) OVER w_running AS store_id_min_quantity
    FROM joined
    WHERE latest_rank <> 1
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY store_id)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        s.opened_date AS store_opened_date,
        s.store_name,
        s.city
    FROM enriched a
    LEFT JOIN stores s
        ON a.store_id = s.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY store_id_min_quantity DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN quantity_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS quantity_dense_rank_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock) AS year_start,
    CASE WHEN store_id_count_quantity >= 13 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS store_id_count_quantity_tier,
    MAX(quantity_dense_rank) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_max_quantity_dense_rank,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(quantity, 0.5) AS quantity_p50,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no, 0.95) AS seq_no_p95,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Chiang Mai' THEN store_id_count_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS chiang_mai_store_id_count_quantity,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities
FROM ranked
GROUP BY CASE WHEN quantity_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', last_restock), CASE WHEN store_id_count_quantity >= 13 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY quantity_p50 DESC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("adjusted_quantity").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("latest_rank").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("store_id_min_quantity").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-03-13").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 0.85), 2).alias("adjusted_quantity"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

joined = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.quantity",
        "s.last_restock",
        "s.latest_rank",
        F.col("b.opened_date"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") != 1)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("quantity_dense_rank"),
        F.count("quantity").over(w_running).alias("store_id_count_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no"),
        F.min("quantity").over(w_running).alias("store_id_min_quantity"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("s.opened_date").alias("store_opened_date"),
        F.col("s.store_name"),
        F.col("s.city"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("latest_rank_2", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_2") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank_2")
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("quantity_dense_rank") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("quantity_dense_rank_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "last_restock").alias("year_start"),
        F.when(F.col("store_id_count_quantity") >= 13, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("store_id_count_quantity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", F.col("quantity_dense_rank"))).alias("bangkok_max_quantity_dense_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", 0.5).alias("quantity_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", 0.95).alias("seq_no_p95"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", F.col("store_id_count_quantity")).otherwise(0)).alias("chiang_mai_store_id_count_quantity"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.countDistinct("city").alias("distinct_cities"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_p50").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(discount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_discount,
        LEAD(shipping_fee, 2) OVER (ORDER BY discount, id) AS next_shipping_fee,
        AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_5,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount, id) AS row_seq,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 4) AS amount_share
    FROM orders
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount >= 1320 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date) AS week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS activity_month,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    ROUND(AVG(amount_share), 2) AS avg_amount_share,
    ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS amount_per_mobile,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    MAX(amount_share) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_max_amount_share,
    STDDEV_SAMP(discount) AS discount_stddev,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1320 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) DESC) AS num_status_dense_rank
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 1320 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', order_date), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("amount_tier").orderBy(F.col("num_status").desc())

with_windows = (
    df_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("last_known_discount"),
        F.lead("shipping_fee", 2).over(w2).alias("next_shipping_fee"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w3).alias("amount_avg_5"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w4)), 4).alias("amount_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1320, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date").alias("week_start"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "order_date").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount_share"), 2).alias("avg_amount_share"),
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_mobile"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("amount_share"))).alias("web_max_amount_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("discount").alias("discount_stddev"),
    )
    .withColumn("num_status_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w5))
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        country,
        DATE_FORMAT(started_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS started_at_label
    FROM sessions
    WHERE browser NOT IN ('Chrome', 'Edge', 'Firefox')
      AND started_at >= DATE '2023-05-19'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.country,
        p.city,
        p.name,
        p.age
    FROM cleaned e
    INNER JOIN customers p
        ON e.customer_id = p.id
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time >= '2025-09-13'
        )
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        c.country AS customer_country,
        c.credit_limit,
        c.age AS customer_age
    FROM not_flagged a
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON a.customer_id <=> c.id
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.web_event_event_time
    FROM joined s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_time AS web_event_event_time
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.country,
    s.city,
    s.age,
    s.customer_country,
    s.credit_limit,
    s.customer_age,
    (SELECT AVG(o2.discount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS avg_order_discount
FROM latest_match s
ORDER BY customer_age DESC NULLS LAST, country;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM order_items
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY unit_price) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(unit_price) OVER (ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS unit_price_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(quantity / SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id), 4) AS quantity_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS event_seq,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_min_quantity
    FROM ranked
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        unit_price_avg_3_prior,
        quantity_share,
        event_seq,
        order_id_min_quantity,
        MIN(quantity_share) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_id_min_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_quantity_share,
        AVG(quantity_share) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_id_min_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_quantity_share,
        COUNT(quantity_share) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_id_min_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_quantity_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price_avg_3_prior) AS unit_price_avg_3_prior_cume_dist
    FROM metrics
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_share NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT s.*, p.cost
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_min_quantity_share, 0.9) AS running_min_quantity_share_p90,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS cost_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM with_dims
GROUP BY 1
HAVING PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_min_quantity_share, 0.9) > 0
ORDER BY running_min_quantity_share_p90 NULLS LAST;

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS key, value
)

SELECT
    id,
    level,
    key,
    value,
    ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service, level), 4) AS status_code_share,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_dense_rank,
    SUM(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_sum_15m,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code ASC) AS status_code_percent_rank,
    MAX(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_max_status_code
FROM exploded

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS key, attr_value
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    MAX(log_ts) AS ended_at,
    MAX(log_ts) AS last_log_ts
FROM flattened
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts), DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts)
ORDER BY activity_day NULLS FIRST;

    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
