WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS k, v
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(latency_ms, 1) OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms, id, k) AS next_latency_ms,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY status_code DESC, id, k) AS status_code_bucket
    FROM lines
    WHERE status_code > 271
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN log_ts - LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) > INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM scored
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        status_code_bucket,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM sessionized
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, k ORDER BY log_ts DESC, id, k) = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS num_levels,
        COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS distinct_ks,
        COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS distinct_ks_2
    FROM deduped
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts)
)
SELECT
    activity_day,
    row_count,
    num_levels,
    distinct_ks,
    distinct_ks_2
FROM totals
ORDER BY activity_day DESC, num_levels DESC
LIMIT 5
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "k")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level", "k").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "k")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

scored = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("status_code") > 271)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("latency_ms", 1).over(w).alias("next_latency_ms"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("status_code_bucket"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    scored
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(w3) > F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "status_code_bucket",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w4).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

totals = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("DAY", "log_ts").alias("activity_day"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("log_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("log_ts"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.countDistinct("k").alias("distinct_ks"),
        F.countDistinct("k").alias("distinct_ks_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select("activity_day", "row_count", "num_levels", "distinct_ks", "distinct_ks_2")
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_day").desc(), F.col("num_levels").desc())
    .limit(5)
)

matched_keys AS (

joined AS (

    LEFT JOIN accounts d

        src.account_id,
        src.txn_type,
        src.merchant,
        src.is_flagged,
        b.balance AS account_balance,

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element
    from price_tiers
    lateral view explode(discounts) x as element
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        coalesce(element, 0) element_filled,
        case when element >= 69 then 'High' when element >= 26 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end element_tier
    from exploded
    where effective_from >= to_date('2024-06-20')
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        element_filled,
        element_tier,
        cume_dist() over (order by element desc nulls first) element_cume_dist,
        max(element) over (partition by currency) currency_max_element,
        percent_rank() over (order by element_filled) element_filled_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (partition by currency order by element_filled nulls last) element_filled_dense_rank
    from valid
    where year(effective_from) = 2025
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, element_cume_dist / nullif(element_filled, 0) element_cume_dist_per_element_filled
    from with_windows
    where currency_max_element > 42
),
summary as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when element_filled >= 83 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as element_filled_tier,
        case when element_filled_dense_rank >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as element_filled_dense_rank_tier,
        percentile_approx(element_filled_percent_rank, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as element_filled_percent_rank_quartiles,
        sum(element_filled_percent_rank) as total_element_filled_percent_rank,
        approx_percentile(element_filled, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as element_filled_quartiles,
        sum(element_cume_dist_per_element_filled) as total_element_cume_dist_per_element_filled,
        count(*) as event_count
    from filtered
    group by rollup (case when element_filled >= 83 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when element_filled_dense_rank >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
)
select
    element_filled_tier,
    element_filled_dense_rank_tier,
    element_filled_percent_rank_quartiles,
    total_element_cume_dist_per_element_filled,
    event_count
from summary

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w3 = Window.orderBy("element_filled")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element_filled").asc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("element"))
)

valid = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2024-06-20")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("element", F.lit(0)).alias("element_filled"),
        F.when(F.col("element") >= 69, "High").when(F.col("element") >= 26, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("element_tier"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.year("effective_from") == 2025)
    .select(
        "id",
        "element_filled",
        "element_tier",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("element_cume_dist"),
        F.max("element").over(w2).alias("currency_max_element"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("element_filled_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("element_filled_dense_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("currency_max_element") > 42)
    .withColumn("element_cume_dist_per_element_filled", (F.col("element_cume_dist") / F.nullif("element_filled", F.lit(0))))
)

summary = (
    filtered
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("element_filled") >= 83, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("element_filled_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("element_filled_dense_rank") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("element_filled_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("element_filled_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("element_filled_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.sum("element_filled_percent_rank").alias("total_element_filled_percent_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("element_filled", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("element_filled_quartiles"),
        F.sum("element_cume_dist_per_element_filled").alias("total_element_cume_dist_per_element_filled"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "element_filled_tier",
        "element_filled_dense_rank_tier",
        "element_filled_percent_rank_quartiles",
        "total_element_cume_dist_per_element_filled",
        "event_count",
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(city) AS city_upper,
        COALESCE(region, 'DIRECT') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-05-30'
      AND region IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.sale_date < s.opened_date
        )
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM not_flagged
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER w_grp AS next_sqft,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sqft,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sqft_avg_6,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        SUM(sqft) OVER w_running AS cumulative_sqft
    FROM ranked
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id), w_running AS (ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        region,
        city,
        event_seq
    FROM scored
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(event_seq) AS value_sum
    FOR city IN ('Bangkok' AS bangkok, 'Chiang Mai' AS chiang_mai, 'London' AS london)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-05-30").cast("date")) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("city_upper", F.upper("city"))
    .withColumn("region_filled", F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.sale_date") < F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

ranked = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("sqft", 1).over(w_grp).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w3).alias("running_sqft"),
        F.avg("sqft").over(w4).alias("sqft_avg_6"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w_running).alias("cumulative_sqft"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("region")
    .pivot("city", ["Bangkok", "Chiang Mai", "London"])
    .agg(F.avg("event_seq").alias("value_sum"))
    .select(
        "region",
        F.col("Bangkok").alias("bangkok"),
        F.col("Chiang Mai").alias("chiang_mai"),
        F.col("London").alias("london"),
    )
)

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS discount_pct_avg_2_prior,
        LAST_VALUE(channel, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
        MAX(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_max_discount_pct
    FROM promotions
)
SELECT
    channel,
    promo_code,
    CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.3 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_pct_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(promo_code_max_discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promo_code = 'BUNDLE' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS promo_code_max_discount_pct_per_bundle,
    SUM(discount_pct_avg_3_prior) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'partner') AS partner_total_discount_pct_avg_3_prior
FROM scored
GROUP BY CUBE (channel, promo_code, CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.3 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
ORDER BY promo_code DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code")

scored = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("discount_pct_avg_2_prior", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_channel", F.last("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("discount_pct_avg_3_prior", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w3))
    .withColumn("promo_code_max_discount_pct", F.max("discount_pct").over(w4))
)

result = (
    scored
    .cube(
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.3, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("promo_code_max_discount_pct") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "BUNDLE", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("promo_code_max_discount_pct_per_bundle"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "partner", F.col("discount_pct_avg_3_prior"))).alias("partner_total_discount_pct_avg_3_prior"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("promo_code").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue + units AS revenue_per_unit,
        ROUND(revenue * 100, 2) AS adjusted_revenue
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-08-13'
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.city,
        b.opened_date,
        b.sqft
    FROM cleaned src
    JOIN stores b
        ON src.store_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.product_id,
        p.cost
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON a.product_id = p.id
    WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(p.tags, 'sale')
),
enriched_store_sales AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(cost, 2) OVER w_grp AS next_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS row_seq
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY cost, id)
)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    cost
FROM enriched_store_sales
ORDER BY id, cost

WITH long_format AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        measure,
        reading
    FROM (
        SELECT
            id,
            channel,
            shipping_fee,
            amount,
            discount
        FROM orders
    ) src
    UNPIVOT (
        reading FOR measure IN (shipping_fee, amount, discount)
    )
)
SELECT
    channel,
    CASE WHEN reading >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS reading_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN measure = 'discount' THEN reading ELSE 0 END) AS discount_reading,
    ROUND(SUM(reading) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS reading_per_web,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(reading, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS reading_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(reading, 0.9) AS reading_p90
FROM long_format
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING reading_p90 > 0
ORDER BY discount_reading DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

long_format = (
    df_orders
    .select("id", "channel", "shipping_fee", "amount", "discount")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "channel"],
        values=["shipping_fee", "amount", "discount"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)

result = (
    long_format
    .groupBy(
        "channel",
        F.when(F.col("reading") >= 74, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("reading_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("measure") == "discount", F.col("reading")).otherwise(0)).alias("discount_reading"),
        F.round(F.sum("reading") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("reading_per_web"),
        F.percentile_approx("reading", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("reading_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("reading", 0.9).alias("reading_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading_p90") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("discount_reading").desc())
)

WITH with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.product_price,
        top1.product_stock_qty
    FROM suppliers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.price AS product_price, c.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.cost BETWEEN 390 AND 580
        )
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.category IN ('Electronics', 'Grocery')
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM eligible
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(product_stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY dedup_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS product_stock_qty_avg_3,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC) AS rating_cume_dist,
        SUM(product_price) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country) AS city_sum_product_price,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY product_stock_qty, id) AS product_stock_qty_bucket
    FROM latest
    WHERE supplier_name IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY product_price) AS product_price_dense_rank,
        LEAD(product_stock_qty_avg_3, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS next_product_stock_qty_avg_3,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY product_stock_qty, id) AS product_stock_qty_bucket_2
    FROM scored
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN city_sum_product_price >= 5601 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS city_sum_product_price_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END) AS singapore_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'JP') AS jp_rows,
    AVG(product_stock_qty_bucket_2) AS avg_product_stock_qty_bucket_2,
    ROUND(SUM(product_price_dense_rank) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Chiang Mai' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS product_price_dense_rank_per_chiang_mai
FROM enriched
GROUP BY city_sum_product_price_tier
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END) >= 1
ORDER BY avg_product_stock_qty_bucket_2 DESC;

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN account_type IN ('CREDIT', 'LOAN') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS account_type_group,
        SUBSTRING(account_type, 1, 3) AS account_type_prefix
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'OPEN'
      AND status IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_min_balance,
        COUNT(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_balance,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_avg_balance,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type, customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS balance_avg_5_prior
    FROM base
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        opened_date,
        status,
        account_type_prefix,
        last7_count_balance,
        balance_avg_5_prior
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance_avg_5_prior NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM with_windows
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.status,
        s.last7_count_balance,
        latest.transaction_txn_time
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time AS transaction_txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.last7_count_balance,
        latest.transaction_txn_time_2
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time AS transaction_txn_time_2
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    last7_count_balance,
    transaction_txn_time_2
FROM with_latest
ORDER BY transaction_txn_time_2 DESC

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

    .withColumn("account_type_prefix", F.substring("account_type", 1, 3))
)

with_windows = (

        F.count("balance").over(w).alias("last7_count_balance"),

        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sum_shipping_fee,

    FROM with_dims
),
matched_keys AS (

    INTERSECT

    FROM shipments

),
kept_rows AS (

        a.*,

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        LAST_DAY(sale_date) AS sale_date_month_end
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > TO_DATE('2023-09-14')
      AND revenue BETWEEN 1100 AND 2600
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT product_id, store_id
    FROM cleaned
    INTERSECT
    SELECT product_id, store_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (5, 8, 9)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.store_id = k.store_id
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        store_id,
        product_id,
        ROUND(units / SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id), 4) AS units_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC) AS units_dense_rank
    FROM verified
    WHERE units IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        product_id,
        units_share,
        RANK() OVER w_grp AS units_dense_rank_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS units_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        MAX(units_share) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_max_units_share
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_dense_rank NULLS LAST)
),
with_windows_store_sales AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        product_id,
        units_share,
        units_dense_rank_rank,
        units_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        store_id_max_units_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY store_id_max_units_share DESC)
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(e.store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank) AS min_store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank
FROM with_windows_store_sales e
LEFT JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.category)
ORDER BY min_store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units_dense_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("store_id_max_units_share").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-14"))) & F.col("revenue").between(1100, 2600))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        F.last_day("sale_date").alias("sale_date_month_end"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("product_id", "store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([5, 8, 9]))
        .select("product_id", "store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("units").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(w)), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("units_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "product_id",
        "units_share",
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("units_dense_rank_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("units_dense_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.max("units_share").over(w5).alias("store_id_max_units_share"),
    )
)

with_windows_store_sales = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "product_id",
        "units_share",
        "units_dense_rank_rank",
        "units_dense_rank_percent_rank",
        "store_id_max_units_share",
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_store_sales
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .rollup(F.col("p.category").alias("category"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("e.store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank")).alias("min_store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_store_id_max_units_share_dense_rank").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        SUBSTRING(country, 1, 2) country_prefix
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.device,
        a.country,
        a.country_prefix,
        p.signup_date
    FROM valid a
    INNER JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time >= '2025-08-01'
        )
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, d.segment
    FROM eligible a
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON a.customer_id = d.id
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.session_id IN (10, 15)
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        country_prefix,
        signup_date,
        segment,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id) seq_no
    FROM not_flagged
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.country,
        s.country_prefix,
        s.signup_date,
        x.page,
        x.event_type
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.page, c.event_type
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', signup_date) AS week_start,
    COUNT_IF(page = '/search') AS search_events,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'SG') AS sg_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT page) AS distinct_pages,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'DE') AS de_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_type) AS distinct_event_types,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM with_last
GROUP BY week_start
HAVING COUNT_IF(page = '/search') > 1;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("signup_date", "id")

        F.col("p.signup_date"),

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS attr_key, attr_value
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        attr_value,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS has_fault
    FROM lines
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        attr_value,
        TRIM(service) AS clean_service,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 467 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code >= 252 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_band
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WHERE has_fault < 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS status_code_share,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS status_code_share_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_cume_dist
    FROM filtered
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        status_code_band,
        status_code_share,
        status_code_share_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_hist AS status_code_share_2_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE status_code_share_2 IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_share_2 DESC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    status_code,
    status_code_band,
    status_code_share,
    status_code_share_2_percent_rank
FROM scored

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code_share_2").desc())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_value",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    flattened_attrs
    .filter(F.col("has_fault") < 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_value",
        F.trim("service").alias("clean_service"),
        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 467, "High").when(F.col("status_code") >= 252, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("status_code_band"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4).alias("status_code_share_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("status_code_cume_dist"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("status_code_share_2").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "status_code_band",
        "status_code_share",
        "status_code_share_2",
        F.percent_rank().over(w_hist).alias("status_code_share_2_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "status_code_band",
        "status_code_share",
        "status_code_share_2_percent_rank",
    )
)

        COALESCE(brand, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_brand
    FROM products

kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.unit_price >= 150
        )

eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.store_id IN (1, 2, 4, 6)
        )
),
eligible_products AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.unit_price <= 350
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        SUM(price) OVER (ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_price
    FROM with_windows
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)

)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS attr_key, attr_value
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN attr_key IN ('trace', 'version') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END attr_key_group,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'DIRECT') attr_key_filled
    FROM flattened
    WHERE latency_ms > 1857
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        attr_key,
        attr_key_group,
        attr_key_filled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key, level ORDER BY latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) event_seq,
        STDDEV_SAMP(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key) attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms,
        LAST_VALUE(latency_ms) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY latency_ms, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_latency_ms,
        LAST_VALUE(latency_ms, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_latency_ms_2
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key ORDER BY event_seq, id, attr_key) seq_no,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id, attr_key) event_seq_bucket,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY host) host_min_latency_ms,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY service, attr_key ORDER BY last_known_latency_ms, id, attr_key) last_known_latency_ms_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) row_seq
    FROM scored
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, level ORDER BY attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY last_known_latency_ms_2 DESC, id, attr_key) AS rank_in_group
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(last_known_latency_ms_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY host_min_latency_ms, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_last_known_latency_ms_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) seq_no_2,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms DESC, id, attr_key) attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms_bucket,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service) service_min_latency_ms
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    id,
    host,
    level,
    latency_ms,
    attr_key,
    attr_key_filled,
    last_known_latency_ms,
    seq_no,
    host_min_latency_ms,
    CASE WHEN level RLIKE '^(WARN|ERROR)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS level_zone
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY level DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level", "attr_key").orderBy("event_seq", "id", "attr_key")
w6 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id", "attr_key")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key").orderBy("last_known_latency_ms", "id", "attr_key")
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy(F.col("attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("last_known_latency_ms_2").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w12 = Window.orderBy("host_min_latency_ms", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w13 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w14 = Window.partitionBy("service")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") > 1857)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key").isin(["trace", "version"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("attr_key_group"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("attr_key_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_key_group",
        "attr_key_filled",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.stddev_samp("latency_ms").over(w2).alias("attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms"),
        F.last("latency_ms", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_latency_ms"),
        F.last("latency_ms", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("last_known_latency_ms_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .withColumn("event_seq_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w6))
    .withColumn("host_min_latency_ms", F.min("latency_ms").over(w7))
    .withColumn("last_known_latency_ms_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w8))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w9))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w11))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("last_known_latency_ms_bucket").over(w12).alias("running_last_known_latency_ms_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w13).alias("attr_key_stddev_samp_latency_ms_bucket"),
        F.min("latency_ms").over(w14).alias("service_min_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_key_filled",
        "last_known_latency_ms",
        "seq_no",
        "host_min_latency_ms",
        F.when(F.col("level").rlike("^(WARN|ERROR)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("level_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("level").desc())
)

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT a.*, d.sqft
    FROM store_sales a
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON a.store_id = d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.city,
        b.store_name,
        b.opened_date
    FROM with_dims e
    INNER JOIN stores b
        ON e.store_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        sqft,
        opened_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY units DESC, id) AS units_bucket,
        CORR(units, revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS corr_units_revenue
    FROM enriched
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CEIL(units_bucket) AS units_bucket_whole
    FROM scored
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-06-04'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        seq_no,
        units_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_bucket_whole DESC, id) AS units_bucket_whole_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY corr_units_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_sqft,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY corr_units_revenue DESC NULLS FIRST) AS corr_units_revenue_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(units_bucket_whole, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_units_bucket_whole
    FROM valid
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        seq_no,
        units_bucket,
        units_bucket_whole_bucket,
        first_known_sqft,
        seq_no * first_known_sqft AS seq_no_times_first_known_sqft
    FROM metrics
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-09-24'
      AND units_bucket BETWEEN 3 AND 7
),
scored_store_sales AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(seq_no_times_first_known_sqft) OVER (ORDER BY units_bucket_whole_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS seq_no_times_first_known_sqft_avg_2_prior,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seq_no, id) AS event_seq,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY units_bucket DESC) AS units_bucket_cume_dist,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY units_bucket_whole_bucket, id) AS units_bucket_whole_bucket_bucket
    FROM filtered
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', sale_date) AS year_start,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(first_known_sqft, 0.95) AS first_known_sqft_p95,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM scored_store_sales
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY year_start DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units_bucket_whole").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("corr_units_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("corr_units_revenue").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.orderBy("units_bucket_whole_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w9 = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("units_bucket").desc())
w11 = Window.orderBy("units_bucket_whole_bucket", "id")

with_dims = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.sqft"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.city"), F.col("b.store_name"), F.col("b.opened_date"))
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "sqft",
        "opened_date",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w2).alias("units_bucket"),
        F.corr("units", "revenue").over(w3).alias("corr_units_revenue"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-06-04").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("units_bucket_whole", F.ceil("units_bucket"))
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "sale_date",
        "seq_no",
        "units_bucket",
        F.ntile(3).over(w4).alias("units_bucket_whole_bucket"),
        F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_sqft"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("corr_units_revenue_cume_dist"),
        F.last("units_bucket_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_units_bucket_whole"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-09-24").cast("date")) & F.col("units_bucket").between(3, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "sale_date",
        "seq_no",
        "units_bucket",
        "units_bucket_whole_bucket",
        "first_known_sqft",
        (F.col("seq_no") * F.col("first_known_sqft")).alias("seq_no_times_first_known_sqft"),
    )
)

scored_store_sales = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("seq_no_times_first_known_sqft_avg_2_prior", F.avg("seq_no_times_first_known_sqft").over(w8))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w9))
    .withColumn("units_bucket_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w10))
    .withColumn("units_bucket_whole_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w11))
)

result = (
    scored_store_sales
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "sale_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("first_known_sqft", 0.95).alias("first_known_sqft_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc_nulls_first())
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT id, channel, promo_code, starts_on, ends_on, UPPER(promo_code) AS promo_code_upper, COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_filled FROM promotions WHERE ends_on >= DATE '2023-08-25'), attributed AS (SELECT a.*, pr.id AS promo_id, pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code, pr.discount_pct FROM base a INNER JOIN promotions pr ON a.channel <=> pr.channel AND a.ends_on >= pr.starts_on AND a.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '30' DAY), filtered AS (SELECT id, channel, promo_code, starts_on, ends_on, promo_id, promotion_promo_code, discount_pct - promo_id AS discount_pct_minus_promo_id FROM attributed WHERE ends_on > DATE '2023-09-21' AND promotion_promo_code IS NOT NULL), attributed_promotions AS (SELECT e.*, pr.id AS promo_id_2, pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2, pr.discount_pct FROM filtered e LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON e.channel = pr.channel AND e.ends_on >= pr.starts_on AND e.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '7' DAY), cleaned AS (SELECT id, channel, promo_code, starts_on, promo_id, promotion_promo_code, discount_pct_minus_promo_id, promo_id_2, discount_pct, ROUND(discount_pct, 1) AS discount_pct_rounded, CAST(promo_id AS DOUBLE) AS promo_id_num FROM attributed_promotions WHERE ends_on > TO_DATE('2023-08-08')) SELECT CASE WHEN promo_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS promo_id_tier, promotion_promo_code, PERCENTILE_APPROX(promo_id_2, 0.5) AS promo_id_2_p50, COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END) AS mobile_count, ROUND(SUM(discount_pct_minus_promo_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promo_code = 'SPRING10' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS discount_pct_minus_promo_id_per_spring10, AVG(promo_id) AS avg_promo_id, ROUND(AVG(promo_id_2), 2) AS avg_promo_id_2, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN promo_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY ROUND(AVG(promo_id_2), 2) DESC) AS avg_promo_id_2_dense_rank FROM cleaned GROUP BY CASE WHEN promo_id >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, promotion_promo_code ORDER BY avg_promo_id_2 DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_id_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_promo_id_2").desc())

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-25").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        F.upper("promo_code").alias("promo_code_upper"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    attributed
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-09-21").cast("date")) & F.col("promotion_promo_code").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        (F.col("discount_pct") - F.col("promo_id")).alias("discount_pct_minus_promo_id"),
    )
)

attributed_promotions = (
    filtered
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("e.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("e.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("e.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    attributed_promotions
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-08")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        "discount_pct_minus_promo_id",
        "promo_id_2",
        "discount_pct",
        F.round("discount_pct", 1).alias("discount_pct_rounded"),
        F.col("promo_id").cast("double").alias("promo_id_num"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("promo_id") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("promo_id_tier"),
        "promotion_promo_code",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("promo_id_2", 0.5).alias("promo_id_2_p50"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_count"),
        F.round(F.sum("discount_pct_minus_promo_id") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("discount_pct_minus_promo_id_per_spring10"),
        F.avg("promo_id").alias("avg_promo_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("promo_id_2"), 2).alias("avg_promo_id_2"),
    )
    .withColumn("avg_promo_id_2_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_promo_id_2").desc_nulls_first())
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        country,
        coalesce(supplier_name, 'unassigned') as supplier_name_filled
    from suppliers
    where city is not null
      and city is not distinct from 'New York'
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from valid s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and array_contains(c.tags, 'sale')
        )
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name_filled,
        latest.launch_date,
        latest.product_cost
    from kept s
    left join lateral (
            select c.launch_date, c.cost as product_cost
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.launch_date desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from with_latest
    except
    select id
    from suppliers
    where supplier_name like 'Sia%'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_latest s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, date_sub(launch_date, 52) as launch_date_minus_52d
    from kept_rows
    where product_cost <= 390
),
kept_suppliers as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from base s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products ch
            where ch.supplier_id = s.id
              and ch.launch_date < s.launch_date_minus_52d
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    date_trunc('week', launch_date_minus_52d) as week_start,
    max(product_cost) as max_product_cost,
    approx_percentile(product_cost, 0.5) as product_cost_p50,
    count(*) as cnt,
    avg(product_cost) as avg_product_cost,
    count(*) as event_count,
    count(*) as cnt_2
from kept_suppliers
group by rollup (date_trunc('week', launch_date_minus_52d))
having max_product_cost < 1000000;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("New York"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        F.coalesce("supplier_name", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("supplier_name_filled"),
    )
)

kept = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.array_contains(F.col("c.tags"), "sale")), "left_anti")
)

with_latest = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.supplier_name_filled",
        F.col("c.launch_date"),

    with_latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("product_cost") <= 390)
    .withColumn("launch_date_minus_52d", F.date_sub("launch_date", 52))
)

kept_suppliers = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.launch_date") < F.col("s.launch_date_minus_52d")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers
    .rollup(F.date_trunc("week", "launch_date_minus_52d").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("product_cost").alias("max_product_cost"),
        F.percentile_approx("product_cost", 0.5).alias("product_cost_p50"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.avg("product_cost").alias("avg_product_cost"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt_2"),

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        round(quantity * 0.9, 2) as quantity_adjusted
    from inventory
    where last_restock >= date '2023-03-16'
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        last_value(quantity_adjusted, true) over (partition by product_id order by last_restock, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_quantity_adjusted,
        avg(quantity_adjusted) over (partition by store_id, product_id) as store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted,
        lag(quantity_adjusted, 1) over (partition by store_id order by last_restock, id) as prev_quantity_adjusted
    from valid
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        last_known_quantity_adjusted,
        least(store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted, prev_quantity_adjusted) as least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted,
        coalesce(store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted, 0) as store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled
    from enriched
    where store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted = 76
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select store_id, id
    from filtered
    intersect
    select store_id, id
    from inventory
    where product_id = 3
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    join remaining_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id and s.id = k.id
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled - least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted as store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted,
        round(last_known_quantity_adjusted, 1) as last_known_quantity_adjusted_rounded
    from reconciled
    where store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled between 56 and 61
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    store_id,
    case when store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted >= 81 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted_tier,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids
from cleaned
group by store_id, case when store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted >= 81 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by store_id nulls last;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-03-16").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.round((F.col("quantity") * 0.9), 2).alias("quantity_adjusted"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        F.last("quantity_adjusted", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("last_known_quantity_adjusted"),
        F.avg("quantity_adjusted").over(w2).alias("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted"),
        F.lag("quantity_adjusted", 1).over(w3).alias("prev_quantity_adjusted"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted") == 76)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "last_known_quantity_adjusted",
        F.least("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted", "prev_quantity_adjusted").alias("least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted"),
        F.coalesce("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted", F.lit(0)).alias("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("product_id") == 3)
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled").between(56, 61))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled") - F.col("least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted")).alias("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted"),
        F.round("last_known_quantity_adjusted", 1).alias("last_known_quantity_adjusted_rounded"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        "store_id",
        F.when(F.col("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted") >= 81, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_filled_minus_least_store_id_avg_quantity_adjusted_prev_quantity_adjusted_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("store_id").asc_nulls_last())
)

    select

        brand,
        launch_date,
        supplier_id,
        avg(cost) over (order by cost asc, id asc rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as cost_avg_6_prior,

    count(distinct supplier_id) as distinct_supplier_ids,
    approx_percentile(corr_cost_price, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as corr_cost_price_quartiles
from with_windows

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        FLOOR(cost) AS cost_whole,
        CASE WHEN status IN ('RETURNED', 'IN_TRANSIT') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS status_group,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        delivered_date,
        cost_whole,
        status_group,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_cost,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_avg_cost,
        COUNT(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_cost,
        MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_max_cost,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE carrier IN ('UPS', 'FedEx', 'Kerry')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT a.*, b.discount
    FROM scored a
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.order_id,
        e.last7_count_cost,
        e.last7_max_cost,
        b.discount AS order_discount,
        b.shipping_fee,
        b.order_date
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id <=> b.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        last7_count_cost,
        last7_max_cost,
        order_discount,
        shipping_fee,
        SUM(order_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY last7_max_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_order_discount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last7_count_cost NULLS FIRST) AS last7_count_cost_dense_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_date, id) AS row_seq
    FROM with_dims
),
enriched_shipments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(running_order_discount) OVER w_running AS last4_sum_running_order_discount,
        MIN(running_order_discount) OVER w_running AS last4_min_running_order_discount,
        MAX(running_order_discount) OVER w_running AS last4_max_running_order_discount
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY last7_count_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored_shipments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(last7_max_cost, 1) OVER (ORDER BY row_seq, id) AS prev_last7_max_cost,
        LEAD(last4_sum_running_order_discount, 2) OVER (ORDER BY last4_sum_running_order_discount, id) AS next_last4_sum_running_order_discount
    FROM enriched_shipments
),
stats AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 41 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS shipping_fee_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(order_discount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS order_discount_quartiles,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(row_seq, 0.5) AS row_seq_p50,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(last4_min_running_order_discount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last4_min_running_order_discount_quartiles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM scored_shipments
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    shipping_fee_tier,
    row_seq_p50,
    distinct_ids
FROM stats
ORDER BY shipping_fee_tier DESC NULLS LAST, row_seq_p50 DESC;

WITH not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.session_id IN (17, 31)
        )
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.web_event_event_time,
        x.event_type
    FROM not_flagged s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_time AS web_event_event_time, c.event_type
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time < s.web_event_event_time
        )
),
kept_sessions AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_type = 'purchase'
        )
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.browser,
    s.started_at,
    s.country,
    s.web_event_event_time,
    CASE WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Firefox|Safari)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Chrome|Edge)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS browser_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(x.discount) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_order_discount
FROM kept_sessions s

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        cast(revenue as int) as revenue_int
    from store_sales
    where revenue >= 1700
),
cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        add_months(sale_date, 6) as sale_date_plus_months
    from valid
    where sale_date >= date '2023-03-23'
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select product_id, store_id
    from cleaned
    except
    select product_id, store_id
    from store_sales
    where store_id in (1, 2, 6)
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    join remaining_keys k on s.product_id = k.product_id and s.store_id = k.store_id
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select product_id
    from kept_rows
    intersect
    select product_id
    from store_sales
    where sale_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-02-01'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from kept_rows s
    join kept_keys k on s.product_id = k.product_id
),
kept_keys_2 as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select product_id
    from verified
    intersect all
    select product_id
    from store_sales
    where units between 25 and 37
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from verified s
    join kept_keys_2 k on s.product_id = k.product_id
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select store_id, id
    from reconciled
    except distinct
    select store_id, id
    from store_sales
    where store_id = 3
),
reconciled_store_sales as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation

        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,

    FROM products

      AND brand IS DISTINCT FROM 'Acme'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT

        s.brand,
        s.price,
        s.cost,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.launch_date,
        s.tags,
        s.is_eco,

    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.product_id IN (18, 25, 39)

),

        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(monthly_fee, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_monthly_fee,

filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        GREATEST(monthly_fee, prev_monthly_fee) AS greatest_monthly_fee_prev_monthly_fee,
        prev_monthly_fee + first_known_monthly_fee AS prev_monthly_fee_plus_first_known_monthly_fee
    FROM scored
    WHERE prev_monthly_fee BETWEEN 170 AND 180
      AND start_date > DATE '2023-09-05'
),
scored_subscriptions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,

        prev_monthly_fee,
        greatest_monthly_fee_prev_monthly_fee,
        prev_monthly_fee_plus_first_known_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee, id) AS row_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(monthly_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY first_known_monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_monthly_fee
    FROM filtered

        row_seq,
        last_known_monthly_fee,
        ROUND(prev_monthly_fee * 100, 2) AS prev_monthly_fee_scaled,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', start_date) AS start_date_period
    FROM scored_subscriptions
    WHERE YEAR(start_date) = 2025
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,

        monthly_fee,
        prev_monthly_fee,
        greatest_monthly_fee_prev_monthly_fee,
        row_seq,

WITH latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.account_type,
        s.balance,
        s.status,
        top1.txn_type
    FROM accounts s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_type
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.amount < 2600
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, customer_id ORDER BY balance NULLS FIRST) balance_dense_rank,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance_avg_3,
        SUM(balance) OVER w_running running_balance,
        AVG(balance) OVER w_part balance_avg_2
    FROM eligible
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_part AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery

        )
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate

    c.country,
    c.segment,
    a.account_type,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    AVG(a.credit_limit) AS avg_credit_limit,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM kept_accounts a
INNER JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY CUBE (c.country, c.segment, a.account_type)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.amount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

latest_match = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance",
        "s.status",
        F.col("c.txn_type"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.amount") < 2600), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("balance_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w3).alias("balance_avg_3"),
        F.sum("balance").over(w_running).alias("running_balance"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w_part).alias("balance_avg_2"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_accounts
        .filter(F.col("status").isin(["OPEN", "CLOSED"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.txn_type").isin(["DEBIT", "FEE"])), "left_semi")
)

enriched = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance_dense_rank",
        "s.balance_avg_2",
        F.col("c.credit_limit"),
        F.col("c.age"),
    )
)

kept_accounts = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (~F.col("c.is_flagged")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_accounts
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .cube(
        F.col("c.country").alias("country"),
        F.col("c.segment").alias("segment"),
        F.col("a.account_type").alias("account_type"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.avg(F.col("a.credit_limit")).alias("avg_credit_limit"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)
