sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS k, value
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value,
        LAG(latency_ms, 1) OVER w_grp AS prev_latency_ms,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_grp_2 AS status_code_bucket
    FROM exploded
    WHERE k = 'version'
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY status_code ASC, id ASC, k ASC), w_grp_2 AS (PARTITION BY service, k ORDER BY status_code ASC, id ASC, k ASC)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        status_code,
        k,
        prev_latency_ms,
        status_code_bucket
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, k ORDER BY status_code DESC, id ASC, k ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        CASE WHEN status_code_bucket >= 9 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code_bucket >= 3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_bucket_level,
        CASE WHEN k = 'region' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_region,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_filled
    FROM latest
    WHERE status_code > 263
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms <> 816
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    status_code,
    k,
    status_code_bucket_level,
    is_region,
    k_filled,
    CASE WHEN k RLIKE '^(version|region)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS k_zone
FROM verified
ORDER BY k_zone ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")
w_grp_2 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "k")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("k") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "value",
        F.lag("latency_ms", 1).over(w_grp).alias("prev_latency_ms"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_grp_2).alias("status_code_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "prev_latency_ms",
        "status_code_bucket",
    )
)

base = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("status_code") > 263)
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        F.when(F.col("status_code_bucket") >= 9, "High").when(F.col("status_code_bucket") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("status_code_bucket_level"),
        F.when(F.col("k") == "region", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_region"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("NONE")).alias("k_filled"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") != 816)
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .select(
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "status_code_bucket_level",
        "is_region",
        "k_filled",
        F.when(F.col("k").rlike("^(version|region)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("k_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("k_zone")
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('-', plan, status) plan_status_key
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date >= DATE '2023-09-03'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        plan_status_key,
        FIRST_VALUE(monthly_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_monthly_fee,
        STDDEV_SAMP(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) customer_id_stddev_samp_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_monthly_fee
    FROM base
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        monthly_fee,
        plan_status_key,
        first_known_monthly_fee,
        running_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp row_seq,
        SUM(first_known_monthly_fee) OVER w_running running_first_known_monthly_fee,
        SUM(running_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, status) plan_sum_running_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER w_running cumulative_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, plan ORDER BY first_known_monthly_fee DESC, id ASC) event_seq
    FROM scored
    WHERE customer_id_stddev_samp_monthly_fee BETWEEN 76 AND 233
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY running_monthly_fee DESC, id ASC), w_running AS (ORDER BY monthly_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'UNKNOWN') AS merchant_clean
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(is_flagged_flag, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY amount ASC, id ASC) AS prev_is_flagged_flag,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_avg_3_prior,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag ASC, id ASC) AS is_flagged_flag_bucket,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type), 4) AS amount_share,
        LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) AS next_amount
    FROM filtered
    WHERE merchant <> '7-Eleven'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        is_flagged_flag,
        merchant_clean,
        prev_is_flagged_flag,
        amount_avg_3_prior,
        is_flagged_flag_bucket,
        next_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_sum_7d,
        LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY next_amount ASC, id ASC) AS prev_amount
    FROM metrics
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM scored
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        is_flagged,
        amount_sum_7d,
        prev_amount,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM gaps
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount_sum_7d) OVER w_recent AS last7_sum_amount_sum_7d,
        MAX(amount_sum_7d) OVER w_recent AS last7_max_amount_sum_7d,
        COUNT(amount_sum_7d) OVER w_recent AS last7_count_amount_sum_7d,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount_sum_7d) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_part AS first_known_amount_sum_7d
    FROM islands
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY island_id ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_part AS (ORDER BY amount_sum_7d ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY island_id DESC, id ASC) AS rn
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
latest_transactions AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY rn ASC) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    txn_type,
    COUNT_IF(txn_type = 'REFUND') AS refund_events,
    MAX(txn_time) AS last_seen,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS num_txn_types,
    COUNT_IF(txn_type = 'DEBIT') AS debit_events,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(txn_type)) AS num_txn_types_2,
    MIN(txn_time) AS first_txn_time
FROM latest_transactions
GROUP BY txn_type
HAVING refund_events >= 1
ORDER BY num_txn_types_2 DESC;

w9 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("island_id", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.orderBy("amount_sum_7d", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        AVG(balance) OVER (ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) balance_avg_5_prior,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY balance DESC, id) balance_bucket,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type, status ORDER BY balance DESC, id) balance_bucket_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY opened_date DESC, id) row_seq
    FROM accounts
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        src.opened_date,
        src.status,
        src.balance_bucket,
        src.row_seq,
        d.name,
        d.country
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id = d.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(balance_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) next_balance_bucket,
        LEAD(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) next_row_seq,
        LAG(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) prev_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY opened_date, id) seq_no
    FROM with_dims
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.txn_type NOT IN ('DEBIT', 'FEE')
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM kept
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY row_seq DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.transaction_amount
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount AS transaction_amount
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics

FROM with_latest
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date), DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date)), (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date)), ());

    select s.*, top1.price
    from cleaned s
    join lateral (
            select c.price
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.cost desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
eligible_suppliers as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_last s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and c.launch_date >= '2025-10-01'

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_restock) AS days_since_last_restock
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > TO_DATE('2023-05-08')
      AND quantity > 127
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_quantity,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity
    FROM latest
),
cleaned_inventory AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DAY(last_restock) AS last_restock_day,
        FLOOR(running_min_quantity) AS running_min_quantity_whole
    FROM metrics
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-04-07'
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        store_id,
        CASE WHEN cumulative_quantity >= 1055 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cumulative_quantity_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_quartiles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS distinct_store_ids,
        GROUPING(store_id) AS grouping_id
    FROM cleaned_inventory
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (store_id, CASE WHEN cumulative_quantity >= 1055 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
)
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.cumulative_quantity_tier,
    s.distinct_ids,
    s.quantity_quartiles,
    s.distinct_store_ids,
    (SELECT MIN(o2.amount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.store_id = s.store_id) AS min_order_amount
FROM summary s
ORDER BY min_order_amount DESC NULLS FIRST, distinct_store_ids
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
amount_by_store_id = df_orders.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.min("amount").alias("min_order_amount"))

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-08"))) & (F.col("quantity") > 127))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock").alias("days_since_last_restock"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "store_id", "quantity", "last_restock")
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_count_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_avg_quantity"),
        F.min("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_min_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w3).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
    )
)

cleaned_inventory = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-04-07").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("last_restock_day", F.dayofmonth("last_restock"))
    .withColumn("running_min_quantity_whole", F.floor("running_min_quantity"))
)

summary = (
    cleaned_inventory
    .withColumn("cumulative_quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("cumulative_quantity") >= 1055, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("store_id", "cumulative_quantity_tier")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("store_id").alias("distinct_store_ids"),
        F.grouping("store_id").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .join(amount_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "store_id",
        "cumulative_quantity_tier",
        "distinct_ids",
        "quantity_quartiles",
        "distinct_store_ids",
        F.col("min_order_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_order_amount").desc_nulls_first(), "distinct_store_ids")
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        HOUR(reading_ts) AS reading_ts_hour
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 09:00:00'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(reading_ts_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_min_reading_ts_hour,
        FIRST_VALUE(reading_ts_hour) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_reading_ts_hour,
        AVG(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_bits_avg_3_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure DESC NULLS FIRST) AS pressure_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(status_bits_avg_3_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY humidity DESC NULLS LAST) AS humidity_dense_rank,
        AVG(status_bits) OVER (ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_bits_avg_3
    FROM scored
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts < '2024-12-11'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        device_code,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        reading_ts_hour,
        device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior,
        humidity_dense_rank,
        reading_ts_hour * device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior AS reading_ts_hour_times_device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior
    FROM verified
    WHERE humidity IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    temp_c,
    humidity,
    pressure,
    reading_ts_hour,
    humidity_dense_rank
FROM valid
ORDER BY reading_ts_hour DESC NULLS FIRST, humidity;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w2 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy("temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 09:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        F.hour("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_hour"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("reading_ts_hour").over(w).alias("device_code_min_reading_ts_hour"),
        F.first("reading_ts_hour", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_reading_ts_hour"),
        F.avg("status_bits").over(w3).alias("status_bits_avg_3_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("pressure_dense_rank"),

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior", F.min("status_bits_avg_3_prior").over(w))
    .withColumn("humidity_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("status_bits_avg_3", F.avg("status_bits").over(w6))
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("reading_ts") < "2024-12-11")
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("humidity").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "device_code",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "reading_ts_hour",
        "device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior",
        "humidity_dense_rank",
        (F.col("reading_ts_hour") * F.col("device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior")).alias("reading_ts_hour_times_device_code_min_status_bits_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .select("temp_c", "humidity", "pressure", "reading_ts_hour", "humidity_dense_rank")
    .orderBy(F.col("reading_ts_hour").desc_nulls_first(), "humidity")

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_rank
    FROM flattened
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS(',', currency, plan) AS currency_plan_key
    FROM metrics
    WHERE plan = 'starter'
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(tier_value_rank, 0) AS tier_value_rank_filled,
        tier_value - tier_value_rank AS tier_value_minus_tier_value_rank
    FROM base
    WHERE plan != 'pro'
),
base_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_rank,
        currency_plan_key,
        tier_value_rank_filled,
        LENGTH(currency) AS currency_length,
        tier_value * tier_value_rank AS tier_value_times_tier_value_rank
    FROM valid
    WHERE tier_value_rank < 5
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value_rank,
        currency_plan_key,
        tier_value_rank_filled,
        currency_length,
        tier_value_times_tier_value_rank,
        CONCAT(currency, ' ', plan) AS currency_plan,
        ROUND(tier_value_rank, 1) AS tier_value_rank_rounded
    FROM base_price_tiers
    WHERE tier_value_rank BETWEEN 4 AND 6
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    currency,
    kpi,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        currency,
        tier_value_times_tier_value_rank,
        tier_value_rank_rounded,
        tier_value_rank_filled
    FROM cleaned
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    val FOR kpi IN (tier_value_times_tier_value_rank, tier_value_rank_rounded AS TIER_VALUE_RANK_ROUNDED, tier_value_rank_filled AS TIER_VALUE_RANK_FILLED)
) long_rows;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"))
)

metrics = flattened.select("*", F.rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_rank"))

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "starter")
    .select("*", F.concat_ws(",", "currency", "plan").alias("currency_plan_key"))
)

valid = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("plan") != "pro")
    .withColumn("tier_value_rank_filled", F.coalesce("tier_value_rank", F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("tier_value_minus_tier_value_rank", (F.col("tier_value") - F.col("tier_value_rank")))
)

base_price_tiers = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_rank") < 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "currency_plan_key",
        "tier_value_rank_filled",
        F.length("currency").alias("currency_length"),
        (F.col("tier_value") * F.col("tier_value_rank")).alias("tier_value_times_tier_value_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    base_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_rank").between(4, 6))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "currency_plan_key",
        "tier_value_rank_filled",
        "currency_length",
        "tier_value_times_tier_value_rank",
        F.concat("currency", F.lit(" "), "plan").alias("currency_plan"),
        F.round("tier_value_rank", 1).alias("tier_value_rank_rounded"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "currency",
        "tier_value_times_tier_value_rank",
        F.col("tier_value_rank_rounded").alias("TIER_VALUE_RANK_ROUNDED"),
        F.col("tier_value_rank_filled").alias("TIER_VALUE_RANK_FILLED"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["currency"],
        values=["tier_value_times_tier_value_rank", "TIER_VALUE_RANK_ROUNDED", "TIER_VALUE_RANK_FILLED"],
        variableColumnName="kpi",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
)

        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq
    FROM subscriptions
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY start_date DESC, id ASC)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        running_monthly_fee,
        row_seq,
        COUNT(row_seq) OVER w_part AS running_count_row_seq,
        MIN(row_seq) OVER w_part AS running_min_row_seq,
        MAX(row_seq) OVER w_part AS running_max_row_seq,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_monthly_fee ASC) AS running_monthly_fee_percent_rank
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows_subscriptions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(running_max_row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_max_row_seq ASC, id ASC) AS prev_running_max_row_seq,
        LEAD(running_max_row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_max_row_seq ASC, id ASC) AS next_running_max_row_seq,
        LEAD(running_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_max_row_seq ASC, id ASC) AS next_running_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_max_row_seq ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq_2
    FROM with_windows
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows_subscriptions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY next_running_max_row_seq DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT

        MIN(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_min_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY row_seq DESC, id ASC) AS row_seq_3
    FROM latest
    WHERE running_monthly_fee_percent_rank BETWEEN 0.44 AND 0.51
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT

    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY row_seq_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS row_seq_2_rank
FROM metrics;

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CAST(pressure AS INT) pressure_int
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= DATE '2025-09-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(pressure) OVER w_ordered pressure_avg_2_prior,
        CORR(status_bits, pressure) OVER w_grp corr_status_bits_pressure,
        AVG(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) pressure_avg_30m
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code)
),
with_windows_device_readings AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        pressure_avg_2_prior,
        pressure_avg_30m,
        SUM(pressure_avg_30m) OVER w_grp cumulative_pressure_avg_30m,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_pressure
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE corr_status_bits_pressure >= 0.2
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        pressure_avg_2_prior,
        pressure_avg_30m,
        cumulative_pressure_avg_30m,
        running_pressure,
        CASE WHEN temp_c >= 39.6 THEN 'High' WHEN temp_c >= 25.3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END temp_c_level,
        ROUND(pressure * 1.07, 2) adjusted_pressure
    FROM with_windows_device_readings
    WHERE humidity >= 37
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM cleaned
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE pressure >= 1017
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure_avg_2_prior,
        pressure_avg_30m,
        cumulative_pressure_avg_30m,
        running_pressure,
        temp_c_level,
        adjusted_pressure,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY temp_c NULLS LAST) temp_c_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY temp_c) temp_c_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY pressure DESC NULLS LAST) pressure_cume_dist
    FROM kept_rows
),
enriched_device_readings AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered temp_c_percent_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY humidity DESC) humidity_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS LAST)
)
SELECT

    running_pressure,
    temp_c_level,
    adjusted_pressure,
    temp_c_dense_rank,
    temp_c_percent_rank
FROM enriched_device_readings
ORDER BY temp_c_percent_rank DESC

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(rating) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_rating,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC) AS rating_bucket
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating BETWEEN 2.6 AND 2.7
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        rating,
        cumulative_rating,
        rating + rating_bucket AS rating_plus_rating_bucket,
        REPLACE(supplier_name, ' ', '') AS supplier_name_slug
    FROM enriched
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(supplier_name)) = 'tokyo traders'
),
enriched_suppliers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(cumulative_rating) OVER w_part AS prev_cumulative_rating,
        LEAD(cumulative_rating) OVER w_part AS next_cumulative_rating,
        LEAD(rating) OVER w_part AS next_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY rating_plus_rating_bucket ASC, id ASC)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(rating, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY prev_cumulative_rating ASC NULLS FIRST) AS prev_cumulative_rating_cume_dist,
        FIRST_VALUE(next_rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY next_rating ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_next_rating,
        LAG(next_rating, 1) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC) AS prev_next_rating
    FROM enriched_suppliers
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        rating,
        rating_plus_rating_bucket,
        supplier_name_slug,
        prev_cumulative_rating,
        next_rating,
        seq_no,
        last_known_rating,
        prev_cumulative_rating_cume_dist,
        first_known_next_rating,
        prev_next_rating,
        SUM(next_cumulative_rating) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_rating ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_next_cumulative_rating,
        LAST_VALUE(cumulative_rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_ordered AS last_known_cumulative_rating
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY prev_cumulative_rating_cume_dist ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    rating,
    rating_plus_rating_bucket,
    prev_cumulative_rating,
    next_rating,
    last_known_rating,
    prev_cumulative_rating_cume_dist,
    first_known_next_rating
FROM metrics
ORDER BY rating ASC

with filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        date_trunc('MONTH', ends_on) as ends_on_period
    from promotions
    where channel is not null
      and starts_on > date '2023-04-15'
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(ends_on_period) over (partition by channel order by ends_on_period, id) as prev_ends_on_period
    from filtered
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_ends_on_period is null or ends_on_period > prev_ends_on_period + interval '60' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from with_prev
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        ends_on_period,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by channel order by ends_on_period, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from flagged
),
flagged_2 as (

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("ends_on_period", "id")

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_ends_on_period").isNull() | (F.col("ends_on_period") > F.col("prev_ends_on_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        SUBSTRING(city, 1, 2) AS city_prefix,
        LENGTH(country) AS country_length,
        COALESCE(segment, 'UNKNOWN') AS segment_filled
    FROM customers
    WHERE NOT is_active
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment, city ORDER BY country_length, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(age, 0) AS age_filled,
        INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_city
    FROM deduped
    WHERE name LIKE 'M%'
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT s.*, latest.started_at
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.started_at
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.started_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        city,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        city_prefix,
        country_length,
        resolved_city,
        started_at
    FROM with_latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id, city
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, city
    FROM customers
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.plan = 'premium'
        )
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN country_length >= 79 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS country_length_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at) AS year_start,
    AVG(age) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_avg_age,
    SUM(country_length) AS total_country_length,
    MAX(started_at) AS last_started_at,
    MAX(credit_limit) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_max_credit_limit,
    MIN(country_length) AS min_country_length,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(country_length, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS country_length_quartiles,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM eligible
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN country_length >= 79 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at)), (CASE WHEN country_length >= 79 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), ())
ORDER BY chiang_mai_avg_age;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city").orderBy("country_length", "id")

cleaned = (

    .select(

    .filter(F.col("name").like("M%"))
    .select(

)

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))

)

        "name",
        "city",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "city_prefix",
        "country_length",
        "resolved_city",
        "started_at",
    )
)

matched_keys = (

    .select("id", "city")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("is_active"))
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

verified = (

    .select("s.*")
)

eligible = (

    .alias("s")

    .orderBy("chiang_mai_avg_age")

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(discounts) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY element DESC) AS element_cume_dist
    FROM exploded
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(element * 1.1, 2) AS element_scaled
    FROM scored
    WHERE effective_from > TO_DATE('2024-05-05')
      AND currency = 'EUR'
),
cleaned_price_tiers AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(element AS INT) AS element_int
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-06-20'
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(element_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_sum_element_cume_dist,
        MAX(element_int) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_max_element_int,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY element_int DESC NULLS LAST) AS element_int_cume_dist,
        AVG(element) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_element
    FROM cleaned_price_tiers
)
SELECT
    currency,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(AVG(currency_avg_element), 2) AS avg_currency_avg_element
FROM scored_price_tiers
GROUP BY currency
HAVING avg_currency_avg_element >= 0;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_int").desc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("element"))
)

scored = exploded.select("*", F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("element_cume_dist"))

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter((F.col("effective_from") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-05-05"))) & (F.col("currency") == "EUR"))
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("element") * 1.1), 2).alias("element_scaled"))
)

cleaned_price_tiers = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-06-20").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.col("element").cast("int").alias("element_int"))
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    cleaned_price_tiers
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("element_cume_dist").over(w2).alias("currency_sum_element_cume_dist"),
        F.max("element_int").over(w2).alias("currency_max_element_int"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("element_int_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("element").over(w2).alias("currency_avg_element"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .groupBy("currency")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("currency_avg_element"), 2).alias("avg_currency_avg_element"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_currency_avg_element") >= 0)
)

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(discount_pct AS INT) AS discount_pct_int,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_clean
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND discount_pct >= 0.24
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM deduped a
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON a.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND a.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND a.starts_on <= DATE_ADD(pr.ends_on, 3)
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM attributed src
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults

with gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) is null
                 or reading_ts > lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) + interval 30 minutes then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from device_readings
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from gaps
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) as prev_reading_ts
    from islands
),
gaps_2 as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_reading_ts is null or reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + interval '15' minute then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from with_prev
),
sessions_device_readings as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from gaps_2
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        pressure,
        is_new_burst,
        burst_id,
        prev_reading_ts,
        is_new_session,
        island_id
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device_code order by is_new_session desc, id) as rank_in_group
        from sessions_device_readings
    ) t
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        prev_reading_ts,
        island_id,
        lag(pressure) over (order by pressure, id) as prev_pressure,
        lead(pressure) over (order by pressure, id) as next_pressure,
        lead(is_new_burst) over (order by pressure, id) as next_is_new_burst,
        row_number() over (order by pressure, id) as seq_no
    from ranked
),

with valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        substring(city, 1, 3) as city_prefix,
        coalesce(city, 'UNKNOWN') as resolved_city
    from suppliers
    where country in ('US', 'TH', 'UK')
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.price,
        top1.launch_date
    from valid s
    left join lateral (
            select c.price, c.launch_date
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
            order by c.price desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from latest_match s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and array_contains(c.tags, 'sale')
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        city,
        resolved_city,
        avg(price) over (order by rating, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as price_avg_3_prior,
        ntile(3) over (partition by country order by rating, id) as rating_bucket,
        sum(rating) over (partition by country order by price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_rating
    from eligible
    where country = 'JP'
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from scored s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products x
            where x.supplier_id = s.id
              and month(x.launch_date) in (3, 10, 12)
        )
)
select
    id,
    city,
    resolved_city,
    price_avg_3_prior,
    rating_bucket,
    running_rating
from kept
order by id nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country").isin(["US", "TH", "UK"]))
    .withColumn("city_prefix", F.substring("city", 1, 3))
    .withColumn("resolved_city", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

latest_match = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.price"), F.col("c.launch_date"))
)

eligible = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.array_contains(F.col("c.tags"), "sale")), "left_anti")
)

scored = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("country") == "JP")
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "resolved_city",
        F.avg("price").over(w2).alias("price_avg_3_prior"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.sum("rating").over(w4).alias("running_rating"),
    )
)

kept = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.month(F.col("x.launch_date")).isin([3, 10, 12])), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "resolved_city",
        "price_avg_3_prior",
        "rating_bucket",
        "running_rating",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        discount * amount AS discount_times_amount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-06-14'
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.opened_date,
        b.city,
        b.region
    FROM filtered e
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON e.store_id <=> b.id
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.order_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.order_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.store_id,
        s.order_date,
        s.shipping_fee,
        s.discount_times_amount,
        s.city,
        s.region,
        s.subscription_id,
        s.plan,
        s.monthly_fee,
        top1.shipment_delivered_date
    FROM matched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.delivered_date AS shipment_delivered_date
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_window AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id_2,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM with_last a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.order_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.order_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 7 DAYS
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.store_id,
    s.order_date,
    s.shipping_fee,
    s.discount_times_amount,
    s.subscription_id,
    s.monthly_fee,

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select id, element
    from price_tiers
    lateral view explode(tier_limits) t as element
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        element,
        percent_rank() over (order by element desc) as element_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by element nulls first) as element_rank
    from flattened
    where element between 36 and 77
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, cast(element_rank as double) as element_rank_str
    from scored
    where element < 20
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        element,
        element_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by element) as element_rank_2,
        dense_rank() over w_ordered as element_rank_dense_rank,
        rank() over (order by element_rank desc nulls first) as element_rank_rank
    from valid
    window w_ordered as (order by element_rank desc nulls last)
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        element_percent_rank,
        element_rank_dense_rank,
        element_rank_rank,
        element + element_rank_dense_rank as element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank
    from metrics
    where element_percent_rank between 0.55 and 0.64
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when element_rank_rank >= 9 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as element_rank_rank_tier,
    case when element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank >= 90 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank_tier,
    round(avg(element_rank_dense_rank), 2) as avg_element_rank_dense_rank,
    avg(element_rank_dense_rank) as avg_element_rank_dense_rank_2
from cleaned
group by case when element_rank_rank >= 9 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, case when element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank >= 90 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by avg_element_rank_dense_rank_2 nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy("element")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_rank").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = df_price_tiers.select("id", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("element"))

scored = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("element").between(36, 77))
    .select(
        "id",
        "element",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("element_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("element_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("element") < 20)
    .select("*", F.col("element_rank").cast("double").alias("element_rank_str"))
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "element",
        "element_percent_rank",
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("element_rank_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered).alias("element_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("element_rank_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("element_percent_rank").between(0.55, 0.64))
    .select(
        "element_percent_rank",
        "element_rank_dense_rank",
        "element_rank_rank",
        (F.col("element") + F.col("element_rank_dense_rank")).alias("element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("element_rank_rank") >= 9, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("element_rank_rank_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank") >= 90, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("element_plus_element_rank_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("element_rank_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_element_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("element_rank_dense_rank").alias("avg_element_rank_dense_rank_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_element_rank_dense_rank_2").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_SUB(ends_on, 88) AS ends_on_minus_88d,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct BETWEEN 0.19 AND 0.32
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', ends_on_minus_88d) AS year_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(promo_code)) AS num_promo_codes,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END) AS store_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(discount_pct, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS discount_pct_quartiles,
    MAX(discount_pct) FILTER (WHERE promo_code = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_max_discount_pct
FROM valid
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', ends_on_minus_88d)
HAVING num_promo_codes > 1
ORDER BY year_start DESC NULLS FIRST;
code:

valid = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.19, 0.32))
    .withColumn("ends_on_minus_88d", F.date_sub("ends_on", 88))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "ends_on_minus_88d").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("num_promo_codes"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_count"),

    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH valid AS (

    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Bangkok'
      AND signup_date > TO_DATE('2023-02-11')
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_active AS INT) AS is_active_flag,
        is_consumer + age AS is_consumer_plus_age
    FROM valid
    WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2023-06-15'
      AND segment IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        country,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        is_consumer,
        is_consumer_plus_age,
        ROUND(credit_limit, 0) AS credit_limit_rounded
    FROM base
    WHERE signup_date >= TO_DATE('2023-02-19')
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(is_consumer_plus_age AS INT) AS is_consumer_plus_age_int
    FROM filtered
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-03-04'
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT s.*, top1.status
    FROM valid_customers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status
            FROM subscriptions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.monthly_fee DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    segment,
    metric_name,
    reading
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        segment,
        credit_limit,
        credit_limit_rounded
    FROM latest_match
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (credit_limit AS CREDIT_LIMIT_VAL, credit_limit_rounded AS CREDIT_LIMIT_ROUNDED)
)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.location,
        p.dept_name
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN departments p
        ON s.dept_id = p.id
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY salary, id) = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(salary) OVER w_ordered AS prev_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq,
        ROUND(salary / SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY location, level), 4) AS salary_share
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY salary, id)
),
scored_employees AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(event_seq, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY prev_salary, id) AS prev_event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(level, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY prev_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_level,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS event_seq_bucket
    FROM scored
    WHERE hire_date <= '2024-01-18'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        level,
        location,
        dept_name,
        prev_salary,
        event_seq,
        last_known_level,
        event_seq_bucket,
        LEAD(salary) OVER w_ordered AS next_salary,
        LAG(event_seq_bucket) OVER w_ordered AS prev_event_seq_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS seq_no,
        LEAD(event_seq_bucket, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS next_event_seq_bucket
    FROM scored_employees
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY event_seq, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY event_seq_bucket DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY next_salary DESC NULLS LAST) AS next_salary_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY next_event_seq_bucket DESC, id) AS event_seq_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_event_seq_bucket DESC, id) AS event_seq_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY next_salary DESC, id) AS seq_no_2
    FROM metrics
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT level, id
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT level, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE level = 'L1'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.level = k.level AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    location,
    level,
    dept_name,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Sales' THEN 1 END) AS sales_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'London' THEN row_seq ELSE 0 END) AS london_row_seq
FROM verified
GROUP BY location, level, dept_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Sales' THEN 1 END) > 1
ORDER BY london_row_seq DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location", "level")
w3 = Window.orderBy("prev_salary", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("prev_salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("event_seq_bucket").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_salary").desc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("next_event_seq_bucket").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_event_seq_bucket").desc(), "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("next_salary").desc(), "id")

joined = (
    df_employees
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.location"), F.col("p.dept_name"))
)

latest = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

scored = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("salary").over(w).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("salary") / F.sum("salary").over(w2)), 4).alias("salary_share"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(budget, 0) AS budget_rounded,
        COALESCE(location, 'OTHER') AS resolved_location
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name = 'Marketing'
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.manager_id IS NOT NULL
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.job_title,
        top1.level
    FROM not_flagged s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.job_title, c.level
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, level ORDER BY budget_rounded, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM latest_match
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(dept_name) AS dept_name_upper,
        SUBSTRING(location, 1, 3) AS location_prefix,
        COALESCE(location, 'N/A') AS resolved_location_2
    FROM deduped
    WHERE location IN ('London', 'Tokyo')
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    LAG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_name ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) AS prev_budget,
    LEAD(budget_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_name ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) AS next_budget_rounded,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_name ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) AS row_seq,
    AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS budget_avg_6
FROM base
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.salary").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "level").orderBy("budget_rounded", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_name").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing")
    .withColumn("budget_rounded", F.round("budget", 0))
    .withColumn("resolved_location", F.coalesce("location", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.manager_id").isNotNull()), "left_semi")
)

latest_match = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.job_title"), F.col("c.level"))
)

deduped = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

base = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("location").isin(["London", "Tokyo"]))
    .withColumn("dept_name_upper", F.upper("dept_name"))
    .withColumn("location_prefix", F.substring("location", 1, 3))
    .withColumn("resolved_location_2", F.coalesce("location", F.lit("N/A")))
)

result = (
    base
    .withColumn("prev_budget", F.lag("budget").over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_budget_rounded", F.lead("budget_rounded").over(w3))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .withColumn("budget_avg_6", F.avg("budget").over(w4))
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, v
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(status_code) OVER w_running AS last3_max_status_code,
        MIN(status_code) OVER w_running AS last3_min_status_code,
        AVG(status_code) OVER w_running AS last3_avg_status_code
    FROM lines
    WHERE host IN ('h3', 'h2')
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY host, level ORDER BY latency_ms, id, key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key) AS prev_log_ts
    FROM enriched
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_log_ts IS NULL OR log_ts > prev_log_ts + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        v,
        last3_max_status_code,
        last3_min_status_code,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
flagged_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN log_ts - LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key) > INTERVAL '20' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM islands
),
islands_app_logs AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        v,
        last3_max_status_code,
        last3_min_status_code,
        session_id,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged_2
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        key,
        v,
        last3_max_status_code,
        burst_id,
        COUNT(last3_max_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_last3_max_status_code,
        MAX(last3_max_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_last3_max_status_code,
        AVG(last3_max_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_last3_max_status_code
    FROM islands_app_logs
)
SELECT
    id,
    key,
    v,
    burst_id,
    running_count_last3_max_status_code,
    running_max_last3_max_status_code,
    running_avg_last3_max_status_code,
    CASE WHEN key RLIKE '^(version|trace)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN key RLIKE '^(region)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS key_zone
FROM metrics
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("host", "level").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("host").isin(["h3", "h2"]))
    .withColumn("last3_max_status_code", F.max("status_code").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("last3_min_status_code", F.min("status_code").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("last3_avg_status_code", F.avg("status_code").over(w_running))
)

with_prev = enriched.withColumn("prev_log_ts", F.lag("log_ts").over(w2))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_log_ts").isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.col("prev_log_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "v",
        "last3_max_status_code",
        "last3_min_status_code",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w3).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

flagged_2 = (
    islands
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(w2) > F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands_app_logs = (
    flagged_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "v",
        "last3_max_status_code",
        "last3_min_status_code",
        "session_id",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w3).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    islands_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "v",
        "last3_max_status_code",
        "burst_id",
        F.count("last3_max_status_code").over(w3).alias("running_count_last3_max_status_code"),
        F.max("last3_max_status_code").over(w3).alias("running_max_last3_max_status_code"),
        F.avg("last3_max_status_code").over(w3).alias("running_avg_last3_max_status_code"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "v",
        "burst_id",
        "running_count_last3_max_status_code",
        "running_max_last3_max_status_code",
        "running_avg_last3_max_status_code",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(version|trace)$"), "PRIORITY").when(F.col("key").rlike("^(region)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH exploded AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        key,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(attributes) e AS key, value
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('year', created_at) created_at_period
    FROM exploded
    WHERE TO_DATE(created_at) < '2025-05-29'
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        key,
        value,
        created_at_period,
        QUARTER(created_at) created_at_quarter,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') resolved_key
    FROM filtered
    WHERE created_at >= TO_DATE('2025-03-02')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.customer_id,
        src.key,
        src.created_at_period,
        src.created_at_quarter,
        src.resolved_key,
        c.segment
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON src.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE c.country NOT IN ('SG', 'UK', 'TH')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.signup_date,
        p.credit_limit,
        p.age
    FROM enriched a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id <=> p.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    key,

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        amount * discount AS amount_times_discount,
        ADD_MONTHS(order_date, 1) AS order_date_plus_months
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.shipped_date >= s.order_date
        )
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.status,
        s.channel,
        s.amount,
        s.discount,
        s.shipping_fee,
        s.order_date_plus_months,
        x.carrier
    FROM eligible s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.carrier
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.shipped_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        order_date_plus_months,
        carrier,
        discount - shipping_fee AS discount_minus_shipping_fee
    FROM with_last
    WHERE carrier = 'FedEx'
),
eligible_orders AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.paid_at <= s.order_date_plus_months
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    channel,
    amount,
    discount,
    shipping_fee,
    order_date_plus_months,
    carrier,
    discount_minus_shipping_fee
FROM eligible_orders
ORDER BY status

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_limits) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM lines
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LOWER(plan) AS plan_lower
    FROM scored
    WHERE currency = 'THB'
),
valid_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        tier_value,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        plan_lower,
        ROUND(tier_value_dense_rank * 1.1, 2) AS adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank,
        CEIL(tier_value) AS tier_value_whole
    FROM valid
    WHERE tier_value = 68
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank,
        CEIL(adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank) AS adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole,
        tier_value - adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank AS tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM valid_price_tiers
    WHERE tier_value > 42
),
base_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole,
        tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole - tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank AS adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole_minus_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank,
        adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank / NULLIF(tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank, 0) AS adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM base
    WHERE adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank > 32
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, plan
    FROM base_price_tiers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id, plan
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency IN ('USD', 'EUR')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_price_tiers s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.plan = k.plan
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        plan,
        CASE WHEN tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank >= 76 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_tier,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'starter') AS starter_events,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'starter') AS starter_events_2,
        ROUND(SUM(adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_pro,
        ROUND(SUM(tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'basic' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_basic
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((plan, CASE WHEN tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank >= 76 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (plan))
)
SELECT
    tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_tier,
    starter_events,
    adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_pro,
    tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_basic
FROM grouped
ORDER BY starter_events, adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_pro DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_last())

lines = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

scored = lines.select("*", F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"))

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "THB")
    .withColumn("plan_lower", F.lower("plan"))

valid_price_tiers = (

    .filter(F.col("tier_value") == 68)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        "plan_lower",
        F.round((F.col("tier_value_dense_rank") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank"),
        F.ceil("tier_value").alias("tier_value_whole"),
    )
)

base = (
    valid_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") > 42)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank",
        F.ceil("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank").alias("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole"),

    )
)

base_price_tiers = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank") > 32)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        "adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole",
        "tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank",
        (F.col("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole") - F.col("tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank")).alias("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_whole_minus_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank"),
        (F.col("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank") / F.nullif("tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank", F.lit(0))).alias("adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank_per_tier_value_minus_adjusted_tier_value_dense_rank"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    base_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan")
    .intersect(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["USD", "EUR"]))
        .select("id", "plan")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base_price_tiers

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")

    .withColumn("event_type_page", F.concat("event_type", F.lit(", "), "page"))
