WITH kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, city
    FROM suppliers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IN ('Singapore', 'Bangkok', 'Berlin')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM suppliers s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.brand IN ('Acme', 'Globex')
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rating_cume_dist,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS rating_share,
        MIN(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_min_rating
    FROM eligible
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.price < 410
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    supplier_name,
    country,
    rating,
    rating_cume_dist,
    rating_share,
    country_min_rating,
    CASE WHEN country RLIKE '^(SG|US)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN country RLIKE '^(TH|JP)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS country_zone
FROM kept
ORDER BY country DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LOWER(status) AS status_lower
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= '2024-02-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_cost,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_cost,
        COUNT(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_cost
    FROM cleaned
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status_lower,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost DESC, id) AS cost_bucket,
        MAX(running_sum_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_max_running_sum_cost,
        LAG(cost, 1) OVER w_hist AS prev_cost
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE shipped_date < '2025-03-01'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id)
),
cleaned_shipments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAST(cost, cost_bucket) AS least_cost_cost_bucket,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', shipped_date) AS week_start,
    CASE WHEN least_cost_cost_bucket >= 82 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS least_cost_cost_bucket_tier,
    COUNT_IF(carrier = 'DHL') AS dhl_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(carrier)) AS carrier_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS distinct_carriers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'UPS' THEN order_id_max_running_sum_cost ELSE 0 END) AS ups_order_id_max_running_sum_cost,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM cleaned_shipments
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', shipped_date), CASE WHEN least_cost_cost_bucket >= 82 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', shipped_date)));

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") >= "2024-02-01")
    .withColumn("status_lower", F.lower("status"))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("cost").over(w).alias("running_max_cost"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w).alias("running_sum_cost"),
        F.count("cost").over(w).alias("running_count_cost"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") < "2025-03-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status_lower",
        F.ntile(5).over(w2).alias("cost_bucket"),
        F.max("running_sum_cost").over(w3).alias("order_id_max_running_sum_cost"),
        F.lag("cost", 1).over(w_hist).alias("prev_cost"),
    )
)

cleaned_shipments = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.least("cost", "cost_bucket").alias("least_cost_cost_bucket"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_shipments
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "shipped_date"))
    .withColumn("least_cost_cost_bucket_tier", F.when(F.col("least_cost_cost_bucket") >= 82, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["week_start", "least_cost_cost_bucket_tier"], ["week_start"]],
        "week_start",
        "least_cost_cost_bucket_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("carrier") == "DHL").alias("dhl_events"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("carrier")).alias("carrier_list"),

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "UPS", F.col("order_id_max_running_sum_cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("ups_order_id_max_running_sum_cost"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )

WITH flattened AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_prices) AS val
    FROM price_tiers
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN val >= 90 THEN 'High' WHEN val >= 25 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS val_tier
    FROM flattened
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-02-22'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(effective_from, 6) AS effective_from_plus_months
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE effective_from >= TO_DATE('2024-06-15')
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT currency, id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT currency, id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE effective_from > '2024-08-07'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.currency = k.currency AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        val
    FROM reconciled
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(val) AS total
    FOR currency IN ('EUR', 'USD', 'THB')
);

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT level
    FROM employees
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT level
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IN ('L2', 'L5', 'L3')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.level = k.level
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.full_name,
    s.email,
    s.dept_id,
    s.manager_id,
    s.job_title,
    s.salary,
    s.is_remote,
    s.level,
    CASE WHEN level RLIKE '^(L1|L4)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN level RLIKE '^(L2|L3)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'CORE' END AS level_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.dept_id = s.dept_id) AS min_employee_salary
FROM kept_rows s
ORDER BY min_employee_salary NULLS FIRST

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        INITCAP(TRIM(method)) AS method_title,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS method_clean
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IS DISTINCT FROM 'bank_transfer'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM cleaned
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        method_clean,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT method
    FROM islands
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT method
    FROM payments
    WHERE amount BETWEEN 420 AND 1330
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.method = k.method
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        LOWER(method) AS method_lower,
        CASE WHEN method IN ('cash', 'paypal') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS method_group
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE paid_at >= TO_DATE('2023-09-29')
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        method,
        paid_at,
        method_lower,
        method_group,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist AS amount_dense_rank,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_max_90d,
        COUNT(amount) OVER w_recent AS amount_count_7d
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY amount NULLS FIRST), w_recent AS (ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount_dense_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS amount_dense_rank_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_part AS amount_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount_count_7d NULLS FIRST) AS amount_count_7d_rank,
        ROUND(amount_max_90d / SUM(amount_max_90d) OVER (PARTITION BY method), 4) AS amount_max_90d_share
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY amount_dense_rank DESC)
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        WEEKOFYEAR(paid_at) AS paid_at_weekofyear,
        COALESCE(method, 'UNKNOWN') AS method_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    paid_at,
    method_lower,
    amount_dense_rank,
    amount_dense_rank_rank,
    amount_dense_rank_cume_dist,
    amount_count_7d_rank,
    amount_max_90d_share,
    paid_at_weekofyear,
    method_clean
FROM base
ORDER BY paid_at_weekofyear;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount_dense_rank").desc())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_count_7d").asc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("method")

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter((~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("bank_transfer"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        F.initcap(F.trim("method")).alias("method_title"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("N/A")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "method_clean",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    islands
    .select("method")
    .exceptAll(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("amount").between(420, 1330))
        .select("method")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    islands
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.method") == F.col("k.method")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    kept_rows
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-29"))) & F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        F.lower("method").alias("method_lower"),
        F.when(F.col("method").isin(["cash", "paypal"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("method_group"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "method_lower",
        "method_group",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_hist).alias("amount_dense_rank"),
        F.max("amount").over(w4).alias("amount_max_90d"),
        F.count("amount").over(w_recent).alias("amount_count_7d"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("amount_dense_rank_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("amount_dense_rank_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("amount_count_7d_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
    .withColumn("amount_max_90d_share", F.round((F.col("amount_max_90d") / F.sum("amount_max_90d").over(w9)), 4))
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull())

WITH kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT event_type
    FROM web_events
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT event_type
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_type = 'click'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM web_events s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.event_type = k.event_type
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT page, id
    FROM verified
    EXCEPT
    SELECT page, id
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page = '/home'
),
verified_web_events AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.page = k.page AND s.id = k.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        CONCAT(event_type, ' - ', page) AS event_type_page
    FROM verified_web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
      AND event_type IN ('purchase', 'add_to_cart')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.session_id,
        a.event_type_page,
        p.browser,
        p.device
    FROM cleaned a
    LEFT JOIN sessions p
        ON a.session_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        s.country,
        s.browser AS session_browser,
        s.device AS session_device
    FROM with_dims e
    LEFT JOIN sessions s
        ON e.session_id = s.id
),
with_dims_web_events AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        src.session_id,
        src.country,
        src.session_browser,
        src.session_device,
        d.browser AS session_browser_2,
        d.country AS session_country
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN sessions d
        ON src.session_id = d.id
    WHERE d.customer_id IN (22, 25, 36)
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT s.*, b.country AS session_country_2
    FROM with_dims_web_events s
    JOIN sessions b
        ON s.session_id = b.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    session_country_2,
    session_browser,
    COUNT_IF(session_device = 'desktop') AS desktop_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(session_country_2)) AS session_country_2_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'TH') AS th_rows,
    COUNT_IF(session_browser = 'Edge') AS edge_events,
    GROUPING(session_country_2) AS grouping_id
FROM joined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((session_country_2, session_browser), (session_country_2), ());
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

kept_keys = (
    df_web_events
    .select("event_type")
    .intersectAll(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_type") == "click")
        .select("event_type")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.event_type") == F.col("k.event_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

matched_keys = (
    verified
    .select("page", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("page") == "/home")
        .select("page", "id")
    )
)

verified_web_events = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    verified_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & F.col("event_type").isin(["purchase", "add_to_cart"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.concat("event_type", F.lit(" - "), "page").alias("event_type_page"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("p"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("a.session_id", "a.event_type_page", F.col("p.browser"), F.col("p.device"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("s.browser").alias("session_browser"),
        F.col("s.device").alias("session_device"),
    )
)

with_dims_web_events = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.customer_id").isin([22, 25, 36]))
    .select(
        "src.session_id",
        "src.country",
        "src.session_browser",
        "src.session_device",
        F.col("d.browser").alias("session_browser_2"),
        F.col("d.country").alias("session_country"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_dims_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.country").alias("session_country_2"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupingSets(
        [["session_country_2", "session_browser"], ["session_country_2"], []],
        "session_country_2",
        "session_browser",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("session_device") == "desktop").alias("desktop_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("session_country_2")).alias("session_country_2_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "TH", 1)).alias("th_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("session_browser") == "Edge").alias("edge_events"),
        F.grouping("session_country_2").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(supplier_name) supplier_name_lower,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(supplier_name, ' ', '') supplier_name_slug,
        COALESCE(city, 'UNKNOWN') city_filled
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IN ('Bangkok', 'London')
),
base_suppliers AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        rating,
        supplier_name_lower,
        supplier_name_slug,
        ROUND(rating * 1.07, 2) rating_adjusted
    FROM base
    WHERE city <> 'New York'
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        s.supplier_name_lower,
        s.rating_adjusted,
        top1.stock_qty,
        top1.product_launch_date
    FROM base_suppliers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty, c.launch_date AS product_launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        s.rating_adjusted,
        s.stock_qty,
        s.product_launch_date,
        x.product_launch_date_2
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date AS product_launch_date_2
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    country,
    rating_adjusted,
    stock_qty,
    product_launch_date,
    product_launch_date_2
FROM with_latest
ORDER BY rating_adjusted DESC NULLS FIRST;

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, attr_value
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        latency_ms,
        attr_value,
        SUBSTRING(k, 1, 4) AS k_prefix
    FROM lines
    WHERE log_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 06:00:00'
      AND k IS NOT NULL
),
valid AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(latency_ms * 1.07, 2) AS latency_ms_adjusted
    FROM filtered
    WHERE latency_ms < 1202
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(latency_ms_adjusted, 0) AS latency_ms_adjusted_rounded,
        COALESCE(latency_ms, 0) AS latency_ms_filled
    FROM valid
    WHERE latency_ms_adjusted BETWEEN 67 AND 76
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        latency_ms,
        attr_value,
        k_prefix,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_adjusted DESC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_adjusted_cume_dist,

    FROM cleaned

    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms_filled_dense_rank, 0.9) AS latency_ms_filled_dense_rank_p90,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(latency_ms, 0.95) AS latency_ms_p95,

    MAX(latency_ms) AS max_latency_ms
FROM with_windows

WITH with_dims AS (

        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.product_id,
        a.quantity,
        d.city
    FROM inventory a
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON a.store_id = d.id

    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_dims
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        LAG(quantity, 1) OVER w_part AS prev_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_avg_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY latest_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_6_prior
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY latest_rank, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        prev_quantity,
        quantity_avg_6_prior,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY prev_quantity DESC NULLS LAST) AS prev_quantity_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity_avg_6_prior) AS quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        s.region,
        s.opened_date
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN stores s
        ON src.store_id = s.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM joined
    EXCEPT
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 163 AND 233
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    quantity_avg_6_prior,
    quantity_avg_6_prior_dense_rank,
    region,
    opened_date
FROM reconciled

FROM enriched

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_limits) e AS tier_value
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        tier_value,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_min_tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_cume_dist,
        SUM(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_tier_value,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value ASC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rank
    FROM flattened
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(tier_value_rank / SUM(tier_value_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS tier_value_rank_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY plan_sum_tier_value ASC NULLS FIRST) AS plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM metrics
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_cume_dist_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS tier_value_rank_share_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY plan_sum_tier_value DESC) AS plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_rank_share DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_rank_share_dense_rank_2
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_rank_share DESC)
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_cume_dist DESC) AS tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank,
        COUNT(tier_value_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_count_tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM scored
    WHERE tier_value_cume_dist_2 >= 0.73
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from) AS year_start,
        CASE WHEN tier_value_cume_dist_2 >= 0.76 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'basic') AS basic_events,
        SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN tier_value_cume_dist ELSE 0 END) AS enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'starter') AS starter_events,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN tier_value_cume_dist ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank
    FROM scored_price_tiers
    GROUP BY year_start, tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier
)
SELECT
    year_start,
    tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier,
    basic_events,
    enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist,
    starter_events,
    enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank
FROM summary
ORDER BY tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier ASC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("plan_sum_tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rank_share").desc())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("plan_sum_tier_value").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_rank_share").desc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist").desc())
w9 = Window.partitionBy("year_start").orderBy(F.col("enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist").desc())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.explode("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "tier_value",
        F.min("tier_value").over(w).alias("plan_min_tier_value"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("tier_value").over(w).alias("plan_sum_tier_value"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("tier_value_rank"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("tier_value_rank") / F.sum("tier_value_rank").over(w)), 4).alias("tier_value_rank_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("tier_value_cume_dist_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_grp).alias("tier_value_rank_share_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("tier_value_rank_share_dense_rank_2"),
    )
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2") >= 0.73)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w8).alias("tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
        F.count("tier_value_cume_dist").over(w).alias("plan_count_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

summary = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "effective_from").alias("year_start"),
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2") >= 0.76, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "basic").alias("basic_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", F.col("tier_value_cume_dist")).otherwise(0)).alias("enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "starter").alias("starter_events"),
    )
    .withColumn("enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w9))
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "year_start",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier",
        "basic_events",
        "enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist",
        "starter_events",
        "enterprise_tier_value_cume_dist_percent_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist_2_tier").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CORR(shipping_fee, amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS corr_shipping_fee_amount,
        AVG(discount) OVER (ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_avg_3
    FROM orders
    WHERE store_id IN (19, 36)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(discount_avg_3) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_avg_discount_avg_3,
        CORR(shipping_fee, discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS corr_shipping_fee_discount
    FROM with_windows
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.product_id IS NOT NULL
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.order_date,
        s.channel,
        s.discount,
        s.discount_avg_3,
        s.customer_id_avg_discount_avg_3,
        x.payment_amount
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount AS payment_amount
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    c.country,
    src.channel,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(src.discount_avg_3) AS min_discount_avg_3,
    SUM(src.customer_id_avg_discount_avg_3) AS total_customer_id_avg_discount_avg_3
FROM latest_match src
INNER JOIN customers c ON src.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (c.country, src.channel)

    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT device_code, firmware
    FROM device_readings
    INTERSECT
    SELECT device_code, firmware
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE device_code NOT IN ('DV-03', 'DV-01', 'DV-04')
),
verified AS (

-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    device_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN pressure ELSE 0 END) AS dv_01_pressure,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-03' THEN 1 END) AS dv_03_count,

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        LAST_DAY(delivered_date) delivered_date_month_end,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 4) status_prefix
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
      AND status IN ('LOST', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'RETURNED')
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        delivered_date_month_end,
        status_prefix
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id) = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date_month_end NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY dedup_rank DESC, id) seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date_month_end, id) row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) row_seq_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dedup_rank DESC, id) seq_no_2
    FROM latest
)
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    delivered_date_month_end,
    status_prefix,
    event_seq,
    row_seq,
    row_seq_2,
    seq_no_2,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(RETURNED|DELIVERED)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN status RLIKE '^(IN_TRANSIT|LOST)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS status_zone
FROM metrics
ORDER BY status_zone DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time < s.started_at
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at) AS year_start,
    country,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 END) AS desktop_count,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_seen,
    MAX(started_at) AS ended_at,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at)) AS grouping_level
FROM kept
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at), country)
ORDER BY desktop_count DESC NULLS LAST;

        s.merchant,

metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        merchant,
        balance,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS account_id_max_amount,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY balance DESC NULLS FIRST) AS balance_cume_dist

    SELECT

        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount ASC NULLS FIRST) AS amount_dense_rank,

    FROM metrics
    WHERE merchant IN ('Starbucks', 'Grab', 'Amazon')
),
scored_transactions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        merchant,
        balance,
        account_id_max_amount,
        balance_cume_dist,
        amount_dense_rank,
        row_seq,
        AVG(account_id_max_amount) OVER w_running AS account_id_max_amount_avg_3,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY seq_no ASC NULLS FIRST) AS seq_no_dense_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_recent AS amount_bucket
    FROM scored

)

    amount_dense_rank,
    row_seq,
    account_id_max_amount_avg_3,

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN status IN ('LOST', 'DELIVERED') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS status_group,
        LAST_DAY(delivered_date) AS delivered_date_month_end,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT carrier, id
    FROM cleaned
    INTERSECT
    SELECT carrier, id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date <= '2023-06-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.carrier = k.carrier AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        status_group,
        delivered_date_month_end,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_rank,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS cost_share,
        MIN(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_min_cost,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS cost_share_2
    FROM reconciled
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.carrier,
        s.shipped_date,
        s.delivered_date,
        s.status,
        s.status_group,
        s.order_id_min_cost,
        d.status AS order_status,
        d.channel,
        d.amount
    FROM scored s
    JOIN orders d
        ON s.order_id <=> d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(order_id_min_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS channel_count_order_id_min_cost,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel), 4) AS amount_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_status ORDER BY order_id_min_cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS order_id_min_cost_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE YEAR(delivered_date) >= 2025
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date) AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        AVG(channel_count_order_id_min_cost) AS avg_channel_count_order_id_min_cost,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount, 0.9) AS amount_p90,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
        COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS distinct_channels
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', delivered_date)
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    row_count,
    avg_channel_count_order_id_min_cost,
    amount_p90,
    num_status,
    distinct_channels
FROM daily
ORDER BY quarter_start DESC;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CEIL(units) AS units_whole
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-08-10'
      AND revenue > 2900
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.product_id,
        e.sale_date,
        p.stock_qty,
        p.price
    FROM filtered e
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON e.product_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS price_avg_6,
        MIN(stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_min_stock_qty,
        SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_price
    FROM with_dims
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        sale_date,
        price_avg_6,
        store_id_min_stock_qty,
        LEAD(price, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY cumulative_price, id) AS next_price,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY cumulative_price NULLS FIRST) AS cumulative_price_percent_rank,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY price_avg_6, id) AS price_avg_6_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date, id) AS event_seq
    FROM metrics
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id_min_stock_qty,
        next_price,
        price_avg_6_bucket,
        event_seq,
        AVG(cumulative_price_percent_rank) OVER w_part AS last7_avg_cumulative_price_percent_rank,
        SUM(cumulative_price_percent_rank) OVER w_part AS last7_sum_cumulative_price_percent_rank,
        COUNT(cumulative_price_percent_rank) OVER w_part AS last7_count_cumulative_price_percent_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY next_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS event_seq_tier,
    CASE WHEN last7_avg_cumulative_price_percent_rank >= 0.8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS last7_avg_cumulative_price_percent_rank_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_price_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(last7_sum_cumulative_price_percent_rank, 0.95) AS last7_sum_cumulative_price_percent_rank_p95
FROM scored
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN last7_avg_cumulative_price_percent_rank >= 0.8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END);

sql: WITH unpacked AS (SELECT id, plan, effective_from, currency, tier_limits, tier_prices, discounts, ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price, AGGREGATE(tier_prices, 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price, SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits, ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices FROM price_tiers) SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY avg_tier_price, id) AS avg_tier_price_bucket, SUM(lowest_price) OVER (ORDER BY lowest_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_lowest_price, SUM(avg_tier_price) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_avg_tier_price FROM unpacked WHERE currency != 'EUR';

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("avg_tier_price", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("lowest_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

)

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        ADD_MONTHS(sale_date, 3) AS sale_date_plus_months,
        COALESCE(units, 0) AS units_filled
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id = 4
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        LEAD(units, 1) OVER w_grp AS next_units,
        RANK() OVER w_running AS units_rank,
        AVG(units) OVER w_ordered AS units_avg_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 2, 5, 6)
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date_plus_months, id), w_running AS (ORDER BY units DESC NULLS FIRST), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(units_avg_2 * 1.07, 2) AS units_avg_2_adjusted,
        QUARTER(sale_date) AS sale_date_quarter
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE units_avg_2 BETWEEN 16 AND 20
),
with_windows_store_sales AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        units,
        units_rank,
        units_avg_2,
        units_avg_2_adjusted,
        sale_date_quarter,
        AVG(units_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_avg_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS units_rank_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(units_avg_2) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date_quarter, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_units_avg_2,
        SUM(sale_date_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_sale_date_quarter
    FROM valid
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        units_rank,
        units_rank_avg_3
    FROM with_windows_store_sales
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY first_known_units_avg_2, id) = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT
    SELECT store_id, id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (3, 7, 10)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.id = k.id
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        store_id,
        CASE WHEN units_rank_avg_3 >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS units_rank_avg_3_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(units_rank), 2) AS avg_units_rank,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        MAX(units_rank_avg_3) AS max_units_rank_avg_3,
        GROUPING(store_id) AS gid
    FROM verified
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((store_id, CASE WHEN units_rank_avg_3 >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (store_id), ())
)
SELECT
    units_rank_avg_3_tier,
    avg_units_rank,
    num_rows,
    gid
FROM summary
ORDER BY num_rows DESC NULLS FIRST, units_rank_avg_3_tier;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("sale_date_plus_months", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("units").desc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units_avg_2", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date_quarter", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("first_known_units_avg_2", "id")

filtered = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("store_id") == 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        F.add_months("sale_date", 3).alias("sale_date_plus_months"),
        F.coalesce("units", F.lit(0)).alias("units_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 2, 5, 6]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        F.lead("units", 1).over(w_grp).alias("next_units"),
        F.rank().over(w_running).alias("units_rank"),
        F.avg("units").over(w_ordered).alias("units_avg_2"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("units_avg_2").between(16, 20))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("units_avg_2") * 1.07), 2).alias("units_avg_2_adjusted"),
        F.quarter("sale_date").alias("sale_date_quarter"),
    )
)

with_windows_store_sales = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "units",
        "units_rank",
        "units_avg_2",
        "units_avg_2_adjusted",
        "sale_date_quarter",
        F.avg("units_rank").over(w4).alias("units_rank_avg_3"),
        F.first("units_avg_2", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_units_avg_2"),
        F.sum("sale_date_quarter").over(w6).alias("cumulative_sale_date_quarter"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_windows_store_sales
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "store_id", "units_rank", "units_rank_avg_3")
)

kept_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([3, 7, 10]))
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

summary = (
    verified
    .withColumn("units_rank_avg_3_tier", F.when(F.col("units_rank_avg_3") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["store_id", "units_rank_avg_3_tier"], ["store_id"], []],
        "store_id",
        "units_rank_avg_3_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("units_rank"), 2).alias("avg_units_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.max("units_rank_avg_3").alias("max_units_rank_avg_3"),
        F.grouping("store_id").alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("units_rank_avg_3_tier", "avg_units_rank", "num_rows", "gid")
    .orderBy(F.col("num_rows").desc_nulls_first(), "units_rank_avg_3_tier")
)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_sqft,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sqft,
        MIN(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city) city_min_sqft
    FROM stores
),
metrics_stores AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        sqft,
        first_known_sqft,
        running_sqft,
        LEAD(first_known_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY running_sqft, id) next_first_known_sqft,
        LAG(running_sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY running_sqft, id) prev_running_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY running_sqft, id) event_seq
    FROM metrics
    WHERE sqft <= 5097
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        sqft,
        first_known_sqft,
        running_sqft,
        next_first_known_sqft,
        prev_running_sqft,
        event_seq,
        AVG(running_sqft) OVER w_hist region_avg_running_sqft,
        MIN(prev_running_sqft) OVER w_hist region_min_prev_running_sqft,
        SUM(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY next_first_known_sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_sqft
    FROM metrics_stores
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY region)
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(region_avg_running_sqft) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_sqft, id) next_region_avg_running_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_sqft, id) next_sqft,
        LAG(sqft) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_sqft, id) prev_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_known_sqft, id) event_seq_2,
        LEAD(region_min_prev_running_sqft, 2) OVER (ORDER BY region_avg_running_sqft, id) next_region_min_prev_running_sqft
    FROM enriched
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(region_avg_running_sqft, 2) OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id) next_region_avg_running_sqft_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY event_seq_2 DESC NULLS LAST) event_seq_2_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(next_region_min_prev_running_sqft, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY running_sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_running_sqft DESC, id) seq_no
    FROM scored
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft >= 74209 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft_tier,
    CASE WHEN event_seq_2_cume_dist >= 0.81 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_2_cume_dist_tier,
    seq_no,
    ROUND(AVG(running_sqft), 2) AS avg_running_sqft,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
    MAX(next_region_avg_running_sqft) AS max_next_region_avg_running_sqft
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft >= 74209 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN event_seq_2_cume_dist >= 0.81 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, seq_no)
ORDER BY avg_running_sqft NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("running_sqft", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("region")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("next_first_known_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy("first_known_sqft", "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy("region_avg_running_sqft", "id")
w9 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq_2").desc_nulls_last())
w11 = Window.orderBy("running_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_running_sqft").desc(), "id")

metrics = (
    df_stores
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w2).alias("running_sqft"),
        F.min("sqft").over(w3).alias("city_min_sqft"),
    )
)

metrics_stores = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("sqft") <= 5097)
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft",
        "first_known_sqft",
        "running_sqft",
        F.lead("first_known_sqft").over(w4).alias("next_first_known_sqft"),
        F.lag("running_sqft").over(w4).alias("prev_running_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics_stores
    .select(
        "id",
        "sqft",
        "first_known_sqft",
        "running_sqft",
        "next_first_known_sqft",
        "prev_running_sqft",
        "event_seq",
        F.avg("running_sqft").over(w_hist).alias("region_avg_running_sqft"),
        F.min("prev_running_sqft").over(w_hist).alias("region_min_prev_running_sqft"),
        F.sum("sqft").over(w6).alias("cumulative_sqft"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("region_avg_running_sqft").over(w7).alias("next_region_avg_running_sqft"),
        F.lead("sqft").over(w7).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.lag("sqft").over(w7).alias("prev_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.lead("region_min_prev_running_sqft", 2).over(w8).alias("next_region_min_prev_running_sqft"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("region_avg_running_sqft", 2).over(w9).alias("next_region_avg_running_sqft_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w10).alias("event_seq_2_cume_dist"),
        F.last("next_region_min_prev_running_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w11).alias("last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w12).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft") >= 74209, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("last_known_next_region_min_prev_running_sqft_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("event_seq_2_cume_dist") >= 0.81, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_2_cume_dist_tier"),
        "seq_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("running_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_running_sqft"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.max("next_region_avg_running_sqft").alias("max_next_region_avg_running_sqft"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_running_sqft").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS(',', region, city) AS region_city_key,
        COALESCE(region, 'DIRECT') AS region_clean
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT s.*, x.inventory_last_restock
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.last_restock AS inventory_last_restock
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.region,
        s.opened_date,
        s.sqft,
        s.inventory_last_restock,
        latest.store_sale_revenue,
        latest.store_sale_units
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.revenue AS store_sale_revenue, c.units AS store_sale_units
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        sqft,
        store_sale_revenue,
        store_sale_units
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY store_sale_units DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM with_latest
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN store_sale_revenue >= 3200 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS store_sale_revenue_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'South') AS south_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN 1 END) AS east_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'West' THEN store_sale_units ELSE 0 END) AS west_store_sale_units
FROM deduped
GROUP BY 1
HAVING east_count < 1000
ORDER BY south_rows;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.last_restock").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.sale_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("store_sale_units").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws(",", "region", "city").alias("region_city_key"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("region_clean"),
    )
)

latest_match = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.last_restock").alias("inventory_last_restock"))
)

with_latest = (
    latest_match
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.region",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.sqft",
        "s.inventory_last_restock",
        F.col("c.revenue").alias("store_sale_revenue"),
        F.col("c.units").alias("store_sale_units"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "region", "sqft", "store_sale_revenue", "store_sale_units")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("store_sale_revenue") >= 3200, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("store_sale_revenue_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "South", 1)).alias("south_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "East", 1)).alias("east_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "West", F.col("store_sale_units")).otherwise(0)).alias("west_store_sale_units"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("east_count") < 1000)
    .orderBy("south_rows")
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        supplier_id,
        MIN(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS brand_min_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS seq_no,
        ROUND(price / SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand), 4) AS price_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist_2 AS row_seq
    FROM products
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC), w_hist_2 AS (ORDER BY stock_qty DESC, id ASC)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_name,
    s.category,
    s.supplier_id,
    s.brand_min_price,
    s.seq_no,
    s.price_share,
    CASE WHEN category RLIKE '^(Electronics|Home)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN category RLIKE '^(Sports|Books)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS category_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(x.price) FROM products x WHERE x.supplier_id = s.supplier_id) AS max_product_price
FROM with_windows s
ORDER BY supplier_id DESC

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("brand", "category")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("price", "id")

        F.row_number().over(w_hist_2).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .join(price_by_supplier_id, on="supplier_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote
    FROM employees
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.dept_id,
        s.hire_date,
        d.budget,
        d.location
    FROM ranked s
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON s.dept_id = d.id
    WHERE d.dept_name IN ('Legal', 'Sales', 'Marketing')
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date DESC, id) = 1
),
enriched_employees AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, location ORDER BY hire_date, id) AS next_budget,
        SUM(budget) OVER w_running AS running_budget
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY location, dept_id ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    location,
    measure,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        next_budget,
        budget
    FROM enriched_employees
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (next_budget, budget)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "location").orderBy("hire_date", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_id").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

ranked = (
    df_employees
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "dept_id", "manager_id", "salary", "hire_date", "is_remote")
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.dept_name").isin(["Legal", "Sales", "Marketing"]))
    .select("s.id", "s.dept_id", "s.hire_date", F.col("d.budget"), F.col("d.location"))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

enriched_employees = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("budget", 1).over(w3).alias("next_budget"),
        F.sum("budget").over(w_running).alias("running_budget"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_employees
    .select("id", "location", "next_budget", "budget")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "location"],
        values=["next_budget", "budget"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(country) AS country_length,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), started_at) AS days_since_started_at,
        COALESCE(country, 'OTHER') AS resolved_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > DATE '2023-08-28'
      AND country IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'TH'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        country,
        days_since_started_at,
        resolved_country,
        SUM(days_since_started_at) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_days_since_started_at,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY country, browser ORDER BY country_length DESC, id ASC) AS country_length_bucket
    FROM valid
    WHERE days_since_started_at BETWEEN 39 AND 73
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        days_since_started_at,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY cumulative_days_since_started_at DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(country_length_bucket, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, country ORDER BY country_length_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country_length_bucket
    FROM enriched
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY last_known_country_length_bucket ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        AVG(last_known_country_length_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY days_since_started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior
    FROM with_windows
),
enriched_sessions_2 AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        LAG(last_known_country_length_bucket, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist ASC, id ASC) AS prev_last_known_country_length_bucket,
        LAG(last_known_country_length_bucket, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior ASC, id ASC) AS prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2
    FROM enriched_sessions
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist >= 0.86 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier,
    seq_no,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS seq_no_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2_quartiles,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist >= 0.86 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS gid
FROM enriched_sessions_2
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist >= 0.86 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, seq_no), (CASE WHEN cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist >= 0.86 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), ())

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("days_since_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "browser").orderBy(F.col("country_length").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "country").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_days_since_started_at").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "country").orderBy("country_length_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("last_known_country_length_bucket", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("days_since_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior").desc(), "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior", "id")

valid = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.lit("2023-08-28").cast("date")) & (F.col("country").eqNullSafe(F.lit("TH"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length("country").alias("country_length"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "started_at").alias("days_since_started_at"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_country"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("days_since_started_at").between(39, 73))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "country",
        "days_since_started_at",
        "resolved_country",
        F.sum("days_since_started_at").over(w).alias("cumulative_days_since_started_at"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w2).alias("country_length_bucket"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "days_since_started_at",
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist"),
        F.last("country_length_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("last_known_country_length_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_sessions = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .withColumn("last_known_country_length_bucket_avg_3_prior", F.avg("last_known_country_length_bucket").over(w6))
)

enriched_sessions_2 = (
    enriched_sessions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w7).alias("running_seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w8).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lag("last_known_country_length_bucket", 1).over(w9).alias("prev_last_known_country_length_bucket"),
        F.lag("last_known_country_length_bucket", 1).over(w10).alias("prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_sessions_2
    .withColumn("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist") >= 0.86, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier", "seq_no"], ["cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier"], []],
        "cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier",
        "seq_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_last_known_country_length_bucket_2_quartiles"),
        F.grouping("cumulative_days_since_started_at_cume_dist_tier").alias("gid"),
    )
)

sql: WITH with_prev AS (SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at FROM sessions), flagged AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag FROM with_prev), sessions_sessions AS (SELECT id, browser, started_at, country, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no FROM flagged) SELECT CASE WHEN session_no >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_no_tier, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at) AS year_start, COUNT(*) AS num_rows, COUNT_IF(country = 'US') AS us_events, AVG(session_no) FILTER (WHERE country = 'DE') AS de_avg_session_no, GROUPING(CASE WHEN session_no >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END) AS grouping_level FROM sessions_sessions GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN session_no >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', started_at)) ORDER BY year_start DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_prev = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .withColumn("session_no_tier", F.when(F.col("session_no") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("year_start", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "started_at"))
    .rollup("session_no_tier", "year_start")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count_if(F.col("country") == "US").alias("us_events"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", F.col("session_no"))).alias("de_avg_session_no"),
        F.grouping("session_no_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc())
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        channel,
        INITCAP(TRIM(channel)) channel_title,
        discount - shipping_fee discount_minus_shipping_fee,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') channel_filled
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_date >= DATE '2023-08-04'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_id,
        s.channel_filled,
        x.payment_status,
        x.payment_method
    FROM valid s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status AS payment_status, c.method AS payment_method
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.paid_at <= s.order_date
            ORDER BY c.paid_at DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.sqft,
        p.city
    FROM with_latest e
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON e.store_id = p.id
),
enriched_orders AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_id,
        s.channel_filled,
        s.payment_status,
        s.city,
        p2.opened_date,
        p2.city AS store_city
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN stores p2
        ON s.store_id = p2.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        channel_filled,
        city,
        FIRST_VALUE(store_city, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_city ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_store_city,
        LAST_VALUE(payment_status) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_payment_status,
        FIRST_VALUE(city, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY payment_status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_city
    FROM enriched_orders
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LOWER(city) city_lower
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE store_id IN (25, 34)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.first_known_store_city,
        a.city_lower,
        b.city AS store_city,
        b.region
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN stores b
        ON a.store_id = b.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    store_city,
    region,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(store_city)) AS num_store_cities,
    COUNT_IF(region = 'Central') AS central_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS region_list,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(store_city)) AS num_store_cities_2,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM with_dims
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((store_city, region), (store_city), ())
