w4 = Window.partitionBy("payment_status").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-04").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        F.initcap(F.trim("channel")).alias("channel_title"),
        (F.col("discount") - F.col("shipping_fee")).alias("discount_minus_shipping_fee"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("N/A")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.paid_at") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.channel_filled",
        F.col("c.status").alias("payment_status"),
        F.col("c.method").alias("payment_method"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_latest
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.sqft"), F.col("p.city"))
)

enriched_orders = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p2"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("p2.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.store_id",
        "s.channel_filled",
        "s.payment_status",
        "s.city",
        F.col("p2.opened_date"),
        F.col("p2.city").alias("store_city"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched_orders
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "channel_filled",
        "city",
        F.first("store_city", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_store_city"),
        F.last("payment_status", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_payment_status"),
        F.first("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_city"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([25, 34]))
    .withColumn("city_lower", F.lower("city"))
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.store_id",
        "a.first_known_store_city",
        "a.city_lower",
        F.col("b.city").alias("store_city"),
        F.col("b.region"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupingSets(
        [["store_city", "region"], ["store_city"], []],
        "store_city",
        "region",
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("store_city")).alias("num_store_cities"),
        F.count_if(F.col("region") == "Central").alias("central_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("region")).alias("region_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("store_city")).alias("num_store_cities_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
)

sql:
WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        country,
        signup_date,
        age,
        LAST_VALUE(city) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_city,
        MIN(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_min_credit_limit
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment = 'SMB'
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT s.*, top1.account_account_type
    FROM with_windows s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.account_type AS account_account_type
            FROM accounts c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.opened_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY account_account_type, country ORDER BY city_min_credit_limit, id) AS city_min_credit_limit_bucket,
        LEAD(city_min_credit_limit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_account_type ORDER BY city_min_credit_limit, id) AS next_city_min_credit_limit,
        AVG(city_min_credit_limit) OVER (ORDER BY city_min_credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS city_min_credit_limit_avg_2
    FROM with_last
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country, account_account_type ORDER BY city_min_credit_limit DESC NULLS LAST) AS dedup_rank
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.email,
        s.country,
        s.signup_date,
        s.age,
        s.city_min_credit_limit,
        s.account_account_type,
        s.city_min_credit_limit_bucket,
        s.next_city_min_credit_limit,
        top1.subscription_plan,
        top1.status
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.plan AS subscription_plan, c.status
            FROM subscriptions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.monthly_fee DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
enriched_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(city_min_credit_limit_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY age, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_city_min_credit_limit_bucket,
        SUM(city_min_credit_limit) OVER w_recent AS cumulative_city_min_credit_limit,
        ROUND(next_city_min_credit_limit / SUM(next_city_min_credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_plan, status), 4) AS next_city_min_credit_limit_share
    FROM with_latest
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY subscription_plan ORDER BY city_min_credit_limit_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    email,
    country,
    signup_date,
    age,
    city_min_credit_limit,
    account_account_type,
    city_min_credit_limit_bucket,
    next_city_min_credit_limit,
    CASE WHEN account_account_type RLIKE '^(SAVINGS|LOAN)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'CORE' END AS account_account_type_zone
FROM enriched_customers;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.opened_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_account_type", "country").orderBy("city_min_credit_limit", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_account_type").orderBy("city_min_credit_limit", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("city_min_credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("country", "account_account_type").orderBy(F.col("city_min_credit_limit").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.monthly_fee").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w9 = Window.orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan").orderBy("city_min_credit_limit_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan", "status")

with_windows = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("segment") == "SMB")
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "age",
        F.last("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("last_known_city"),
        F.min("credit_limit").over(w2).alias("city_min_credit_limit"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.account_type").alias("account_account_type"))
)

enriched = (
    with_last
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w4).alias("city_min_credit_limit_bucket"),
        F.lead("city_min_credit_limit", 1).over(w5).alias("next_city_min_credit_limit"),
        F.avg("city_min_credit_limit").over(w6).alias("city_min_credit_limit_avg_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_latest = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.email",
        "s.country",
        "s.signup_date",
        "s.age",
        "s.city_min_credit_limit",
        "s.account_account_type",
        "s.city_min_credit_limit_bucket",
        "s.next_city_min_credit_limit",
        F.col("c.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("c.status"),
    )
)

enriched_customers = (
    with_latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("city_min_credit_limit_bucket").over(w9).alias("cumulative_city_min_credit_limit_bucket"),
        F.sum("city_min_credit_limit").over(w_recent).alias("cumulative_city_min_credit_limit"),
        F.round((F.col("next_city_min_credit_limit") / F.sum("next_city_min_credit_limit").over(w11)), 4).alias("next_city_min_credit_limit_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_customers
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "age",
        "city_min_credit_limit",
        "account_account_type",
        "city_min_credit_limit_bucket",
        "next_city_min_credit_limit",
        F.when(F.col("account_account_type").rlike("^(SAVINGS|LOAN)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("CORE").alias("account_account_type_zone"),
    )
)

sql: WITH scored AS (SELECT id, supplier_name, LAG(rating, 2, 0) OVER w_grp AS prev_rating, ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS rating_share, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating NULLS FIRST) AS rating_rank, AVG(rating) OVER w_ordered AS rating_avg_3, NTILE(3) OVER w_grp AS rating_bucket FROM suppliers WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT id, supplier_name, prev_rating, rating_share, rating_avg_3, rating_bucket FROM scored ORDER BY prev_rating DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("rating").asc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

scored = (
    df_suppliers
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        F.lag("rating", 2, 0).over(w_grp).alias("prev_rating"),
        F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w2)), 4).alias("rating_share"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("rating_rank"),
        F.avg("rating").over(w_ordered).alias("rating_avg_3"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_grp).alias("rating_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "prev_rating",
        "rating_share",
        "rating_avg_3",
        "rating_bucket",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("prev_rating").desc())
)

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN merchant IN ('Starbucks', 'Shell') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS merchant_group,
        CEIL(amount) AS amount_whole,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'N/A') AS resolved_merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-10-28 03:00:00'
      AND merchant IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, txn_type ORDER BY amount_whole, id) AS next_amount,
        LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, txn_type ORDER BY amount_whole, id) AS prev_amount,
        LAG(amount_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, txn_type ORDER BY amount_whole, id) AS prev_amount_whole,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, txn_type ORDER BY amount_whole, id) AS seq_no,
        COUNT(amount) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_count_30d
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(amount_whole) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY prev_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_amount_whole,
        COUNT(prev_amount_whole) OVER w_recent AS prev_amount_whole_count_7d,
        LAG(next_amount, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount_whole, id) AS prev_next_amount,
        SUM(amount_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY next_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount_whole
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS prev_txn_time
    FROM enriched
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_prev
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount >= 4100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN amount_whole >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_whole_tier,
    COUNT_IF(txn_type = 'REFUND') AS refund_events,
    ROUND(AVG(is_new_burst), 2) AS avg_is_new_burst
FROM sessions_transactions
GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount >= 4100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', txn_time), CASE WHEN amount_whole >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
HAVING ROUND(AVG(is_new_burst), 2) >= 0
ORDER BY activity_month DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("amount_whole", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("prev_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount_whole", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy("next_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-28 03:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("merchant_group", F.when(F.col("merchant").isin(["Starbucks", "Shell"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("amount_whole", F.ceil("amount"))
    .withColumn("resolved_merchant", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("N/A")))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount").over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_amount_whole", F.lag("amount_whole").over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("amount_count_30d", F.count("amount").over(w2))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("last_known_amount_whole", F.last("amount_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("prev_amount_whole_count_7d", F.count("prev_amount_whole").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("prev_next_amount", F.lag("next_amount", 2).over(w5))
    .withColumn("cumulative_amount_whole", F.sum("amount_whole").over(w6))
)

with_prev = enriched.withColumn("prev_txn_time", F.lag("txn_time").over(w7))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_txn_time").isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.col("prev_txn_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = with_gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w8))

result = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 4100, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "txn_time").alias("activity_month"),
        F.when(F.col("amount_whole") >= 78, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_whole_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("txn_type") == "REFUND").alias("refund_events"),
        F.round(F.avg("is_new_burst"), 2).alias("avg_is_new_burst"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_is_new_burst") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").desc())
)

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM departments
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget >= 3357000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS budget_tier,
    MIN(budget) AS min_budget,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(budget, 0.95) AS budget_p95,
    COUNT(DISTINCT location) AS distinct_locations,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM ranked

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS attr_key, v
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM exploded
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        RANK() OVER w_part AS status_code_high_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_grp AS is_flagged_bucket
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS FIRST), w_grp AS (ORDER BY is_flagged DESC, id, attr_key)
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        status_code_high_rank,
        is_flagged_bucket
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high_rank DESC NULLS LAST, id, attr_key) = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        status_code_high_rank,
        is_flagged_bucket,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY is_flagged_bucket DESC, id, attr_key) AS is_flagged_bucket_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY is_flagged_bucket, id, attr_key) AS event_seq
    FROM deduped
)
SELECT
    attr_key,
    ROUND(SUM(is_flagged_bucket_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN attr_key = 'region' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS is_flagged_bucket_bucket_per_region,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attr_key = 'version') AS version_rows
FROM scored
GROUP BY attr_key
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high_rank").desc_nulls_last(), "id", "attr_key")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged_bucket").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("is_flagged_bucket", "id", "attr_key")

exploded = df_app_logs.select("id", "status_code", F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"))

flattened_attrs = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        F.rank().over(w_part).alias("status_code_high_rank"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_grp).alias("is_flagged_bucket"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "attr_key", "status_code_high_rank", "is_flagged_bucket")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "status_code_high_rank",
        "is_flagged_bucket",
        F.ntile(3).over(w4).alias("is_flagged_bucket_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy("attr_key")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("is_flagged_bucket_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "region", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("is_flagged_bucket_bucket_per_region"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(device) device_upper,
        COALESCE(browser, 'UNKNOWN') browser_clean
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND HOUR(started_at) BETWEEN 9 AND 13
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT country, device
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT country, device
    FROM sessions
    WHERE device = 'mobile'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.country = k.country AND s.device = k.device
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN country = 'DE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_de,
        COALESCE(country, 'OTHER') country_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE device = 'mobile'
      AND started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-08-02 17:00:00'
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND TO_DATE(x.event_time) >= '2024-11-01'
        )
)
SELECT
    device,
    browser,
    started_at,
    country,
    browser_clean,
    is_de,
    country_filled
FROM kept
ORDER BY started_at NULLS FIRST

cleaned = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.hour("started_at").between(9, 13))
    .withColumn("device_upper", F.upper("device"))
    .withColumn("browser_clean", F.coalesce("browser", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

matched_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("country", "device")
    .subtract(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.col("device") == "mobile")
        .select("country", "device")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")) & (F.col("s.device") == F.col("k.device")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    verified
    .filter((F.col("device") == "mobile") & (F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-08-02 17:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("is_de", F.when(F.col("country") == "DE", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("country_filled", F.coalesce("country", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

eligible = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_time") <= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")

kept = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.to_date(F.col("x.event_time")) >= "2024-11-01"), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept
    .select(
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "browser_clean",
        "is_de",
        "country_filled",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("started_at").asc_nulls_first())

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        LEAD(discount_pct, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS next_discount_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_dense_rank,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_pct_avg_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER w_recent AS running_discount_pct
    FROM promotions
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY ends_on, id), w_recent AS (ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        discount_pct_avg_2 * discount_pct_dense_rank AS discount_pct_avg_2_times_discount_pct_dense_rank,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS channel_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE ends_on > TO_DATE('2023-06-02')
      AND channel IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS channel_sum_event_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_discount_pct) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_discount_pct
    FROM cleaned
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel = pr.channel
       AND s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND s.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY channel_sum_event_seq DESC NULLS FIRST, id, promo_id) AS rn
        FROM matched
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    promo_id,
    promo_code,
    kpi,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_id,
        promo_code,
        next_discount_pct,
        discount_pct_avg_2_times_discount_pct_dense_rank
    FROM ranked
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR kpi IN (next_discount_pct, discount_pct_avg_2_times_discount_pct_dense_rank)
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("ends_on", "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w7 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("channel_sum_event_seq").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "promo_id")

metrics = (
    df_promotions
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.lead("discount_pct", 1).over(w).alias("next_discount_pct"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("discount_pct_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w3).alias("discount_pct_avg_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(w_recent).alias("running_discount_pct"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-02"))) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("discount_pct_avg_2_times_discount_pct_dense_rank", (F.col("discount_pct_avg_2") * F.col("discount_pct_dense_rank")))
    .withColumn("channel_clean", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("channel_sum_event_seq", F.sum("event_seq").over(w6))
    .withColumn("first_known_running_discount_pct", F.first("running_discount_pct", ignorenulls=True).over(w7))
)

matched = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("pr.channel")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("s.ends_on") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(

    )

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        TRIM(email) AS clean_email
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-04-12'
      AND level IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN job_title IN ('Intern', 'Engineer') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS job_title_group
    FROM base
    WHERE LENGTH(full_name) < 5
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        job_title,
        job_title_group,
        LAG(salary) OVER w_hist AS prev_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WHERE is_remote
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date, id)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY event_seq DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        job_title,
        CASE WHEN prev_salary >= 159000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS prev_salary_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(prev_salary), 2) AS avg_prev_salary,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list,
        COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) AS distinct_job_titles,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) DESC) AS distinct_job_titles_dense_rank
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY job_title, CASE WHEN prev_salary >= 159000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT
    job_title,
    prev_salary_tier,
    avg_prev_salary,
    job_title_list,
    distinct_job_titles,
    CASE WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Director|Analyst)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN job_title RLIKE '^(Engineer|Manager)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS job_title_zone
FROM daily
ORDER BY job_title DESC;

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        price + stock_qty as price_plus_stock_qty,
        add_months(launch_date, 1) as launch_date_plus_months
    from products
    where cost between 500 and 580
      and launch_date > date '2023-10-02'
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from valid s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from order_items ch
            where ch.product_id = s.id
              and ch.unit_price < 160
        )
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, datediff(launch_date, launch_date_plus_months) as days_launch_date_plus_months_to_launch_date
    from not_flagged
    where launch_date > date '2023-03-29'
      and brand is not null
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select s.*, top1.sale_date
    from base s

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS duration_sec_avg_30d,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS next_duration_sec,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY page, event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS next_duration_sec_2,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS seq_no
    FROM web_events
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_windows
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
flagged_2 AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst_2
    FROM islands
),
sessions_web_events AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst_2) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id_2
    FROM flagged_2
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        next_duration_sec,
        running_duration_sec,
        island_id_2,
        AVG(next_duration_sec_2) OVER w_grp AS last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2,
        SUM(next_duration_sec_2) OVER w_grp AS last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2,
        COUNT(next_duration_sec_2) OVER w_grp AS last4_count_next_duration_sec_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY island_id DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM sessions_web_events
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY next_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(next_duration_sec, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY island_id_2, id) AS prev_next_duration_sec,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2 DESC, id) AS last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2_bucket
    FROM metrics
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        next_duration_sec,
        island_id_2,
        last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2,
        last4_count_next_duration_sec_2,
        row_seq,
        prev_next_duration_sec,
        last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2_bucket,
        COALESCE(running_duration_sec, 0) AS running_duration_sec_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2 < 200
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        island_id_2,
        last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2,
        last4_count_next_duration_sec_2,
        row_seq,
        running_duration_sec_filled,
        CEIL(prev_next_duration_sec) AS prev_next_duration_sec_whole,
        ROUND(last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2 * 0.85, 2) AS last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2_scaled,
        COALESCE(page, 'NONE') AS resolved_page
    FROM valid
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    page,
    SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN prev_next_duration_sec_whole ELSE 0 END) AS home_prev_next_duration_sec_whole,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(page)) AS page_list,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq), 2) AS avg_row_seq
FROM base
GROUP BY page
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/home' THEN prev_next_duration_sec_whole ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY avg_row_seq DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page", "event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("next_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("island_id").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("island_id_2", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2").desc(), "id")

with_windows = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.avg("duration_sec").over(w).alias("duration_sec_avg_30d"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1).over(w2).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1, 0).over(w3).alias("next_duration_sec_2"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w4).alias("running_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w6).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w6) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w7))

flagged_2 = (
    islands
    .withColumn("is_new_burst_2", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w6) > F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = flagged_2.withColumn("island_id_2", F.sum("is_new_burst_2").over(w7))

metrics = (
    sessions_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "next_duration_sec",
        "running_duration_sec",
        "island_id_2",

        F.sum("next_duration_sec_2").over(w_grp).alias("last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2"),
        F.count("next_duration_sec_2").over(w_grp).alias("last4_count_next_duration_sec_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("prev_next_duration_sec", F.lag("next_duration_sec", 2).over(w10))
    .withColumn("last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w11))
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2") < 200)
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "next_duration_sec",
        "island_id_2",
        "last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2",
        "last4_count_next_duration_sec_2",
        "row_seq",
        "prev_next_duration_sec",
        "last4_avg_next_duration_sec_2_bucket",
        F.coalesce("running_duration_sec", F.lit(0)).alias("running_duration_sec_filled"),
    )
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "island_id_2",
        "last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2",
        "last4_count_next_duration_sec_2",
        "row_seq",
        "running_duration_sec_filled",
        F.ceil("prev_next_duration_sec").alias("prev_next_duration_sec_whole"),
        F.round((F.col("last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2") * 0.85), 2).alias("last4_sum_next_duration_sec_2_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_page"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .groupBy("page")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", F.col("prev_next_duration_sec_whole")).otherwise(0)).alias("home_prev_next_duration_sec_whole"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("page")).alias("page_list"),
        F.round(F.avg("row_seq"), 2).alias("avg_row_seq"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("home_prev_next_duration_sec_whole") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_row_seq").desc_nulls_last())
)

    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,

        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER w_hist AS monthly_fee_avg_2,

        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_monthly_fee_2
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

metrics AS (

        id,
        customer_id,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee_avg_2 ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_monthly_fee_2 ASC, id ASC) AS running_monthly_fee_2_bucket

    from subscriptions

    from matched
),

    -- Non-equi join on a validity window

        sub.id as subscription_id_2,

        sub.monthly_fee

    MIN(reading_ts) AS started_at,

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("temp_c")
w2 = Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts_period").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("reading_ts_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date")) & (F.col("pressure") <= 1023))
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        F.round("pressure", 1).alias("pressure_rounded"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.to_date("reading_ts") < "2024-12-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "pressure_rounded",
        (F.col("humidity") - F.col("pressure_rounded")).alias("humidity_minus_pressure_rounded"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 05:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "pressure_rounded",
        F.date_trunc("week", "reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_period"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        "reading_ts_period",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("temp_c_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("humidity", 2).over(w2).alias("next_humidity"),
        F.first("temp_c", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("first_known_temp_c"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("pressure_percent_rank"),
        F.first("humidity", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("first_known_humidity"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "reading_ts_period",
        "first_known_temp_c",
        "first_known_humidity",
        F.max("pressure_percent_rank").over(w5).alias("pressure_percent_rank_max_7d"),
        F.last("temp_c_percent_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_temp_c_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("temp_c") >= 38.5, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("temp_c_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts_period"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        F.min("reading_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.min("reading_ts_period").alias("started_at_2"),
        F.max("reading_ts").alias("last_reading_ts"),
        F.round(F.avg("temp_c"), 2).alias("avg_temp_c"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

WITH scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER w_part AS amount_sum_30d,
        LEAD(amount, 2) OVER w_running AS next_amount,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id) AS amount_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(merchant) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_recent AS first_known_merchant,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount, id) AS amount_bucket_2
    FROM transactions
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_running AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id), w_recent AS (ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.account_id,
    s.txn_type,
    s.merchant,
    s.next_amount,
    s.amount_bucket,
    s.first_known_merchant,
    CASE WHEN merchant RLIKE '^(Starbucks|7-Eleven)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS merchant_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(t2.amount) FROM transactions t2 WHERE t2.account_id = s.account_id) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM scored s;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")
amount_by_account_id = df_transactions.groupBy("account_id").agg(F.max("amount").alias("max_transaction_amount"))

scored = (
    df_transactions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount").over(w_part).alias("amount_sum_30d"),
        F.lead("amount", 2).over(w_running).alias("next_amount"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w3).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.first("merchant", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("first_known_merchant"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w5).alias("amount_bucket_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .join(amount_by_account_id, on="account_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "merchant",
        "next_amount",
        "amount_bucket",
        "first_known_merchant",
        F.when(F.col("merchant").rlike("^(Starbucks|7-Eleven)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("merchant_zone"),
        F.col("max_transaction_amount"),

)

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id) AS store_id_avg_revenue,
        ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id), 4) AS revenue_share
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE revenue IS NOT NULL
),
metrics_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        revenue,
        store_id_avg_revenue,
        revenue_share,
        FIRST_VALUE(revenue) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS first_known_revenue,
        ROUND(units / SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id), 4) AS units_share,
        ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id), 4) AS revenue_share_2,
        RANK() OVER w_grp AS store_id_avg_revenue_rank
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY store_id_avg_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY store_id_avg_revenue DESC)
),
metrics_store_sales_2 AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        revenue,
        store_id_avg_revenue,
        units_share,
        revenue_share_2,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_share_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_avg_3,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY store_id_avg_revenue_rank, id) AS store_id_avg_revenue_rank_bucket
    FROM metrics_store_sales
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM metrics_store_sales_2
    EXCEPT
    SELECT store_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE units >= 23
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics_store_sales_2 s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM reconciled
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT store_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (1, 2, 8, 9)
),
reconciled_store_sales AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.revenue,
        e.store_id_avg_revenue,
        e.revenue_share_2,
        e.revenue_avg_3,
        p.city
    FROM reconciled_store_sales e
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON e.store_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_rows,
    AVG(revenue_share_2) AS avg_revenue_share_2,
    SUM(revenue_avg_3) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_total_revenue_avg_3,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'New York') AS new_york_events
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("store_id_avg_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("store_id_avg_revenue").desc())
w6 = Window.orderBy("revenue_share_2", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("store_id_avg_revenue_rank", "id")

metrics = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("revenue").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("revenue").over(w).alias("store_id_avg_revenue"),
        F.round((F.col("revenue") / F.sum("revenue").over(w2)), 4).alias("revenue_share"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "revenue",
        "store_id_avg_revenue",
        "revenue_share",
        F.first("revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("first_known_revenue"),
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(w4)), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.round((F.col("revenue") / F.sum("revenue").over(w)), 4).alias("revenue_share_2"),
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("store_id_avg_revenue_rank"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales_2 = (
    metrics_store_sales
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "revenue",
        "store_id_avg_revenue",
        "units_share",
        "revenue_share_2",
        F.avg("revenue").over(w6).alias("revenue_avg_3"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w7).alias("store_id_avg_revenue_rank_bucket"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics_store_sales_2
    .select("store_id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("units") >= 23)
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics_store_sales_2
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept_keys = (
    reconciled
    .select("store_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([1, 2, 8, 9]))
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

reconciled_store_sales = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    reconciled_store_sales
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.store_id",
        "e.revenue",
        "e.store_id_avg_revenue",
        "e.revenue_share_2",
        "e.revenue_avg_3",
        F.col("p.city"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("city")).alias("city_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", 1)).alias("tokyo_rows"),
        F.avg("revenue_share_2").alias("avg_revenue_share_2"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", F.col("revenue_avg_3"))).alias("chiang_mai_total_revenue_avg_3"),
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "New York").alias("new_york_events"),
    )
)

    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
parsed AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        k,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit1,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM parsed
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE TO_DATE(log_ts) >= '2024-09-30'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM parsed s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        k,
        flag_bit1,
        status_code_high,
        flag_bit1 - status_code_high AS flag_bit1_minus_status_code_high,
        flag_bit1 - status_code_high AS flag_bit1_minus_status_code_high_2,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS k_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN flag_bit1 >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS flag_bit1_tier,
    k,
    MIN(flag_bit1_minus_status_code_high_2) AS min_flag_bit1_minus_status_code_high_2,
    COUNT_IF(k = 'version') AS version_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS distinct_ks
FROM base
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN flag_bit1 >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, k)
ORDER BY min_flag_bit1_minus_status_code_high_2 DESC NULLS LAST;

lines = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",

    )
)

        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit1"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),

)

        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, value
)

    CASE WHEN status_code >= 427 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS status_code_tier,
    MAX(status_code) FILTER (WHERE k = 'trace') AS trace_max_status_code,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    AVG(status_code) FILTER (WHERE k = 'region') AS region_avg_status_code,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(status_code, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS status_code_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM exploded
GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_code >= 427 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
HAVING AVG(status_code) FILTER (WHERE k = 'region') > 0;

    )
)

    .groupBy(

)

with kept_keys as (
    select carrier
    from shipments
    except
    select carrier
    from shipments
    where month(delivered_date) in (1, 3, 5)
),
reconciled as (
    select s.*
    from shipments s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.carrier = k.carrier
),
valid as (
    select
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        substring(status, 1, 4) as status_prefix,
        coalesce(carrier, 'DIRECT') as carrier_filled
    from reconciled
    where carrier is not null
      and delivered_date < '2024-05-01'
),
valid_shipments as (
    select
        carrier,
        status_prefix,
        carrier_filled,
        dayofweek(delivered_date) as delivered_date_dayofweek,
        coalesce(carrier, 'unassigned') as carrier_filled_2
    from valid
    where year(delivered_date) = 2023
),
filtered as (
    select *, substring(carrier, 1, 3) as carrier_prefix
    from valid_shipments
    where carrier is not distinct from 'Kerry'
      and delivered_date_dayofweek < 43
)
select
    case when delivered_date_dayofweek >= 75 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as delivered_date_dayofweek_tier,
    round(avg(delivered_date_dayofweek), 2) as avg_delivered_date_dayofweek,
    count(*) as row_count,
    approx_percentile(delivered_date_dayofweek, 0.5) as delivered_date_dayofweek_p50
from filtered
group by case when delivered_date_dayofweek >= 75 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end
having round(avg(delivered_date_dayofweek), 2) > 0
order by avg_delivered_date_dayofweek desc nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

kept_keys = (
    df_shipments
    .select("carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.month("delivered_date").isin([1, 3, 5]))
        .select("carrier")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull() & (F.col("delivered_date") < "2024-05-01"))
    .select(
        "carrier",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        F.substring("status", 1, 4).alias("status_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

valid_shipments = (
    valid
    .filter(F.year("delivered_date") == 2023)
    .select(
        "carrier",
        "status_prefix",
        "carrier_filled",
        F.dayofweek("delivered_date").alias("delivered_date_dayofweek"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("carrier_filled_2"),
    )
)

filtered = (

    .filter((F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Kerry"))) & (F.col("delivered_date_dayofweek") < 43))

)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("delivered_date_dayofweek") >= 75, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("delivered_date_dayofweek_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("delivered_date_dayofweek"), 2).alias("avg_delivered_date_dayofweek"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),

    .filter(F.col("avg_delivered_date_dayofweek") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_delivered_date_dayofweek").desc_nulls_last())
)

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        concat(device, '/', country) as device_country
    from sessions
    where started_at >= date '2023-09-17'
      and browser is not null
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.browser,
        s.device_country,
        x.duration_sec,
        x.web_event_page
    from valid s
    join lateral (
            select c.duration_sec, c.page as web_event_page
            from web_events c
            where c.session_id = s.id
            order by c.duration_sec desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from latest_match s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from web_events ch
            where ch.session_id = s.id
              and ch.session_id in (6, 32)
        )
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, round(duration_sec * 1.07, 2) as adjusted_duration_sec
    from eligible
    where web_event_page is not null
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    browser,
    case when duration_sec >= 480 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as duration_sec_tier,
    round(avg(adjusted_duration_sec), 2) as avg_adjusted_duration_sec,
    count(*) as event_count
from cleaned
group by browser, case when duration_sec >= 480 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by browser

valid = (

    .filter((F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-09-17").cast("date")) & F.col("browser").isNotNull())
    .select(

    .alias("s")

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.browser",
        "s.device_country",

eligible = (

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN job_title IN ('Intern', 'Manager') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END job_title_group,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'UNKNOWN') job_title_clean
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary, id) AS row_num
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p2.hire_date AS employee_hire_date,
        p2.full_name AS employee_full_name
    FROM latest e
    LEFT JOIN employees p2
        ON e.manager_id = p2.id
    WHERE LENGTH(p2.email) < 10
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        job_title,
        salary,
        job_title_group,
        job_title_clean,
        row_num,
        employee_hire_date,
        employee_full_name,
        CONCAT(job_title, '/', full_name) job_title_full_name,
        TRIM(email) clean_email
    FROM joined
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-02-09'
      AND row_num = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    job_title,
    CASE WHEN salary >= 141000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS salary_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Manager' THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS manager_salary,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
    STDDEV_SAMP(salary) AS salary_stddev,
    STDDEV_SAMP(salary) AS salary_stddev_2,
    ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary_2,
    GROUPING(job_title) AS grouping_level
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((job_title, CASE WHEN salary >= 141000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (job_title), ());

WITH flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount, id) AS rn
    FROM sessionized
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.amount AS order_amount,
        b.shipping_fee,
        b.status
    FROM latest a
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT e.*, b.order_date
    FROM with_dims e
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON e.order_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_burst_id,
        AVG(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_burst_id,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_burst_id,
        MAX(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_burst_id,
        SUM(order_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY method, order_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_order_amount
    FROM enriched
    WHERE paid_at < '2024-02-10'
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        method,
        order_id,
        status,
        running_max_burst_id
    FROM scored
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(running_max_burst_id) AS value_sum,
    COUNT(1) AS cnt
    FOR status IN ('SHIPPED', 'CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
)

    flagged
    .select(

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        date_format(sale_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as sale_date_label
    from store_sales
    where sale_date >= date '2023-03-15'
      and units <> 20
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        ntile(4) over (partition by product_id, store_id order by units, id) as units_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by store_id, product_id order by units desc, id) as row_seq
    from valid
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(row_seq) over (order by units, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_row_seq,
        row_number() over w_recent as row_seq_2,
        sum(row_seq) over (order by row_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_row_seq,
        avg(units) over (order by units_bucket, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as units_avg_3_prior
    from enriched
    window w_recent as (order by units_bucket, id)
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        coalesce(units_avg_3_prior, 0) as units_avg_3_prior_filled,
        round(running_row_seq / units_bucket, 2) as running_row_seq_per_units_bucket
    from metrics
    where sale_date >= date '2023-06-12'
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        units,
        row_seq,
        running_row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        cumulative_row_seq,
        units_avg_3_prior_filled,
        running_row_seq_per_units_bucket,
        units_avg_3_prior * row_seq_2 as units_avg_3_prior_times_row_seq_2,
        least(row_seq_2, units_bucket) as least_row_seq_2_units_bucket
    from cleaned
    where row_seq_2 > 5
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        row_seq,
        running_row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        running_row_seq_per_units_bucket,
        first_value(running_row_seq) ignore nulls over (order by units_avg_3_prior_times_row_seq_2, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_running_row_seq,
        avg(running_row_seq_per_units_bucket) over (order by least_row_seq_2_units_bucket, id rows between 6 preceding and current row) as running_row_seq_per_units_bucket_avg_6,
        percent_rank() over (order by running_row_seq_per_units_bucket nulls first) as running_row_seq_per_units_bucket_percent_rank
    from filtered
),
enriched_store_sales as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(row_seq_2) over w_ordered as row_seq_2_avg_6,
        first_value(running_row_seq) ignore nulls over (order by row_seq_2, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_running_row_seq_2
    from scored
    where row_seq_2 <> 3
    window w_ordered as (order by row_seq_2, id rows between 6 preceding and current row)
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    case when row_seq >= 9 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as row_seq_tier,
    approx_percentile(row_seq, 0.9) as row_seq_p90,
    percentile_approx(first_known_running_row_seq_2, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as first_known_running_row_seq_2_quartiles,
    round(avg(row_seq_2), 2) as avg_row_seq_2,
    count(*) as event_count,
    percentile_approx(row_seq_2, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as row_seq_2_quartiles,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids
from enriched_store_sales
group by row_seq_tier
order by row_seq_tier nulls first;

w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_row_seq_per_units_bucket").asc_nulls_first())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("row_seq_2", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, event_type
    FROM web_events
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, event_type
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('page_view', 'purchase', 'add_to_cart')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM web_events s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.event_type = k.event_type
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    event_type,
    BIT_AND(duration_sec) AS duration_sec_bit_and,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN page = '/cart' THEN 1 END) AS cart_count,
    AVG(duration_sec) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_avg_duration_sec,
    MIN(event_time) AS first_seen
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cart_count DESC;

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(category) AS category_upper,
        COALESCE(brand, 'N/A') AS brand_clean
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL
),

    -- Attach suppliers attributes

        a.id,
        a.product_name,
        a.brand,
        a.tags,
        a.supplier_id,
        p.rating
    FROM base a
    JOIN suppliers p
        ON a.supplier_id = p.id
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.revenue > 1800
        )
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        rating,
        CASE WHEN rating >= 3.8 THEN 'High' WHEN rating >= 2.2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS rating_band
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL
      AND brand IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Initech'
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.product_name,
        src.supplier_id,
        src.rating_band,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.city
    FROM latest src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s
        ON src.supplier_id = s.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM joined
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY distinct_cities

    select
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        coalesce(quantity, 0) as quantity_filled
    from order_items
    where product_id is not null
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select id, quantity
    from base
    qualify row_number() over (partition by product_id order by quantity desc nulls last, id) = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        quantity,
        lead(quantity) over (order by quantity, id) as next_quantity,
        row_number() over (order by quantity, id) as row_seq
    from ranked
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id
    from metrics
    intersect all
    select id
    from order_items
    where product_id in (36, 37)
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics

    case when quantity >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as quantity_tier,
    case when next_quantity >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as next_quantity_tier,
    case when row_seq >= 8 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as row_seq_tier,
    count(*) as cnt,
    bit_and(quantity) as quantity_bit_and,
    round(avg(next_quantity), 2) as avg_next_quantity,
    percentile_approx(row_seq, 0.5) as row_seq_p50,
    approx_percentile(quantity, 0.9) as quantity_p90,
    round(avg(next_quantity), 2) as avg_next_quantity_2

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("salary_int", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank", "id")

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull() & ~F.col("is_remote"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        F.col("salary").cast("int").alias("salary_int"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-03-28").cast("date")) & (F.col("hire_date") >= "2025-03-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "salary_int",
        (F.col("salary_int") - F.col("salary")).alias("salary_int_minus_salary"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("salary_int_minus_salary").over(w).alias("last4_count_salary_int_minus_salary"),
        F.sum("salary_int_minus_salary").over(w).alias("last4_sum_salary_int_minus_salary"),
        F.avg("salary_int_minus_salary").over(w).alias("last4_avg_salary_int_minus_salary"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank"),
    )
)

base_employees = (
    scored
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-02-19").cast("date")) & F.col("manager_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ceil("salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank").alias("salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank_whole"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base_employees
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

scored_employees = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isin([26, 29, 36]))
    .withColumn("salary_avg_3_prior", F.avg("salary").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("cumulative_salary", F.sum("salary").over(w5))
    .withColumn("next_last4_sum_salary_int_minus_salary", F.lead("last4_sum_salary_int_minus_salary", 1, 0).over(w6))
)

result = (
    scored_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "salary_int",
        "last4_count_salary_int_minus_salary",
        "last4_sum_salary_int_minus_salary",
        "salary_int_minus_salary_percent_rank",
    )
)
