with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        date_trunc('WEEK', event_time) as event_time_period,
        concat_ws('-', event_type, page) as event_type_page_key
    from web_events
    where page = '/cart'
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        last_value(page, true) over w_grp as last_known_page,
        row_number() over (order by event_time, id) as row_seq,
        first_value(page) ignore nulls over w_grp as first_known_page
    from valid
    window w_grp as (order by event_time_period, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(event_time_period) over (partition by event_type order by event_time_period, id) is null
                 or event_time_period > lag(event_time_period) over (partition by event_type order by event_time_period, id) + interval '14' day then 1 else 0 end as new_group_flag
    from metrics
),
sessions_web_events as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        event_time_period,
        event_type_page_key,
        sum(new_group_flag) over (partition by event_type order by event_time_period, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from with_gaps
),
metrics_web_events as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        event_time,
        event_type_page_key,
        burst_id,
        sum(burst_id) over (partition by event_type order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_burst_id,
        row_number() over (partition by event_type order by burst_id desc, id) as event_seq,
        avg(burst_id) over (partition by event_type) as event_type_avg_burst_id,
        ntile(10) over (order by burst_id desc, id) as burst_id_bucket
    from sessions_web_events
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from metrics_web_events
    except
    select id
    from web_events
    where session_id in (29, 39)
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics_web_events s
    join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    burst_id,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids_2,
    max(event_time) as last_seen,
    round(avg(event_seq), 2) as avg_event_seq,
    approx_percentile(burst_id, 0.9) as burst_id_p90
from verified
group by burst_id
having distinct_ids_2 < 1000
order by burst_id
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy("event_time_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("event_time", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time_period", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("event_type")
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc(), "id")

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page") == "/cart")
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time").alias("event_time_period"),
        F.concat_ws("-", "event_type", "page").alias("event_type_page_key"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("page", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp).alias("last_known_page"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("page", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp).alias("first_known_page"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time_period").over(w3).isNull() | (F.col("event_time_period") > F.lag("event_time_period").over(w3) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "event_time_period",
        "event_type_page_key",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w4).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

metrics_web_events = (
    sessions_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_time",
        "event_type_page_key",
        "burst_id",
        F.sum("burst_id").over(w5).alias("running_burst_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("burst_id").over(w7).alias("event_type_avg_burst_id"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w8).alias("burst_id_bucket"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics_web_events
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("session_id").isin([29, 39]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    metrics_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("burst_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_seen"),
        F.round(F.avg("event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("burst_id", 0.9).alias("burst_id_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids_2") < 1000)
    .orderBy("burst_id")
)

sql:
with parsed as (
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        payload_json,
        get_json_object(payload_json, '$.user.tier') as user_tier,
        context['region'] as region,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,
        get_json_object(payload_json, '$.duration') as duration_text,
        from_json(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').duration as duration_sec
    from app_logs
)
select
    service,
    date_trunc('day', log_ts) as activity_day,
    case when status_code_high >= 2 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as status_code_high_tier,
    count(case when service = 'billing' then 1 end) as billing_count,
    count_if(service = 'auth') as auth_events
from parsed
group by grouping sets ((service, date_trunc('day', log_ts), case when status_code_high >= 2 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end), (service, date_trunc('day', log_ts)), (service), ())
order by billing_count desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

parsed = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "payload_json",
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.user.tier").alias("user_tier"),
        F.col("context")["region"].alias("region"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        F.get_json_object("payload_json", "$.duration").alias("duration_text"),
        F.from_json("payload_json", "STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>")["duration"].alias("duration_sec"),
    )
)

result = (
    parsed
    .withColumn("activity_day", F.date_trunc("day", "log_ts"))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_high") >= 2, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["service", "activity_day", "status_code_high_tier"], ["service", "activity_day"], ["service"], []],
        "service",
        "activity_day",
        "status_code_high_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("service") == "auth").alias("auth_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("billing_count").desc())
)

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(salary * 0.9, 2) AS salary_adjusted,
        COALESCE(level, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_level
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-07-08'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, job_title ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        d.budget,
        d.dept_name
    FROM ranked e
    INNER JOIN departments d
        ON e.dept_id = d.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY rn DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, manager_id ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary,
        LAST_VALUE(salary_adjusted, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_name ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_salary_adjusted,
        LAG(budget, 1) OVER (ORDER BY salary, id) AS prev_budget
    FROM joined
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(prev_budget) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, level ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prev_budget,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY salary) AS salary_rank,
        LAG(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY salary_adjusted, id) AS prev_budget_2
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE manager_id IN (21, 25, 28)
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        dept_name,
        CASE WHEN prev_budget >= 3730000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_budget_tier,
        COUNT_IF(dept_name = 'Engineering') AS engineering_events,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level = 'L1') AS l1_rows,
        COUNT_IF(level = 'L2') AS l2_events
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (dept_name, CASE WHEN prev_budget >= 3730000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
)
SELECT
    prev_budget_tier,
    engineering_events,
    l2_events
FROM stats
ORDER BY prev_budget_tier DESC, engineering_events;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY k, service ORDER BY latency_ms NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_cume_dist
    FROM flattened
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value,
        latency_ms_cume_dist,
        latency_ms_cume_dist - status_code AS latency_ms_cume_dist_minus_status_code,
        COALESCE(k, 'NONE') AS k_clean
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE log_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 06:00:00'
      AND latency_ms_cume_dist < 0.29
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, COUNT(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS latency_ms_count_1h
    FROM cleaned
)
SELECT
    id,
    log_ts,
    latency_ms,
    status_code,
    k,
    attr_value,
    latency_ms_cume_dist,
    latency_ms_cume_dist_minus_status_code,
    k_clean,
    CASE WHEN k RLIKE '^(trace|version)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN k RLIKE '^(region)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS k_zone
FROM enriched
ORDER BY k DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k", "service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = flattened.withColumn("latency_ms_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01 06:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("latency_ms_cume_dist") < 0.29))
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        (F.col("latency_ms_cume_dist") - F.col("status_code")).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist_minus_status_code"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("NONE")).alias("k_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = cleaned.withColumn("latency_ms_count_1h", F.count("latency_ms").over(w2))

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist_minus_status_code",
        "k_clean",
        F.when(F.col("k").rlike("^(trace|version)$"), "CORE").when(F.col("k").rlike("^(region)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("k_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("k").desc_nulls_first())
)

    name,
    email,
    country,
    city,
    credit_limit,
    age,
    SUM(age) OVER (ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_age,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY credit_limit DESC NULLS LAST) AS credit_limit_dense_rank,
    LAG(age, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, country ORDER BY signup_date, id) AS prev_age,
    FIRST_VALUE(age, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY age, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_age
FROM customers
WHERE age <= 32;

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_limits) li AS val
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, UPPER(currency) currency_upper
    FROM flattened
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-02-27'
      AND currency = 'USD'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val NULLS LAST) val_percent_rank,
        MIN(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_min_val,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val DESC) val_percent_rank_2
    FROM cleaned
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_min_val_2,
        MIN(val_percent_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_min_val_percent_rank_2,
        MAX(val_percent_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_max_val_percent_rank_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val_percent_rank_2 DESC NULLS FIRST) val_percent_rank_2_percent_rank
    FROM metrics
    WHERE val BETWEEN 21 AND 59
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        currency,
        currency_min_val,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        currency_min_val_percent_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY currency_min_val_2 DESC NULLS LAST) currency_min_val_2_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_max_val_percent_rank_2 DESC) currency_max_val_percent_rank_2_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_part val_percent_rank_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY val_percent_rank)
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        currency,
        currency_min_val,
        val_percent_rank_2,
        currency_min_val_percent_rank_2,
        currency_min_val_2_dense_rank,
        currency_max_val_percent_rank_2_rank,
        val_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        ROUND(val_percent_rank_2 / currency_min_val_2_dense_rank, 2) val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank
    FROM scored
    WHERE currency_min_val_percent_rank_2 <= 0
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        currency,
        COUNT_IF(currency = 'USD') AS usd_events,
        AVG(val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS eur_avg_val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS currency_list
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY currency
    HAVING usd_events >= 1
)
SELECT
    currency,
    usd_events,
    eur_avg_val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank,
    CASE WHEN currency RLIKE '^(EUR|USD)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN currency RLIKE '^(THB)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS currency_zone
FROM summary
ORDER BY currency

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_percent_rank_2").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("currency_min_val_2").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_max_val_percent_rank_2").desc())
w_part = Window.orderBy("val_percent_rank")

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", "currency", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("val"))
)

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-02-27").cast("date")) & (F.col("currency") == "USD"))
    .withColumn("currency_upper", F.upper("currency"))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("val_percent_rank"),
        F.min("val").over(w2).alias("currency_min_val"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("val_percent_rank_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("val").between(21, 59))
    .withColumn("currency_min_val_2", F.min("val").over(w2))
    .withColumn("currency_min_val_percent_rank_2", F.min("val_percent_rank_2").over(w2))
    .withColumn("currency_max_val_percent_rank_2", F.max("val_percent_rank_2").over(w2))
    .withColumn("val_percent_rank_2_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "currency",
        "currency_min_val",
        "val_percent_rank_2",
        "currency_min_val_percent_rank_2",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("currency_min_val_2_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("currency_max_val_percent_rank_2_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_part).alias("val_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_val_percent_rank_2") <= 0)
    .select(
        "currency",
        "currency_min_val",
        "val_percent_rank_2",
        "currency_min_val_percent_rank_2",
        "currency_min_val_2_dense_rank",
        "currency_max_val_percent_rank_2_rank",
        "val_percent_rank_cume_dist",
        F.round((F.col("val_percent_rank_2") / F.col("currency_min_val_2_dense_rank")), 2).alias("val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    valid
    .groupBy("currency")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("currency") == "USD").alias("usd_events"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", F.col("val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank"))).alias("eur_avg_val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("currency")).alias("currency_list"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("usd_events") >= 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "currency",
        "usd_events",
        "eur_avg_val_percent_rank_2_per_currency_min_val_2_dense_rank",
        F.when(F.col("currency").rlike("^(EUR|USD)$"), "CORE").when(F.col("currency").rlike("^(THB)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("currency_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("currency")
)

sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT id, order_id, method, amount, paid_at, status, TRIM(method) AS clean_method, COALESCE(method, 'DIRECT') AS method_filled FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-05-26 18:00:00') AND order_id IS NOT NULL), scored AS (SELECT id, order_id, paid_at, status, method_filled, LAG(amount, 1) OVER (ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM valid), metrics AS (SELECT id, order_id, paid_at, status, prev_amount, amount_rank, AVG(prev_amount) OVER w_recent AS last4_avg_prev_amount, COUNT(prev_amount) OVER w_recent AS last4_count_prev_amount, MIN(prev_amount) OVER w_recent AS last4_min_prev_amount FROM scored WHERE prev_amount >= 1580 WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)), joined AS (SELECT src.*, p.order_date FROM metrics src LEFT JOIN orders p ON src.order_id = p.id) SELECT id, order_id, metric_name, value FROM (SELECT id, order_id, prev_amount, last4_min_prev_amount, last4_avg_prev_amount FROM joined) src UNPIVOT (value FOR metric_name IN (prev_amount, last4_min_prev_amount, last4_avg_prev_amount))

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-05-26 18:00:00"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.trim("method").alias("clean_method"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "method_filled",
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(w).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("amount_rank"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("prev_amount") >= 1580)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "prev_amount",
        "amount_rank",
        F.avg("prev_amount").over(w_recent).alias("last4_avg_prev_amount"),
        F.count("prev_amount").over(w_recent).alias("last4_count_prev_amount"),
        F.min("prev_amount").over(w_recent).alias("last4_min_prev_amount"),
    )
)

joined = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")

        "order_id",
        "prev_amount",
        "last4_min_prev_amount",

    )

        ids=["id", "order_id"],
        values=["prev_amount", "last4_min_prev_amount", "last4_avg_prev_amount"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)

sql: WITH parsed AS (SELECT id, plan, effective_from, currency, tier_limits, discounts, SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits, ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price, ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices FROM price_tiers) SELECT id, effective_from, entry_price, FIRST_VALUE(entry_price, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY effective_from, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_entry_price, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY entry_price, id) AS entry_price_bucket, NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY entry_price, id) AS entry_price_bucket_2 FROM parsed WHERE plan IN ('pro', 'enterprise');
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("effective_from", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("entry_price", "id")

parsed = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "discounts",
        F.slice("tier_limits", 1, 2).alias("first_two_limits"),
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
    )
)

        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("entry_price_bucket"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w2).alias("entry_price_bucket_2"),
    )
)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.order_id,
        e.method,
        e.paid_at,
        o.amount AS order_amount,
        o.channel
    FROM payments e
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON e.order_id = o.id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        paid_at,
        channel,
        COALESCE(method, 'Unknown') AS method_filled,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_clean
    FROM joined
    WHERE paid_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-11-12 04:00:00')
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        method_filled,
        method_clean
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY paid_at DESC, id) AS row_num
        FROM filtered
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, UPPER(channel) AS channel_upper
    FROM deduped
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN channel IN ('web', 'mobile') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS channel_group,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS channel_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE channel = 'store'
),
daily AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        channel,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS channel_list,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END) AS mobile_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, channel_list
FROM daily
ORDER BY channel DESC
LIMIT 10;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc(), "id")

joined = (
    df_payments
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.order_id",
        "e.method",
        "e.paid_at",
        F.col("o.amount").alias("order_amount"),
        F.col("o.channel"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    joined
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-11-12 04:00:00"))) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at",
        "channel",
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("method_filled"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "channel", "method_filled", "method_clean")
)

cleaned = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("channel_upper", F.upper("channel"))
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("channel") == "store")
    .withColumn("channel_group", F.when(F.col("channel").isin(["web", "mobile"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("channel_clean", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

daily = (
    base
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("channel", "channel_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("channel").desc())
    .limit(10)
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS k, value
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT service
    FROM flattened
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT service
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE host <> 'h2'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM flattened s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.service = k.service
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, UPPER(service) AS service_upper
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE service = 'auth'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(level, 1, 2) AS level_prefix,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS k_clean
    FROM base
    WHERE k IN ('trace', 'region')
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code >= 405 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'trace') AS trace_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(status_code) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS status_code_per_error,
    BIT_AND(status_code) AS status_code_bit_and,
    STDDEV_SAMP(status_code) AS status_code_stddev
FROM filtered
GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_code >= 405 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
HAVING COUNT(*) < 1000
ORDER BY status_code_tier DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("service")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("host") != "h2")
        .select("service")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("service") == "auth")
    .withColumn("service_upper", F.upper("service"))
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("k").isin(["trace", "region"]))
    .withColumn("level_prefix", F.substring("level", 1, 2))
    .withColumn("k_clean", F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 405, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "trace", 1)).alias("trace_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("status_code") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("status_code_per_error"),
        F.bit_and("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_and"),
        F.stddev_samp("status_code").alias("status_code_stddev"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_tier").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        CASE WHEN rating >= 4.5 THEN 'High' WHEN rating >= 1.9 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS rating_band
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND country IN ('US', 'SG')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC) AS rating_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY rating DESC, id ASC) AS rating_bucket_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_rating
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE city NOT IN ('Berlin', 'London', 'Chiang Mai')
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.brand NOT IN ('Acme', 'Initech', 'Stark')
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        rating,
        rating_bucket_2,
        first_known_rating
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating_bucket_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
        FROM eligible
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        rating,
        rating_bucket_2,
        AVG(first_known_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_bucket_2 ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_first_known_rating,
        MIN(first_known_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_bucket_2 ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_first_known_rating,
        SUM(first_known_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_bucket_2 ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_first_known_rating
    FROM deduped
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.launch_date,
        top1.stock_qty
    FROM scored s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.launch_date, c.stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT

WITH latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.dept_name,
        s.location,
        s.budget,
        top1.employee_level
    FROM departments s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.level AS employee_level
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM latest_match
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        employee_level,
        LEAD(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level ORDER BY budget, id) AS next_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level ORDER BY budget, id) AS seq_no,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level ORDER BY budget DESC) AS budget_dense_rank
    FROM ranked
),
ranked_departments AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id) = 1
),
with_windows_departments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(dept_name, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_dept_name,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY employee_level ORDER BY budget_dense_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS budget_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY next_budget DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM ranked_departments
    WHERE seq_no BETWEEN 5 AND 6
)
SELECT
    employee_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT employee_level) AS distinct_employee_levels,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    ROUND(SUM(seq_no) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN employee_level = 'L2' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS seq_no_per_l2
FROM with_windows_departments
GROUP BY 1
HAVING seq_no_per_l2 < 1000000
ORDER BY employee_level;

w4 = Window.partitionBy("employee_level").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("employee_level").orderBy(F.col("budget_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("next_budget").desc(), "id")

latest_match = (
    df_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))

    .select(

WITH matched AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM promotions src
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON src.channel = pr.channel
       AND src.starts_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
with_window AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM matched a
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON a.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND a.starts_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND a.starts_on <= DATE_ADD(pr.ends_on, 10)
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(promo_id_2) OVER w_running AS cumulative_promo_id_2,
        SUM(promotion_discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code_2, promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id, promo_id, promo_id_2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_promotion_discount_pct,
        MIN(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_min_discount_pct
    FROM with_window
    WHERE promo_id_2 <> 9
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY promotion_discount_pct_2, id, promo_id, promo_id_2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY cumulative_promo_id_2 DESC, id, promo_id, promo_id_2) AS latest_rank
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    channel,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on) AS activity_month,
    ROUND(AVG(promo_id), 2) AS avg_promo_id,
    ROUND(SUM(running_promotion_discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_promotion_discount_pct_per_mobile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'partner' THEN running_promotion_discount_pct ELSE 0 END) AS partner_running_promotion_discount_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT channel) AS distinct_channels
FROM ranked
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING ROUND(SUM(running_promotion_discount_pct) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) >= 0;

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        level,
        ROUND(salary, 2) salary_rounded
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-06-11'
      AND job_title IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary_rounded DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM base
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        dedup_rank,
        COUNT(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level) level_count_salary,
        STDDEV_SAMP(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id) job_title_stddev_samp_salary
    FROM ranked
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id) next_salary,
        LAG(job_title_stddev_samp_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id) prev_job_title_stddev_samp_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id) row_seq
    FROM metrics
),
by_type AS (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            dept_id,
            job_title,
            job_title_stddev_samp_salary
        FROM with_windows
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(job_title_stddev_samp_salary) AS amount
        FOR job_title IN ('Designer', 'Director')
    )
)
SELECT
    dept_id,
    Designer,
    Director
FROM by_type
ORDER BY dept_id DESC, Director;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', start_date) AS start_date_period,
        DATEDIFF(start_date, end_date) AS days_end_date_to_start_date
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date > '2023-03-01'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(days_end_date_to_start_date) OVER w_grp AS prev_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        LEAD(days_end_date_to_start_date) OVER w_grp AS next_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        LAG(monthly_fee) OVER w_grp AS prev_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no,
        LAG(days_end_date_to_start_date, 2) OVER (ORDER BY monthly_fee, id) AS prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE start_date_period >= '2023-08-02'
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        start_date_period,
        days_end_date_to_start_date,
        prev_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        prev_monthly_fee,
        seq_no,
        LAG(prev_days_end_date_to_start_date, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_2, id) AS prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        SUM(days_end_date_to_start_date) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY days_end_date_to_start_date, id) AS days_end_date_to_start_date_bucket
    FROM scored
),
scored_subscriptions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date_period,
        days_end_date_to_start_date,
        prev_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        seq_no,
        days_end_date_to_start_date_bucket,
        AVG(running_days_end_date_to_start_date) OVER w_grp AS running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_days_end_date_to_start_date NULLS FIRST) AS prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date NULLS LAST) AS prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY days_end_date_to_start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        days_end_date_to_start_date,
        running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior,
        prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank,
        prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank,
        seq_no + days_end_date_to_start_date AS seq_no_plus_days_end_date_to_start_date,
        seq_no + prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank AS seq_no_plus_prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank
    FROM scored_subscriptions
    WHERE prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank >= 6
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank_tier,
        CASE WHEN running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior >= 308 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank, 0.5) AS prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank_p50,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior, 0.95) AS running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior_p95
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior >= 308 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
)
SELECT
    prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank_tier,
    running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior_tier,
    distinct_ids,
    running_days_end_date_to_start_date_avg_6_prior_p95
FROM daily
ORDER BY prev_prev_days_end_date_to_start_date_dense_rank_tier DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(dept_name, 1, 2) AS dept_name_prefix,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'NONE') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
      AND location IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chiang Mai'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC) AS rank_in_group
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        budget,
        rank_in_group,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC) AS budget_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC) AS budget_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY budget DESC, id) AS budget_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(location, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_location,
        SUM(budget) OVER (ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_budget
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group < 1
),
latest_match AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.employee_hire_date,
        latest.salary
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date AS employee_hire_date, c.salary
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.salary DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM latest_match
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IN ('Engineering', 'Finance')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.hire_date <= s.employee_hire_date
        )
)
SELECT
    budget_rank,
    budget_bucket,
    first_known_location,
    employee_hire_date
FROM kept
ORDER BY employee_hire_date DESC;

        src.customer_country,

metrics AS (

    SELECT

    (SELECT MAX(o2.discount) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_order_discount
FROM metrics s

WITH parsed AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        payload_json,
        context['region'] AS region,
        GET_JSON_OBJECT(payload_json, '$.user.tier') AS user_tier,
        COALESCE(context['version'], 'unknown') AS version_or_default,
        SIZE(context) AS num_context
    FROM app_logs
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(log_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(log_ts))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(host)) AS num_hosts,
    ROUND(SUM(latency_ms) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN host = 'h3' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS latency_ms_per_h3,
    SUM(num_context) AS total_num_context,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN host = 'h3' THEN 1 END) AS h3_count
FROM parsed
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts)
ORDER BY h3_count DESC;

parsed = (

with metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        cume_dist() over (order by rating desc) as rating_cume_dist,
        round(rating / sum(rating) over (partition by city), 4) as rating_share
    from suppliers
),
metrics_suppliers as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        lead(rating, 1) over (partition by city order by rating_share, id) as next_rating,
        avg(rating_cume_dist) over (partition by country order by rating_share, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as rating_cume_dist_avg_2,
        sum(rating_cume_dist) over (order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_rating_cume_dist,
        ntile(3) over (partition by city, country order by rating, id) as rating_bucket,
        max(rating_share) over (partition by city) as city_max_rating_share
    from metrics
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        ntile(3) over w_hist as rating_bucket_bucket,
        ntile(3) over (partition by country order by rating_bucket, id) as rating_bucket_bucket_2
    from metrics_suppliers
    window w_hist as (partition by country order by rating_bucket desc, id)
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, city
    from scored
    except
    select id, city
    from suppliers
    where supplier_name like 'Tok%'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.city = k.city
),
scored_suppliers as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        min(rating_share) over (partition by city, country) as city_min_rating_share,
        cume_dist() over (partition by country order by rating) as rating_cume_dist_2
    from kept_rows
    where city_max_rating_share != 0
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        rating_bucket_bucket_2 - city_max_rating_share as rating_bucket_bucket_2_minus_city_max_rating_share,
        coalesce(city, 'NONE') as city_filled
    from scored_suppliers
    where country = 'SG'
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and c.product_name like '%Wate%'
        )
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        city,
        rating_cume_dist_2,
        rating_cume_dist,
        rating
    from eligible
) src
unpivot (
    value for measure in (rating_cume_dist_2 as RATING_CUME_DIST_2_VAL, rating_cume_dist as RATING_CUME_DIST_VAL, rating as RATING)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("rating").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating_share", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating_share", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating_bucket").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating_bucket", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating")

metrics = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("rating_share", F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w2)), 4))
)

metrics_suppliers = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("rating", 1).over(w3).alias("next_rating"),
        F.avg("rating_cume_dist").over(w4).alias("rating_cume_dist_avg_2"),
        F.sum("rating_cume_dist").over(w5).alias("cumulative_rating_cume_dist"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w6).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.max("rating_share").over(w2).alias("city_max_rating_share"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_bucket_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("rating_bucket_bucket_2", F.ntile(3).over(w8))
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("id", "city")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("Tok%"))
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored_suppliers = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("city_max_rating_share") != 0)
    .withColumn("city_min_rating_share", F.min("rating_share").over(w9))
    .withColumn("rating_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w10))
)

filtered = (
    scored_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "SG")
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("rating_bucket_bucket_2") - F.col("city_max_rating_share")).alias("rating_bucket_bucket_2_minus_city_max_rating_share"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("NONE")).alias("city_filled"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.product_name").like("%Wate%")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "city",
        F.col("rating_cume_dist_2").alias("RATING_CUME_DIST_2_VAL"),
        F.col("rating_cume_dist").alias("RATING_CUME_DIST_VAL"),
        F.col("rating").alias("RATING"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["city"],
        values=["RATING_CUME_DIST_2_VAL", "RATING_CUME_DIST_VAL", "RATING"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)

WITH valid AS (

        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        ROUND(quantity * 0.85, 2) adjusted_quantity,
        CASE WHEN quantity >= 253 THEN 'High' WHEN quantity >= 70 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END quantity_level
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= TO_DATE('2023-08-10')
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock <= '2023-06-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
valid_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN adjusted_quantity >= 87 THEN 'High' WHEN adjusted_quantity >= 15 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END adjusted_quantity_tier,
        FLOOR(quantity) quantity_whole
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE last_restock <= '2025-10-01'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity_whole DESC) quantity_whole_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_part quantity_whole_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) OVER w_grp product_id_stddev_samp_quantity
    FROM valid_inventory
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 142 AND 233
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity_whole DESC NULLS LAST), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id)
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,

        quantity,
        adjusted_quantity,
        quantity_level,
        adjusted_quantity_tier,

        quantity_whole_rank,
        quantity_whole_cume_dist,
        CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) quantity_num,
        quantity_whole_cume_dist * adjusted_quantity quantity_whole_cume_dist_times_adjusted_quantity
    FROM metrics
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-06-28'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity_whole NULLS LAST) quantity_whole_cume_dist_2
    FROM cleaned

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        base.id,
        base.customer_id,
        base.coupon_codes,
        li_item.qty,
        li_item.price
    FROM carts base
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(base.items) li AS li_item
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        qty,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(coupon_codes, 'WELCOME5') AS is_welcome5
    FROM exploded
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND price BETWEEN 60 AND 130
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM carts
    WHERE SIZE(coupon_codes) > 1
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT src.*, d.email
    FROM reconciled src
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id <=> d.id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(qty / SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) AS qty_share,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC) AS qty_rank
    FROM enriched
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        qty,
        is_welcome5,
        email,
        qty_rank,
        ROUND(qty_share, 1) AS qty_share_rounded,
        SIZE(coupon_codes) AS coupon_codes_count
    FROM metrics
    WHERE qty >= 2
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN coupon_codes_count >= 79 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS coupon_codes_count_tier,
        CASE WHEN qty_share_rounded >= 65 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS qty_share_rounded_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_ids_2,
        MAX(coupon_codes_count) AS max_coupon_codes_count,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY coupon_codes_count_tier, qty_share_rounded_tier
)
SELECT
    coupon_codes_count_tier,
    qty_share_rounded_tier,
    num_rows,
    distinct_customer_ids_2,
    max_coupon_codes_count,
    event_count
FROM daily
ORDER BY qty_share_rounded_tier DESC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc())

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("li_item", F.explode("items"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.col("li_item.qty"),
        F.col("li_item.price"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("price").between(60, 130))
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "qty",
        F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "WELCOME5").alias("is_welcome5"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("customer_id")
    .intersect(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.size("coupon_codes") > 1)
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("src.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.email"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("qty") / F.sum("qty").over(w)), 4).alias("qty_share"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("qty_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("qty") >= 2)
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "qty",
        "is_welcome5",
        "email",
        "qty_rank",
        F.round("qty_share", 1).alias("qty_share_rounded"),
        F.size("coupon_codes").alias("coupon_codes_count"),
    )
)

daily = (
    valid
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("coupon_codes_count") >= 79, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("coupon_codes_count_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("qty_share_rounded") >= 65, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("qty_share_rounded_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids_2"),
        F.max("coupon_codes_count").alias("max_coupon_codes_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "coupon_codes_count_tier",
        "qty_share_rounded_tier",
        "num_rows",
        "distinct_customer_ids_2",
        "max_coupon_codes_count",
        "event_count",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("qty_share_rounded_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)

kept_rows AS (

    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id

valid AS (

    WHERE least_unit_price_quantity < 80

with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.amount,
        p.discount,
        p.order_date
    FROM valid a
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON a.order_id = p.id
    WHERE p.shipping_fee <= 10

metrics AS (
    SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount NULLS FIRST) AS discount_percent_rank
    FROM with_dims
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id, order_id
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.order_id = k.order_id
)
SELECT
    o.status,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    SUM(a.unit_price_per_least_unit_price_quantity) AS total_unit_price_per_least_unit_price_quantity
FROM verified a
LEFT JOIN orders o ON a.order_id = o.id

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "unit_price",
        F.least("unit_price", "quantity").alias("least_unit_price_quantity"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("order_id") == 16)
        .select("order_id")
    )

kept_rows = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("least_unit_price_quantity") < 80)
    .withColumn("unit_price_per_least_unit_price_quantity", (F.col("unit_price") / F.nullif("least_unit_price_quantity", F.lit(0))))
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.shipping_fee") <= 10)

with enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(age) over w_part as running_age,
        round(age / sum(age) over (partition by city), 4) as age_share,
        sum(credit_limit) over (partition by country order by credit_limit, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_credit_limit
    from customers
    window w_part as (partition by segment order by age, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        avg(running_age) over (partition by city) as city_avg_running_age,
        min(credit_limit) over (partition by country, city) as country_min_credit_limit,
        ntile(3) over (partition by segment, country order by credit_limit, id) as credit_limit_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by country order by credit_limit desc, id) as event_seq
    from enriched
),
eligible as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from orders c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
              and c.order_date <= s.signup_date
        )
),
eligible_customers as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from eligible s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders x
            where x.customer_id = s.id
              and x.shipping_fee > 40
        )
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        city,
        age_share,
        credit_limit
    from eligible_customers
) src
unpivot (
    value for metric in (age_share as AGE_SHARE, credit_limit as CREDIT_LIMIT)
);

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("age", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("credit_limit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("segment", "country").orderBy("credit_limit", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")

enriched = (
    df_customers
    .withColumn("running_age", F.sum("age").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("age_share", F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_credit_limit", F.sum("credit_limit").over(w3))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("running_age").over(w2).alias("city_avg_running_age"),
        F.min("credit_limit").over(w4).alias("country_min_credit_limit"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w5).alias("credit_limit_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.order_date") <= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_semi")
)

eligible_customers = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.shipping_fee") > 40), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible_customers
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        F.col("age_share").alias("AGE_SHARE"),
        F.col("credit_limit").alias("CREDIT_LIMIT"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "city"],
        values=["AGE_SHARE", "CREDIT_LIMIT"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) x as k, attr_value
),
flattened_attrs as (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    select
        id,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        cast((status_code & 8) != 0 as int) as flag_bit8,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high
    from exploded
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select level
    from flattened_attrs
    except
    select level
    from app_logs
    where status_code between 293 and 360
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from flattened_attrs s
    join matched_keys k on s.level = k.level
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, dense_rank() over (partition by k, level order by status_code_high desc nulls first) as status_code_high_dense_rank
    from verified
    where flag_bit8 < 0
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        sum(flag_bit8) over (partition by k) as k_sum_flag_bit8,
        cume_dist() over (partition by k order by status_code) as status_code_cume_dist
    from metrics
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        status_code,
        k,
        status_code_high,
        status_code_high_dense_rank,
        k_sum_flag_bit8,
        length(level) as level_length
    from scored
    where flag_bit8 <= 0
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    k,
    round(sum(k_sum_flag_bit8) / nullif(count(case when k = 'version' then 1 end), 0), 2) as k_sum_flag_bit8_per_version,
    round(avg(status_code), 2) as avg_status_code
from base
group by k
having round(sum(k_sum_flag_bit8) / nullif(count(case when k = 'version' then 1 end), 0), 2) < 1000000;

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS key, v
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        v,
        CAST(latency_ms AS DOUBLE) AS latency_ms_num,
        INITCAP(TRIM(key)) AS key_title
    FROM exploded
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        v,
        latency_ms_num,
        key_title,
        MAX(latency_ms_num) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS latency_ms_num_max_15m,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms DESC) AS latency_ms_dense_rank,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_sum_status_code,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms_num DESC NULLS FIRST) AS latency_ms_num_cume_dist,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_sum_15m
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE level = 'WARN'
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT level
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT level
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms <= 2205
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.level = k.level
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(latency_ms_num_max_15m, 2) AS latency_ms_num_max_15m_rounded
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE status_code > 437
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    level,
    CASE WHEN service_sum_status_code >= 1756 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS service_sum_status_code_tier,
    CASE WHEN status_code >= 454 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS status_code_tier,
    AVG(status_code_sum_15m) AS avg_status_code_sum_15m,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level = 'INFO') AS info_rows
FROM base
GROUP BY level, CASE WHEN service_sum_status_code >= 1756 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN status_code >= 454 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END;

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

w4 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_num").desc_nulls_first())

    .select(

        "service",
        "host",

        "latency_ms",

    )

    exploded
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "v",
        F.col("latency_ms").cast("double").alias("latency_ms_num"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("key")).alias("key_title"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("level") == "WARN")
    .select(
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "v",

        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w3).alias("service_sum_status_code"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("latency_ms_num_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w).alias("status_code_sum_15m"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("level")
    .subtract(

        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") <= 2205)
        .select("level")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("status_code") > 437)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("latency_ms_num_max_15m", 2).alias("latency_ms_num_max_15m_rounded"),
    )

result = (

        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 454, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_code_tier"),

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        status_bits_num,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    device_code,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reading_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    CORR(temp_c, status_bits) AS corr_temp_c_status_bits,
    BIT_AND(status_bits) AS status_bits_bit_and,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM islands
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts), device_code)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.hour("reading_ts").between(6, 13))
    .select("*", F.col("status_bits").cast("double").alias("status_bits_num"))
)

with_prev = base.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "status_bits_num",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("activity_day", F.date_trunc("DAY", "reading_ts"))
    .cube("activity_day", "device_code")
    .agg(
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.corr("temp_c", "status_bits").alias("corr_temp_c_status_bits"),
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

        )

    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (

            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.brand = 'Umbrella'
        )
)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        CAST(unit_price AS INT) AS unit_price_int,
        quantity * unit_price AS line_total
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (1, 11, 17)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_int,
        CAST(line_total AS INT) AS line_total_int,
        unit_price + line_total AS unit_price_plus_line_total
    FROM valid
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(unit_price, 1) AS unit_price_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        unit_price,
        line_total_int,
        unit_price_plus_line_total,
        SUM(unit_price_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price_plus_line_total ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_unit_price_rounded,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY unit_price_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST) AS unit_price_rounded_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE product_id IS NULL
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    unit_price,
    line_total_int,
    running_unit_price_rounded,
    NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC, id ASC) AS unit_price_bucket,
    LAG(unit_price_rounded_dense_rank, 2) OVER (ORDER BY running_unit_price_rounded ASC, id ASC) AS prev_unit_price_rounded_dense_rank
FROM scored
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price_plus_line_total", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price_rounded").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("running_unit_price_rounded", "id")

valid = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([1, 11, 17]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        F.col("unit_price").cast("int").alias("unit_price_int"),
        (F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_int",
        F.col("line_total").cast("int").alias("line_total_int"),
        (F.col("unit_price") + F.col("line_total")).alias("unit_price_plus_line_total"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.round("unit_price", 1).alias("unit_price_rounded"))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "line_total_int",
        "unit_price_plus_line_total",
        F.sum("unit_price_rounded").over(w).alias("running_unit_price_rounded"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("unit_price_rounded_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "unit_price",
        "line_total_int",
        "running_unit_price_rounded",
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("unit_price_bucket"),
        F.lag("unit_price_rounded_dense_rank", 2).over(w4).alias("prev_unit_price_rounded_dense_rank"),
    )
)
