sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        HOUR(paid_at) AS paid_at_hour,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 3) AS status_prefix,
        COALESCE(method, 'DIRECT') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-11-12 17:00:00'
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY status, method ORDER BY paid_at_hour DESC, id ASC) AS paid_at_hour_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at_hour ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM valid
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        paid_at_hour,
        status_prefix,
        method_filled,
        paid_at_hour_bucket,
        event_seq,
        TO_DATE(paid_at) AS paid_at_date,
        COALESCE(method, 'UNKNOWN') AS method_clean
    FROM scored
    WHERE paid_at_hour IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY event_seq DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        status,
        status_prefix,
        paid_at_hour_bucket,
        event_seq,
        paid_at_date
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM ranked
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount,
    status,
    status_prefix,
    paid_at_hour_bucket,
    event_seq,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(SUCCESS|FAILED)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS status_zone
FROM deduped
ORDER BY amount ASC NULLS FIRST
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at_hour").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at_hour", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at", "id")

valid = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-11-12 17:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.hour("paid_at").alias("paid_at_hour"),
        F.substring("status", 1, 3).alias("status_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w).alias("paid_at_hour_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("paid_at_hour").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "paid_at_hour",
        "status_prefix",
        "method_filled",
        "paid_at_hour_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        F.to_date("paid_at").alias("paid_at_date"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "status_prefix",
        "paid_at_hour_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "paid_at_date",
    )
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "status",
        "status_prefix",
        "paid_at_hour_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        F.when(F.col("status").rlike("^(SUCCESS|FAILED)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("CORE").alias("status_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount").asc_nulls_first())
)

sql:
with lines as (
    select
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        explode_outer(tier_prices) as tier_value
    from price_tiers
),
filtered as (
    select
        *,
        case when currency in ('THB', 'EUR') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as currency_group,
        substring(plan, 1, 2) as plan_prefix
    from lines
    where currency <> 'THB'
),
scored as (
    select
        id,
        plan,
        dense_rank() over (order by tier_value desc nulls last) as tier_value_dense_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by tier_value nulls first) as tier_value_percent_rank,
        sum(tier_value) over (partition by currency, plan) as currency_sum_tier_value,
        stddev_samp(tier_value) over (partition by currency) as currency_stddev_samp_tier_value,
        max(tier_value) over (partition by plan, currency) as plan_max_tier_value
    from filtered
),
base as (
    select *, round(currency_sum_tier_value * 1.15, 2) as currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted
    from scored
    where plan = 'enterprise'
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        percent_rank() over (partition by plan order by plan_max_tier_value nulls first) as plan_max_tier_value_percent_rank,
        percent_rank() over (partition by plan order by currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted desc nulls last) as currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank,
        count(tier_value_percent_rank) over (partition by plan) as plan_count_tier_value_percent_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by tier_value_dense_rank desc nulls last) as tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank
    from base
)
select
    case when tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank_tier,
    plan,
    avg(currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank) filter (where plan = 'starter') as starter_avg_currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank,
    round(sum(plan_max_tier_value) / nullif(count(case when plan = 'basic' then 1 end), 0), 2) as plan_max_tier_value_per_basic,
    sum(case when plan = 'pro' then tier_value_percent_rank else 0 end) as pro_tier_value_percent_rank
from enriched
group by tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank_tier, plan
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("plan_max_tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("currency") != "THB")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("currency").isin(["THB", "EUR"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("currency_group"),
        F.substring("plan", 1, 2).alias("plan_prefix"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.sum("tier_value").over(w3).alias("currency_sum_tier_value"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(w4).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value"),
        F.max("tier_value").over(w5).alias("plan_max_tier_value"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "enterprise")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("currency_sum_tier_value") * 1.15), 2).alias("currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .withColumn("plan_max_tier_value_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w7))
    .withColumn("plan_count_tier_value_percent_rank", F.count("tier_value_percent_rank").over(w8))
    .withColumn("tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w9))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("tier_value_dense_rank_dense_rank_tier"),
        "plan",
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("plan") == "starter", F.col("currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank"))).alias("starter_avg_currency_sum_tier_value_adjusted_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.sum("plan_max_tier_value") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("plan_max_tier_value_per_basic"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", F.col("tier_value_percent_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("pro_tier_value_percent_rank"),
    )
)

with filtered as (
    select
        *,
        ceil(budget) budget_whole,
        concat(dept_name, ' - ', location) dept_name_location,
        coalesce(location, 'DIRECT') location_filled
    from departments
    where dept_name is not null
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        location,
        dept_name_location,
        location_filled,
        ntile(5) over (partition by location order by budget_whole desc, id) budget_whole_bucket,
        ntile(10) over (partition by location order by budget desc, id) budget_bucket,
        rank() over (partition by dept_name, location order by budget desc nulls last) budget_rank
    from filtered
),
with_latest as (
    select
        s.id,
        s.location,
        s.dept_name_location,
        x.employee_level
    from enriched s
    left join lateral (
            select c.level as employee_level
            from employees c
            where c.dept_id = s.id
            order by c.salary desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
),
filtered_departments as (
    select
        *,
        substring(location, 1, 3) location_prefix,
        coalesce(location, 'UNKNOWN') location_filled
    from with_latest
    where employee_level is not null
      and location is distinct from 'Berlin'
),
kept as (
    select s.*
    from filtered_departments s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from employees x
            where x.dept_id = s.id
              and x.full_name like 'Iv%'
        )
)
select
    id,
    location,
    dept_name_location,
    employee_level,
    case when location rlike '^(New York|Bangkok)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'GROUP_B' end as location_zone
from kept
order by location_zone nulls first, employee_level;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget_whole").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.salary").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",

        F.concat("dept_name", F.lit(" - "), "location").alias("dept_name_location"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("location_filled"),

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "location",
        "dept_name_location",
        "location_filled",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("budget_whole_bucket"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w2).alias("budget_bucket"),

with_latest = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("c"), (F.col("c.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")

WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM transactions
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM with_gaps
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM sessionized
    INTERSECT
    SELECT txn_type, merchant
    FROM transactions
    WHERE TO_DATE(txn_time) >= '2023-04-07'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessionized s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type AND s.merchant = k.merchant
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'OTHER') AS merchant_clean
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE txn_time > DATE '2023-07-08'
      AND merchant NOT IN ('7-Eleven', 'Grab', 'Amazon')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        session_no,
        is_flagged_flag,
        merchant_clean,
        is_flagged_flag * session_no AS is_flagged_flag_times_session_no,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_merchant
    FROM valid
    WHERE txn_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-08-18 07:00:00'
      AND is_flagged_flag <= 56
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, is_flagged_flag / NULLIF(is_flagged_flag_times_session_no, 0) AS is_flagged_flag_per_is_flagged_flag_times_session_no
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND merchant IS DISTINCT FROM 'Amazon'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM base
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE account_id IN (4, 36, 39)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(is_flagged_flag_times_session_no, 0) AS is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded,
        CAST(session_no AS DOUBLE) AS session_no_num,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'N/A') AS merchant_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE txn_time >= DATE '2023-07-21'
      AND merchant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Lazada'
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN is_flagged_flag_times_session_no >= 74 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_tier,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(txn_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(txn_time))) / 60 AS span_minutes,
        ROUND(SUM(is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN merchant = 'Grab' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded_per_grab,
        COUNT_IF(merchant = 'Shell') AS shell_events
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN is_flagged_flag_times_session_no >= 74 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT
    is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_tier,
    span_minutes,
    is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded_per_grab,
    shell_events
FROM daily;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    sessionized
    .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    .intersect(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.to_date("txn_time") >= "2023-04-07")
        .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    reconciled
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-07-08").cast("date")) & ~F.col("merchant").isin(["7-Eleven", "Grab", "Amazon"]))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_flag", F.col("is_flagged").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("merchant_clean", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-08-18 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("is_flagged_flag") <= 56))
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "session_no",
        "is_flagged_flag",
        "merchant_clean",
        (F.col("is_flagged_flag") * F.col("session_no")).alias("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (~F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Amazon"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("is_flagged_flag") / F.nullif("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no", F.lit(0))).alias("is_flagged_flag_per_is_flagged_flag_times_session_no"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("txn_type")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([4, 36, 39]))
        .select("txn_type")
    )
)

verified = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-07-21").cast("date")) & (F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Lazada"))))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded", F.round("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no", 0))
    .withColumn("session_no_num", F.col("session_no").cast("double"))

daily = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no") >= 74, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_tier"),
    )
    .agg(

        F.round(F.sum("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Grab", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded_per_grab"),
        F.count_if(F.col("merchant") == "Shell").alias("shell_events"),
    )
)

result = (

        "span_minutes",
        "is_flagged_flag_times_session_no_rounded_per_grab",
        "shell_events",
    )

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        cost,
        status,
        CONCAT_WS('/', carrier, status) carrier_status_key
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IS DISTINCT FROM 'Kerry'
      AND shipped_date < '2024-05-01'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM base
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
latest_shipments AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM latest
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
base_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        cost,
        status,
        latest_rank,
        rank_in_group,
        LEAST(latest_rank, rank_in_group) least_latest_rank_rank_in_group
    FROM latest_shipments
    WHERE status = 'LOST'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        latest_rank,
        rank_in_group,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_avg_cost,
        MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_max_cost,
        COUNT(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_count_cost
    FROM base_shipments
)
SELECT
    status,
    CASE WHEN running_count_cost >= 15 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS running_count_cost_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'DELIVERED' THEN 1 END) AS delivered_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_rows,
    MIN(running_avg_cost) AS min_running_avg_cost
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CUBE (status, CASE WHEN running_count_cost >= 15 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END)
HAVING delivered_count < 1000
ORDER BY delivered_count DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("latest_rank").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Kerry"))) & (F.col("shipped_date") < "2024-05-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.concat_ws("/", "carrier", "status").alias("carrier_status_key"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

latest_shipments = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

base_shipments = (
    latest_shipments
    .filter(F.col("status") == "LOST")
    .select(
        "id",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "latest_rank",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.least("latest_rank", "rank_in_group").alias("least_latest_rank_rank_in_group"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "latest_rank",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.avg("cost").over(w3).alias("running_avg_cost"),
        F.max("cost").over(w3).alias("running_max_cost"),
        F.count("cost").over(w3).alias("running_count_cost"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .cube(
        "status",
        F.when(F.col("running_count_cost") >= 15, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_count_cost_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "DELIVERED", 1)).alias("delivered_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "RETURNED", 1)).alias("returned_rows"),
        F.min("running_avg_cost").alias("min_running_avg_cost"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("delivered_count") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("delivered_count").desc())
)

WITH matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT job_title, manager_id
    FROM employees
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT job_title, manager_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IN ('L2', 'L1', 'L5')
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.job_title = k.job_title AND s.manager_id = k.manager_id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN salary >= 160000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS salary_tier,
    manager_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level = 'L1') AS l1_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'L3' THEN salary ELSE 0 END) AS l3_salary,
    COUNT_IF(level = 'L1') AS l1_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN salary >= 160000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, manager_id)
ORDER BY manager_id

matched_keys = (
    df_employees
    .select("job_title", "manager_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("level").isin(["L2", "L1", "L5"]))
        .select("job_title", "manager_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_employees
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.job_title") == F.col("k.job_title")) & (F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("k.manager_id")), "inner")

    .rollup("salary_tier", "manager_id")

WITH deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM payments
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS row_num_2
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY row_num_2 = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        row_num,
        row_num_2,
        CASE WHEN method = 'card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_card,
        COALESCE(method, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_method
    FROM latest
    WHERE method IS DISTINCT FROM 'promptpay'
      AND paid_at > DATE '2023-08-14'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT e.*, o.order_date
    FROM valid e
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON e.order_id = o.id
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    amount,
    paid_at,
    status,
    is_card,
    LAG(amount) OVER w_recent AS prev_amount,
    LEAD(amount) OVER w_recent AS next_amount,
    LAG(is_card) OVER w_recent AS prev_is_card,
    LEAD(is_card) OVER w_recent AS next_is_card,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS seq_no
FROM enriched
WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY order_date, id);

with with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        ntile(10) over (partition by channel order by discount_pct desc, id) as discount_pct_bucket,
        sum(discount_pct) over (order by starts_on, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_discount_pct
    from promotions
    where discount_pct <= 0.27
),
deduped as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by channel order by cumulative_discount_pct desc nulls first, id) as rn
        from with_windows
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),
attributed as (
    select
        src.*,
        pr.id as promo_id,
        pr.promo_code as promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct
    from deduped src
    left join promotions pr
        on src.channel = pr.channel
       and src.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       and src.ends_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 3)
),
with_windows_promotions as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        discount_pct_bucket,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        ntile(10) over (order by discount_pct, id, promo_id) as discount_pct_bucket_2,
        lag(discount_pct, 1) over (partition by promotion_promo_code order by discount_pct, id, promo_id) as prev_discount_pct
    from attributed
),
filtered as (
    select
        *,
        round(prev_discount_pct / promo_id, 2) as prev_discount_pct_per_promo_id,
        discount_pct + discount_pct_bucket_2 as discount_pct_plus_discount_pct_bucket_2
    from with_windows_promotions
    where ends_on > date '2023-07-02'
),
ranked as (
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        discount_pct_bucket,
        promo_id,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        discount_pct_bucket_2
    from filtered
    qualify row_number() over (partition by channel order by discount_pct_bucket, id, promo_id) = 1
),
attributed_promotions as (
    select
        s.*,
        pr.id as promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct as promotion_discount_pct_2
    from ranked s
    left join promotions pr
        on s.channel = pr.channel
       and s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       and s.ends_on <= date_add(pr.ends_on, 3)
)
select
    date_trunc('year', ends_on) as year_start,
    count(*) as row_count,
    count_if(channel = 'partner') as partner_events,
    count_if(promo_code = 'VIP') as vip_events,
    sum(promo_id_2) as total_promo_id_2,
    max(promotion_discount_pct_2) as max_promotion_discount_pct_2
from attributed_promotions
group by date_trunc('year', ends_on)

        F.lag("discount_pct", 1).over(w5).alias("prev_discount_pct"),
    )
)

filtered = (

    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-07-02").cast("date"))

WITH prev_events AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) AS prev_started_at
    FROM sessions
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_started_at IS NULL OR started_at > prev_started_at + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.device,
    s.browser,
    s.country,
    CASE WHEN country RLIKE '^(TH|DE)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN country RLIKE '^(US|SG)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS country_zone,
    (SELECT SUM(x.discount) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS sum_order_discount
FROM sessions_sessions s;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
discount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.sum("discount").alias("sum_order_discount"))

prev_events = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .join(discount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("country").rlike("^(TH|DE)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("country").rlike("^(US|SG)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("country_zone"),
        F.col("sum_order_discount"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        FLOOR(pressure) AS pressure_whole
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-09-01 02:00:00')
      AND reading_ts >= '2025-08-11'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        pressure_whole,
        AVG(pressure_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pressure_whole_avg_5,
        MAX(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_bits_max_30m,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits ASC) AS status_bits_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        pressure_whole,
        status_bits_max_30m,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure_whole DESC) AS pressure_whole_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY pressure_whole_avg_5 ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure,
        MAX(pressure) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pressure_max_15m
    FROM scored
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits_max_30m ASC, id ASC) AS status_bits_max_30m_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(temp_c) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY status_bits_max_30m ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_temp_c,
        FIRST_VALUE(status_bits_max_30m, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits_max_30m ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status_bits_max_30m
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    id,
    metric_name,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        temp_c,
        first_known_pressure,
        pressure,
        first_known_temp_c
    FROM metrics_device_readings
) src
UNPIVOT (
    val FOR metric_name IN (temp_c, first_known_pressure, pressure, first_known_temp_c)
);

with filtered as (
    select
        *,
        dayofweek(ends_on) ends_on_dayofweek,
        coalesce(channel, 'UNKNOWN') channel_clean
    from promotions
    where ends_on > to_date('2023-06-15')
      and promo_code in ('WELCOME5', 'SPRING10', 'BUNDLE')
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        first_value(channel, true) over (partition by promo_code order by starts_on, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) first_known_channel,
        avg(discount_pct) over (order by discount_pct, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) discount_pct_avg_5_prior
    from filtered
),
base as (
    select
        id,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        ends_on_dayofweek,
        channel_clean,
        first_known_channel,
        discount_pct_avg_5_prior,
        dayofweek(starts_on) starts_on_dayofweek,
        coalesce(channel, 'NONE') resolved_channel
    from with_windows
    where channel is distinct from 'partner'
      and ends_on >= date '2023-06-27'
),
remaining_keys as (
    select id
    from base
    intersect all
    select id
    from promotions
    where ends_on > '2023-04-01'
),
reconciled as (
    select s.*
    from base s
    join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
scored as (
    select *, rank() over (order by starts_on_dayofweek nulls last) starts_on_dayofweek_rank
    from reconciled
    where starts_on_dayofweek = 40
)
select
    id,
    ends_on,
    discount_pct,
    ends_on_dayofweek,
    first_known_channel,
    starts_on_dayofweek,
    resolved_channel
from scored
order by id desc nulls last;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("starts_on_dayofweek").asc_nulls_last())

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-15"))) & F.col("promo_code").isin(["WELCOME5", "SPRING10", "BUNDLE"]))
    .withColumn("ends_on_dayofweek", F.dayofweek("ends_on"))
    .withColumn("channel_clean", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_channel"),
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("discount_pct_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter((~F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("partner"))) & (F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-06-27").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "ends_on_dayofweek",
        "channel_clean",
        "first_known_channel",
        "discount_pct_avg_5_prior",
        F.dayofweek("starts_on").alias("starts_on_dayofweek"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("ends_on") > "2023-04-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("starts_on_dayofweek") == 40)
    .withColumn("starts_on_dayofweek_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "ends_on_dayofweek",
        "first_known_channel",
        "starts_on_dayofweek",
        "resolved_channel",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc_nulls_last())
)

amount_by_account_id = df_transactions.groupBy("account_id").agg(F.sum("amount").alias("sum_transaction_amount"))

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (~F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Lazada"))))
    .select("*", F.date_trunc("month", "txn_time").alias("txn_time_period"))
)

with_dims = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.account_id",
        "s.txn_type",
        "s.amount",
        "s.merchant",
        "s.is_flagged",
        F.col("b.opened_date"),
        F.col("b.account_type"),
    )
)

    with_dims
    .select("merchant", "account_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
        .select("merchant", "account_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")) & (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS k, attr_value
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(level, 1, 3) AS level_prefix,
        COALESCE(k, 'UNKNOWN') AS k_filled
    FROM exploded
    WHERE k = 'region'
),
valid_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        k,
        attr_value,
        LOWER(level) AS level_lower,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS k_filled_2
    FROM valid
    WHERE k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'trace'
      AND level IN ('DEBUG', 'ERROR', 'WARN')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        level_lower,
        k_filled_2,
        UPPER(k) AS k_upper
    FROM valid_app_logs
    WHERE level IN ('ERROR', 'DEBUG', 'WARN')
),
valid_app_logs_2 AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(level)) AS level_title
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE level = 'WARN'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    level,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'WARN' THEN 1 END) AS warn_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'WARN' THEN 1 END) AS warn_count_2,
    COUNT_IF(level = 'DEBUG') AS debug_events
FROM valid_app_logs_2
GROUP BY CUBE (level)
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'WARN' THEN 1 END) < 1000
ORDER BY event_count DESC NULLS FIRST

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "level", F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"))

valid = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("k") == "region")
    .withColumn("level_prefix", F.substring("level", 1, 3))
    .withColumn("k_filled", F.coalesce("k", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

valid_app_logs = (
    valid
    .filter((F.col("k").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace"))) & F.col("level").isin(["DEBUG", "ERROR", "WARN"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.lower("level").alias("level_lower"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("k_filled_2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["ERROR", "DEBUG", "WARN"]))
    .select("id", "level", "level_lower", "k_filled_2", F.upper("k").alias("k_upper"))

valid_app_logs_2 = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("level") == "WARN")
    .select("*", F.initcap(F.trim("level")).alias("level_title"))

result = (

    .cube("level")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "WARN", 1)).alias("warn_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "WARN", 1)).alias("warn_count_2"),
        F.count_if(F.col("level") == "DEBUG").alias("debug_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("warn_count") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("event_count").desc_nulls_first())
)

    SELECT customer_id, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(account_type)) AS account_type_list
    FROM accounts
    WHERE balance >= 32000
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.id, c.signup_date, C.account_type_list
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN CustomerTotals C ON c.id = C.customer_id;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customer_totals = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("balance") >= 32000)
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(F.sort_array(F.collect_set("account_type")).alias("account_type_list"))
)

result = (
    df_customers.alias("c")
    .join(customer_totals.alias("C"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("C.customer_id"), "inner")
    .select(F.col("c.id"), F.col("c.signup_date"), F.col("C.account_type_list"))
)

    where amount > 1400
    group by account_id
)

    a.id,
    a.customer_id,
    a.account_type,
    at.merchant_values
from accounts a
inner join account_totals at on a.id = at.account_id;

    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(account_totals.alias("at"), F.col("a.id") == F.col("at.account_id"), "inner")

WITH web_events_by_session AS (
    SELECT session_id, ROUND((100 * SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'add_to_cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_add_to_cart
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page = '/checkout'
    GROUP BY session_id
)

FROM sessions s
JOIN web_events_by_session webs ON s.id = webs.session_id;

    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page") == "/checkout")
    .groupBy("session_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(((100 * F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "add_to_cart", 1).otherwise(0))) / F.count("*")), 1).alias("pct_add_to_cart"),
    )
)

    df_sessions.alias("s")
    .join(web_events_by_session.alias("webs"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("webs.session_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        F.col("s.customer_id"),
        F.col("s.started_at"),

    )
)

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(monthly_fee * 1.07, 2) AS adjusted_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date > TO_DATE('2023-09-16')
      AND start_date BETWEEN '2023-07-02' AND '2023-12-26'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        status,
        LAG(monthly_fee) OVER w_part AS prev_monthly_fee,
        LEAD(adjusted_monthly_fee) OVER w_part AS next_adjusted_monthly_fee,
        LAG(adjusted_monthly_fee) OVER w_part AS prev_adjusted_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        next_adjusted_monthly_fee,
        seq_no
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY next_adjusted_monthly_fee DESC, id) AS row_num
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        next_adjusted_monthly_fee,
        seq_no,
        MAX(seq_no) OVER w_running AS running_max_seq_no,
        COUNT(seq_no) OVER w_running AS running_count_seq_no,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER w_running AS running_sum_seq_no
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        next_adjusted_monthly_fee,
        seq_no,
        running_max_seq_no,
        running_count_seq_no,
        running_sum_seq_no,
        CAST(seq_no AS STRING) AS seq_no_str
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE running_sum_seq_no BETWEEN 18 AND 24
)
SELECT
    id,
    next_adjusted_monthly_fee,
    seq_no,
    running_sum_seq_no,
    seq_no_str
FROM base
ORDER BY next_adjusted_monthly_fee DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("end_date", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("next_adjusted_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("end_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-16"))) & F.col("start_date").between("2023-07-02", "2023-12-26"))
    .withColumn("adjusted_monthly_fee", F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") * 1.07), 2))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "status",
        F.lag("monthly_fee").over(w_part).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.lead("adjusted_monthly_fee").over(w_part).alias("next_adjusted_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("adjusted_monthly_fee").over(w_part).alias("prev_adjusted_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "start_date", "next_adjusted_monthly_fee", "seq_no")
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_adjusted_monthly_fee",
        "seq_no",
        F.max("seq_no").over(w_running).alias("running_max_seq_no"),
        F.count("seq_no").over(w_running).alias("running_count_seq_no"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w_running).alias("running_sum_seq_no"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("running_sum_seq_no").between(18, 24))
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_adjusted_monthly_fee",
        "seq_no",
        "running_max_seq_no",
        "running_count_seq_no",
        "running_sum_seq_no",
        F.col("seq_no").cast("string").alias("seq_no_str"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_adjusted_monthly_fee",
        "seq_no",

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(balance) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_balance,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type, customer_id) AS account_type_sum_balance,
        FIRST_VALUE(balance) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_ordered AS first_known_balance,
        SUM(balance) OVER w_grp AS running_balance
    FROM accounts
    WHERE account_type NOT IN ('SAVINGS', 'CHECKING')
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM metrics a
    INNER JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.opened_date BETWEEN sub.start_date AND sub.end_date
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        status,
        cumulative_balance,
        account_type_sum_balance,
        first_known_balance,
        running_balance,
        subscription_id,
        LOWER(account_type) AS account_type_lower,
        COALESCE(status, 'N/A') AS status_clean
    FROM with_window
    WHERE status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'OPEN'
      AND plan IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        cumulative_balance,
        subscription_id,
        account_type_lower,
        AVG(first_known_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY account_type_sum_balance, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_first_known_balance,
        MAX(first_known_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY account_type_sum_balance, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_first_known_balance,
        SUM(first_known_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY account_type_sum_balance, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_first_known_balance,
        MIN(first_known_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY account_type_sum_balance, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_first_known_balance
    FROM filtered
),
filtered_accounts AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        subscription_id,
        running_avg_first_known_balance,
        running_max_first_known_balance,
        running_sum_first_known_balance,
        running_min_first_known_balance,
        CAST(subscription_id AS DOUBLE) AS subscription_id_num
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE running_avg_first_known_balance >= 35000
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        subscription_id,
        running_max_first_known_balance,
        running_sum_first_known_balance,
        running_min_first_known_balance,
        subscription_id_num,
        SUM(subscription_id_num) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_subscription_id_num,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY running_sum_first_known_balance DESC) AS running_sum_first_known_balance_cume_dist
    FROM filtered_accounts
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY subscription_id_num, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_type IN ('FEE', 'REFUND', 'CREDIT')
        )
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN subscription_id_num >= 65 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS subscription_id_num_tier,
    CASE WHEN cumulative_subscription_id_num >= 339 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cumulative_subscription_id_num_tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(running_min_first_known_balance), 2) AS avg_running_min_first_known_balance,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_min_first_known_balance, 0.95) AS running_min_first_known_balance_p95
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY 1, 2;

        SUBSTRING(city, 1, 2) city_prefix
    FROM stores
    WHERE city = 'Bangkok'
      AND opened_date >= TO_DATE('2023-04-24')

latest AS (

        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1

metrics AS (

        *,
        LAG(sqft_whole, 2) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_whole ASC, id ASC) prev_sqft_whole,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_whole DESC, id ASC) sqft_whole_bucket,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY region) region_avg_sqft
    FROM latest
),
latest_stores AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft_whole DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        city,
        region,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id ASC) row_seq_2
    FROM latest_stores

FROM (

        city,
        region,
        row_seq_2
    FROM with_windows
) src

WITH gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at) AS quarter_start,
    SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success_total_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) AS refunded_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'cash' THEN 1 END) AS cash_count,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at)) AS grouping_level
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at), DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at))
HAVING SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') < 1000000

    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_limits) li AS val

        val_rank - val_cume_dist AS val_rank_minus_val_cume_dist,

    FROM base

)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status,
        ABS(balance) AS abs_balance
    FROM accounts
    WHERE opened_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-22')
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.opened_date,
        s.status,
        s.abs_balance,
        top1.txn_time
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_last
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(status) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_ordered AS first_known_status,
        MAX(is_new_burst) OVER w_hist AS is_new_burst_max_7d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        LOWER(firmware) AS firmware_lower,
        ROUND(pressure * 0.85, 2) AS pressure_adjusted
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-09-01 03:00:00')
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_reading_ts
    FROM valid
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts) AS hour_window,
    CASE WHEN temp_c >= 37.9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS temp_c_tier,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(prev_reading_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(prev_reading_ts))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(burst_id) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-02') AS dv_02_total_burst_id,
    CORR(temp_c, pressure) AS corr_temp_c_pressure
FROM islands
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', reading_ts), CASE WHEN temp_c >= 37.9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING dv_02_total_burst_id > 0
ORDER BY temp_c_tier DESC NULLS LAST

    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        datediff(current_date(), launch_date) as days_since_launch_date,
        concat(product_name, ' ', category) as product_name_category,
        coalesce(brand, 'DIRECT') as brand_clean
    from products
    where price between 380 and 710
),
cleaned_products as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        days_since_launch_date,
        product_name_category,
        brand_clean,
        round(price, 1) as price_rounded
    from cleaned
    where launch_date >= date '2023-05-30'
      and brand is not null
),
joined as (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    select
        src.*,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        s.rating
    from cleaned_products src
    left join suppliers s
        on src.supplier_id = s.id
    where s.country = 'US'
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.product_name,
        s.category,
        s.brand,
        s.cost,
        s.launch_date,
        s.brand_clean,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.country,
        latest.order_item_quantity,
        latest.unit_price
    from joined s
    join lateral (
            select c.quantity as order_item_quantity, c.unit_price
            from order_items c
            where c.product_id = s.id
            order by c.quantity desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    category,
    country,
    max(order_item_quantity) as max_order_item_quantity,
    avg(cost) filter (where brand = 'Stark') as stark_avg_cost
from with_latest
group by category, country
order by country nulls last

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.quantity").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

        F.concat("product_name", F.lit(" "), "category").alias("product_name_category"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("brand_clean"),
    )
)

    cleaned
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-30").cast("date")) & F.col("brand").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "days_since_launch_date",
        "product_name_category",
        "brand_clean",
        F.round("price", 1).alias("price_rounded"),
    )
)

joined = (
    cleaned_products
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("src.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.country") == "US")
    .select("src.*", F.col("s.supplier_name"), F.col("s.country"), F.col("s.rating"))
)

with_latest = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

        "s.id",
        "s.product_name",
        "s.category",
        "s.brand",
        "s.cost",
        "s.launch_date",
        "s.brand_clean",
        "s.supplier_name",
        "s.country",
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("order_item_quantity"),
        F.col("c.unit_price"),
    )
)

result = (

    .agg(

        F.avg(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Stark", F.col("cost"))).alias("stark_avg_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").asc_nulls_last())

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT id, line.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) x AS line
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    promo,
    COUNT_IF(promo = 'VIP') AS vip_events,
    COUNT_IF(promo = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_events,
    COUNT_IF(promo = 'VIP') AS vip_events_2,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM lines
GROUP BY promo
HAVING COUNT_IF(promo = 'SPRING10') < 1000;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_success
    FROM payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND method IN ('card', 'paypal')
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
sessions_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
filtered_payments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', method, status) AS method_status_key,
        COALESCE(method, 'NONE') AS method_clean
    FROM sessions_payments
    WHERE paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-10-20 19:00:00'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        is_new_burst,
        island_id,
        method_status_key,
        ROUND(amount, 2) AS amount_rounded,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS method_clean_2
    FROM filtered_payments
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned_payments AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        is_new_burst,
        island_id,
        method_clean_2,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2023-09-02'
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    method,
    amount,
    island_id,
    method_clean_2,
    clean_status,
    CASE WHEN method RLIKE '^(bank_transfer|paypal)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS method_zone
FROM cleaned_payments
ORDER BY method;

)

filtered_payments = (
    sessions_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-10-20 19:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "method", "status").alias("method_status_key"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("NONE")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    filtered_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "is_new_burst",
        "island_id",
        "method_status_key",
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_clean_2"),
    )
)

cleaned_payments = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "is_new_burst",
        "island_id",
        "method_clean_2",
        F.trim("status").alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "island_id",
        "method_clean_2",
        "clean_status",
        F.when(F.col("method").rlike("^(bank_transfer|paypal)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("method_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("method")

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(w).alias("corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.avg("corr_status_code_latency_ms").over(w))
    .withColumn("service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.min("corr_status_code_latency_ms").over(w))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_2", F.rank().over(w_running))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        "service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        "service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        F.round((F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_2") / F.sum("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_2").over(w)), 4).alias("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_2_share"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_3"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms_cume_dist"),
    )
)

summary = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms_tier", F.when(F.col("service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["service", "service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms_tier"], ["service"], []],
        "service",
        "service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", F.col("corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_3"))).alias("auth_max_corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_3"),
        F.round(F.avg("service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms"), 2).alias("avg_service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", F.col("service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms"))).alias("billing_max_service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "service",
        "service_min_corr_status_code_latency_ms_tier",
        "auth_max_corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_3",
        "avg_service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        "billing_max_service_avg_corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        F.when(F.col("service").rlike("^(checkout|billing)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("service").rlike("^(auth|search)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("service_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("auth_max_corr_status_code_latency_ms_rank_3").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM store_sales
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (1, 4)
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM store_sales s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN revenue >= 4200 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS revenue_tier,
    store_id,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    BIT_AND(units) AS units_bit_and,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN revenue >= 4200 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, store_id
ORDER BY units_bit_and DESC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_store_sales
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([1, 4]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("revenue") >= 4200, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("revenue_tier"),
        "store_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("revenue").alias("total_revenue"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.bit_and("units").alias("units_bit_and"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("units_bit_and").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        status,
        LOWER(status) AS status_lower
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND account_type = 'CREDIT'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.transaction_txn_type,
        top1.transaction_merchant
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_type AS transaction_txn_type, c.merchant AS transaction_merchant
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        src.account_type,
        src.balance,
        src.status,
        src.transaction_txn_type,
        src.transaction_merchant,
        b.name,
        b.signup_date,
        b.credit_limit
    FROM with_latest src
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
    WHERE b.segment IN ('Corporate', 'Consumer')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_type ORDER BY signup_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance,
        SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY transaction_merchant ORDER BY credit_limit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_credit_limit
    FROM with_dims
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(name, 'N/A') AS name_filled,
        balance * running_credit_limit AS balance_times_running_credit_limit
    FROM enriched
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_latest_accounts AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        s.balance,
        s.status,
        s.transaction_txn_type,
        s.name,
        s.signup_date,
        s.credit_limit,
        s.running_balance,
        s.running_credit_limit,
        latest.txn_time,
        latest.transaction_txn_type_2
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time, c.txn_type AS transaction_txn_type_2
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.signup_date
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY transaction_txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS prev_txn_time
    FROM with_latest_accounts
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY transaction_txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    account_type,
    balance,
    name,
    signup_date,
    credit_limit,
    running_balance,
    transaction_txn_type_2,
    prev_txn_time,
    CASE WHEN name RLIKE '^(FRANK MILLER|Jack Taylor)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS name_zone
FROM sessionized

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        TRIM(event_type) AS clean_event_type,
        HOUR(event_time) AS event_time_hour,
        COALESCE(page, 'N/A') AS page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(event_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_event_time_hour,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY event_time, id) AS seq_no
    FROM filtered
    WHERE event_time_hour BETWEEN 61 AND 74
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        clean_event_type,
        event_time_hour,
        prev_event_time_hour,
        seq_no
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page, event_type ORDER BY prev_event_time_hour NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time_hour DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY seq_no) = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    event_type,
    seq_no,
    CASE WHEN event_time_hour >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS event_time_hour_tier,
    AVG(event_time_hour) AS avg_event_time_hour,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_event_time_hour, 0.95) AS prev_event_time_hour_p95,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    ROUND(SUM(prev_event_time_hour) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS prev_event_time_hour_per_click,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY ROUND(SUM(prev_event_time_hour) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) DESC) AS prev_event_time_hour_per_click_dense_rank
FROM deduped
GROUP BY event_type, seq_no, CASE WHEN event_time_hour >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY seq_no DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, GREATEST(shipping_fee, discount) AS greatest_shipping_fee_discount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-04-05'
      AND amount BETWEEN 1050 AND 1110
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.order_date,
        s.channel,
        s.discount,
        s.shipping_fee,
        top1.payment_status,
        top1.method
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.status AS payment_status, c.method
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM with_latest e
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(e.channel, 'store') = pr.channel
       AND e.order_date BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_window s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND TO_DATE(c.paid_at) >= '2025-01-01'
        )
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_date,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        promo_id,
        discount_pct,
        LAG(discount_pct) OVER w_hist AS prev_discount_pct,
        LEAD(promo_id) OVER w_hist AS next_promo_id,
        LAG(promo_id) OVER w_hist AS prev_promo_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS event_seq,
        LAG(promo_id, 1) OVER (ORDER BY shipping_fee, id, promo_id) AS prev_promo_id_2
    FROM eligible
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, method ORDER BY promo_id, id, promo_id)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.order_id IN (7, 10, 20, 23)
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS event_seq_tier,
    promo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(next_promo_id), 2) AS avg_next_promo_id,
    AVG(shipping_fee) AS avg_shipping_fee,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(promo_id, 0.95) AS promo_id_p95,
    ROUND(AVG(promo_id), 2) AS avg_promo_id
FROM eligible_orders
GROUP BY 1, 2;

WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM store_sales
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) days_since_sale_date,
        ROUND(revenue, 1) revenue_rounded
    FROM latest
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-08-20'
),
valid_store_sales AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(revenue_rounded / units, 2) revenue_rounded_per_units
    FROM valid
    WHERE sale_date >= TO_DATE('2023-04-20')
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.price
    FROM valid_store_sales src
    JOIN products p
        ON src.product_id = p.id
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY days_since_sale_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM deduped
    INTERSECT
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id IN (2, 4, 5, 6)
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.sale_date,
    s.units,
    s.revenue,
    s.days_since_sale_date,
    s.revenue_rounded,
    s.price,
    (SELECT SUM(i2.quantity) FROM inventory i2 WHERE i2.product_id = s.product_id) AS sum_inventory_quantity
FROM verified s
ORDER BY sale_date DESC;
