from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("days_since_sale_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.sum("quantity").alias("sum_inventory_quantity"))

latest = (
    df_store_sales
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

valid = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "sale_date").alias("days_since_sale_date"),
        F.round("revenue", 1).alias("revenue_rounded"),
    )
)

valid_store_sales = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-20")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("revenue_rounded") / F.col("units")), 2).alias("revenue_rounded_per_units"),
    )
)

joined = (
    valid_store_sales
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.price"))
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

matched_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([2, 4, 5, 6]))
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "days_since_sale_date",
        "revenue_rounded",
        "price",
        F.col("sum_inventory_quantity"),

WITH matched_keys AS (
    SELECT city, country
    FROM customers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT city, country
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment = 'SMB'
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM customers s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.country = k.country
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        CORR(credit_limit, age) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS corr_credit_limit_age,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age) AS age_dense_rank
    FROM kept_rows
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        age_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age_dense_rank DESC) AS age_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY corr_credit_limit_age DESC NULLS FIRST) AS corr_credit_limit_age_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age_dense_rank) AS age_dense_rank_rank
    FROM with_windows
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.status IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
        )
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM kept
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM customers
    WHERE segment IS NULL
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    age_dense_rank,
    age_dense_rank_dense_rank,
    age_dense_rank_rank,
    CASE WHEN name RLIKE '^(Mia Rossi|Kanya Srisuk)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS name_zone
FROM reconciled
ORDER BY age_dense_rank_rank NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city")
w2 = Window.orderBy("age")

w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("corr_credit_limit_age").desc_nulls_first())

    .select("s.*")

        "name",

    .select("s.*")
)

result = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "age_dense_rank",
        "age_dense_rank_dense_rank",

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, substring(full_name, 1, 4) as full_name_prefix
    from employees
    where level is not null
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        level,
        max(salary) over (partition by dept_id, job_title) as dept_id_max_salary,
        first_value(job_title) ignore nulls over (partition by job_title order by salary, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_job_title,
        row_number() over (partition by dept_id, job_title order by salary, id) as seq_no
    from base
    where month(hire_date) in (1, 3, 5)
),
metrics_employees as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        lag(seq_no) over (partition by job_title order by salary, id) as prev_seq_no,
        lag(salary) over (partition by job_title order by salary, id) as prev_salary,
        row_number() over (partition by job_title order by salary, id) as event_seq
    from metrics
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        dept_id,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        dept_id_max_salary,
        first_known_job_title,
        prev_seq_no,
        prev_salary,
        count(prev_salary) over w_ordered as last7_count_prev_salary,
        max(prev_salary) over w_ordered as last7_max_prev_salary,
        min(prev_salary) over w_ordered as last7_min_prev_salary
    from metrics_employees
    window w_ordered as (partition by job_title, dept_id order by prev_salary, id rows between 6 preceding and current row)
),
metrics_employees_2 as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        lead(prev_seq_no) over w_hist as next_prev_seq_no,
        lag(last7_min_prev_salary) over w_hist as prev_last7_min_prev_salary,
        row_number() over w_hist as seq_no,
        lead(salary, 1) over (order by salary, id) as next_salary
    from scored
    window w_hist as (partition by dept_id order by salary, id)
)
select
    s.id,
    s.dept_id,
    s.salary,
    s.dept_id_max_salary,
    s.prev_seq_no,
    s.prev_salary,
    s.last7_max_prev_salary,
    s.last7_min_prev_salary,
    s.next_prev_seq_no,
    (select max(x.salary) from employees x where x.dept_id = s.dept_id) as max_employee_salary
from metrics_employees_2 s
order by last7_max_prev_salary desc;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("salary", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("salary", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy("prev_salary", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("salary", "id")
salary_by_dept_id = df_employees.groupBy("dept_id").agg(F.max("salary").alias("max_employee_salary"))

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("level").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.substring("full_name", 1, 4).alias("full_name_prefix"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.month("hire_date").isin([1, 3, 5]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        F.max("salary").over(w).alias("dept_id_max_salary"),
        F.first("job_title", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_job_title"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

metrics_employees = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("seq_no").over(w4).alias("prev_seq_no"),
        F.lag("salary").over(w4).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "salary",
        "is_remote",
        "dept_id_max_salary",
        "first_known_job_title",
        "prev_seq_no",
        "prev_salary",
        F.count("prev_salary").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_count_prev_salary"),
        F.max("prev_salary").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_max_prev_salary"),
        F.min("prev_salary").over(w_ordered).alias("last7_min_prev_salary"),
    )
)

metrics_employees_2 = (
    scored
    .withColumn("next_prev_seq_no", F.lead("prev_seq_no").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("prev_last7_min_prev_salary", F.lag("last7_min_prev_salary").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("next_salary", F.lead("salary", 1).over(w7))
)

result = (
    metrics_employees_2
    .join(salary_by_dept_id, on="dept_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "salary",
        "dept_id_max_salary",
        "prev_seq_no",
        "prev_salary",
        "last7_max_prev_salary",
        "last7_min_prev_salary",
        "next_prev_seq_no",
        F.col("max_employee_salary"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("last7_max_prev_salary").desc())
)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        revenue,
        CAST(units AS STRING) AS units_str
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (2, 7, 10)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_id_avg_revenue,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_part AS revenue_bucket,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_ordered AS revenue_bucket_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS seq_no,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id)
),
base_store_sales AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CEIL(revenue_rank) AS revenue_rank_whole
    FROM enriched
    WHERE revenue_rank = 5
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM base_store_sales
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue_rank NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    sale_date,
    revenue,
    product_id_avg_revenue,
    revenue_bucket,
    revenue_rank,
    revenue_rank_whole,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id) AS seq_no_bucket,
    SUM(seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY product_id_avg_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no,
    NTILE(10) OVER w_running AS revenue_bucket_bucket
FROM latest
WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY revenue_bucket DESC, id)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER w_running AS plan_min_tier_value,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_dense_rank,
        SUM(tier_value) OVER w_running AS plan_sum_tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value) AS tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM exploded
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY plan)
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan != 'basic'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plan_sum_tier_value DESC) AS plan_sum_tier_value_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_cume_dist DESC) AS tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist,
        SUM(tier_value_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM kept_rows
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        plan_min_tier_value,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        plan_sum_tier_value,
        tier_value_cume_dist,
        tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist,
        plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist,
        plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist,
        CAST(tier_value_dense_rank AS DOUBLE) AS tier_value_dense_rank_num
    FROM metrics
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-02-02'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    plan,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from) AS week_start,
    ROUND(AVG(plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist), 2) AS avg_plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans,
    SUM(tier_value_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'enterprise') AS enterprise_total_tier_value_cume_dist,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(plan_min_tier_value, 0.95) AS plan_min_tier_value_p95
FROM valid
GROUP BY plan, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("tier_value")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("plan_sum_tier_value").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist").desc())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.explode_outer("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.min("tier_value").over(w_running).alias("plan_min_tier_value"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("tier_value").over(w_running).alias("plan_sum_tier_value"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("plan", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("plan") != "basic")
        .select("plan", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("plan_sum_tier_value_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w5))
    .withColumn("plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist", F.sum("tier_value_cume_dist").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist", F.stddev_samp("tier_value_cume_dist").over(w_running))
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-02-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "plan_min_tier_value",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        "plan_sum_tier_value",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_cume_dist_cume_dist",
        "plan_sum_tier_value_cume_dist",
        "plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist",
        F.col("tier_value_dense_rank").cast("double").alias("tier_value_dense_rank_num"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .groupBy("plan", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "effective_from").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist"), 2).alias("avg_plan_stddev_samp_tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.countDistinct("plan").alias("distinct_plans"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", F.col("tier_value_cume_dist"))).alias("enterprise_total_tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.percentile_approx("plan_min_tier_value", 0.95).alias("plan_min_tier_value_p95"),
    )
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, v
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        service,
        host,
        status_code,
        v,
        MIN(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host, level) AS host_min_status_code,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS status_code_share,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_rank
    FROM lines
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_grp AS host_min_status_code_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(host_min_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS status_code_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS status_code_rank_3
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE status_code_rank >= 7
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY service, host ORDER BY host_min_status_code), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code)
),
enriched_app_logs AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT *, COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host) AS host_count_status_code
    FROM enriched
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN service = 'search' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_search
    FROM enriched_app_logs
    WHERE host_count_status_code <= 15
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN host_min_status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS host_min_status_code_rank_tier,
    service,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(status_code_share, 0.9) AS status_code_share_p90,
    ROUND(AVG(service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code), 2) AS avg_service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service) AS distinct_services,
    ROUND(AVG(service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code), 2) AS avg_service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code_2,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(status_code_share, 0.9) AS status_code_share_p90_2,
    ROUND(SUM(service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code_per_billing,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN host_min_status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY PERCENTILE_APPROX(status_code_share, 0.9) DESC) AS status_code_share_p90_rank
FROM base
GROUP BY CASE WHEN host_min_status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, service;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host", "level")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("service", "host").orderBy("host_min_status_code")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("host")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("host_min_status_code_rank_tier").orderBy(F.col("status_code_share_p90").desc())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .select(
        "service",
        "host",
        "status_code",
        "v",
        F.min("status_code").over(w).alias("host_min_status_code"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w2)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("status_code_rank"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("status_code_rank") >= 7)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("host_min_status_code_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("host_min_status_code").over(w5).alias("service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("status_code_rank_2"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("status_code_rank_3"),
    )
)

enriched_app_logs = enriched.withColumn("host_count_status_code", F.count("status_code").over(w7))

base = (
    enriched_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("host_count_status_code") <= 15)
    .withColumn("is_search", F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("host_min_status_code_rank") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("host_min_status_code_rank_tier"),
        "service",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("status_code_share", 0.9).alias("status_code_share_p90"),
        F.round(F.avg("service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code"), 2).alias("avg_service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code"),
        F.countDistinct("service").alias("distinct_services"),
        F.round(F.avg("service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code"), 2).alias("avg_service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code_share", 0.9).alias("status_code_share_p90_2"),
        F.round(F.sum("service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("service_stddev_samp_host_min_status_code_per_billing"),
    )
    .withColumn("status_code_share_p90_rank", F.rank().over(w8))
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(page, 1, 4) AS page_prefix,
        COALESCE(page, 'N/A') AS page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec IS NULL
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY is_new_session DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM islands
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        page_prefix,
        page_filled,
        is_new_session,
        burst_id,
        rank_in_group,
        CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS event_time_day
    FROM deduped
    WHERE event_time > TO_DATE('2023-06-04')
      AND rank_in_group > 1
),
with_gaps_2 AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM cleaned
),
sessions_web_events AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_2
    FROM with_gaps_2
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(burst_id_2) OVER w_part AS next_burst_id_2,
        LAG(burst_id_2) OVER w_part AS prev_burst_id_2,
        LAG(is_new_session) OVER w_part AS prev_is_new_session,
        LEAD(is_new_session) OVER w_part AS next_is_new_session,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS row_seq,
        SUM(burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY is_new_session, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_burst_id
    FROM sessions_web_events
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id)
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session_2
    FROM metrics
),
islands_web_events AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session_2) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_3
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    cumulative_burst_id,
    CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS is_new_burst_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE page = '/home') AS home_rows,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(page)) AS num_pages,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_time))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM islands_web_events
GROUP BY CUBE (cumulative_burst_id, CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time))
HAVING (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_time))) / 60 > 0
ORDER BY num_pages NULLS FIRST;

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        INITCAP(TRIM(email)) AS email_title,
        COALESCE(level, 'OTHER') AS resolved_level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.full_name AS employee_full_name,
        b.level
    FROM filtered a
    LEFT JOIN employees b
        ON a.manager_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        hire_date,
        email_title,
        resolved_level,
        level,
        CONCAT(email, ' ', employee_full_name) AS email_employee_full_name,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'DIRECT') AS job_title_filled
    FROM joined
    WHERE level IS NOT NULL
      AND level IS DISTINCT FROM 'L1'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.full_name,
        e.dept_id,
        e.hire_date,
        e.resolved_level,
        e.level,
        e.email_employee_full_name,
        e.job_title_filled,
        d.budget,
        d.location,
        d.dept_name
    FROM base e
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON e.dept_id = d.id
),
filtered_employees AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        hire_date,
        resolved_level,
        level,
        email_employee_full_name,
        job_title_filled,
        budget,
        location,
        dept_name,
        CONCAT_WS('-', level, full_name) AS level_full_name_key,
        COALESCE(level, 'N/A') AS resolved_level_2
    FROM enriched
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-04-25'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date) AS activity_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', hire_date) AS quarter_start,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'L3' THEN 1 END) AS l3_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN location = 'Bangkok' THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS bangkok_budget,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(budget, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS budget_quartiles
FROM filtered_employees
GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date), DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', hire_date))
ORDER BY l3_count DESC NULLS LAST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN page IN ('/home', '/cart') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_group,
        COALESCE(page, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time > TIMESTAMP '2023-03-18 06:00:00'
      AND event_type <> 'search'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(duration_sec) OVER w_grp AS prev_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(event_seq * 0.9, 2) AS event_seq_scaled,
        COALESCE(page, 'DIRECT') AS page_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-03-25 17:00:00'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) AS seq_no,
        MAX(prev_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_duration_sec_max_90d,
        LEAD(event_seq, 1) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id) AS next_event_seq
    FROM cleaned
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM metrics
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(event_seq_scaled, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY next_event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_event_seq_scaled,

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("event_time", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("next_event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_event_seq").desc())

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-03-18 06:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("event_type") != "search"))
    .withColumn("page_group", F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/home", "/cart"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("resolved_page", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("prev_duration_sec", F.lag("duration_sec").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-03-25 17:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("event_seq") * 0.9), 2).alias("event_seq_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.max("prev_duration_sec").over(w3).alias("prev_duration_sec_max_90d"),
        F.lead("event_seq", 1).over(w4).alias("next_event_seq"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w5).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w5) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w6))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("seq_no") == 7)
    .select(
        "*",

        F.avg("seq_no").over(w8).alias("seq_no_avg_2"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("next_event_seq_rank"),

)

        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec"), 2).alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "seq_no_tier",
        "week_start",
        "search_is_new_burst",

    )

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_prices) e AS val
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(val) OVER w_recent AS plan_min_val,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST) AS val_rank,
        COUNT(val) OVER w_recent AS plan_count_val,
        RANK() OVER w_running AS val_rank_2,
        STDDEV_SAMP(val) OVER w_recent AS plan_stddev_samp_val
    FROM flattened
    WHERE val BETWEEN 46 AND 55
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan), w_running AS (ORDER BY val DESC)
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, plan_stddev_samp_val + plan_min_val AS plan_stddev_samp_val_plus_plan_min_val
    FROM metrics
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-04-25'
      AND val_rank = 6
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        val_rank,
        plan_count_val,
        val_rank_2,
        plan_stddev_samp_val,
        plan_stddev_samp_val_plus_plan_min_val,
        CAST(plan_min_val AS STRING) AS plan_min_val_str
    FROM base
    WHERE effective_from >= TO_DATE('2024-01-31')
),
base_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(plan_stddev_samp_val_plus_plan_min_val, 0) AS plan_stddev_samp_val_plus_plan_min_val_rounded,
        ROUND(val_rank_2 / val_rank, 2) AS val_rank_2_per_val_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE plan_stddev_samp_val >= 52
)
SELECT
    id,
    val_rank,
    plan_stddev_samp_val,
    plan_stddev_samp_val_plus_plan_min_val,
    plan_min_val_str,
    val_rank_2_per_val_rank
FROM base_price_tiers
ORDER BY val_rank NULLS LAST;

with filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        round(balance, 0) as balance_rounded,
        case when status = 'FROZEN' then 1 else 0 end as is_frozen,
        coalesce(status, 'NONE') as status_clean
    from accounts
    where customer_id is not null
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        s.balance,
        s.status,
        s.status_clean,
        top1.transaction_txn_type
    from filtered s
    left join lateral (
            select c.txn_type as transaction_txn_type
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
            order by c.txn_time desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        s.status_clean,
        top1.transaction_merchant
    from with_latest s
    left join lateral (
            select c.merchant as transaction_merchant
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
            order by c.amount desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
with_last_accounts as (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.*,
        top1.merchant,
        top1.amount
    from with_last s
    join lateral (
            select c.merchant, c.amount
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
            order by c.txn_time desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
stats as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        case when amount >= 3900 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as amount_tier,
        count(case when merchant = 'Shell' then 1 end) as shell_count,
        count(*) as num_rows,
        size(collect_set(merchant)) as num_merchants
    from with_last_accounts
    group by case when amount >= 3900 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
)
select amount_tier, shell_count
from stats
order by amount_tier desc;

with with_windows as (

        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        row_number() over w_part as row_seq,
        ntile(4) over w_part_2 as monthly_fee_bucket
    from subscriptions
    window w_part as (partition by plan order by start_date desc, id), w_part_2 as (partition by customer_id, status order by monthly_fee, id)
),
cleaned as (

    from with_windows
    where customer_id is not null
),
with_windows_subscriptions as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        row_seq,
        monthly_fee_bucket_str,
        lag(row_seq) over (partition by plan order by row_seq, id) as prev_row_seq,
        lead(row_seq) over (partition by plan order by row_seq, id) as next_row_seq,
        lead(monthly_fee_bucket) over (partition by plan order by row_seq, id) as next_monthly_fee_bucket,
        lag(monthly_fee_bucket) over (partition by plan order by row_seq, id) as prev_monthly_fee_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by plan order by row_seq, id) as event_seq,
        avg(monthly_fee_bucket_str) over (partition by customer_id, plan order by monthly_fee_bucket_str, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as monthly_fee_bucket_str_avg_5
    from cleaned
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        lead(next_row_seq) over w_running as next_next_row_seq,
        lag(next_row_seq) over w_running as prev_next_row_seq,
        lead(row_seq) over w_running as next_row_seq_2,
        lag(row_seq) over w_running as prev_row_seq_2,
        row_number() over w_running as row_seq_2,
        round(prev_row_seq / sum(prev_row_seq) over (partition by customer_id), 4) as prev_row_seq_share
    from with_windows_subscriptions
    window w_running as (partition by customer_id, plan order by prev_monthly_fee_bucket, id)
),
base as (
    select
        *,
        round(prev_next_row_seq, 0) as prev_next_row_seq_rounded,
        round(next_next_row_seq, 1) as next_next_row_seq_rounded
    from enriched
    where customer_id is not null
)

    min(e.row_seq) as min_row_seq
from base e
inner join customers c on e.customer_id = c.id
group by grouping sets ((c.country, c.segment, e.plan), (c.country));

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS k, value
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_min_latency_ms,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms, id, k) AS seq_no
    FROM flattened
    WHERE k = 'trace'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        ROUND(seq_no / SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS seq_no_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS latency_ms_dense_rank,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY service_min_latency_ms, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_seq_no
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, seq_no_share + latency_ms_dense_rank AS seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE latency_ms < 818
),
cleaned_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank * latency_ms_dense_rank AS seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_times_latency_ms_dense_rank,
        ROUND(seq_no_share * 1.15, 2) AS adjusted_seq_no_share
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    k,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank, 0.9) AS seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_p90,
    COUNT_IF(k = 'region') AS region_events
FROM cleaned_app_logs
GROUP BY k
HAVING APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank, 0.9) > 0
ORDER BY seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_p90;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("latency_ms")
w5 = Window.orderBy("service_min_latency_ms", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

scored = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("k") == "trace")
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        F.min("latency_ms").over(w).alias("service_min_latency_ms"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        F.round((F.col("seq_no") / F.sum("seq_no").over(w3)), 4).alias("seq_no_share"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w5).alias("running_seq_no"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") < 818)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("seq_no_share") + F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank")).alias("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned_app_logs = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank") * F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank")).alias("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_times_latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("seq_no_share") * 1.15), 2).alias("adjusted_seq_no_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_app_logs
    .groupBy("k")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank", 0.9).alias("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_p90"),
        F.count_if(F.col("k") == "region").alias("region_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_p90") > 0)
    .orderBy("seq_no_share_plus_latency_ms_dense_rank_p90")
)

    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,

    MIN(e.shipping_fee) AS min_shipping_fee,

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        merchant,
        LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS next_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS amount_dense_rank
    FROM transactions
),
enriched_transactions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS row_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY next_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS row_seq_2
    FROM enriched
    WHERE amount_dense_rank < 7
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY amount_dense_rank, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        merchant,
        row_seq,
        first_known_amount,
        MAX(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS running_max_row_seq,
        COUNT(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS running_count_row_seq,
        SUM(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS running_sum_row_seq,
        LEAD(amount_dense_rank, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, merchant ORDER BY row_seq_2, id) AS next_amount_dense_rank
    FROM enriched_transactions
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY first_known_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        first_known_amount,
        running_max_row_seq,
        running_sum_row_seq,
        next_amount_dense_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount DESC, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        running_max_row_seq,
        running_sum_row_seq,
        next_amount_dense_rank,
        CAST(running_max_row_seq AS INT) AS running_max_row_seq_int
    FROM ranked
    WHERE next_amount_dense_rank <= 5
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN running_max_row_seq >= 9.0 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_max_row_seq_tier,
        CASE WHEN running_sum_row_seq >= 34 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_sum_row_seq_tier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        MAX(running_max_row_seq) AS max_running_max_row_seq,
        ROUND(AVG(running_sum_row_seq), 2) AS avg_running_sum_row_seq
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_max_row_seq >= 9.0 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN running_sum_row_seq >= 34 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 1
)
SELECT
    running_max_row_seq_tier,
    running_sum_row_seq_tier,
    max_running_max_row_seq,
    avg_running_sum_row_seq
FROM grouped
ORDER BY max_running_max_row_seq DESC NULLS FIRST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("amount_dense_rank", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("next_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("first_known_amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant").orderBy("row_seq_2", "id")

enriched = (
    df_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        F.lead("amount", 1).over(w).alias("next_amount"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("amount_dense_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_transactions = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("amount_dense_rank") < 7)
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("first_known_amount", F.first("amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
    .withColumn("row_seq_2", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

metrics = (
    enriched_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "row_seq",
        "first_known_amount",
        F.max("row_seq").over(w_grp).alias("running_max_row_seq"),
        F.count("row_seq").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_row_seq"),
        F.sum("row_seq").over(w_grp).alias("running_sum_row_seq"),
        F.lead("amount_dense_rank", 1).over(w7).alias("next_amount_dense_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "first_known_amount",
        "running_max_row_seq",
        "running_sum_row_seq",
        "next_amount_dense_rank",
    )
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("next_amount_dense_rank") <= 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "running_max_row_seq",
        "running_sum_row_seq",
        "next_amount_dense_rank",
        F.col("running_max_row_seq").cast("int").alias("running_max_row_seq_int"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_row_seq") >= 9.0, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_max_row_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("running_sum_row_seq") >= 34, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_sum_row_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.max("running_max_row_seq").alias("max_running_max_row_seq"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_sum_row_seq"), 2).alias("avg_running_sum_row_seq"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") > 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "running_max_row_seq_tier",
        "running_sum_row_seq_tier",
        "max_running_max_row_seq",
        "avg_running_sum_row_seq",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_running_max_row_seq").desc_nulls_first())
)

w_running = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        src.created_at,
        src.coupon_codes,
        elem.product_id
    FROM carts src
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(src.items) t AS elem
),
flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        EXPLODE(coupon_codes) AS value
    FROM exploded
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        d.email,
        d.city
    FROM flattened src
    LEFT JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id = d.id
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(city)) AS city_title,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS resolved_city
    FROM joined
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.email,
    s.resolved_city,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.balance) FROM accounts t2 WHERE t2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS min_account_balance
FROM cleaned s
ORDER BY min_account_balance DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

balance_by_customer_id = df_accounts.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.min("balance").alias("min_account_balance"))

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("elem", F.explode_outer("items"))
    .select("id", "customer_id", "created_at", "coupon_codes", F.col("elem.product_id"))
)

flattened = exploded.select("id", "customer_id", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("value"))

joined = (
    flattened
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("src.id", "src.customer_id", F.col("d.email"), F.col("d.city"))
)

cleaned = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("city")).alias("city_title"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .join(balance_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select("id", "customer_id", "email", "resolved_city", F.col("min_account_balance"))
    .orderBy(F.col("min_account_balance").desc_nulls_last(), "customer_id")
)

with cleaned as (
    select
        *,
        coalesce(sqft, 0) as sqft_filled,
        upper(store_name) as store_name_upper
    from stores
    where opened_date >= to_date('2023-03-30')
),
deduped as (
    select
        id,
        city,
        region,
        sqft
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by city order by sqft desc nulls first, id) as rank_in_group
        from cleaned
    ) x
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
latest as (
    select *, row_number() over (partition by city order by sqft nulls last, id) as row_num
    from deduped
    qualify row_num = 1
),
latest_match as (
    select
        s.id,
        s.sqft,
        top1.order_status,
        top1.order_order_date
    from latest s
    join lateral (
            select c.status as order_status, c.order_date as order_order_date
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
            order by c.discount desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
ranked as (
    select
        id,
        sqft,
        order_status
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by order_status order by sqft, id) as rank_in_group
        from latest_match
    ) x
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        avg(sqft) over w_part as running_avg_sqft,
        max(sqft) over w_part as running_max_sqft,
        min(sqft) over w_part as running_min_sqft,
        sum(sqft) over w_part as running_sum_sqft,
        sum(sqft) over (order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sqft
    from ranked
    window w_part as (partition by order_status order by sqft, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
)
select
    id,
    sqft,
    order_status,
    running_max_sqft,
    running_min_sqft,
    case when order_status rlike '^(CANCELLED|COMPLETED)$' then 'GROUP_B' when order_status rlike '^(PENDING|SHIPPED)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'PRIORITY' end as order_status_zone
from with_windows
order by running_max_sqft desc, order_status;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sqft").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.discount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_status").orderBy("sqft", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_status").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("opened_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-30")))
    .withColumn("sqft_filled", F.coalesce("sqft", F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("store_name_upper", F.upper("store_name"))
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "city", "region", "sqft")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

latest_match = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.sqft",
        F.col("c.status").alias("order_status"),
        F.col("c.order_date").alias("order_order_date"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "sqft", "order_status")
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("running_avg_sqft", F.avg("sqft").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_max_sqft", F.max("sqft").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_min_sqft", F.min("sqft").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_sum_sqft", F.sum("sqft").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_sqft", F.sum("sqft").over(w6))
)

result = (
    with_windows

FROM base
WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue DESC NULLS LAST), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY store_id), w_running AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);

with remaining_keys as (

metrics as (

        avg(sqft) over (partition by city) city_avg_sqft,
        rank() over (partition by city order by sqft desc) sqft_rank,

    from verified
),
remaining_keys_2 as (

    from metrics
    intersect
    select region, id
    from stores
    where region in ('East', 'Central', 'West')
),
kept_rows as (
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    join remaining_keys_2 k on s.region = k.region and s.id = k.id
),
enriched as (
    select
        store_name,

        opened_date,
        city_avg_sqft,
        sqft_cume_dist,
        dense_rank() over (partition by city, region order by sqft_rank desc) sqft_rank_dense_rank,

    from kept_rows
),
summary as (

        city,
        count(*) filter (where city = 'Bangkok') as bangkok_rows,
        round(avg(sqft_cume_dist), 2) as avg_sqft_cume_dist,

from summary

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_grp AS amount_bucket,
        RANK() OVER w_hist AS amount_rank
    FROM transactions
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount, id), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY amount NULLS FIRST)
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT a.*, p.status
    FROM metrics a
    LEFT JOIN accounts p
        ON a.account_id = p.id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        amount_bucket,
        amount_rank,
        status,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status, account_id ORDER BY amount_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_amount_2,
        MAX(amount_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant) AS account_id_max_amount_rank
    FROM enriched
),
metrics_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        merchant,
        amount_bucket,
        status,
        cumulative_amount_2,
        account_id_max_amount_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant, status ORDER BY account_id_max_amount_rank) AS account_id_max_amount_rank_cume_dist,
        ROUND(amount_rank / SUM(amount_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id), 4) AS amount_rank_share,
        LEAD(amount_bucket, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, txn_type ORDER BY first_known_amount, id) AS next_amount_bucket
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    id,
    account_id,
    txn_type,
    merchant,
    status,
    cumulative_amount_2,
    amount_rank_share,
    next_amount_bucket,
    CASE WHEN txn_type RLIKE '^(FEE|CREDIT)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN txn_type RLIKE '^(DEBIT|REFUND)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS txn_type_zone
FROM metrics_transactions
ORDER BY status DESC NULLS LAST, next_amount_bucket;

with flattened as (
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) li as attr_key, v
),
unpacked as (
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        attr_key,
        v,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,

metrics as (
    select
        id,
        level,
        v,

        avg(status_code_high) over (partition by attr_key) as attr_key_avg_status_code_high,
        percent_rank() over (order by flag_bit8 nulls first) as flag_bit8_percent_rank,
        rank() over (partition by host order by flag_bit8 desc nulls first) as flag_bit8_rank
    from unpacked
    where host in ('h3', 'h4')
    window w_hist as (partition by attr_key order by status_code_high nulls first)
),
base as (
    select *, round(status_code_high / flag_bit8_dense_rank, 2) as status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank
    from metrics
    where status_code_high_dense_rank = 6
),
cleaned as (

        length(level) as level_length,
        trim(level) as clean_level
    from base
    where status_code_high_dense_rank is not null
),
cleaned_app_logs as (
    select *, flag_bit8_dense_rank / nullif(status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank, 0) as flag_bit8_dense_rank_per_status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank
    from cleaned
    where flag_bit8 = 1
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        rank() over (partition by level order by flag_bit8_rank desc nulls last) as flag_bit8_rank_rank,
        avg(status_code_high_dense_rank) over (partition by level) as level_avg_status_code_high_dense_rank,
        sum(status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank) over (partition by level) as level_sum_status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank
    from cleaned_app_logs
)
select

    flag_bit8_dense_rank_per_status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank,
    level_avg_status_code_high_dense_rank,
    level_sum_status_code_high_per_flag_bit8_dense_rank
from with_windows
order by level_length;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc())

    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("salary_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("salary", 1, 0).over(w3).alias("next_salary"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_employees.alias("p2"), F.col("e.manager_id") == F.col("p2.id"), "inner")
    .select(

        "e.manager_id",

result = (

)

with scored as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        count(monthly_fee) over w_grp as running_count_monthly_fee,
        min(monthly_fee) over w_grp as running_min_monthly_fee,
        avg(monthly_fee) over w_grp as running_avg_monthly_fee
    from subscriptions
    where status not in ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED')
    window w_grp as (partition by plan order by start_date asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
latest as (
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by running_count_monthly_fee desc, id asc) as row_num
    from scored
    qualify row_num = 1
),
ranked as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        running_count_monthly_fee
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by plan order by running_count_monthly_fee desc, id asc) as rn
        from latest
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),
base as (
    select
        *,
        monthly_fee * running_count_monthly_fee as monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee - running_count_monthly_fee as monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee
    from ranked
    where status != 'CANCELLED'
),
latest_subscriptions as (
    select
        id,
        status,
        running_count_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by monthly_fee asc nulls last, id asc) as rn
        from base
    ) x
    where rn = 1
),
latest_subscriptions_2 as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by status order by monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee desc nulls first) as dedup_rank
        from latest_subscriptions
    ) x
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
daily as (
    select
        case when running_count_monthly_fee >= 14 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as running_count_monthly_fee_tier,
        sum(case when status = 'PAUSED' then monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee else 0 end) as paused_monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee,
        avg(running_count_monthly_fee) as avg_running_count_monthly_fee,
        count_if(status = 'CANCELLED') as cancelled_events,
        approx_percentile(monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee, 0.9) as monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee_p90,
        approx_percentile(monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee_quartiles,
        avg(monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee) as avg_monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee
    from latest_subscriptions_2
    group by cube (case when running_count_monthly_fee >= 14 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
)
select
    running_count_monthly_fee_tier,
    paused_monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee,
    avg_running_count_monthly_fee,
    cancelled_events,
    monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee_p90,
    monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee_quartiles,
    avg_monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee
from daily
order by monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee_p90 desc nulls last

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

scored = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["ACTIVE", "PAUSED"]))
    .select(

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "monthly_fee", "status", "running_count_monthly_fee")

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("status") != "CANCELLED")
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee", (F.col("monthly_fee") * F.col("running_count_monthly_fee")))
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee", (F.col("monthly_fee") - F.col("running_count_monthly_fee")))

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w5))

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "PAUSED", F.col("monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee")).otherwise(0)).alias("paused_monthly_fee_minus_running_count_monthly_fee"),

        F.avg("monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee").alias("avg_monthly_fee_times_running_count_monthly_fee"),

result = (

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) AS days_since_sale_date,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), sale_date) AS days_since_sale_date_2
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id IN (2, 3, 4)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY days_since_sale_date_2, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, id) AS row_seq_2,
        LAG(units, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY days_since_sale_date_2, id) AS prev_units,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY days_since_sale_date NULLS LAST) AS days_since_sale_date_percent_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id) AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WHERE days_since_sale_date_2 > 73
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, GREATEST(row_seq, days_since_sale_date) AS greatest_row_seq_days_since_sale_date
    FROM enriched
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-06-19'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY days_since_sale_date_2 DESC) AS latest_rank
    FROM base
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        store_id,
        SUM(days_since_sale_date) AS total_days_since_sale_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (store_id)
)
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.total_days_since_sale_date,
    s.distinct_ids,
    (SELECT AVG(x.quantity) FROM inventory x WHERE x.store_id = s.store_id) AS avg_inventory_quantity
FROM totals s
ORDER BY avg_inventory_quantity DESC NULLS FIRST, distinct_ids

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("days_since_sale_date_2", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("days_since_sale_date_2", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("days_since_sale_date").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("days_since_sale_date_2").desc())
quantity_by_store_id = df_inventory.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.avg("quantity").alias("avg_inventory_quantity"))

filtered = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([2, 3, 4]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "sale_date").alias("days_since_sale_date"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "sale_date").alias("days_since_sale_date_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("days_since_sale_date_2") > 73)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.lag("units", 2, 0).over(w3).alias("prev_units"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("days_since_sale_date_percent_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-19").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("greatest_row_seq_days_since_sale_date", F.greatest("row_seq", "days_since_sale_date"))
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

totals = (
    ranked
    .rollup("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("days_since_sale_date").alias("total_days_since_sale_date"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .join(quantity_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "store_id",
        "total_days_since_sale_date",
        "distinct_ids",
        F.col("avg_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_inventory_quantity").desc_nulls_first(), "distinct_ids")
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER w_part AS running_duration_sec,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER w_grp AS duration_sec_max_90d,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 2) OVER w_hist AS next_duration_sec,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS duration_sec_bucket
    FROM web_events
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec_bucket DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_windows
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.browser
    FROM latest e
    LEFT JOIN sessions b
        ON e.session_id = b.id
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM with_dims
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        row_seq,
        duration_sec_bucket,
        browser,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    id,
    event_type,
    event_time,
    row_seq,
    browser,
    session_no,
    CASE WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Firefox|Safari)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN browser RLIKE '^(Chrome|Edge)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS browser_zone
FROM sessionized;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_bucket").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_windows = (
    df_web_events
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w_part).alias("running_duration_sec"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(w_grp).alias("duration_sec_max_90d"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 2).over(w_hist).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w5).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    latest
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.browser"))
)

flagged = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w7) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "row_seq",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        "browser",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w8).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "row_seq",
        "browser",
        "session_no",
        F.when(F.col("browser").rlike("^(Firefox|Safari)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("browser").rlike("^(Chrome|Edge)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("browser_zone"),
    )
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_SUB(opened_date, 46) opened_date_minus_46d
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IN ('CLOSED', 'OPEN')
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        e.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM cleaned e
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.opened_date_minus_46d >= sub.start_date
       AND e.opened_date_minus_46d < sub.end_date + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
cleaned_accounts AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date_minus_46d) opened_date_minus_46d_period
    FROM with_window
    WHERE opened_date_minus_46d BETWEEN '2024-03-29' AND '2025-03-12'
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_type,
        s.balance,
        s.status,
        s.opened_date_minus_46d,
        s.subscription_id,
        s.plan,
        s.opened_date_minus_46d_period,
        latest.txn_time
    FROM cleaned_accounts s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY subscription_id ASC NULLS FIRST) subscription_id_percent_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY subscription_id ASC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC) subscription_id_bucket
    FROM with_last
    WHERE balance BETWEEN 20000 AND 51000
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        opened_date_minus_46d,
        subscription_id,
        plan,
        opened_date_minus_46d_period,
        txn_time,
        FIRST_VALUE(status, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY balance ASC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_status,
        LEAD(subscription_id, 1, 0) OVER w_hist next_subscription_id
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY subscription_id_percent_rank ASC, id ASC, subscription_id ASC)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, status
    FROM enriched
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, status
    FROM accounts
    WHERE customer_id = 10
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.status = k.status
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', txn_time) AS year_start,
    plan,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date_minus_46d_period) AS week_start,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans,
    ROUND(AVG(subscription_id), 2) AS avg_subscription_id,
    MIN(subscription_id) AS min_subscription_id,
    ROUND(SUM(subscription_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS subscription_id_per_enterprise,
    MAX(subscription_id) AS max_subscription_id,
    ROUND(AVG(next_subscription_id), 2) AS avg_next_subscription_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM verified
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', txn_time), plan, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', opened_date_minus_46d_period)), (DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', txn_time), plan));
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.subscription_id")).orderBy(F.col("c.txn_time").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("subscription_id").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("balance", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("subscription_id_percent_rank", "id", "subscription_id")

cleaned = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("status").isin(["CLOSED", "OPEN"]))
    .withColumn("opened_date_minus_46d", F.date_sub("opened_date", 46))
)

with_window = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.opened_date_minus_46d") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.opened_date_minus_46d") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

cleaned_accounts = (
    with_window
    .filter(F.col("opened_date_minus_46d").between("2024-03-29", "2025-03-12"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "opened_date_minus_46d").alias("opened_date_minus_46d_period"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    cleaned_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.account_type",
        "s.balance",
        "s.status",
        "s.opened_date_minus_46d",
        "s.subscription_id",
        "s.plan",
        "s.opened_date_minus_46d_period",
        F.col("c.txn_time"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_last
    .filter(F.col("balance").between(20000, 51000))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("subscription_id_percent_rank"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w3).alias("subscription_id_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "status",
        "opened_date_minus_46d",
        "subscription_id",
        "plan",
        "opened_date_minus_46d_period",
        "txn_time",
        F.first("status", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_status"),
        F.lead("subscription_id", 1, 0).over(w_hist).alias("next_subscription_id"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "status")
    .intersectAll(
        df_accounts
        .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 10)
        .select("id", "status")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("year_start", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "txn_time"))
    .withColumn("week_start", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "opened_date_minus_46d_period"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["year_start", "plan", "week_start"], ["year_start", "plan"]],
        "year_start",
        "plan",
        "week_start",
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.round(F.avg("subscription_id"), 2).alias("avg_subscription_id"),
        F.min("subscription_id").alias("min_subscription_id"),
        F.round(F.sum("subscription_id") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("subscription_id_per_enterprise"),
        F.max("subscription_id").alias("max_subscription_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_subscription_id"), 2).alias("avg_next_subscription_id"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
)
