WITH with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM sessions
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    device,
    browser,
    started_at,
    country,
    island_id,
    CASE WHEN device RLIKE '^(mobile|desktop)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN device RLIKE '^(tablet)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'CORE' END AS device_zone
FROM sessions_sessions
ORDER BY browser ASC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "island_id",
        F.when(F.col("device").rlike("^(mobile|desktop)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("device").rlike("^(tablet)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("CORE").alias("device_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("browser").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, attr_value
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        attr_key,
        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit8,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(flag_bit8) OVER w_hist AS running_flag_bit8,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_recent AS status_code_high_bucket
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_high, id, attr_key)
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_code_high_rank,
        COUNT(running_flag_bit8) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_count_running_flag_bit8
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE status_code_high_bucket <= 5
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id, attr_key) AS rn
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(service_count_running_flag_bit8) OVER w_hist AS running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
        AVG(service_count_running_flag_bit8) OVER w_hist AS running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
        MAX(service_count_running_flag_bit8) OVER w_hist AS running_max_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
        SUM(service_count_running_flag_bit8) OVER w_hist AS cumulative_service_count_running_flag_bit8
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high_rank, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        status_code_high_rank * running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8 AS status_code_high_rank_times_running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
        ROUND(rn / running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8, 2) AS rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'NONE') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM metrics
    WHERE attr_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'version'
)
SELECT
    id,
    attr_key,
    service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    rn,
    running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    running_max_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    cumulative_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    status_code_high_rank_times_running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8,
    CASE WHEN attr_key RLIKE '^(trace|region)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS attr_key_zone
FROM base
ORDER BY rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8 DESC NULLS LAST, id
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code_high_rank", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "attr_key",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit8"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("flag_bit8").over(w_hist).alias("running_flag_bit8"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_recent).alias("status_code_high_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("status_code_high_bucket") <= 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("status_code_high_rank"),
        F.count("running_flag_bit8").over(w4).alias("service_count_running_flag_bit8"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .withColumn("running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8", F.count("service_count_running_flag_bit8").over(w6))
    .withColumn("running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8", F.avg("service_count_running_flag_bit8").over(w6))
    .withColumn("running_max_service_count_running_flag_bit8", F.max("service_count_running_flag_bit8").over(w6))
    .withColumn("cumulative_service_count_running_flag_bit8", F.sum("service_count_running_flag_bit8").over(w6))
)

base = (
    metrics
    .filter(~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version")))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank_times_running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8", (F.col("status_code_high_rank") * F.col("running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8")))
    .withColumn("rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8", F.round((F.col("rn") / F.col("running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8")), 2))
    .withColumn("attr_key_clean", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")))
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        "rn",
        "running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        "running_max_service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        "cumulative_service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        "status_code_high_rank_times_running_count_service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        "rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key").rlike("^(trace|region)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("attr_key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("rn_per_running_avg_service_count_running_flag_bit8").desc_nulls_last(),
        "id",
    )
)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        ROUND(amount / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status), 4) AS amount_share,
        AVG(amount) OVER w_part AS amount_avg_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part_2 AS row_seq,
        SUM(amount) OVER w_part_3 AS method_sum_amount
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_part_2 AS (ORDER BY paid_at, id), w_part_3 AS (PARTITION BY method)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN row_seq >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS row_seq_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at) AS quarter_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE method = 'bank_transfer') AS bank_transfer_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount_share, 0.5) AS amount_share_p50,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount_avg_3, 0.9) AS amount_avg_3_p90,
    ROUND(SUM(row_seq) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'paypal' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS row_seq_per_paypal,
    AVG(row_seq) AS avg_row_seq
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CASE WHEN row_seq >= 8 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', paid_at);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_part_2 = Window.orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w_part_3 = Window.partitionBy("method")

enriched = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("method").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w)), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w_part).alias("amount_avg_3"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part_2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w_part_3).alias("method_sum_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 8, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("row_seq_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "paid_at").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer", 1)).alias("bank_transfer_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_share", 0.5).alias("amount_share_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_avg_3", 0.9).alias("amount_avg_3_p90"),
        F.round(F.sum("row_seq") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("row_seq_per_paypal"),
        F.avg("row_seq").alias("avg_row_seq"),

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), started_at) AS days_since_started_at,
        COALESCE(country, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > TO_DATE('2023-09-06')
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM cleaned
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY days_since_started_at DESC NULLS FIRST) AS row_num
        FROM islands
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_new_burst ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_is_new_burst,
        MIN(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_new_burst ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_is_new_burst,
        MAX(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_new_burst ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_is_new_burst,
        COUNT(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_new_burst ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_is_new_burst
    FROM ranked
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY is_new_burst DESC, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
SELECT
    *,
    SUM(burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY dedup_rank ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_burst_id,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY days_since_started_at DESC, id ASC) AS days_since_started_at_bucket
FROM latest
WHERE is_new_burst >= 1

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w4 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("days_since_started_at").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (

    .withColumn("resolved_country", F.coalesce("country", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))

with valid as (

    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        age,
        case when country = 'US' then 1 else 0 end as is_us,
        coalesce(segment, 'N/A') as segment_clean
    from customers
    where signup_date >= date '2023-04-18'
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        name,
        email,
        is_active,
        age,
        is_us,
        avg(is_us) over (partition by city order by age, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as is_us_avg_5_prior,
        max(is_us) over (partition by segment) as segment_max_is_us
    from valid
    where is_active
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(age) over (order by is_us, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_age,
        ntile(10) over (order by is_us, id) as is_us_bucket
    from metrics
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from subscriptions c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
              and c.status not in ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
        )
),
eligible_customers as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from eligible s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from sessions ch
            where ch.customer_id = s.id
              and ch.country in ('US', 'JP')
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    case when is_us_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as is_us_bucket_tier,
    case when is_us_avg_5_prior >= 75 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as is_us_avg_5_prior_tier,
    case when age >= 72 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as age_tier,
    round(avg(segment_max_is_us), 2) as avg_segment_max_is_us,
    avg(is_us) as avg_is_us,
    count(*) as row_count,
    bit_or(age) as age_bit_or,
    count(*) as num_rows
from eligible_customers
group by case when is_us_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when is_us_avg_5_prior >= 75 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, case when age >= 72 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by age_bit_or;

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_limits) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_recent AS element_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element) AS element_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_recent AS element_dense_rank_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_recent AS element_cume_dist,
        SUM(element) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_element
    FROM flattened
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element DESC)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN element >= 72 THEN 'High' WHEN element >= 23 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS element_band
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE effective_from > DATE '2024-03-26'
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN element_dense_rank >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN element_dense_rank >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS element_dense_rank_level,
        CEIL(element) AS element_whole
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE element_cume_dist BETWEEN 0.34 AND 0.63
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from) AS year_start,
    plan,
    AVG(element_dense_rank_2) AS avg_element_dense_rank_2,
    SUM(element_dense_rank) AS total_element_dense_rank,
    ROUND(AVG(plan_sum_element), 2) AS avg_plan_sum_element,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from), plan), (DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from)), ());

),

        lead(store_sale_revenue) over w_grp as next_store_sale_revenue,
        lag(store_sale_units) over w_grp as prev_store_sale_units,
        row_number() over w_grp as event_seq,
        lead(revenue, 2) over (partition by category, supplier_id order by launch_date, id) as next_revenue

        revenue,

)

    date_trunc('year', launch_date) as year_start,
    percentile_approx(next_revenue, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as next_revenue_quartiles,

    sum(case when category = 'Grocery' then greatest_prev_store_sale_units_event_seq else 0 end) as grocery_greatest_prev_store_sale_units_event_seq,
    percentile_approx(event_seq, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as event_seq_quartiles,
    grouping_id() as gid
from base
group by rollup (date_trunc('year', launch_date));

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(opened_date, 12) AS opened_date_plus_months
    FROM stores
    WHERE region IS DISTINCT FROM 'Central'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date_plus_months) AS row_num
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id) AS next_sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY region, city ORDER BY opened_date_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(sqft) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY opened_date_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_sqft_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date_plus_months DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM deduped
    WHERE region IN ('South', 'West', 'North')
),
deduped_stores AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        opened_date_plus_months,
        next_sqft,
        first_known_sqft,
        event_seq
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY first_known_sqft, id) = 1
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.shipping_fee,
        x.order_channel
    FROM deduped_stores s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.shipping_fee, c.channel AS order_channel
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.discount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    opened_date_plus_months,
    next_sqft,
    shipping_fee,
    order_channel
FROM latest_match
ORDER BY next_sqft DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("opened_date_plus_months")
w2 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("opened_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("opened_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("opened_date_plus_months").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("first_known_sqft", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.discount").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

filtered = (
    df_stores
    .filter(~F.col("region").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Central")))
    .select("*", F.add_months("opened_date", 12).alias("opened_date_plus_months"))
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("region").isin(["South", "West", "North"]))
    .withColumn("next_sqft", F.lead("sqft", 1).over(w2))
    .withColumn("first_known_sqft", F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("first_known_sqft_2", F.first("sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

deduped_stores = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "opened_date_plus_months",
        "next_sqft",
        "first_known_sqft",
        "event_seq",
    )
)

latest_match = (
    deduped_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.shipping_fee"), F.col("c.channel").alias("order_channel"))
)

result = (
    latest_match
    .select(
        "id",
        "opened_date_plus_months",
        "next_sqft",
        "shipping_fee",
        "order_channel",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next_sqft").desc_nulls_first())
)

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        store_name,
        region,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        coalesce(sqft, 0) as sqft_filled,
        coalesce(region, 'DIRECT') as resolved_region
    from stores
    where region is not null
),
with_last as (
    -- Latest matching order per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.store_name,
        s.sqft,
        s.resolved_region,
        latest.order_discount
    from cleaned s
    left join lateral (
            select c.discount as order_discount
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
              and c.order_date <= s.opened_date
            order by c.order_date desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from with_last s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders x
            where x.store_id = s.id
              and x.store_id = 7
        )
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, case when order_discount >= 0.32 then 'High' when order_discount >= 0.16 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as order_discount_level
    from eligible
    where lower(trim(store_name)) = 'downtown express'
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        sqft,
        resolved_region,
        order_discount,
        order_discount_level,
        ntile(5) over (order by sqft desc, id) as sqft_bucket,
        avg(order_discount) over (order by order_discount, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as order_discount_avg_3_prior,
        avg(sqft) over (order by order_discount, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as sqft_avg_3,
        avg(sqft) over (order by sqft, id rows between 6 preceding and current row) as sqft_avg_6
    from filtered
    where lower(trim(store_name)) = 'airport kiosk'
),
filtered_stores as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        sqft,
        resolved_region,
        order_discount,
        order_discount_level,
        sqft_bucket,
        order_discount_avg_3_prior,
        sqft_avg_3,
        sqft_avg_6,
        round(sqft / sqft_bucket, 2) as sqft_per_sqft_bucket,
        cast(order_discount as int) as order_discount_int
    from enriched
    where sqft is not null
),
eligible_stores as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from filtered_stores s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
              and c.status = 'PENDING'

)
-- Running and moving aggregates
select

    avg(order_discount_int) over (order by sqft_avg_6, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as order_discount_int_avg_3_prior,
    sum(sqft_avg_3) over (order by sqft_per_sqft_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sqft_avg_3,
    avg(sqft_avg_6) over (order by sqft_avg_3, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as sqft_avg_6_avg_5

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', ends_on) ends_on_period,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') channel_filled
    FROM promotions
    WHERE ends_on > '2023-11-01'
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    channel_filled,
    LAST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_channel,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct) discount_pct_dense_rank,
    AVG(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) discount_pct_avg_2,
    NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) discount_pct_bucket,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct) discount_pct_cume_dist
FROM base
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct")
w3 = Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct")

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > "2023-11-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "ends_on").alias("ends_on_period"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel_filled",
        F.last("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("last_known_channel"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("discount_pct_dense_rank"),
        F.avg("discount_pct").over(w3).alias("discount_pct_avg_2"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w4).alias("discount_pct_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("discount_pct_cume_dist"),
    )
)

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) e as k, value
),
parsed as (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    select
        id,
        log_ts,
        k,
        cast((status_code & 2) != 0 as int) as is_flagged,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high
    from exploded
    where log_ts >= '2023-07-13'
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        k,
        max(is_flagged) over (partition by k order by log_ts, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_is_flagged,
        avg(is_flagged) over (partition by k order by log_ts, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_is_flagged,
        count(is_flagged) over (partition by k order by log_ts, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_is_flagged
    from parsed
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        lag(running_avg_is_flagged) over (partition by k order by running_avg_is_flagged, id, k) as prev_running_avg_is_flagged,
        lead(running_avg_is_flagged) over (partition by k order by running_avg_is_flagged, id, k) as next_running_avg_is_flagged,
        lead(running_count_is_flagged) over (partition by k order by running_avg_is_flagged, id, k) as next_running_count_is_flagged,
        row_number() over (partition by k order by running_avg_is_flagged, id, k) as seq_no
    from metrics
    where k in ('trace', 'version', 'region')
),
metrics_app_logs as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        ntile(10) over (partition by k order by running_max_is_flagged, id, k) as running_max_is_flagged_bucket,
        sum(seq_no) over (partition by k order by running_max_is_flagged, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_seq_no
    from with_windows
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    seq_no,
    approx_percentile(next_running_avg_is_flagged, 0.5) as next_running_avg_is_flagged_p50,
    count(*) filter (where k = 'region') as region_rows,
    approx_percentile(running_max_is_flagged, 0.9) as running_max_is_flagged_p90,
    size(collect_set(k)) as num_ks
from metrics_app_logs
group by seq_no
order by region_rows nulls last

        coupon_codes,
        line.price,
        line.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(items) x AS line

base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(price * 0.9, 2) AS price_scaled,
        COALESCE(promo, 'NONE') AS promo_clean
    FROM exploded
    WHERE price <= 80
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY price_scaled NULLS FIRST) AS price_scaled_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY price_scaled NULLS FIRST) AS price_scaled_dense_rank_2,
        MAX(price_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY promo) AS promo_max_price_scaled,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price_scaled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS price_scaled_dense_rank_3,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY price_scaled NULLS LAST) AS price_scaled_cume_dist
    FROM base
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        price,
        price_scaled_dense_rank_2,
        promo_max_price_scaled,
        price_scaled_cume_dist,
        MAX(price_scaled_dense_rank_3) OVER w_recent AS promo_max_price_scaled_dense_rank_3,
        SUM(promo_max_price_scaled) OVER w_recent AS promo_sum_promo_max_price_scaled,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY price_scaled_dense_rank_3) AS price_scaled_dense_rank_3_rank,
        ROUND(price_scaled_dense_rank_3 / SUM(price_scaled_dense_rank_3) OVER (PARTITION BY promo), 4) AS price_scaled_dense_rank_3_share,
        MAX(price_scaled_dense_rank_3) OVER w_recent AS promo_max_price_scaled_dense_rank_3_2

)

    where store_id in (4, 5)

        lag(quantity, 2) over w_recent_2 as prev_quantity
    from valid
    window w_running as (partition by store_id order by quantity_filled, id rows between 5 preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by store_id, product_id order by adjusted_quantity nulls first), w_hist as (partition by store_id, product_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_recent_2 as (partition by product_id order by adjusted_quantity, id)
),

    select
        *,
        lead(adjusted_quantity_dense_rank) over w_running as next_adjusted_quantity_dense_rank,
        lag(adjusted_quantity_dense_rank) over w_running as prev_adjusted_quantity_dense_rank,
        lead(adjusted_quantity_avg_5) over w_running as next_adjusted_quantity_avg_5,
        lag(adjusted_quantity_avg_5) over w_running as prev_adjusted_quantity_avg_5,

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) x AS attr_key, attr_value
),
flattened_carts AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        element
    FROM flattened
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) x AS element
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        TO_DATE(created_at) created_at_date,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'DIRECT') attr_key_filled
    FROM flattened_carts
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-01'
      AND attr_key IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        created_at,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        created_at_date,
        attr_key_filled,
        DAY(created_at) created_at_day
    FROM filtered
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    attr_key,
    attr_value,
    created_at_date,
    attr_key_filled,
    created_at_day
FROM base
ORDER BY attr_key DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

flattened_carts = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("element"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    flattened_carts
    .filter((F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")) & F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())

    .withColumn("attr_key_filled", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("DIRECT")))

    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull())

        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "created_at_date",

    .select(

        "attr_value",
        "created_at_date",
        "attr_key_filled",

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, b.discount
    FROM payments src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        status,
        discount,
        CASE WHEN amount >= 1540 THEN 'High' WHEN amount >= 610 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_tier,
        TRIM(status) clean_status
    FROM joined
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2023-05-12'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) order_id_stddev_samp_discount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount DESC, id) event_seq,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id) status_sum_discount
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY status_sum_discount NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        discount,
        amount_tier,
        clean_status,
        order_id_stddev_samp_discount,
        event_seq,
        status_sum_discount,
        COALESCE(discount, 0) discount_filled
    FROM ranked
    WHERE status_sum_discount = 2
),
with_windows_payments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        clean_status,
        order_id_stddev_samp_discount,
        event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount_filled, id) event_seq_2,
        SUM(order_id_stddev_samp_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount_filled, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY status_sum_discount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) event_seq_avg_3_prior,
        SUM(order_id_stddev_samp_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2
    FROM base
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2 >= 2 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(event_seq, 0.5) AS event_seq_p50,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(order_id_stddev_samp_discount, 0.5) AS order_id_stddev_samp_discount_p50,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM with_windows_payments
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2 >= 2 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY order_id_stddev_samp_discount_p50 DESC NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("status_sum_discount").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("discount_filled", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("discount_filled", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("status_sum_discount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

joined = (
    df_payments
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.discount"))
)

valid = (
    joined
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-12").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "status",
        "discount",
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1540, "High").when(F.col("amount") >= 610, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_tier"),
        F.trim("status").alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("discount").over(w).alias("order_id_stddev_samp_discount"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("discount").over(w3).alias("status_sum_discount"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("status_sum_discount") == 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "discount",
        "amount_tier",
        "clean_status",
        "order_id_stddev_samp_discount",
        "event_seq",
        "status_sum_discount",
        F.coalesce("discount", F.lit(0)).alias("discount_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows_payments = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "clean_status",
        "order_id_stddev_samp_discount",
        "event_seq",
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.sum("order_id_stddev_samp_discount").over(w6).alias("running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(w7).alias("event_seq_avg_3_prior"),
        F.sum("order_id_stddev_samp_discount").over(w8).alias("running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_payments
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2") >= 2, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("running_order_id_stddev_samp_discount_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", 0.5).alias("event_seq_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("order_id_stddev_samp_discount", 0.5).alias("order_id_stddev_samp_discount_p50"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
    )

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_prices) x AS tier_value
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_percent_rank,
        MAX(tier_value) OVER w_part AS currency_max_tier_value
    FROM exploded
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY currency, plan)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(currency_max_tier_value * 0.9, 2) AS currency_max_tier_value_scaled
    FROM metrics
    WHERE currency != 'USD'
),
cleaned_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, COALESCE(currency_max_tier_value_scaled, 0) AS currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE tier_value_percent_rank BETWEEN 0.51 AND 0.63
),
cleaned_price_tiers_2 AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        currency_max_tier_value,
        currency_max_tier_value_scaled,
        currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled,
        CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_eur
    FROM cleaned_price_tiers
    WHERE currency = 'USD'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        currency,
        currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled,
        is_eur,
        MAX(is_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_max_is_eur,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_eur NULLS LAST) AS is_eur_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned_price_tiers_2
)
SELECT
    is_eur,
    plan_max_is_eur,
    is_eur_percent_rank
FROM scored;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_eur").asc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.max("tier_value").over(w_part).alias("currency_max_tier_value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("currency") != "USD")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("currency_max_tier_value") * 0.9), 2).alias("currency_max_tier_value_scaled"),
    )
)

cleaned_price_tiers = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_percent_rank").between(0.51, 0.63))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("currency_max_tier_value_scaled", F.lit(0)).alias("currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled"),
    )
)

cleaned_price_tiers_2 = (
    cleaned_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "currency_max_tier_value",
        "currency_max_tier_value_scaled",
        "currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled",
        F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_eur"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned_price_tiers_2
    .select(
        "currency",
        "currency_max_tier_value_scaled_filled",
        "is_eur",
        F.max("is_eur").over(w3).alias("plan_max_is_eur"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("is_eur_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = scored.select("is_eur", "plan_max_is_eur", "is_eur_percent_rank")

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT a.*, s.supplier_name
    FROM products a
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s
        ON a.supplier_id = s.id
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, DATE_SUB(launch_date, 43) AS launch_date_minus_43d
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE launch_date >= TO_DATE('2023-02-23')
      AND supplier_name NOT LIKE 'P%'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY launch_date DESC) AS row_num
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.sale_date < s.launch_date
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(cost) OVER w_ordered AS running_count_cost,
        MAX(cost) OVER w_ordered AS running_max_cost,
        MIN(cost) OVER w_ordered AS running_min_cost
    FROM eligible
    WHERE supplier_name IS NOT NULL
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY category, supplier_id ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.product_name,
        s.category,
        s.cost,
        s.tags,
        s.launch_date_minus_43d,
        s.row_num,
        s.running_count_cost,
        s.running_max_cost,
        s.running_min_cost,
        top1.sale_date,
        top1.store_sale_revenue
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.sale_date, c.revenue AS store_sale_revenue
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.revenue DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
with_latest_products AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.launch_date_minus_43d,
        s.running_count_cost,
        s.running_max_cost,
        s.running_min_cost,
        s.store_sale_revenue,
        top1.order_item_unit_price,
        top1.order_item_quantity
    FROM with_latest s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.unit_price AS order_item_unit_price, c.quantity AS order_item_quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    running_max_cost,
    store_sale_revenue,
    order_item_unit_price,
    order_item_quantity
FROM with_latest_products
ORDER BY id
LIMIT 20;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").desc())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("category", "supplier_id").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.revenue").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.unit_price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

with_dims = (
    df_products
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("a.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("s.supplier_name"))
)

filtered = (
    with_dims
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-02-23"))) & ~F.col("supplier_name").like("P%"))
    .withColumn("launch_date_minus_43d", F.date_sub("launch_date", 43))
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("x"), (F.col("x.product_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.sale_date") < F.col("s.launch_date")), "left_semi")
)

metrics = (
    eligible
    .filter(F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("running_count_cost", F.count("cost").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("running_max_cost", F.max("cost").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("running_min_cost", F.min("cost").over(w_ordered))
)

with_latest = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.product_name",
        "s.category",
        "s.cost",
        "s.tags",
        "s.launch_date_minus_43d",
        "s.row_num",
        "s.running_count_cost",
        "s.running_max_cost",
        "s.running_min_cost",
        F.col("c.sale_date"),
        F.col("c.revenue").alias("store_sale_revenue"),
    )
)

with_latest_products = (
    with_latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.launch_date_minus_43d",
        "s.running_count_cost",
        "s.running_max_cost",
        "s.running_min_cost",
        "s.store_sale_revenue",
        F.col("c.unit_price").alias("order_item_unit_price"),
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("order_item_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_latest_products
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_max_cost",
        "store_sale_revenue",
        "order_item_unit_price",
        "order_item_quantity",
    )
    .orderBy("id")
    .limit(20)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating_bucket", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & F.col("city").isin(["Tokyo", "London", "New York"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        F.trim("country").alias("clean_country"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_city"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "clean_country",
        "resolved_city",
        F.ntile(4).over(w).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("event_seq").over(w3).alias("next_event_seq"),
        F.lag("rating_bucket").over(w3).alias("prev_rating_bucket"),
        F.lead("rating_bucket").over(w3).alias("next_rating_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("rating_bucket").over(w4).alias("cumulative_rating_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

base_suppliers = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("next_event_seq") >= 5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "clean_country",
        "resolved_city",
        "rating_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "next_event_seq",
        "prev_rating_bucket",
        "next_rating_bucket",
        "row_seq",
        "cumulative_rating_bucket",
        "rn",
        F.round("next_rating_bucket", 0).alias("next_rating_bucket_rounded"),
        F.round((F.col("row_seq") / F.col("cumulative_rating_bucket")), 2).alias("row_seq_per_cumulative_rating_bucket"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_city_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_suppliers
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("cumulative_rating_bucket", 0.95).alias("cumulative_rating_bucket_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", 1)).alias("chiang_mai_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_rating_bucket", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_rating_bucket_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("chiang_mai_count").desc())
)

    .filter((F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10") & (F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-08-15").cast("date")))

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        val
    from price_tiers
    lateral view explode(tier_limits) t as val
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        val,
        cume_dist() over w_recent as val_cume_dist
    from flattened
    window w_recent as (partition by plan order by val desc nulls first)
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        val,
        dense_rank() over (order by val nulls first) as val_dense_rank,
        dense_rank() over (order by val_cume_dist desc nulls last) as val_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by val_cume_dist desc nulls first) as val_cume_dist_percent_rank
    from metrics
    where val = 40
),
scored_price_tiers as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        val,
        val_dense_rank,
        val_cume_dist_percent_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by val_cume_dist_percent_rank desc nulls last) as val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        cume_dist() over (order by val_cume_dist_dense_rank desc nulls first) as val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        percent_rank() over (order by val_cume_dist_percent_rank desc) as val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank
    from scored
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, val_cume_dist_percent_rank + val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist as val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist
    from scored_price_tiers
    where val_cume_dist_percent_rank > 0.64
),
filtered_price_tiers as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, round(val, 0) as val_rounded
    from filtered
    where val_dense_rank is not null
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        val,
        val_cume_dist_percent_rank,
        val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        dense_rank() over (order by val_rounded nulls last) as val_rounded_dense_rank,
        dense_rank() over w_hist as val_cume_dist_percent_rank_dense_rank
    from filtered_price_tiers
    window w_hist as (order by val_cume_dist_percent_rank)
)
select
    val,
    val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist,
    val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank,
    val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist,
    val_rounded_dense_rank,
    val_cume_dist_percent_rank_dense_rank
from with_windows
order by val nulls first;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist_percent_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_cume_dist_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())

    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("val"))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("val") == 40)
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("val_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("val_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("val_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
    )
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "val",
        "val_dense_rank",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank",
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("val_cume_dist_percent_rank") > 0.64)
    .withColumn("val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist", (F.col("val_cume_dist_percent_rank") + F.col("val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist")))
)

filtered_price_tiers = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("val_dense_rank").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.round("val", 0).alias("val_rounded"))
)

with_windows = (

    .select(
        "val",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank",
        "val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist",
        F.dense_rank().over(w8).alias("val_rounded_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_hist).alias("val_cume_dist_percent_rank_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "val",
        "val_cume_dist_dense_rank_cume_dist",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank_plus_val_cume_dist_percent_rank_cume_dist",
        "val_rounded_dense_rank",
        "val_cume_dist_percent_rank_dense_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, GREATEST(quantity, unit_price) AS greatest_quantity_unit_price
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (11, 18, 23)
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        rank_in_group,
        LEAD(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS next_unit_price,
        LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS prev_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS next_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id) AS row_seq,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_6_prior
    FROM deduped
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT src.*, d.price
    FROM scored src
    LEFT JOIN products d
        ON src.product_id = d.id
    WHERE d.product_name LIKE '%Lapto%'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        rank_in_group,
        next_unit_price,
        prev_quantity,
        row_seq,
        price,
        LAST_VALUE(row_seq, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY next_unit_price DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM with_dims
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_id,
    s.next_unit_price,
    s.prev_quantity,
    s.row_seq,
    s.price,
    s.last_known_row_seq,
    s.event_seq,
    (SELECT AVG(t2.units) FROM store_sales t2 WHERE t2.product_id = s.product_id) AS avg_store_sale_units
FROM enriched s;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w3 = Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_unit_price").desc(), "id")
units_by_product_id = df_store_sales.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.avg("units").alias("avg_store_sale_units"))

base = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([11, 18, 23]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("quantity", "unit_price").alias("greatest_quantity_unit_price"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.lead("unit_price").over(w).alias("next_unit_price"),
        F.lag("quantity").over(w).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.lead("quantity").over(w).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(w2).alias("quantity_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    scored
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.product_name").like("%Lapto%"))
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.price"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "rank_in_group",
        "next_unit_price",
        "prev_quantity",
        "row_seq",
        "price",
        F.last("row_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .join(units_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "next_unit_price",
        "prev_quantity",
        "row_seq",
        "price",
        "last_known_row_seq",
        "event_seq",
        F.col("avg_store_sale_units"),
    )
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at_period", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("started_at") >= F.lit("2023-07-17").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("device").isin(["tablet", "desktop"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("device_group"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "started_at").alias("started_at_period"),
        F.coalesce("country", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("country_clean"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("started_at_period").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("started_at_period") > F.lag("started_at_period").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(discounts) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        element,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element ASC NULLS LAST) element_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element DESC NULLS FIRST) element_rank_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan ORDER BY element DESC NULLS FIRST) element_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY element DESC NULLS LAST) element_rank_3,
        MAX(element) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_max_element
    FROM flattened
    WHERE element IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        element_rank,
        element_rank_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_max_element ASC) currency_max_element_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY element DESC) element_dense_rank
    FROM scored
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        plan,
        element_rank_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY element_rank_2 ASC NULLS FIRST) element_rank_2_cume_dist,
        ROUND(element_dense_rank / SUM(element_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY currency), 4) element_dense_rank_share
    FROM metrics
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        element_dense_rank_share - element_rank_2_cume_dist element_dense_rank_share_minus_element_rank_2_cume_dist,
        CASE WHEN plan IN ('starter', 'enterprise') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END plan_group
    FROM scored_price_tiers
    WHERE element_rank_2_cume_dist <= 0.57
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        plan,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(element_rank_2, 0.5) AS element_rank_2_p50,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(element_rank_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS element_rank_2_quartiles,
        ROUND(SUM(element_rank_2_cume_dist) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS element_rank_2_cume_dist_per_pro,
        ROUND(SUM(element_rank_2) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS element_rank_2_per_enterprise
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY plan
)
SELECT
    plan,
    element_rank_2_p50,
    element_rank_2_cume_dist_per_pro,
    element_rank_2_per_enterprise
FROM grouped
ORDER BY element_rank_2_per_enterprise DESC NULLS FIRST, plan ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency", "plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w6 = Window.orderBy("currency_max_element")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_rank_2").asc_nulls_first())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("element"))
)

scored = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("element").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "element",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("element_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("element_rank_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("element_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("element_rank_3"),
        F.max("element").over(w5).alias("currency_max_element"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "element_rank",
        "element_rank_2",
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("currency_max_element_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("element_dense_rank"),
    )
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "plan",
        "element_rank_2",
        F.cume_dist().over(w8).alias("element_rank_2_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("element_dense_rank") / F.sum("element_dense_rank").over(w5)), 4).alias("element_dense_rank_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("element_rank_2_cume_dist") <= 0.57)
    .withColumn("element_dense_rank_share_minus_element_rank_2_cume_dist", (F.col("element_dense_rank_share") - F.col("element_rank_2_cume_dist")))
    .withColumn("plan_group", F.when(F.col("plan").isin(["starter", "enterprise"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other"))
)

grouped = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("element_rank_2", 0.5).alias("element_rank_2_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("element_rank_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("element_rank_2_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("element_rank_2_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("element_rank_2_cume_dist_per_pro"),
        F.round(F.sum("element_rank_2") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("element_rank_2_per_enterprise"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "plan",
        "element_rank_2_p50",
        "element_rank_2_cume_dist_per_pro",
        "element_rank_2_per_enterprise",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("element_rank_2_per_enterprise").desc_nulls_first(), "plan")
)

sql: WITH prev_events AS (SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) AS prev_paid_at FROM payments), flagged AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag FROM prev_events), sessionized AS (SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id FROM flagged) SELECT CASE WHEN new_group_flag >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS new_group_flag_tier, status, ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS amount_per_failed, SUM(new_group_flag) AS total_new_group_flag, MAX(paid_at) AS ended_at, GROUPING_ID() AS gid FROM sessionized GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN new_group_flag >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, status) ORDER BY total_new_group_flag DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    prev_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("new_group_flag_tier", F.when(F.col("new_group_flag") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .cube("new_group_flag_tier", "status")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("amount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("amount_per_failed"),
        F.sum("new_group_flag").alias("total_new_group_flag"),
        F.max("paid_at").alias("ended_at"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("total_new_group_flag").desc_nulls_first())
)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.product_name,
        a.cost,
        a.launch_date,
        a.supplier_id,
        d.rating,
        d.country,
        d.city
    FROM products a
    INNER JOIN suppliers d
        ON a.supplier_id = d.id
    WHERE d.city = 'Chiang Mai'
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.product_name,
        s.supplier_id,
        s.rating,
        s.city,
        latest.quantity
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.last_restock <= s.launch_date
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        supplier_id,
        rating,
        city,
        MIN(quantity) OVER w_part AS last3_min_quantity,
        COUNT(quantity) OVER w_part AS last3_count_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER w_part AS last3_avg_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, city) AS supplier_id_sum_quantity
    FROM latest_match
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY city, supplier_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.supplier_id,
        s.city,
        s.last3_min_quantity,
        s.supplier_id_sum_quantity,
        top1.store_sale_units
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.units AS store_sale_units
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.supplier_id,
    s.city,
    s.last3_min_quantity,
    s.supplier_id_sum_quantity,
    s.store_sale_units,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN city RLIKE '^(New York|Singapore)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS city_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(x.price) FROM products x WHERE x.supplier_id = s.supplier_id) AS min_product_price
FROM with_last s
ORDER BY supplier_id, min_product_price DESC;

with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) t as key, v
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        level,
        key,
        avg(status_code) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 7200 preceding and current row) as status_code_avg_2h,
        max(status_code) over (order by cast(log_ts as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as status_code_max_15m,
        sum(status_code) over (partition by key) as key_sum_status_code,
        rank() over (partition by level, service order by status_code desc) as status_code_rank
    from lines
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        status_code_max_15m,
        key_sum_status_code,
        status_code_rank,
        trim(key) as clean_key,
        floor(status_code_avg_2h) as status_code_avg_2h_whole
    from metrics
    where status_code_avg_2h > 378
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        status_code_max_15m,
        key_sum_status_code,
        clean_key,
        status_code_rank * status_code_max_15m as status_code_rank_times_status_code_max_15m
    from base
    where status_code_avg_2h_whole between 60 and 74
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        status_code_max_15m,
        status_code_rank_times_status_code_max_15m,
        rank() over (order by status_code_rank_times_status_code_max_15m nulls first) as status_code_rank_times_status_code_max_15m_rank,

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, case when country in ('US', 'SG') then 'Priority' else 'Other' end as country_group
    from sessions
    where started_at > timestamp '2023-03-08 07:00:00'
      and to_date(started_at) >= '2025-04-27'
),
with_window as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        src.*,
        sub.id as subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    from cleaned src
    left join subscriptions sub
        on src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and src.started_at >= sub.start_date
       and src.started_at < sub.end_date + interval '30' day
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(started_at) over (partition by plan order by started_at, id, subscription_id) as prev_started_at
    from with_window
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_started_at is null or started_at > prev_started_at + interval 7 days then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from with_prev
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by plan order by started_at, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from flagged
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when started_at - lag(started_at) over (partition by device order by started_at, id, subscription_id) > interval 90 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from sessionized
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        subscription_id,
        prev_started_at,
        session_no,
        sum(is_new_session) over (partition by device order by started_at, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from with_gaps
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from islands s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from web_events ch
            where ch.session_id = s.id
              and ch.event_time <= s.prev_started_at
        )
),
latest_match as (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.started_at,
        s.subscription_id,
        s.session_no,
        latest.event_time,
        latest.page
    from eligible s
    left join lateral (
            select c.event_time, c.page
            from web_events c
            where c.session_id = s.id
            order by c.duration_sec desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) latest on true
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(session_no) over (partition by page order by started_at, id, subscription_id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_avg_session_no,
        min(session_no) over (partition by page order by started_at, id, subscription_id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_min_session_no,
        count(session_no) over (partition by page order by started_at, id, subscription_id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_count_session_no,
        ntile(4) over (order by session_no desc, id, subscription_id) as session_no_bucket
    from latest_match
)
select
    id,
    started_at,
    subscription_id,
    session_no,
    page,
    last3_min_session_no,
    last3_count_session_no,
    session_no_bucket
from with_windows
order by started_at desc, page

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        CONCAT(country, ' ', browser) country_browser
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > DATE '2023-03-27'
      AND device NOT IN ('tablet', 'mobile')
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        country,
        country_browser,
        SUBSTRING(device, 1, 2) device_prefix,
        COALESCE(country, 'N/A') country_filled
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE device = 'mobile'
      AND country IS NOT NULL
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        top1.event_type,
        top1.web_event_duration_sec
    FROM filtered s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_type, c.duration_sec AS web_event_duration_sec
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.duration_sec DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        country_browser,
        country_filled,
        MAX(web_event_duration_sec) OVER w_hist running_max_web_event_duration_sec,
        MIN(web_event_duration_sec) OVER w_hist running_min_web_event_duration_sec,
        AVG(web_event_duration_sec) OVER w_hist running_avg_web_event_duration_sec,
        SUM(web_event_duration_sec) OVER w_hist running_sum_web_event_duration_sec
    FROM latest_match
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY web_event_duration_sec ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT device
    FROM scored
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT device
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at < '2024-06-02'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.device = k.device
),
report AS (
    SELECT
        device,
        country_browser,
        country_filled,
        running_max_web_event_duration_sec,
        running_min_web_event_duration_sec,
        running_avg_web_event_duration_sec,
        running_sum_web_event_duration_sec
    FROM verified
    ORDER BY running_sum_web_event_duration_sec ASC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
    device,
    country_browser,
    running_min_web_event_duration_sec,
    running_avg_web_event_duration_sec,
    running_sum_web_event_duration_sec
FROM report
