WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(page) AS page_length,
        SUBSTRING(page, 1, 3) AS page_prefix
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-09 18:00:00'
      AND page IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY page, event_type) AS page_min_duration_sec,
        LAG(page_length, 1) OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec ASC, id ASC) AS prev_page_length,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY page_length DESC) AS page_length_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE session_id IN (10, 25)
),
metrics_web_events AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        page_length,
        page_prefix,
        prev_page_length,
        page_length_dense_rank,
        COUNT(prev_page_length) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type) AS event_type_count_prev_page_length,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY page_length DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM metrics
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, page
    FROM metrics_web_events
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page = '/product'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics_web_events s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.page = k.page
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.device,
        d.country
    FROM kept_rows a
    INNER JOIN sessions d
        ON a.session_id = d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(channel) AS channel_lower,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS channel_clean
    FROM orders
    WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL
      AND customer_id IN (13, 16, 17, 20)
),
cleaned_orders AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        channel_lower,
        CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 31 THEN 'High' WHEN shipping_fee >= 9 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS shipping_fee_tier,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-05-07'
      AND store_id IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        channel,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        shipping_fee_tier,
        LAG(shipping_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC) AS prev_shipping_fee,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY discount DESC, id ASC) AS discount_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running AS shipping_fee_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned_orders
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, p.name
    FROM metrics a
    INNER JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id <=> p.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        shipping_fee_tier,
        prev_shipping_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, store_id ORDER BY discount_bucket DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY prev_shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_shipping_fee,
        FIRST_VALUE(shipping_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY shipping_fee_cume_dist ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_shipping_fee,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount DESC) AS discount_dense_rank,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY shipping_fee_cume_dist DESC, id ASC) AS shipping_fee_cume_dist_bucket
    FROM joined
    WHERE shipping_fee > 17
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching shipment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.shipped_date
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.shipped_date
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
joined_orders AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.shipping_fee_tier,
        s.event_seq,
        s.first_known_shipping_fee,
        s.shipping_fee_cume_dist_bucket,
        b.credit_limit,
        b.city,
        b.signup_date
    FROM latest_match s
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON s.customer_id <=> b.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    customer_id,
    city,
    ROUND(SUM(event_seq) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS event_seq_per_bangkok,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    SUM(event_seq) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_total_event_seq,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS city_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM joined_orders
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((customer_id, city), (customer_id), ())
ORDER BY distinct_cities ASC;

    currency_sum_val_minus_val_dense_rank,

    select *, round(revenue * 100, 2) as adjusted_revenue
    from store_sales
    where sale_date between '2024-03-01' and '2025-01-17'
),
joined as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        e.*,
        d.cost,
        d.category,
        d.price
    from cleaned e
    left join products d
        on e.product_id = d.id
    where d.product_name like 'La%'
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        cost,
        price
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by store_id, product_id order by adjusted_revenue nulls first, id) as latest_rank
        from joined
    ) t
    where latest_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from ranked
    except distinct
    select id
    from store_sales
    where product_id in (9, 10)
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from ranked s
    join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, cost + price as margin
    from kept_rows
    where sale_date > date '2023-06-11'
      and price between 370 and 850
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, rank() over (order by revenue desc) as revenue_rank
    from filtered
),
with_windows_store_sales as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, cume_dist() over (order by price desc nulls first) as price_cume_dist
    from with_windows
)
-- Grouped metrics

    round(avg(revenue), 2) as avg_revenue,

    count(*) as event_count,

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM web_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        is_new_burst,
        burst_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY burst_id) AS burst_id_rank,
        LAG(is_new_burst, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, page ORDER BY duration_sec, id) AS prev_is_new_burst,
        COUNT(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS duration_sec_count_7d,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY page, session_id ORDER BY burst_id, id) AS next_duration_sec
    FROM islands
    WHERE burst_id >= 4
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM enriched
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        burst_id,
        burst_id_rank,
        next_duration_sec,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_2
    FROM flagged
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, event_type
    FROM sessionized
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, event_type
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec < 120
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessionized s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.event_type = k.event_type
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_avg_7d,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY burst_id_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS burst_id_rank_percent_rank,
        COUNT(burst_id_2) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id_2_count_7d
    FROM kept_rows
),
summary AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN burst_id_2 >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS burst_id_2_tier,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(burst_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS burst_id_quartiles,
        COUNT_IF(event_type = 'add_to_cart') AS add_to_cart_events,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id_rank_percent_rank, 0.95) AS burst_id_rank_percent_rank_p95,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(burst_id_2_count_7d, 0.5) AS burst_id_2_count_7d_p50
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN burst_id_2 >= 9 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
)
SELECT
    burst_id_2_tier,
    burst_id_quartiles,
    add_to_cart_events,
    burst_id_2_count_7d_p50
FROM summary
ORDER BY burst_id_2_count_7d_p50 DESC NULLS LAST

w8 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_id_rank").desc_nulls_last())

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        started_at,
        country,
        SUBSTRING(device, 1, 2) AS device_prefix,
        UPPER(device) AS device_upper
    FROM sessions
    WHERE HOUR(started_at) BETWEEN 12 AND 20
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned_sessions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        country,
        device_prefix,
        device_upper,
        YEAR(started_at) AS started_at_year
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE started_at >= DATE '2023-02-27'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, FLOOR(started_at_year) AS started_at_year_whole
    FROM cleaned_sessions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id, country
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT customer_id, country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country = 'SG'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.country = k.country
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events ch
            WHERE ch.session_id = s.id
              AND ch.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT customer_id, country
    FROM not_flagged
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT customer_id, country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country IN ('DE', 'UK', 'TH')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.country = k.country
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time >= s.started_at
        )
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at) AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE country = 'DE') AS de_rows,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'SG' THEN 1 END) AS sg_count,
        MAX(started_at_year) FILTER (WHERE country = 'JP') AS jp_max_started_at_year,
        MAX(started_at) AS ended_at
    FROM kept
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at))
)
SELECT
    de_rows,
    sg_count,
    ended_at
FROM stats
ORDER BY de_rows

        store_name,

        store_name_normalized,

    FROM with_latest

),
eligible AS (

    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id

    FROM eligible
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)

WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM payments
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM islands
),
gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst_2
    FROM with_prev
),
islands_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst_2) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps_2
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT order_id, status
    FROM islands_payments
    EXCEPT
    SELECT order_id, status
    FROM payments
    WHERE amount BETWEEN 430 AND 1330
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM islands_payments s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id AND s.status = k.status
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.shipping_fee
    FROM reconciled src
    INNER JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id = p.id
),
enriched_payments AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.order_date,
        o.amount AS order_amount
    FROM enriched src
    INNER JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id <=> o.id
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN amount >= 1710 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS amount_tier,
        CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_new_burst_tier,
        method,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(is_new_burst_2, 0.9) AS is_new_burst_2_p90,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(paid_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(paid_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
        MIN(is_new_burst) AS min_is_new_burst,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE method = 'bank_transfer') AS bank_transfer_rows,
        MAX(prev_paid_at) AS ended_at,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END) AS refunded_count
    FROM enriched_payments
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN amount >= 1710 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN is_new_burst >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, method)
)
SELECT
    amount_tier,
    is_new_burst_tier,
    is_new_burst_2_p90,
    duration_min,
    min_is_new_burst,
    ended_at
FROM summary
ORDER BY duration_min DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

with_prev = islands.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(w))

gaps_2 = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst_2", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands_payments = gaps_2.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst_2").over(w2))

matched_keys = (
    islands_payments
    .select("order_id", "status")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("amount").between(430, 1330))
        .select("order_id", "status")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    islands_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.shipping_fee"))
)

enriched_payments = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.order_date"), F.col("o.amount").alias("order_amount"))
)

summary = (
    enriched_payments
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1710, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("is_new_burst") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_new_burst_tier"),
        "method",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("is_new_burst_2", 0.9).alias("is_new_burst_2_p90"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("paid_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("paid_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.min("is_new_burst").alias("min_is_new_burst"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "bank_transfer", 1)).alias("bank_transfer_rows"),
        F.max("prev_paid_at").alias("ended_at"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "amount_tier",
        "is_new_burst_tier",
        "is_new_burst_2_p90",
        "duration_min",
        "min_is_new_burst",
        "ended_at",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_min").desc())
)

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(attributes) t as attr_key, attr_value
),
exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        attr_key,
        explode_outer(coupon_codes) as code
    from flattened
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.*,
        b.email,
        b.credit_limit
    from exploded src
    left join customers b
        on src.customer_id = b.id
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        attr_key,
        code,
        email,
        credit_limit,
        coalesce(credit_limit, 0) as credit_limit_filled,
        upper(email) as email_upper
    from joined
    where email is null
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        stddev_samp(credit_limit) over (partition by attr_key) as attr_key_stddev_samp_credit_limit,
        rank() over (partition by code order by credit_limit_filled nulls last) as credit_limit_filled_rank,
        sum(credit_limit_filled) over (partition by code, attr_key) as code_sum_credit_limit_filled
    from cleaned
    where code = 'BUNDLE'
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        attr_key,
        code,
        email,
        credit_limit_filled,
        credit_limit_filled_rank,
        code_sum_credit_limit_filled,
        dense_rank() over (order by credit_limit_filled nulls first) as credit_limit_filled_dense_rank,
        count(credit_limit_filled) over (partition by code, attr_key) as code_count_credit_limit_filled,
        stddev_samp(credit_limit_filled_rank) over (partition by attr_key, code) as attr_key_stddev_samp_credit_limit_filled_rank
    from scored
),
valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, credit_limit_filled + attr_key_stddev_samp_credit_limit_filled_rank as credit_limit_filled_plus_attr_key_stddev_samp_credit_limit_filled_rank
    from metrics
    where code_count_credit_limit_filled != 6
),
stats as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        code,
        case when credit_limit_filled_dense_rank >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as credit_limit_filled_dense_rank_tier,
        sort_array(collect_set(attr_key)) as attr_key_list,
        min(credit_limit_filled_rank) as min_credit_limit_filled_rank,
        sum(case when code = 'BUNDLE' then credit_limit_filled else 0 end) as bundle_credit_limit_filled,
        percentile_approx(credit_limit_filled, 0.95) as credit_limit_filled_p95,
        sum(case when code = 'WELCOME5' then code_sum_credit_limit_filled else 0 end) as welcome5_code_sum_credit_limit_filled
    from valid
    group by 1, 2
    having credit_limit_filled_p95 >= 0
)
select
    code,
    credit_limit_filled_dense_rank_tier,
    attr_key_list,
    credit_limit_filled_p95
from stats;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("code").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit_filled").asc_nulls_last())

cleaned = (

    .filter(F.col("email").isNull())
    .select(

        "code",
        "email",
        "credit_limit",

        F.upper("email").alias("email_upper"),
    )

scored = (

    .filter(F.col("code") == "BUNDLE")
    .select(
        "*",

metrics = (

valid = (

    )
    .filter(F.col("credit_limit_filled_p95") >= 0)
)

result = (

        unit_price,
        ROUND(unit_price * 0.9, 2) AS adjusted_unit_price,
        CASE WHEN unit_price >= 320 THEN 'High' WHEN unit_price >= 80 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS unit_price_band
    FROM order_items
    WHERE unit_price <= 290

        adjusted_unit_price,
        COUNT(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY adjusted_unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_unit_price,
        AVG(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY adjusted_unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_unit_price,
        SUM(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY adjusted_unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_unit_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS event_seq
    FROM valid
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_count_unit_price DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_avg_unit_price DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        running_sum_unit_price,
        latest_rank
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY event_seq DESC) = 1
)

    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_sum_unit_price) AS running_sum_unit_price_rank,

    AVG(running_sum_unit_price) OVER (ORDER BY latest_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_unit_price_avg_6
FROM latest

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        case when quantity >= 263 then 'High' when quantity >= 71 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as quantity_level
    from inventory
    where last_restock >= date '2023-02-21'
      and last_restock <= '2024-08-07'
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        count(quantity) over (partition by store_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_quantity,
        avg(quantity) over (partition by store_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_quantity,
        max(quantity) over (partition by store_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_quantity,
        first_value(quantity, true) over (partition by store_id order by quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_quantity
    from base
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        quantity,
        quantity_level,
        running_avg_quantity,
        running_max_quantity,
        avg(running_count_quantity) over (partition by store_id order by running_avg_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_running_count_quantity,
        max(running_count_quantity) over (partition by store_id order by running_avg_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_running_count_quantity,
        count(running_count_quantity) over (partition by store_id order by running_avg_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_running_count_quantity,
        sum(running_count_quantity) over (partition by store_id order by running_avg_quantity, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sum_running_count_quantity,
        ntile(4) over (partition by store_id order by first_known_quantity, id) as first_known_quantity_bucket
    from scored
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select store_id, id
    from with_windows
    except distinct
    select store_id, id
    from inventory
    where last_restock between '2024-01-30' and '2024-02-16'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    join kept_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id and s.id = k.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        running_avg_quantity,
        running_avg_running_count_quantity,
        running_max_running_count_quantity,
        running_count_running_count_quantity,
        round(running_avg_quantity / running_count_running_count_quantity, 2) as running_avg_quantity_per_running_count_running_count_quantity
    from reconciled
    where running_max_quantity < 130
)
select
    id,
    running_avg_quantity,
    running_max_running_count_quantity,
    running_count_running_count_quantity
from filtered

WITH with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.product_stock_qty
    FROM suppliers s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.cost DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        ROUND(product_stock_qty * 1.15, 2) AS product_stock_qty_adjusted,
        LOWER(country) AS country_lower,
        COALESCE(city, 'N/A') AS city_filled
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Tokyo'
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.launch_date > '2023-08-01'
        )
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.product_cost
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost AS product_cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.brand IN ('Initech', 'Stark')
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_adjusted, id) AS prev_rating,
        LEAD(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_adjusted, id) AS next_rating,
        LAG(product_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_adjusted, id) AS prev_product_cost,
        LEAD(product_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_adjusted, id) AS next_product_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_adjusted, id) AS event_seq
    FROM not_flagged
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY product_cost NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    city,
    product_stock_qty_adjusted,
    country_lower,
    product_cost,
    prev_rating,
    next_rating,
    next_product_cost,
    event_seq,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Berlin|Tokyo)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS city_zone
FROM deduped;

    left join subscriptions sub
        on a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and a.opened_date between sub.start_date and sub.end_date
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from attributed s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions x
            where x.account_id = s.id
              and x.txn_time < s.opened_date
        )
),
eligible as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from kept s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions ch
            where ch.account_id = s.id
              and ch.txn_time <= s.opened_date
        )
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        subscription_id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        subscription_id_2,
        subscription_plan,
        subscription_monthly_fee
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by plan order by subscription_monthly_fee, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as rn
        from eligible
    ) t
    where rn = 1
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
select
    id,
    subscription_id,
    monthly_fee,
    subscription_id_2,
    subscription_plan,
    lead(subscription_monthly_fee) over (partition by customer_id order by subscription_id_2, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as next_subscription_monthly_fee,
    lag(subscription_monthly_fee) over (partition by customer_id order by subscription_id_2, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as prev_subscription_monthly_fee,
    lag(subscription_id) over (partition by customer_id order by subscription_id_2, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as prev_subscription_id,
    lead(subscription_id) over (partition by customer_id order by subscription_id_2, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as next_subscription_id,
    row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by subscription_id_2, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) as event_seq,
    last_value(subscription_monthly_fee) ignore nulls over (partition by subscription_plan order by subscription_id, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2 rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_subscription_monthly_fee
from ranked
where subscription_id between 4 and 8;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("subscription_monthly_fee", "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("subscription_id_2", "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan").orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_window = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("e.opened_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("e.opened_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    with_window
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("a.opened_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id_2"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

kept = (
    attributed
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.txn_time") < F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

eligible = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.txn_time") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

ranked = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "subscription_id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id_2",
        "subscription_plan",
        "subscription_monthly_fee",
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("subscription_id").between(4, 8))
    .select(
        "id",
        "subscription_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id_2",
        "subscription_plan",
        F.lead("subscription_monthly_fee").over(w2).alias("next_subscription_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("subscription_monthly_fee").over(w2).alias("prev_subscription_monthly_fee"),
        F.lag("subscription_id").over(w2).alias("prev_subscription_id"),
        F.lead("subscription_id").over(w2).alias("next_subscription_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("subscription_monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) AS carrier_title,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'N/A') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= TO_DATE('2023-03-05')
      AND delivered_date >= '2024-01-23'
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status <> 'RETURNED'
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.order_id = k.order_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost ASC NULLS LAST) AS cost_rank,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier), 4) AS cost_share
    FROM reconciled
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(carrier, 1, 4) AS carrier_prefix
    FROM metrics
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-07-13'
      AND carrier IS NOT NULL
),
matched_keys_2 AS (
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status, order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date BETWEEN '2024-02-19' AND '2025-03-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys_2 k ON s.status = k.status AND s.order_id = k.order_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.delivered_date,
    s.cost,
    s.status,
    s.carrier_title,
    s.cost_rank,
    s.cost_share,
    (SELECT SUM(o2.quantity) FROM order_items o2 WHERE o2.order_id = s.order_id) AS sum_order_item_quantity
FROM kept_rows s
ORDER BY id ASC NULLS FIRST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
quantity_by_order_id = df_order_items.groupBy("order_id").agg(F.sum("quantity").alias("sum_order_item_quantity"))

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-05"))) & (F.col("delivered_date") >= "2024-01-23"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.initcap(F.trim("carrier")).alias("carrier_title"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    base
    .select("status", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("status") != "RETURNED")
        .select("status", "order_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("cost_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w2)), 4).alias("cost_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-07-13").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.substring("carrier", 1, 4).alias("carrier_prefix"))
)

matched_keys_2 = (
    filtered
    .select("status", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("shipped_date").between("2024-02-19", "2025-03-01"))
        .select("status", "order_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .join(quantity_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "carrier_title",
        "cost_rank",
        "cost_share",
        F.col("sum_order_item_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        ROUND(credit_limit / age, 2) AS credit_limit_per_age,
        LOWER(city) AS city_lower
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > DATE '2023-03-18'
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.end_date >= '2024-07-01'
        )
),
not_flagged_customers AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sessions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.started_at < '2024-07-08'
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT city, id
    FROM not_flagged_customers
    EXCEPT
    SELECT city, id
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IN ('Berlin', 'Tokyo')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged_customers s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.city = k.city AND s.id = k.id
),
remaining_keys_2 AS (
    SELECT city
    FROM kept_rows
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IN ('New York', 'Bangkok', 'Tokyo')
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept_rows s
    JOIN remaining_keys_2 k ON s.city = k.city
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit_per_age >= 77 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS credit_limit_per_age_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    ROUND(SUM(credit_limit_per_age) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS credit_limit_per_age_per_new_york,
    ROUND(AVG(credit_limit), 2) AS avg_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(age) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN segment = 'SMB' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS age_per_smb
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY credit_limit_per_age_tier
ORDER BY credit_limit_per_age_per_new_york;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("signup_date") > F.lit("2023-03-18").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.col("age")), 2).alias("credit_limit_per_age"),
        F.lower("city").alias("city_lower"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.end_date") >= "2024-07-01"), "left_anti")
)

not_flagged_customers = (
    not_flagged
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.started_at") < "2024-07-08"), "left_semi")
)

remaining_keys = (
    not_flagged_customers
    .select("city", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("city").isin(["Berlin", "Tokyo"]))
        .select("city", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    not_flagged_customers
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

remaining_keys_2 = (
    kept_rows
    .select("city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("city").isin(["New York", "Bangkok", "Tokyo"]))
        .select("city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit_per_age") >= 77, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("credit_limit_per_age_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("city")).alias("num_cities"),
        F.round(F.sum("credit_limit_per_age") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("credit_limit_per_age_per_new_york"),
        F.round(F.avg("credit_limit"), 2).alias("avg_credit_limit"),
        F.round(F.sum("age") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "SMB", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("age_per_smb"),
    )
    .orderBy("credit_limit_per_age_per_new_york")
)

sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, level, latency_ms, status_code, key, v FROM app_logs LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, v), unpacked AS (SELECT id, service, host, log_ts, key, v, SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high, CAST((status_code & 4) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged FROM lines), with_gaps AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN log_ts - LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, key) > INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag FROM unpacked), islands AS (SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id FROM with_gaps), with_windows AS (SELECT *, AVG(is_flagged) OVER w_grp AS last7_avg_is_flagged, COUNT(is_flagged) OVER w_grp AS last7_count_is_flagged, SUM(is_flagged) OVER w_grp AS last7_sum_is_flagged FROM islands WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY key, host ORDER BY session_id, id, key ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT id, service, host, key, v, is_flagged, new_group_flag, session_id, last7_avg_is_flagged, CASE WHEN key RLIKE '^(version|region)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS key_zone FROM with_windows ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS FIRST, key
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("key", "host").orderBy("session_id", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(4) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    unpacked
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("log_ts") - F.lag("log_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .withColumn("last7_avg_is_flagged", F.avg("is_flagged").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last7_count_is_flagged", F.count("is_flagged").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last7_sum_is_flagged", F.sum("is_flagged").over(w_grp))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "key",
        "v",
        "is_flagged",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_id",
        "last7_avg_is_flagged",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(version|region)$"), "CORE").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_first(), "key")
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, ADD_MONTHS(shipped_date, 3) AS shipped_date_plus_months, COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS resolved_carrier FROM shipments WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-04-06' AND status IN ('RETURNED', 'LOST')), ranked AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY delivered_date) AS latest_rank FROM base) ranked WHERE latest_rank = 1), with_dims AS (SELECT src.*, o.discount, o.shipping_fee FROM ranked src INNER JOIN orders o ON src.order_id <=> o.id WHERE o.discount > 0.25), base_shipments AS (SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(shipped_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS shipped_date_label, COALESCE(carrier, 'N/A') AS resolved_carrier_2 FROM with_dims WHERE shipped_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-05')) SELECT id, order_id, carrier, shipped_date, delivered_date, cost, status, shipped_date_plus_months, latest_rank, CASE WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(Kerry|DHL)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(FedEx|Flash)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS carrier_zone FROM base_shipments ORDER BY id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("delivered_date")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-04-06").cast("date")) & F.col("status").isin(["RETURNED", "LOST"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.add_months("shipped_date", 3).alias("shipped_date_plus_months"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    ranked
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("o.discount") > 0.25)
    .select("src.*", F.col("o.discount"), F.col("o.shipping_fee"))
)

base_shipments = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-05")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("shipped_date", "yyyy-MM").alias("shipped_date_label"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_carrier_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_shipments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        "shipped_date_plus_months",
        "latest_rank",
        F.when(F.col("carrier").rlike("^(Kerry|DHL)$"), "CORE").when(F.col("carrier").rlike("^(FedEx|Flash)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("carrier_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)

with metrics as (
    select
        *,
        lead(sqft) over w_ordered as next_sqft,
        row_number() over w_ordered as row_seq,
        round(sqft / sum(sqft) over (partition by city), 4) as sqft_share
    from stores
    window w_ordered as (partition by region, city order by sqft, id)
),
enriched as (
    select
        *,
        ntile(3) over (partition by region order by row_seq desc, id) as row_seq_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by city order by sqft_share, id) as event_seq,
        sum(row_seq) over w_grp as running_row_seq,
        lead(next_sqft, 1) over (partition by city order by next_sqft, id) as next_next_sqft
    from metrics
    window w_grp as (partition by region order by row_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
enriched_stores as (
    select
        *,
        sum(event_seq) over (order by opened_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_event_seq,
        avg(next_next_sqft) over (partition by region order by next_next_sqft, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as next_next_sqft_avg_2_prior,
        avg(sqft) over (partition by region order by sqft, id rows between 6 preceding and current row) as sqft_avg_6
    from enriched
),
with_latest as (
    select s.*, x.shipping_fee
    from enriched_stores s
    join lateral (
            select c.shipping_fee
            from orders c
            where c.store_id = s.id
            order by c.shipping_fee desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) x on true
)
select
    id,
    city,
    metric_name,
    reading
from (
    select
        id,
        city,
        sqft_share,
        shipping_fee
    from with_latest
) src
unpivot (
    reading for metric_name in (sqft_share, shipping_fee)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("region", "city").orderBy("sqft", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("row_seq").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft_share", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("next_sqft", "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("next_next_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.shipping_fee").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

metrics = (
    df_stores
    .withColumn("next_sqft", F.lead("sqft").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("sqft_share", F.round((F.col("sqft") / F.sum("sqft").over(w2)), 4))
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_seq_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w3))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_row_seq", F.sum("row_seq").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_next_sqft", F.lead("next_sqft", 1).over(w6))
)

enriched_stores = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w7).alias("running_event_seq"),
        F.avg("next_next_sqft").over(w8).alias("next_next_sqft_avg_2_prior"),
        F.avg("sqft").over(w9).alias("sqft_avg_6"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    enriched_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.shipping_fee"))
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .select("id", "city", "sqft_share", "shipping_fee")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "city"],
        values=["sqft_share", "shipping_fee"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        tier_limits,
        discounts,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps
    FROM price_tiers

    CASE WHEN lowest_price >= 30 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS lowest_price_tier,
    AVG(lowest_price) AS avg_lowest_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY CASE WHEN lowest_price >= 30 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        LENGTH(channel) AS channel_length
    FROM promotions
    WHERE starts_on >= DATE '2023-04-12'
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel = pr.channel
       AND s.ends_on >= pr.starts_on
       AND s.ends_on < pr.ends_on + INTERVAL 14 DAYS
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel_length,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_running AS promo_id_bucket,
        STDDEV_SAMP(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct
    FROM matched
    WHERE ends_on < '2024-08-01'
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY promo_id DESC, id, promo_id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        channel_length,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        promo_id_bucket,
        channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct,
        SUM(channel_length) OVER (ORDER BY promo_id_bucket, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_channel_length,
        LAST_VALUE(channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY channel_length, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct
    FROM metrics
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct > 0.17
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
kept_keys_2 AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM verified
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel = 'mobile'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys_2 k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN last_known_channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct >= 0 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS last_known_channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(channel_length, 0.5) AS channel_length_p50,
    ROUND(SUM(promo_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promotion_promo_code = 'BUNDLE' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS promo_id_per_bundle,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE promotion_promo_code = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_rows,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(promotion_promo_code)) AS num_promotion_promo_codes
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY CASE WHEN last_known_channel_stddev_samp_discount_pct >= 0 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY num_promotion_promo_codes DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("promo_id").desc(), "id", "promo_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w3 = Window.orderBy("promo_id_bucket", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") >= F.lit("2023-04-12").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",

    .alias("s")

    .select(

        "promo_id",

    .agg(

        F.size(F.collect_set("promotion_promo_code")).alias("num_promotion_promo_codes"),

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        amount * discount AS amount_times_discount,
        CAST(shipping_fee AS INT) AS shipping_fee_int,
        COALESCE(channel, 'N/A') AS resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'web'
      AND channel IN ('mobile', 'store')
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        amount_times_discount,
        shipping_fee_int,
        resolved_channel,
        CAST(amount_times_discount AS INT) AS amount_times_discount_int,
        ROUND(amount_times_discount * 1.07, 2) AS amount_times_discount_scaled
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE shipping_fee <= 11
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        c.name,
        c.age
    FROM filtered src
    INNER JOIN customers c
        ON src.customer_id = c.id
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching payment per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.payment_method,
        latest.paid_at
    FROM with_dims s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.method AS payment_method, c.paid_at
            FROM payments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_last
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipping_fee NULLS LAST) = 1
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM ranked a
    INNER JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.order_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.order_date <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 7)
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching order_item per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.store_id,
        s.amount,
        s.discount,
        s.shipping_fee,
        s.amount_times_discount,
        s.shipping_fee_int,
        s.resolved_channel,
        s.amount_times_discount_scaled,
        s.name,
        s.subscription_id,
        s.plan,
        s.monthly_fee,
        latest.order_item_quantity
    FROM attributed s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity AS order_item_quantity
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.unit_price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    plan,
    store_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS plan_list,
    COUNT(DISTINCT plan) AS distinct_plans,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT plan) DESC) AS distinct_plans_rank
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY plan, store_id
ORDER BY plan DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        discount,
        CONCAT_WS(',', status, channel) AS status_channel_key,
        CONCAT_WS('/', status, channel) AS status_channel_key_2,
        COALESCE(channel, 'OTHER') AS channel_clean
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-03-03'
      AND order_date <= '2023-04-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_discount,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_hist AS discount_bucket,
        MIN(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_min_discount
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY discount DESC, id ASC), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY store_id, status ORDER BY discount DESC, id ASC)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(discount_bucket, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY discount_bucket ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_discount_bucket,
        AVG(status_min_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY status_min_discount ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_min_discount_avg_3
    FROM with_windows
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.paid_at >= s.order_date
        )
),
kept_orders AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.product_id IS NULL
        )
),
with_windows_orders AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_discount,
        SUM(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_discount,
        AVG(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_discount,
        AVG(last_known_discount_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY discount ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS last_known_discount_bucket_avg_3_prior
    FROM kept_orders
    WHERE discount_bucket < 5
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows_orders s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.shipped_date <= s.order_date
        )
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    LEAD(running_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC) AS next_running_discount,
    LEAD(status_min_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC) AS next_status_min_discount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC) AS row_seq
FROM not_flagged

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("discount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("status_min_discount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id")

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-03").cast("date")) & (F.col("order_date") <= "2023-04-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "discount",
        F.concat_ws(",", "status", "channel").alias("status_channel_key"),
        F.concat_ws("/", "status", "channel").alias("status_channel_key_2"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("running_discount", F.sum("discount").over(w2))
    .withColumn("discount_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("status_min_discount", F.min("discount").over(w4))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("last_known_discount_bucket", F.last("discount_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
    .withColumn("status_min_discount_avg_3", F.avg("status_min_discount").over(w6))
)

kept = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.paid_at") >= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

kept_orders = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.product_id").isNull()), "left_semi")
)

with_windows_orders = (
    kept_orders
    .filter(F.col("discount_bucket") < 5)
    .withColumn("running_max_discount", F.max("discount").over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_sum_discount", F.sum("discount").over(w7))
    .withColumn("running_avg_discount", F.avg("discount").over(w7))
    .withColumn("last_known_discount_bucket_avg_3_prior", F.avg("last_known_discount_bucket").over(w8))
)

not_flagged = (
    with_windows_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.shipped_date") <= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("next_running_discount", F.lead("running_discount").over(w9))
    .withColumn("next_status_min_discount", F.lead("status_min_discount").over(w9))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w9))
)

WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM sessions
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        x.web_event_event_time,
        x.duration_sec
    FROM sessionized s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_time AS web_event_event_time, c.duration_sec
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        started_at,
        session_start_flag,
        session_id,
        web_event_event_time,
        duration_sec
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, browser ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id ASC) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_last
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_last_sessions AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.session_start_flag,
        s.web_event_event_time,
        x.web_event_event_type,
        x.web_event_page
    FROM latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_type AS web_event_event_type, c.page AS web_event_page
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    web_event_event_type,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', web_event_event_time) AS year_start,
    CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_start_flag_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(web_event_event_type)) AS web_event_event_type_list,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(web_event_event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(web_event_event_time))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    MAX(web_event_event_time) AS last_web_event_event_time,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN web_event_page = '/cart' THEN 1 END) AS cart_count
FROM with_last_sessions
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((web_event_event_type, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', web_event_event_time), CASE WHEN session_start_flag >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (web_event_event_type, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', web_event_event_time)), (web_event_event_type))
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN web_event_page = '/cart' THEN 1 END) < 1000
ORDER BY web_event_event_type ASC;

    .groupingSets(

WITH with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '1' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM device_readings
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts) AS activity_day,
    CASE WHEN island_id >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS island_id_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(status_bits) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS status_bits_per_dv_01,
    STDDEV_SAMP(humidity) AS humidity_stddev,
    MIN(island_id) AS min_island_id,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS num_device_codes
FROM islands
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('DAY', reading_ts), CASE WHEN island_id >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
HAVING MIN(island_id) > 0
ORDER BY min_island_id DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("island_id_tier").orderBy(F.col("num_pages").desc())

with_gaps = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    .groupBy(

        "island_id",

    .agg(
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_seen"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("page")).alias("num_pages"),

        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_time")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_time"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.round(F.sum("new_group_flag") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("new_group_flag_per_home"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_event_time"),
    )
    .withColumn("num_pages_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
    .orderBy(F.col("island_id").desc())
)

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(tier_prices) li AS val
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(val * 0.9, 2) AS val_scaled
    FROM exploded
    WHERE effective_from > TO_DATE('2024-04-09')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        effective_from,
        currency,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_part AS val_scaled_rank,
        AVG(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_val,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val_scaled) AS val_scaled_percent_rank
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY val_scaled DESC)
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val_percent_rank,
        val_scaled_percent_rank,
        currency_avg_val + val_percent_rank AS currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank,
        DAYOFWEEK(effective_from) AS effective_from_dayofweek
    FROM enriched
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-02-11'
),
valid_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val_percent_rank,
        val_scaled_percent_rank,
        effective_from_dayofweek,
        val_scaled_percent_rank * val_percent_rank AS val_scaled_percent_rank_times_val_percent_rank,
        COALESCE(currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank, 0) AS currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled
    FROM valid
    WHERE effective_from >= DATE '2024-05-28'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT currency
    FROM valid_price_tiers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency NOT IN ('EUR', 'THB')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_price_tiers s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.currency = k.currency
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', effective_from) AS quarter_start,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(val_percent_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS val_percent_rank_quartiles,
        SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled ELSE 0 END) AS eur_currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(val_percent_rank, 0.9) AS val_percent_rank_p90
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING val_percent_rank_p90 >= 0
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    val_percent_rank_quartiles,
    eur_currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled,
    val_percent_rank_p90
FROM grouped
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("val_scaled").desc())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("val_scaled")

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", "currency", F.explode("tier_prices").alias("val"))
)

base = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") > F.to_date(F.lit("2024-04-09")))
    .withColumn("val_scaled", F.round((F.col("val") * 0.9), 2))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("val_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_part).alias("val_scaled_rank"),
        F.avg("val").over(w3).alias("currency_avg_val"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("val_scaled_percent_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-02-11").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "val_percent_rank",
        "val_scaled_percent_rank",
        (F.col("currency_avg_val") + F.col("val_percent_rank")).alias("currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank"),
        F.dayofweek("effective_from").alias("effective_from_dayofweek"),
    )
)

valid_price_tiers = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-05-28").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "val_percent_rank",
        "val_scaled_percent_rank",
        "effective_from_dayofweek",
        (F.col("val_scaled_percent_rank") * F.col("val_percent_rank")).alias("val_scaled_percent_rank_times_val_percent_rank"),
        F.coalesce("currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank", F.lit(0)).alias("currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    valid_price_tiers
    .select("currency")
    .intersect(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(~F.col("currency").isin(["EUR", "THB"]))
        .select("currency")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid_price_tiers
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.currency") == F.col("k.currency")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

grouped = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "effective_from").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("val_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("val_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", F.col("currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled")).otherwise(0)).alias("eur_currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled"),
        F.percentile_approx("val_percent_rank", 0.9).alias("val_percent_rank_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("val_percent_rank_p90") >= 0)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "quarter_start",
        "val_percent_rank_quartiles",
        "eur_currency_avg_val_plus_val_percent_rank_filled",
        "val_percent_rank_p90",
    )
)

with latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, rank() over (partition by location, dept_name order by budget desc) as rn
    from departments
    qualify rn = 1
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        dept_name,
        budget,
        rn,
        lag(budget) over w_ordered as prev_budget,
        row_number() over w_ordered as seq_no,
        row_number() over (partition by dept_name order by rn, id) as row_seq
    from latest
    window w_ordered as (partition by location order by rn, id)
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        seq_no,
        row_seq,
        least(row_seq, seq_no) as least_row_seq_seq_no,
        cast(prev_budget as int) as prev_budget_int
    from with_windows
    where row_seq <= 8
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        seq_no,
        row_seq + least_row_seq_seq_no as row_seq_plus_least_row_seq_seq_no,
        coalesce(prev_budget_int, 0) as prev_budget_int_filled
    from base
    where least_row_seq_seq_no < 52
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from employees x
            where x.dept_id = s.id
              and x.salary <= 65000
        )
)
select id, seq_no
from not_flagged
