from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("rn", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("rn", "id")

latest = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "budget",
        "rn",
        F.lag("budget").over(w_ordered).alias("prev_budget"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("row_seq") <= 8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        "seq_no",
        "row_seq",
        F.least("row_seq", "seq_no").alias("least_row_seq_seq_no"),
        F.col("prev_budget").cast("int").alias("prev_budget_int"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("least_row_seq_seq_no") < 52)
    .select(
        "id",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        "seq_no",
        (F.col("row_seq") + F.col("least_row_seq_seq_no")).alias("row_seq_plus_least_row_seq_seq_no"),
        F.coalesce("prev_budget_int", F.lit(0)).alias("prev_budget_int_filled"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("x"), (F.col("x.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.salary") <= 65000), "left_semi")
)

result = not_flagged.select("id", "seq_no")

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("start_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") < 220)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "end_date",
        F.lead("monthly_fee", 1).over(w).alias("next_monthly_fee"),
        F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w4)), 4).alias("monthly_fee_share"),
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w5)), 4).alias("monthly_fee_share_2"),
    )

result = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("quarter", "end_date"))
    .groupingSets(

    FROM valid_products
)

    CASE WHEN cost_avg_3 >= 686 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cost_avg_3_tier,

    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN cost_avg_3 >= 686 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT id) DESC) AS distinct_ids_dense_rank
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, LAST_DAY(delivered_date) AS delivered_date_month_end
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-08-21'
      AND status IN ('LOST', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'RETURNED')
),
joined AS (
    SELECT src.*, b.discount
    FROM base src
    JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id <=> b.id
    WHERE b.channel IN ('web', 'partner', 'store')
),
joined_shipments AS (
    SELECT a.*, b.status AS order_status
    FROM joined a
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON a.order_id = b.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(cost, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS next_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_status, status ORDER BY delivered_date_month_end, id) AS row_seq,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY discount, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_6_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY discount DESC NULLS LAST) AS discount_rank,
        MIN(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS order_status_min_cost
    FROM joined_shipments
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN order_status_min_cost >= 106 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS order_status_min_cost_tier,
        order_status,
        status,
        COUNT_IF(order_status = 'RETURNED') AS returned_events,
        SUM(discount) FILTER (WHERE carrier = 'Flash') AS flash_total_discount,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status_2,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        AVG(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'LOST') AS lost_avg_cost
    FROM enriched
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    order_status_min_cost_tier,
    order_status,
    status,
    returned_events,
    flash_total_discount,
    num_status,
    num_status_2,
    event_count,
    lost_avg_cost
FROM summary
ORDER BY order_status DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy("delivered_date_month_end", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_status")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-08-21").cast("date")) & F.col("status").isin(["LOST", "IN_TRANSIT", "RETURNED"]))
    .withColumn("delivered_date_month_end", F.last_day("delivered_date"))
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("b.channel").isin(["web", "partner", "store"]))
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.discount"))
)

joined_shipments = (
    joined
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.status").alias("order_status"))
)

enriched = (
    joined_shipments
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("cost", 2, 0).over(w).alias("next_cost"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w3).alias("cost_avg_6_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("discount_rank"),
        F.min("cost").over(w5).alias("order_status_min_cost"),
    )
)

summary = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("order_status_min_cost") >= 106, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("order_status_min_cost_tier"),
        "order_status",
        "status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("order_status") == "RETURNED").alias("returned_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "Flash", F.col("discount"))).alias("flash_total_discount"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("status") == "LOST", F.col("cost"))).alias("lost_avg_cost"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "order_status_min_cost_tier",
        "order_status",
        "status",
        "returned_events",
        "flash_total_discount",
        "num_status",
        "num_status_2",
        "event_count",
        "lost_avg_cost",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_status").desc())
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        element
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_prices) x AS element
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS element_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS element_percent_rank_2,
        STDDEV_SAMP(element) OVER w_running_2 AS currency_stddev_samp_element
    FROM lines
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY element), w_running_2 AS (PARTITION BY currency)
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, SUM(element_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan) AS currency_sum_element_percent_rank
    FROM scored
),
scored_price_tiers_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan ORDER BY element_percent_rank_2 NULLS FIRST) AS element_percent_rank_2_cume_dist,
        SUM(element_percent_rank) OVER w_recent AS currency_sum_element_percent_rank_2
    FROM scored_price_tiers
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY currency, plan)
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    plan,
    measure,
    value
FROM (
    SELECT
        plan,
        element,
        element_percent_rank_2,
        element_percent_rank,
        element_percent_rank_2_cume_dist
    FROM scored_price_tiers_2
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR measure IN (element, element_percent_rank_2, element_percent_rank, element_percent_rank_2_cume_dist)
);

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(temp_c / humidity, 2) AS temp_c_per_humidity
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 07:00:00'
      AND temp_c <= 37
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        temp_c_per_humidity,
        AVG(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS humidity_avg_5,
        LAST_VALUE(humidity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_humidity,
        LAG(status_bits, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure, id) AS prev_status_bits,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_status_bits,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS LAST) AS temp_c_rank
    FROM filtered
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        reading_ts,
        status_bits,
        temp_c_per_humidity,
        last_known_humidity,
        prev_status_bits,
        running_status_bits,
        MAX(temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_temp_c_rank,
        SUM(temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_temp_c_rank,
        MIN(temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_temp_c_rank,
        AVG(temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_temp_c_rank,
        AVG(last_known_humidity) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_humidity_avg_2h
    FROM metrics
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_bits) OVER w_running AS status_bits_avg_1h,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_status_bits DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM metrics_device_readings
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(running_min_temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY temp_c_per_humidity, id) AS prev_running_min_temp_c_rank,
        LAG(running_sum_temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY temp_c_per_humidity, id) AS prev_running_sum_temp_c_rank,
        LEAD(running_sum_temp_c_rank) OVER (ORDER BY temp_c_per_humidity, id) AS next_running_sum_temp_c_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY temp_c_per_humidity, id) AS seq_no
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE running_max_temp_c_rank BETWEEN 3.2 AND 6.9
)
SELECT

WITH base AS (

    SELECT *, TRIM(supplier_name) AS clean_supplier_name
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chiang Mai'

metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id) AS event_seq,
        AVG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS rating_avg_3_prior,
        MAX(rating) OVER w_hist AS city_max_rating
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY city)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        rating,
        clean_supplier_name,
        event_seq,
        rating_avg_3_prior,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating_avg_3_prior DESC, id) AS rating_avg_3_prior_bucket,
        ROUND(event_seq / SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS event_seq_share
    FROM metrics
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        rating,
        event_seq,
        rating_avg_3_prior_bucket,
        event_seq_share,
        CEIL(event_seq_share) AS event_seq_share_whole
    FROM enriched
    WHERE rating_avg_3_prior_bucket != 3
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.price < 930
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    country,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'JP' THEN rating_avg_3_prior_bucket ELSE 0 END) AS jp_rating_avg_3_prior_bucket,
    MIN(event_seq) AS min_event_seq,
    AVG(rating) AS avg_rating
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY CUBE (country);

w7 = Window.orderBy("discount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("first_known_discount").desc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount").desc(), "id")
w_recent = Window.orderBy("first_known_discount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.orderBy("first_known_discount", "id")

scored = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("status") != "SHIPPED")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.corr("shipping_fee", "discount").over(w_part).alias("corr_shipping_fee_discount"),
        F.avg("shipping_fee").over(w2).alias("shipping_fee_avg_6"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("discount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "discount", "discount_cume_dist")
)

ranked_orders = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    ranked_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("first_known_discount"),
        F.last("discount", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_discount"),
        F.max("discount").over(w_part).alias("customer_id_max_discount"),
        F.lead("discount", 1).over(w8).alias("next_discount"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank_2", F.rank().over(w9))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank_2") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "discount_cume_dist",
        "first_known_discount",
        "customer_id_max_discount",
        "next_discount",
    )
)

filtered = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("next_discount") < 0.21)
    .withColumn("customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount", (F.col("customer_id_max_discount") * F.col("next_discount")))
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "discount_cume_dist",
        "customer_id_max_discount",
        "next_discount",
        "customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount",
        F.ntile(4).over(w_running).alias("customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount_bucket"),
        F.sum("customer_id_max_discount").over(w_recent).alias("cumulative_customer_id_max_discount"),
        F.lead("customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount", 2).over(w_grp).alias("next_customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "discount_cume_dist",
        "customer_id_max_discount",
        "customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount",
        "customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount_bucket",
        "next_customer_id_max_discount_times_next_discount",
    )
)

        carrier,
        delivered_date,

        status,

        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE MONTH(shipped_date) IN (2, 6, 9)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cost_avg_6,
        MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_max_cost
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        clean_carrier,
        cost_avg_6,
        LAG(cost_avg_6) OVER w_recent AS prev_cost_avg_6,
        LEAD(cost_avg_6) OVER w_recent AS next_cost_avg_6,
        LAG(cost) OVER w_recent AS prev_cost,
        LEAD(cost) OVER w_recent AS next_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id)
),
cleaned_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        delivered_date,
        clean_carrier,
        prev_cost_avg_6,
        prev_cost,
        event_seq,
        SUBSTRING(carrier, 1, 2) AS carrier_prefix,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-09-06'
),
scored_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(prev_cost, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_prev_cost,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_cost_avg_6 NULLS LAST) AS prev_cost_avg_6_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned_shipments
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM scored_shipments
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2025-09-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_shipments s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
with_windows_shipments AS (
    SELECT
        prev_cost,
        event_seq,
        carrier_prefix,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_cost_avg_6 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS prev_cost_avg_6_dense_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY prev_cost_avg_6_dense_rank NULLS LAST) AS prev_cost_avg_6_dense_rank_dense_rank
    FROM reconciled
)

    prev_cost,
    event_seq,
    carrier_prefix,
    prev_cost_avg_6_dense_rank_2
FROM with_windows_shipments

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), paid_at) AS days_since_paid_at,
        LENGTH(status) AS status_length,
        COALESCE(method, 'OTHER') AS resolved_method
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > DATE '2023-09-28'
      AND amount <= 1200
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        days_since_paid_at,
        status_length,
        resolved_method,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY status_length DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_length_cume_dist,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY status, method ORDER BY status_length DESC, id ASC) AS status_length_bucket,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_avg_2_prior
    FROM base
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR paid_at > LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_windows
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
),
gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session_2
    FROM islands
),
islands_payments AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session_2) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps_2
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.discount,
        b.order_date
    FROM islands_payments src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
    WHERE b.channel != 'partner'
),
base_payments AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('week', paid_at) AS paid_at_period
    FROM joined
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-09-16 07:00:00'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY status_length_bucket ASC, id ASC) AS row_num
        FROM base_payments
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.paid_at,
    s.status,
    s.resolved_method,
    s.status_length_cume_dist,
    s.status_length_bucket,
    s.is_new_session,
    s.session_no,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(SUCCESS|FAILED)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN status RLIKE '^(REFUNDED)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS status_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(t2.cost) FROM shipments t2 WHERE t2.order_id = s.order_id) AS max_shipment_cost
FROM latest s
ORDER BY is_new_session DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, SUBSTRING(job_title, 1, 3) AS job_title_prefix
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        level
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        job_title,
        hire_date
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(job_title) AS job_title_lower,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'DIRECT') AS job_title_clean
    FROM ranked
    WHERE MONTH(hire_date) IN (6, 7, 11)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        hire_date,
        job_title_clean
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM deduped
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date)
ORDER BY activity_month DESC NULLS LAST;

    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) x AS code

        code,
        clean_code,
        code_filled,
        resolved_code,
        DAY(created_at) AS created_at_day,
        COALESCE(code, 'N/A') AS resolved_code_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE created_at < '2025-02-01'
      AND code IS DISTINCT FROM 'WELCOME5'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN created_at_day >= 69 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS created_at_day_tier,
    COUNT_IF(code = 'BUNDLE') AS bundle_events,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(created_at_day) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN code = 'WELCOME5' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS created_at_day_per_welcome5

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS k, value
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        host,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit2,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM exploded
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value,
        flag_bit2,
        status_code_high,
        latency_ms * flag_bit2 AS latency_ms_times_flag_bit2,
        CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2616 THEN 'High' WHEN latency_ms >= 1158 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS latency_ms_band
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code) AS status_code_rank,
        CORR(status_code, latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS corr_status_code_latency_ms
    FROM valid
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        k,
        value,
        status_code_high,
        latency_ms_times_flag_bit2,
        status_code_rank,
        corr_status_code_latency_ms,
        SUM(status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_sum_status_code_high,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_rank DESC) AS status_code_rank_rank,
        CORR(latency_ms, status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS corr_latency_ms_status_code
    FROM scored
    WHERE flag_bit2 >= 0
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        status_code_high * status_code_rank_rank AS status_code_high_times_status_code_rank_rank,
        CASE WHEN status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code_rank >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_rank_band,
        COALESCE(k, 'OTHER') AS resolved_k
    FROM enriched
    WHERE status_code_rank_rank >= 5
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    k,
    CASE WHEN status_code_rank_rank >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_rank_rank_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'version' THEN corr_latency_ms_status_code ELSE 0 END) AS version_corr_latency_ms_status_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS distinct_ks
FROM base
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((k, CASE WHEN status_code_rank_rank >= 9 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (k))
ORDER BY distinct_ks DESC NULLS FIRST

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, value
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        value,
        CAST(log_ts AS DATE) AS log_ts_day,
        COALESCE(key, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_key
    FROM flattened
    WHERE log_ts >= DATE '2025-06-01'
),
cleaned_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        value,
        log_ts_day,
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', log_ts_day) AS log_ts_day_period
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'region'
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        log_ts_day_period
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts_day, id, key) AS rank_in_group
        FROM cleaned_app_logs
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(log_ts_day_period) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts_day_period, id, key) AS prev_log_ts_day_period
    FROM ranked
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_log_ts_day_period IS NULL OR log_ts_day_period > prev_log_ts_day_period + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts_day_period, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    LEAD(new_group_flag) OVER w_part AS next_new_group_flag,
    LAG(new_group_flag) OVER w_part AS prev_new_group_flag,
    LEAD(session_no) OVER w_part AS next_session_no,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no
FROM islands
WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_log_ts_day_period, id, key)

w3 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("log_ts_day_period", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("prev_log_ts_day_period", "id", "key")

flattened = (

        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_key"),

gaps = (

)

WITH valid AS (

        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        LEAST(units, revenue) AS least_units_revenue
    FROM store_sales

metrics AS (

        id,
        units,
        least_units_revenue,
        units_num,
        SUM(least_units_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_least_units_revenue,
        COUNT(least_units_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_least_units_revenue,
        MIN(least_units_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_min_least_units_revenue,
        LAST_VALUE(units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_units
    FROM base
),
metrics_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        id,

        last7_sum_least_units_revenue,

        SUM(units) OVER (ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_units,

        LEAD(last7_count_least_units_revenue, 2) OVER (ORDER BY units, id) AS next_last7_count_least_units_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last7_min_least_units_revenue, id) AS seq_no
    FROM metrics
    WHERE least_units_revenue > 33
)
SELECT

    least_units_revenue,
    cumulative_last7_min_least_units_revenue,
    first_known_last7_sum_least_units_revenue,
    next_last7_count_least_units_revenue
FROM metrics_store_sales

with filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status,
        round(amount * 1.15, 2) as amount_scaled,
        lower(method) as method_lower
    from payments
    where paid_at >= date '2023-05-13'
      and order_id is not null
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when paid_at - lag(paid_at) over (partition by method order by paid_at, id) > interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from filtered
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by method order by paid_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when island_id >= 8 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as island_id_tier,
    min(paid_at) as started_at,
    sort_array(collect_set(status)) as status_list,
    count(*) as event_count
from islands
group by 1
order by island_id_tier nulls first

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        COUNT(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel) AS channel_count_discount_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct) AS discount_pct_dense_rank,
        LAG(discount_pct, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS prev_discount_pct,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_discount_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_dense_rank_2
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct > 0.27
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq,
        AVG(channel_count_discount_pct) OVER w_hist AS channel_count_discount_pct_avg_2,
        AVG(discount_pct_dense_rank) OVER w_hist AS discount_pct_dense_rank_avg_2
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY discount_pct_dense_rank_2 DESC, id), w_hist AS (ORDER BY prev_discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics_promotions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(discount_pct_dense_rank) OVER (ORDER BY prev_discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_discount_pct_dense_rank,
        SUM(channel_count_discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY prev_discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_channel_count_discount_pct,
        AVG(channel_count_discount_pct_avg_2) OVER (ORDER BY cumulative_discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS channel_count_discount_pct_avg_2_avg_5,
        LEAD(channel_count_discount_pct, 2) OVER (ORDER BY channel_count_discount_pct, id) AS next_channel_count_discount_pct
    FROM metrics
),
metrics_promotions_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct_dense_rank,
        cumulative_discount_pct,
        discount_pct_dense_rank_2,
        channel_count_discount_pct_avg_2,
        channel_count_discount_pct_avg_2_avg_5,
        next_channel_count_discount_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_dense_rank_avg_2, id) AS event_seq_2,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY running_discount_pct_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_discount_pct_dense_rank_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct_dense_rank) AS discount_pct_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY prev_discount_pct DESC, id) AS prev_discount_pct_bucket
    FROM metrics_promotions
)
SELECT
    id,
    ends_on,
    discount_pct_dense_rank,
    cumulative_discount_pct,
    discount_pct_dense_rank_2,

WITH cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(budget AS INT) budget_int,
        TRIM(dept_name) clean_dept_name
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name = 'Legal'
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.employee_hire_date
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.hire_date AS employee_hire_date
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching employee per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.location,
        s.budget,
        s.budget_int,
        latest.employee_salary
    FROM with_latest s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.salary AS employee_salary
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.hire_date <= s.employee_hire_date
            ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.job_title = 'Engineer'
        )
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget_int >= 87 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_int_tier,
    location,
    COUNT_IF(location = 'London') AS london_events,
    COUNT_IF(location = 'Singapore') AS singapore_events,

FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_int >= 87 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, location
ORDER BY row_count DESC;

    FROM lines

    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN k = 'version' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_version,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 407 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code >= 243 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_tier
    FROM base
    WHERE latency_ms < 942
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_version NULLS LAST) AS is_version_rank,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS latency_ms_share
    FROM base_app_logs
)
SELECT
    id,
    latency_ms,
    status_code,
    k,
    attr_value,
    latency_ms_level,
    latency_ms_rounded,
    k_filled,
    status_code_tier
FROM scored
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS LAST

        LAST_DAY(last_restock) last_restock_month_end
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-07-23'

    SELECT *
    FROM valid

),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        last_restock_label,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_min_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sum_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_avg_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id) seq_no
    FROM deduped
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY seq_no NULLS LAST) AS rn
        FROM scored
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
deduped_inventory AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY running_sum_quantity DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
with_dims AS (

        a.*,

        d.opened_date

        COUNT_IF(region = 'Central') AS central_events,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_min_quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_min_quantity_quartiles,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS event_count_percent_rank
    FROM with_dims

FROM grouped;

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(duration_sec, 2) AS duration_sec_rounded,
        COALESCE(page, 'N/A') AS page_clean
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time > TO_DATE('2023-03-14')
      AND event_time < '2025-09-01'
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, page ORDER BY duration_sec_rounded DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM islands
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT
    SELECT event_type, page
    FROM web_events
    WHERE session_id IN (12, 29)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.event_type = k.event_type AND s.page = k.page
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, session_id ORDER BY session_no DESC) AS session_no_dense_rank,
        COUNT(session_no) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) AS session_id_count_session_no
    FROM kept_rows
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    d.device,
    e.page,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    MAX(e.session_no) AS max_session_no,
    MIN(e.duration_sec_rounded) AS min_duration_sec_rounded,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM metrics e
INNER JOIN sessions d ON e.session_id = d.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.device, e.page), (d.device), ())
ORDER BY max_session_no DESC NULLS LAST

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_rounded").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "session_id").orderBy(F.col("session_no").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("session_id")

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-14"))) & (F.col("event_time") < "2025-09-01"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("duration_sec", 2).alias("duration_sec_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("N/A")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

ranked = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

kept_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("event_type", "page")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("session_id").isin([12, 29]))
        .select("event_type", "page")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.event_type") == F.col("k.event_type")) & (F.col("s.page") == F.col("k.page")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("session_no_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("session_id_count_session_no", F.count("session_no").over(w5))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["device", "page"], ["device"], []],
        F.col("d.device").alias("device"),
        F.col("e.page").alias("page"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.max(F.col("e.session_no")).alias("max_session_no"),
        F.min(F.col("e.duration_sec_rounded")).alias("min_duration_sec_rounded"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("max_session_no").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) t AS element
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_SUB(effective_from, 27) effective_from_minus_27d,
        LOWER(plan) plan_lower
    FROM flattened
    WHERE element > 56
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        element,
        effective_from_minus_27d,
        plan_lower,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element) element_dense_rank,
        SUM(element) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) plan_sum_element,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element) element_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency ORDER BY element DESC) element_dense_rank_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY element DESC) element_dense_rank_3
    FROM valid
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element_dense_rank_2 NULLS FIRST) element_dense_rank_2_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY element_rank DESC) element_rank_dense_rank
    FROM scored
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from_minus_27d) AS year_start,
    CASE WHEN element_dense_rank_3 >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS element_dense_rank_3_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(element_dense_rank_2, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS element_dense_rank_2_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    SUM(element_dense_rank_2) AS total_element_dense_rank_2
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', effective_from_minus_27d), CASE WHEN element_dense_rank_3 >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING SUM(element_dense_rank_2) > 0;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("element")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency").orderBy(F.col("element").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("element").desc())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_dense_rank_2").asc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element_rank").desc())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("element"),
    )
)

valid = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("element") > 56)
    .withColumn("effective_from_minus_27d", F.date_sub("effective_from", 27))
    .withColumn("plan_lower", F.lower("plan"))
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "element",
        "effective_from_minus_27d",
        "plan_lower",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("element_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("element").over(w2).alias("plan_sum_element"),
        F.rank().over(w).alias("element_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("element_dense_rank_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("element_dense_rank_3"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("element_dense_rank_2_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("element_rank_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("YEAR", "effective_from_minus_27d").alias("year_start"),
        F.when(F.col("element_dense_rank_3") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("element_dense_rank_3_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("element_dense_rank_2", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("element_dense_rank_2_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sum("element_dense_rank_2").alias("total_element_dense_rank_2"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_element_dense_rank_2") > 0)
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id")

metrics = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_type").isin(["DEBIT", "REFUND", "FEE"]))
    .withColumn("prev_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_recent))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "txn_time").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.min("txn_time").alias("first_txn_time"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("num_merchants"),
        F.max("txn_time").alias("last_txn_time"),
        F.round(F.sum("event_seq") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("event_seq_per_fee"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("txn_time")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("txn_time"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_merchants") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("quarter_start").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        COALESCE(rating, 0) AS rating_filled
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IN ('Berlin', 'Tokyo')
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, top1.cost
    FROM cleaned s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS cost_share,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating_filled, id) AS rating_filled_bucket,
        LEAD(rating_filled, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY cost, id) AS next_rating_filled
    FROM with_latest
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        cost,
        rating_filled_bucket,
        MIN(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city) AS country_min_cost,
        LEAD(cost, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY cost_share, id) AS next_cost,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY cost_share NULLS LAST) AS cost_share_percent_rank
    FROM scored
    WHERE rating_filled < 38
),
scored_suppliers AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(rating_filled_bucket) OVER w_hist AS running_max_rating_filled_bucket,
        COUNT(rating_filled_bucket) OVER w_hist AS running_count_rating_filled_bucket,
        SUM(rating_filled_bucket) OVER w_hist AS running_sum_rating_filled_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(rating_filled_bucket) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY cost_share_percent_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating_filled_bucket
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY country_min_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_suppliers s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.brand <> 'Globex'
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN next_cost ELSE 0 END) AS new_york_next_cost,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(country_min_cost, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS country_min_cost_quartiles,
    AVG(running_sum_rating_filled_bucket) AS avg_running_sum_rating_filled_bucket,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN cost_share_percent_rank ELSE 0 END) AS singapore_cost_share_percent_rank
FROM not_flagged
GROUP BY city
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN cost_share_percent_rank ELSE 0 END) >= 0
ORDER BY city DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating_filled", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("cost", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("cost_share", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("cost_share").asc_nulls_last())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("country_min_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.orderBy("cost_share_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isin(["Berlin", "Tokyo"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        F.coalesce("rating", F.lit(0)).alias("rating_filled"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.cost"))
)

scored = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("cost_share", F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("rating_filled_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w3))
    .withColumn("next_rating_filled", F.lead("rating_filled", 1).over(w4))
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("rating_filled") < 38)
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "cost",
        "rating_filled_bucket",
        F.min("cost").over(w5).alias("country_min_cost"),
        F.lead("cost", 2).over(w6).alias("next_cost"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("cost_share_percent_rank"),
    )
)

scored_suppliers = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("rating_filled_bucket").over(w_hist).alias("running_max_rating_filled_bucket"),
        F.count("rating_filled_bucket").over(w_hist).alias("running_count_rating_filled_bucket"),
        F.sum("rating_filled_bucket").over(w_hist).alias("running_sum_rating_filled_bucket"),
        F.last("rating_filled_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w9).alias("last_known_rating_filled_bucket"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    scored_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.brand") != "Globex"), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy("city")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", F.col("next_cost")).otherwise(0)).alias("new_york_next_cost"),
        F.percentile_approx("country_min_cost", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("country_min_cost_quartiles"),
        F.avg("running_sum_rating_filled_bucket").alias("avg_running_sum_rating_filled_bucket"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", F.col("cost_share_percent_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("singapore_cost_share_percent_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("singapore_cost_share_percent_rank") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc())
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 15100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS credit_limit_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date) AS quarter_start,
    ROUND(SUM(credit_limit) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS credit_limit_per_new_york,
    SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'Corporate' THEN credit_limit ELSE 0 END) AS corporate_credit_limit,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(city)) AS num_cities,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'Chiang Mai') AS chiang_mai_events,
    ROUND(SUM(age) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Singapore' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS age_per_singapore,
    AVG(credit_limit) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SMB') AS smb_avg_credit_limit,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM customers
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 15100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', signup_date))
HAVING AVG(credit_limit) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SMB') < 1000000
ORDER BY age_per_singapore;

result = (
    df_customers
    .withColumn("credit_limit_tier", F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 15100, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "signup_date"))
    .rollup("credit_limit_tier", "quarter_start")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("credit_limit") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("credit_limit_per_new_york"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", F.col("credit_limit")).otherwise(0)).alias("corporate_credit_limit"),

        F.round(F.sum("age") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("age_per_singapore"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("segment") == "SMB", F.col("credit_limit"))).alias("smb_avg_credit_limit"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("smb_avg_credit_limit") < 1000000)
    .orderBy("age_per_singapore")
)

        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_limits,
        tier_prices,
        discounts,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,

    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'THB') DESC) AS thb_rows_dense_rank

WITH with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.transaction_amount,
        latest.transaction_txn_time
    FROM accounts s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.amount AS transaction_amount, c.txn_time AS transaction_txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND c.txn_time <= s.opened_date
            ORDER BY c.txn_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    account_type,
    customer_id,
    COUNT_IF(account_type = 'CHECKING') AS checking_events,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'OPEN') AS open_events,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY account_type, customer_id
HAVING checking_events > 1
ORDER BY checking_events DESC NULLS LAST

    FROM lines
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN currency_count_tier_value >= 13 THEN 'High' WHEN currency_count_tier_value >= 7 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS currency_count_tier_value_band,
        tier_value_cume_dist_2 + currency_count_tier_value AS tier_value_cume_dist_2_plus_currency_count_tier_value

FROM base

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        tier_prices,
        discounts,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps
    FROM price_tiers
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    SUM(lowest_price) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY lowest_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_lowest_price,
    AVG(entry_price) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY lowest_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) entry_price_avg_2_prior,
    MIN(lowest_price) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) currency_min_lowest_price,
    AVG(lowest_price) OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY entry_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) lowest_price_avg_3
FROM unpacked

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("lowest_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("lowest_price", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        CONCAT(carrier, ' ', status) carrier_status,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-08-25'
      AND carrier IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(carrier) carrier_upper,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'UNKNOWN') carrier_clean_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND carrier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'FedEx'
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY delivered_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        carrier_status,
        carrier_clean,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS LAST) cost_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part row_seq
    FROM latest
    WHERE shipped_date <= '2025-07-01'
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY rank_in_group, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(cost_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier, order_id) carrier_min_cost_cume_dist,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC, id) cost_bucket
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'FedEx' THEN 1 END) AS fedex_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS distinct_carriers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids_2,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN carrier = 'UPS' THEN 1 END) AS ups_count
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', delivered_date)
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 1
ORDER BY activity_month NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_last())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier", "order_id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-08-25").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        F.concat("carrier", F.lit(" "), "status").alias("carrier_status"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("FedEx"))))
    .withColumn("carrier_upper", F.upper("carrier"))
    .withColumn("carrier_clean_2", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

scored = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") <= "2025-07-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "carrier_status",
        "carrier_clean",
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("cost_cume_dist"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .withColumn("carrier_min_cost_cume_dist", F.min("cost_cume_dist").over(w4))
    .withColumn("cost_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w5))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "delivered_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "FedEx", 1)).alias("fedex_count"),
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("carrier") == "UPS", 1)).alias("ups_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").asc_nulls_last())
)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        quantity * unit_price AS line_total,
        ROUND(quantity * 1.07, 2) AS quantity_scaled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_id IN (3, 28, 31)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        line_total,
        SUM(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_unit_price,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id) AS product_id_min_quantity,
        CORR(unit_price, quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS corr_unit_price_quantity
    FROM filtered
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(cumulative_unit_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cumulative_unit_price, id) AS next_cumulative_unit_price,
        SUM(line_total) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY corr_unit_price_quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_line_total,
        SUM(corr_unit_price_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_sum_corr_unit_price_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY product_id_min_quantity, id) AS event_seq
    FROM metrics
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.order_id,
        e.line_total,
        e.cumulative_line_total,
        e.order_id_sum_corr_unit_price_quantity,
        e.event_seq,
        o.amount
    FROM with_windows e
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON e.order_id = o.id
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    line_total,
    cumulative_line_total,
    event_seq,
    COUNT(cumulative_line_total) OVER w_recent AS last4_count_cumulative_line_total,
    AVG(cumulative_line_total) OVER w_recent AS last4_avg_cumulative_line_total,
    MAX(cumulative_line_total) OVER w_recent AS last4_max_cumulative_line_total,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_id_sum_corr_unit_price_quantity NULLS FIRST) AS order_id_sum_corr_unit_price_quantity_dense_rank
FROM with_dims
WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW);

with filtered as (

    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        cost,
        status,
        floor(cost) as cost_whole,
        add_months(shipped_date, 1) as shipped_date_plus_months
    from shipments
    where delivered_date > date '2023-06-04'
      and carrier is distinct from 'Flash'
),
latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from filtered
    qualify row_number() over (partition by status, order_id order by shipped_date desc, id) = 1
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.carrier,
        a.cost,
        a.status,
        a.cost_whole,
        a.shipped_date_plus_months,
        b.order_date
    from latest a
    left join orders b
        on a.order_id = b.id
    where b.order_date between '2023-06-07' and '2025-04-13'
),
joined_shipments as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.*,
        d.discount,
        d.shipping_fee
    from joined a
    left join orders d
        on a.order_id = d.id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.cost,
        s.status,
        s.cost_whole,
        s.discount,
        s.shipping_fee,
        b.status as order_status,
        b.channel,
        b.discount as order_discount
    from joined_shipments s
    left join orders b
        on s.order_id <=> b.id
)

from (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        shipping_fee,
        order_discount,
        cost
    from enriched
) src

WITH valid AS (

        ADD_MONTHS(end_date, 3) AS end_date_plus_months,
        ROUND(monthly_fee, 1) AS monthly_fee_rounded
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (16, 18)

        SUM(monthly_fee_rounded) OVER (ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY end_date_plus_months DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_sum_monthly_fee
    FROM valid
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded,
        event_seq,
        status_sum_monthly_fee,
        ROUND(status_sum_monthly_fee * 1.1, 2) AS status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled
    FROM scored
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded <= 345
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.segment,
        d.signup_date,
        d.credit_limit
    FROM base src
    INNER JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id <=> d.id
    WHERE d.signup_date BETWEEN '2023-12-01' AND '2024-07-01'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.country,
        b.credit_limit AS customer_credit_limit
    FROM enriched a
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON a.customer_id <=> b.id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, customer_id ORDER BY status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN customer_credit_limit >= 13500 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS customer_credit_limit_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'Corporate') AS corporate_rows,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled_quartiles,
    MAX(status_sum_monthly_fee) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SMB') AS smb_max_status_sum_monthly_fee
FROM ranked
GROUP BY activity_month, customer_credit_limit_tier
ORDER BY smb_max_status_sum_monthly_fee;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "monthly_fee_rounded",
        F.sum("monthly_fee_rounded").over(w).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w3).alias("status_sum_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded") <= 345))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "cumulative_monthly_fee_rounded",
        "event_seq",
        "status_sum_monthly_fee",

    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("src.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("d.signup_date").between("2023-12-01", "2024-07-01"))
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("d.segment"),
        F.col("d.signup_date"),
        F.col("d.credit_limit"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("b.country"),
        F.col("b.credit_limit").alias("customer_credit_limit"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    joined
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(

    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)).alias("corporate_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_sum_monthly_fee_scaled_quartiles"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("segment") == "SMB", F.col("status_sum_monthly_fee"))).alias("smb_max_status_sum_monthly_fee"),

)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) li AS val
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(val) OVER w_hist AS plan_sum_val,
        SUM(val) OVER w_ordered AS currency_sum_val,
        SUM(val) OVER w_ordered AS currency_sum_val_2
    FROM lines
    WHERE val <= 33
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY plan), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY currency)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER w_recent AS currency_sum_val_rank,
        SUM(currency_sum_val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_sum_currency_sum_val,
        MAX(plan_sum_val) OVER w_recent_2 AS plan_max_plan_sum_val,
        STDDEV_SAMP(val) OVER w_recent_2 AS plan_stddev_samp_val
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY currency_sum_val DESC NULLS LAST), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY plan)
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, plan_stddev_samp_val * currency_sum_val_rank AS plan_stddev_samp_val_times_currency_sum_val_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE currency_sum_val_rank < 7
),
enriched_price_tiers AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        val,
        plan_sum_val,
        plan_max_plan_sum_val,
        plan_stddev_samp_val,
        plan_stddev_samp_val_times_currency_sum_val_rank,
        COUNT(val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_count_val
    FROM valid
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN plan_sum_val >= 338 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS plan_sum_val_tier,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 END) AS usd_count,
        ROUND(SUM(val) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS val_per_usd,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(plan_sum_val, 0.5) AS plan_sum_val_p50,
        AVG(plan_sum_val) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'pro') AS pro_avg_plan_sum_val
    FROM enriched_price_tiers
    GROUP BY plan_sum_val_tier
)
SELECT
    plan_sum_val_tier,
    usd_count,
    val_per_usd,
    plan_sum_val_p50,
    pro_avg_plan_sum_val
FROM stats;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_sum_val").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("val"),
    )
)

scored = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("val") <= 33)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("val").over(w_hist).alias("plan_sum_val"),
        F.sum("val").over(w_ordered).alias("currency_sum_val"),
        F.sum("val").over(w_ordered).alias("currency_sum_val_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .withColumn("currency_sum_val_rank", F.rank().over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("plan_sum_currency_sum_val", F.sum("currency_sum_val").over(w4))
    .withColumn("plan_max_plan_sum_val", F.max("plan_sum_val").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_val", F.stddev_samp("val").over(w_hist))
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("currency_sum_val_rank") < 7)
    .withColumn("plan_stddev_samp_val_times_currency_sum_val_rank", (F.col("plan_stddev_samp_val") * F.col("currency_sum_val_rank")))
)

enriched_price_tiers = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('/', event_type, page) AS event_type_page_key
    FROM web_events
    WHERE HOUR(event_time) BETWEEN 11 AND 16
      AND event_time > DATE '2023-04-19'
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        duration_sec
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, id) = 1
),
cleaned_web_events AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(duration_sec, 1) AS duration_sec_rounded,
        COALESCE(duration_sec, 0) AS duration_sec_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-10-21 23:00:00'
      AND session_id IN (3, 10, 12, 38)
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM cleaned_web_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        duration_sec_filled,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
),
latest_web_events AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM islands
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(duration_sec_filled, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_duration_sec_filled,
        AVG(duration_sec_filled) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS duration_sec_filled_avg_90d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id) AS seq_no
    FROM latest_web_events
)
SELECT
    id,
    session_id,
    duration_sec_filled,
    session_id_2,
    last_known_duration_sec_filled,
    duration_sec_filled_avg_90d,
    seq_no
FROM enriched
ORDER BY duration_sec_filled DESC, session_id;

with valid as (

    select
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        duration_sec,

deduped as (

    select
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        duration_sec,
        page_event_type_key,
        page_clean
    from valid
    qualify rank() over (partition by page, event_type order by duration_sec desc) = 1
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        duration_sec,
        page_event_type_key,
        lag(duration_sec, 1, 0) over (partition by event_type, page order by duration_sec, id) as prev_duration_sec,
        rank() over (partition by page order by duration_sec desc nulls first) as duration_sec_rank,
        row_number() over (partition by session_id order by duration_sec, id) as seq_no
    from deduped
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        page_event_type_key,
        duration_sec_rank,
        seq_no
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by page, session_id order by duration_sec_rank desc nulls last, id) as dedup_rank
        from scored
    ) ranked
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
scored_web_events as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        min(seq_no) over (partition by session_id, page order by duration_sec_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_min_seq_no,
        max(seq_no) over (partition by session_id, page order by duration_sec_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_seq_no,
        avg(seq_no) over (partition by session_id, page order by duration_sec_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_seq_no,
        last_value(duration_sec_rank) ignore nulls over (partition by page order by seq_no, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_duration_sec_rank
    from ranked
    where seq_no between 6 and 8
),
valid_web_events as (

    select
