w2 = Window.partitionBy("event_type", "page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_rank").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy("duration_sec_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_rank_whole_tier").orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc())

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-04-02").cast("date")) & ~F.col("page").isin(["/cart", "/home"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "duration_sec",
        F.concat_ws("/", "page", "event_type").alias("page_event_type_key"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "duration_sec",
        "page_event_type_key",
        "page_clean",
    )
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "duration_sec",
        "page_event_type_key",
        F.lag("duration_sec", 1, 0).over(w2).alias("prev_duration_sec"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("duration_sec_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "page_event_type_key",
        "duration_sec_rank",
        "seq_no",
    )
)

scored_web_events = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("seq_no").between(6, 8))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("seq_no").over(w6).alias("running_min_seq_no"),
        F.max("seq_no").over(w6).alias("running_max_seq_no"),
        F.avg("seq_no").over(w6).alias("running_avg_seq_no"),
        F.last("duration_sec_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_duration_sec_rank"),
    )
)

valid_web_events = (
    scored_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/product", "/search"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "page_event_type_key",
        "duration_sec_rank",
        "seq_no",
        "running_min_seq_no",
        "running_max_seq_no",
        "running_avg_seq_no",
        "last_known_duration_sec_rank",
        F.ceil("duration_sec_rank").alias("duration_sec_rank_whole"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("duration_sec_rank", "running_max_seq_no").alias("greatest_duration_sec_rank_running_max_seq_no"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    cleaned
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("duration_sec_rank_whole") >= 84, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("duration_sec_rank_whole_tier"),
        "session_id",
        "seq_no",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1)).alias("product_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", F.col("duration_sec_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("product_duration_sec_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("page")).alias("page_list"),
        F.countDistinct("session_id").alias("distinct_session_ids"),
    )
    .withColumn("cnt_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w8))
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "duration_sec_rank_whole_tier",
        "session_id",
        "seq_no",
        "cnt",
        "page_list",
        "cnt_percent_rank",
    )
)

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, attr_value
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS has_fault
    FROM flattened
    WHERE attr_key IN ('region', 'trace')
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        status_code_high,
        has_fault,
        FLOOR(has_fault) AS has_fault_whole,
        CASE WHEN has_fault >= 1 THEN 'High' WHEN has_fault >= 0 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS has_fault_level
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE status_code_high BETWEEN 1 AND 2
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(has_fault_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY has_fault_whole, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_has_fault_whole,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_code_high_cume_dist,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY has_fault DESC, id, attr_key) AS has_fault_bucket,
        LAG(status_code_high, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY has_fault, id, attr_key) AS prev_status_code_high
    FROM valid
    WHERE status_code_high <= 2
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        has_fault_whole,
        cumulative_has_fault_whole,
        status_code_high_cume_dist,
        prev_status_code_high
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code_high_cume_dist) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        LEAD(status_code_high_cume_dist) OVER w_hist AS next_status_code_high_cume_dist,
        LEAD(has_fault_whole) OVER w_hist AS next_has_fault_whole,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS event_seq
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY cumulative_has_fault_whole, id, attr_key)
)
SELECT
    id,
    attr_key,
    attr_value,
    next_status_code_high_cume_dist,
    next_has_fault_whole,
    CASE WHEN attr_key RLIKE '^(trace|version)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS attr_key_zone
FROM metrics;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("has_fault_whole", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("has_fault").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("has_fault", "id", "attr_key")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code_high_cume_dist")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("cumulative_has_fault_whole", "id", "attr_key")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isin(["region", "trace"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
    )
)

valid = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("status_code_high").between(1, 2))
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_high",
        "has_fault",
        F.floor("has_fault").alias("has_fault_whole"),
        F.when(F.col("has_fault") >= 1, "High").when(F.col("has_fault") >= 0, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("has_fault_level"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("status_code_high") <= 2)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("has_fault_whole").over(w).alias("cumulative_has_fault_whole"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("status_code_high_cume_dist"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w3).alias("has_fault_bucket"),
        F.lag("status_code_high", 1).over(w4).alias("prev_status_code_high"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "has_fault_whole",
        "cumulative_has_fault_whole",
        "status_code_high_cume_dist",
        "prev_status_code_high",
    )
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        F.lead("status_code_high_cume_dist").over(w_hist).alias("next_status_code_high_cume_dist"),
        F.lead("has_fault_whole").over(w_hist).alias("next_has_fault_whole"),
        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "next_status_code_high_cume_dist",
        "next_has_fault_whole",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key").rlike("^(trace|version)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("attr_key_zone"),
    )
)

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_quantity,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_sum_quantity
    FROM inventory
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock) AS quarter_start,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(last3_count_quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last3_count_quantity_quartiles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_ids,
    BIT_OR(quantity) AS quantity_bit_or,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(last3_min_quantity, 0.5) AS last3_min_quantity_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(last3_min_quantity), 2) AS avg_last3_min_quantity,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(last3_min_quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last3_min_quantity_quartiles
FROM metrics
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', last_restock)

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)

metrics = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("last3_count_quantity", F.count("quantity").over(w))
    .withColumn("last3_min_quantity", F.min("quantity").over(w))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_quantity", F.sum("quantity").over(w))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "last_restock").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("last3_count_quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last3_count_quantity_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("product_id").alias("distinct_product_ids"),
        F.bit_or("quantity").alias("quantity_bit_or"),
        F.percentile_approx("last3_min_quantity", 0.5).alias("last3_min_quantity_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("last3_min_quantity"), 2).alias("avg_last3_min_quantity"),
        F.percentile_approx("last3_min_quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("last3_min_quantity_quartiles"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (

        id,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS k, v

SELECT

FROM exploded
GROUP BY CASE WHEN status_code >= 465 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END

with with_prev as (
    select *, lag(started_at) over (partition by customer_id order by started_at, id) as prev_started_at
    from sessions
),
with_gaps as (
    select *, case when prev_started_at is null or started_at > prev_started_at + interval 30 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from with_prev
),
sessions_sessions as (
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by customer_id order by started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from with_gaps
)
select
    date_trunc('quarter', prev_started_at) as quarter_start,
    browser,
    min(prev_started_at) as first_seen,
    max(started_at) as last_started_at
from sessions_sessions
group by quarter_start, browser
order by quarter_start desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_prev = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "prev_started_at").alias("quarter_start"),
        "browser",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("prev_started_at").alias("first_seen"),
        F.max("started_at").alias("last_started_at"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quarter_start").desc())
)

WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_limits,
        discounts,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency = 'EUR'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 25 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS avg_tier_price_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(avg_tier_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS avg_tier_price_per_eur,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN avg_tier_price ELSE 0 END) AS pro_avg_tier_price,
    ROUND(AVG(lowest_price), 2) AS avg_lowest_price
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 25 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END);
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "EUR")
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "discounts",
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("avg_tier_price") >= 25, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("avg_tier_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("avg_tier_price") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("avg_tier_price_per_eur"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", F.col("avg_tier_price")).otherwise(0)).alias("pro_avg_tier_price"),
        F.round(F.avg("lowest_price"), 2).alias("avg_lowest_price"),
    )
)

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(discounts) li AS tier_value
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        AVG(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_avg_tier_value
    FROM lines
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan NOT IN ('enterprise', 'basic')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(plan_avg_tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_stddev_samp_plan_avg_tier_value,
        AVG(plan_avg_tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value
    FROM kept_rows
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, FLOOR(plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value) AS plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole
    FROM scored
    WHERE plan_stddev_samp_plan_avg_tier_value BETWEEN 34 AND 64
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT
    SELECT plan, id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE YEAR(effective_from) = 2025
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.plan = k.plan AND s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        plan_avg_tier_value,
        plan_stddev_samp_plan_avg_tier_value,
        plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value,
        plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value) AS plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY plan_avg_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS plan_avg_tier_value_dense_rank,
        MIN(plan_avg_tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_min_plan_avg_tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole NULLS LAST) AS plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole_cume_dist
    FROM verified
    WHERE plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value > 53
)
SELECT
    plan_avg_tier_value,
    plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value,
    plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole,
    plan_avg_tier_value_dense_rank,
    plan_min_plan_avg_tier_value,
    plan_avg_plan_avg_tier_value_whole_cume_dist
FROM enriched
ORDER BY plan_avg_tier_value NULLS LAST;

WITH scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(status_bits, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_status_bits,
        LAST_VALUE(pressure, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_pressure,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_pressure,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts DESC, id) AS seq_no
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts < '2024-08-01'
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        prev_status_bits,
        last_known_pressure,
        running_pressure,
        LENGTH(firmware) AS firmware_length
    FROM scored
    WHERE reading_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 03:00:00'
      AND TO_DATE(reading_ts) >= '2023-12-01'
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL 20 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        firmware,
        firmware_length,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY island_id DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM islands
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    island_id,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list_2,
    SUM(firmware_length) AS total_firmware_length
FROM latest
GROUP BY island_id
HAVING SUM(firmware_length) > 0
ORDER BY island_id

WITH deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM shipments
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY shipped_date DESC) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost,
        AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_3_prior
    FROM deduped
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.shipped_date,
        src.delivered_date,
        src.cost,
        src.cost_avg_3_prior,
        b.discount,
        b.shipping_fee
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON src.order_id = b.id
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        cost_avg_3_prior,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        LEAST(cost, cost_avg_3_prior) AS least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-02-19'
),
report AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior
    FROM base
    ORDER BY id, shipping_fee DESC
)
SELECT
    discount,
    shipping_fee,
    least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior
FROM report;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)

deduped = (
    df_shipments
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("cost").over(w2).alias("cumulative_cost"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w3).alias("cost_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.shipped_date",
        "src.delivered_date",
        "src.cost",
        "src.cost_avg_3_prior",
        F.col("b.discount"),
        F.col("b.shipping_fee"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-02-19").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "cost_avg_3_prior",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.least("cost", "cost_avg_3_prior").alias("least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

report = (
    base
    .select("id", "discount", "shipping_fee", "least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior")
    .orderBy("id", F.col("shipping_fee").desc())
)

result = report.select("discount", "shipping_fee", "least_cost_cost_avg_3_prior")

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, TRIM(country) AS clean_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-04-05 05:00:00')
      AND country IS NOT NULL
),
with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, x.web_event_page
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.page AS web_event_page
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.duration_sec DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time <= s.started_at
        )
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM kept
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        web_event_page,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM sessionized s
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND s.started_at >= sub.start_date
       AND s.started_at <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 7)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN monthly_fee >= 249 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS monthly_fee_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', started_at) AS week_start,
    country,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS device_list,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(burst_id, 0.95) AS burst_id_p95,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN web_event_page = '/cart' THEN 1 END) AS cart_count
FROM attributed
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.duration_sec").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-04-05 05:00:00"))) & F.col("country").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.trim("country").alias("clean_country"))
)

with_last = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.page").alias("web_event_page"))
)

kept = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") <= F.col("s.started_at")), "left_anti")
)

flagged = (
    kept
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w2) > F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "web_event_page",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w3).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.started_at") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("s.started_at") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 7)), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

result = (
    attributed
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 249, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("monthly_fee_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "started_at").alias("week_start"),
        "country",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device")).alias("device_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("burst_id", 0.95).alias("burst_id_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("web_event_page") == "/cart", 1)).alias("cart_count"),
    )
)

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_running AS rating_bucket,
        LAG(rating, 1) OVER w_running_2 AS prev_rating
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE country = 'JP'
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY rating, id), w_running_2 AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id)
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.country,
        s.rating_bucket,
        s.prev_rating,
        latest.product_category
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.category AS product_category
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.stock_qty DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products ch
            WHERE ch.supplier_id = s.id
              AND ch.cost >= 660
        )
),
scored_suppliers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(prev_rating) OVER w_part AS next_prev_rating,
        LAG(rating_bucket) OVER w_part AS prev_rating_bucket,
        LEAD(rating_bucket) OVER w_part AS next_rating_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no,
        SUM(prev_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY product_category, country) AS product_category_sum_prev_rating
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY product_category ORDER BY rating_bucket, id)
),
kept_suppliers AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_suppliers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products x
            WHERE x.supplier_id = s.id
              AND x.price > 1050
        )
)
SELECT
    country,
    CASE WHEN next_rating_bucket >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS next_rating_bucket_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_rating_bucket, 0.5) AS prev_rating_bucket_p50,
    AVG(rating_bucket) AS avg_rating_bucket,
    COUNT_IF(product_category = 'Fashion') AS fashion_events,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_rating_bucket, 0.5) DESC) AS prev_rating_bucket_p50_dense_rank
FROM kept_suppliers
GROUP BY country, CASE WHEN next_rating_bucket >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING COUNT_IF(product_category = 'Fashion') < 1000
ORDER BY avg_rating_bucket DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.orderBy("rating", "id")
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.stock_qty").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("product_category").orderBy("rating_bucket", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_category", "country")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("prev_rating_bucket_p50").desc())

scored = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") == "JP")
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        F.ntile(3).over(w_running).alias("rating_bucket"),
        F.lag("rating", 1).over(w_running_2).alias("prev_rating"),
    )
)

with_last = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.country",
        "s.rating_bucket",
        "s.prev_rating",
        F.col("c.category").alias("product_category"),
    )
)

kept = (
    with_last
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.cost") >= 660), "left_semi")
)

scored_suppliers = (
    kept
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("prev_rating").over(w_part).alias("next_prev_rating"),
        F.lag("rating_bucket").over(w_part).alias("prev_rating_bucket"),
        F.lead("rating_bucket").over(w_part).alias("next_rating_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("seq_no"),
        F.sum("prev_rating").over(w5).alias("product_category_sum_prev_rating"),
    )
)

kept_suppliers = (
    scored_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.price") > 1050), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("next_rating_bucket") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_rating_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("prev_rating_bucket", 0.5).alias("prev_rating_bucket_p50"),
        F.avg("rating_bucket").alias("avg_rating_bucket"),
        F.count_if(F.col("product_category") == "Fashion").alias("fashion_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("fashion_events") < 1000)
    .withColumn("prev_rating_bucket_p50_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w6))
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_rating_bucket").desc())
)

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(store_name, ' ', '') AS store_name_slug,
        COALESCE(region, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_filled
    FROM stores
    WHERE sqft > 11901
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_sqft,
        MIN(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_sqft,
        MAX(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_sqft,
        COUNT(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_sqft,
        AVG(sqft) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sqft_avg_6
    FROM cleaned
),
scored_stores AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        city,
        opened_date,
        store_name_slug,
        running_min_sqft,
        running_max_sqft,
        running_count_sqft,
        LAG(running_count_sqft, 2, 0) OVER (ORDER BY running_count_sqft, id) AS prev_running_count_sqft,
        LEAD(sqft_avg_6, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS next_sqft_avg_6,
        AVG(running_max_sqft) OVER w_running AS running_max_sqft_avg_2,
        LEAD(running_min_sqft, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_avg_6, id) AS next_running_min_sqft,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_count_sqft, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_count_sqft
    FROM scored
    WHERE sqft_avg_6 >= 9971
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY running_max_sqft, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        opened_date,
        store_name_slug,
        running_min_sqft,
        running_max_sqft,
        next_sqft_avg_6,
        running_max_sqft_avg_2,
        COUNT(prev_running_count_sqft) OVER w_grp AS last3_count_prev_running_count_sqft,
        MIN(prev_running_count_sqft) OVER w_grp AS last3_min_prev_running_count_sqft,
        AVG(prev_running_count_sqft) OVER w_grp AS last3_avg_prev_running_count_sqft,
        SUM(prev_running_count_sqft) OVER w_grp AS last3_sum_prev_running_count_sqft
    FROM scored_stores
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY next_sqft_avg_6, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching inventory per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.opened_date,
        s.running_min_sqft,
        s.running_max_sqft,
        s.running_max_sqft_avg_2,
        s.last3_min_prev_running_count_sqft,
        top1.inventory_quantity
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.quantity AS inventory_quantity
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.last_restock <= s.opened_date
            ORDER BY c.last_restock DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN inventory_quantity >= 208 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS inventory_quantity_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date) AS quarter_start,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_min_sqft, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_min_sqft_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_min_sqft, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_min_sqft_quartiles_2,
    ROUND(AVG(running_min_sqft), 2) AS avg_running_min_sqft,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_min_sqft, 0.5) AS running_min_sqft_p50,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN inventory_quantity >= 208 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END) AS grouping_id
FROM with_latest
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN inventory_quantity >= 208 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date))
HAVING num_rows >= 1;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("running_count_sqft", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("running_max_sqft", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("sqft_avg_6", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("next_sqft_avg_6", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.last_restock").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("sqft") > 11901)
    .withColumn("store_name_slug", F.regexp_replace("store_name", " ", ""))
    .withColumn("region_filled", F.coalesce("region", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("sqft").over(w).alias("running_avg_sqft"),
        F.min("sqft").over(w).alias("running_min_sqft"),
        F.max("sqft").over(w).alias("running_max_sqft"),
        F.count("sqft").over(w).alias("running_count_sqft"),
        F.avg("sqft").over(w2).alias("sqft_avg_6"),
    )
)

scored_stores = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("sqft_avg_6") >= 9971)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "city",
        "opened_date",
        "store_name_slug",
        "running_min_sqft",
        "running_max_sqft",
        "running_count_sqft",
        F.lag("running_count_sqft", 2, 0).over(w3).alias("prev_running_count_sqft"),
        F.lead("sqft_avg_6", 1, 0).over(w4).alias("next_sqft_avg_6"),
        F.avg("running_max_sqft").over(w_running).alias("running_max_sqft_avg_2"),
        F.lead("running_min_sqft", 1).over(w6).alias("next_running_min_sqft"),
        F.first("running_count_sqft", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_running_count_sqft"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_stores
    .select(
        "id",
        "opened_date",
        "store_name_slug",
        "running_min_sqft",
        "running_max_sqft",
        "next_sqft_avg_6",
        "running_max_sqft_avg_2",
        F.count("prev_running_count_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("last3_count_prev_running_count_sqft"),
        F.min("prev_running_count_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("last3_min_prev_running_count_sqft"),
        F.avg("prev_running_count_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("last3_avg_prev_running_count_sqft"),
        F.sum("prev_running_count_sqft").over(w_grp).alias("last3_sum_prev_running_count_sqft"),
    )
)

with_latest = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.last_restock") <= F.col("s.opened_date")), "inner")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.running_min_sqft",
        "s.running_max_sqft",
        "s.running_max_sqft_avg_2",
        "s.last3_min_prev_running_count_sqft",
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("inventory_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("inventory_quantity_tier", F.when(F.col("inventory_quantity") >= 208, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("quarter_start", F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "opened_date"))
    .rollup("inventory_quantity_tier", "quarter_start")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_min_sqft", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_min_sqft_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_min_sqft", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_min_sqft_quartiles_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_min_sqft"), 2).alias("avg_running_min_sqft"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_min_sqft", 0.5).alias("running_min_sqft_p50"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.grouping("inventory_quantity_tier").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") >= 1)
)

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS seq_no,
        LAG(discount_pct, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS prev_discount_pct,
        LAST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct >= 0.23
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct_cume_dist NULLS FIRST) AS rn
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
enriched_promotions AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        seq_no,
        last_known_channel,
        rn,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id) AS seq_no_2,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct_cume_dist, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS discount_pct_avg_3_prior
    FROM deduped
),
enriched_promotions_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS discount_pct_percent_rank,
        AVG(seq_no_2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct_avg_3_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_2_avg_6,
        AVG(seq_no_2) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_2_avg_5
    FROM enriched_promotions
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        seq_no,
        rn,
        seq_no_2,
        discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
        discount_pct_percent_rank,
        seq_no_2_avg_6,
        CASE WHEN seq_no_2_avg_5 >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN seq_no_2_avg_5 >= 4 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS seq_no_2_avg_5_band
    FROM enriched_promotions_2
    WHERE seq_no BETWEEN 5 AND 6
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM cleaned
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    starts_on,
    ends_on,
    discount_pct,
    seq_no,
    rn,
    seq_no_2,
    discount_pct_avg_3_prior,
    discount_pct_percent_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS LAST

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("starts_on", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("starts_on", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        TRIM(country) AS clean_country,
        SUBSTRING(browser, 1, 2) AS browser_prefix
    FROM sessions
    WHERE browser IN ('Chrome', 'Firefox', 'Safari')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(device, 1, 3) AS device_prefix,
        COALESCE(browser, 'DIRECT') AS browser_filled
    FROM valid
    WHERE browser IN ('Edge', 'Firefox', 'Safari')
),
cleaned_sessions AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        clean_country,
        browser_prefix,
        CONCAT_WS('-', browser, device) AS browser_device_key,
        LOWER(device) AS device_lower,
        COALESCE(browser, 'UNKNOWN') AS browser_clean
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned_sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time >= '2023-10-01'
        )
),
valid_sessions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN device = 'mobile' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mobile,
        CONCAT_WS('-', country, device) AS country_device_key,
        COALESCE(browser, 'N/A') AS browser_clean_2
    FROM eligible
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid_sessions s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_time >= '2025-10-01'
        )
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_mobile, id) AS is_mobile_bucket,
        SUM(is_mobile) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_mobile, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_is_mobile,
        AVG(is_mobile) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY is_mobile, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS is_mobile_avg_3_prior
    FROM not_flagged
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    country,
    browser,
    ROUND(SUM(running_is_mobile) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN browser = 'Chrome' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_is_mobile_per_chrome,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_is_mobile, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_is_mobile_quartiles,
    SUM(is_mobile) AS total_is_mobile,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS num_countries,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP (country, browser)
ORDER BY total_is_mobile DESC

WITH with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.balance,
        s.opened_date,
        x.txn_time
    FROM accounts s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.txn_time
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.txn_time < s.txn_time
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) balance_avg_5_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(balance, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) event_seq,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_hist balance_bucket
    FROM kept
    WHERE opened_date <= '2025-02-01'
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance DESC, id)
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching transaction per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.transaction_merchant
    FROM with_windows s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.merchant AS transaction_merchant
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.amount DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest_match s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.account_id = 20
        )
),
eligible_accounts AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions ch
            WHERE ch.account_id = s.id
              AND ch.merchant = 'Starbucks'
        )
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    id,
    opened_date,
    txn_time,
    first_known_balance,
    event_seq,
    balance_bucket,
    transaction_merchant,
    LAG(balance_avg_5_prior) OVER w_part prev_balance_avg_5_prior,
    LEAD(balance_avg_5_prior) OVER w_part next_balance_avg_5_prior,
    LAG(event_seq) OVER w_part prev_event_seq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part event_seq_2,
    LAG(balance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY transaction_merchant ORDER BY balance_bucket, id) prev_balance
FROM eligible_accounts
WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, transaction_merchant ORDER BY balance_bucket, id)

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(supplier_name, ' ', '') AS supplier_name_slug,
        CONCAT_WS('-', country, supplier_name) AS country_supplier_name_key
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND supplier_name IS NULL
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.category,
        latest.product_brand
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.category, c.brand AS product_brand
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.price DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_rating,
        AVG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_rating,
        SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_sum_rating,
        MIN(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, product_brand ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM with_latest
    WHERE product_brand = 'Initech'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name_slug,
        country_supplier_name_key,
        category,
        last3_count_rating,
        last3_avg_rating,
        last3_min_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY last3_avg_rating DESC, id) AS event_seq_2,
        LAG(last3_avg_rating, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_brand, category ORDER BY last3_sum_rating, id) AS prev_last3_avg_rating,
        ROUND(last3_avg_rating / SUM(last3_avg_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) AS last3_avg_rating_share
    FROM with_windows
),
with_latest_suppliers AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,
        latest.product_cost,
        latest.product_launch_date
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.cost AS product_cost, c.launch_date AS product_launch_date
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN product_cost >= 670 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS product_cost_tier,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(category)) AS num_categories,
    COUNT_IF(category = 'Fashion') AS fashion_events,
    ROUND(SUM(last3_count_rating) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'Grocery' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS last3_count_rating_per_grocery
FROM with_latest_suppliers
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT_IF(category = 'Fashion') >= 1
ORDER BY last3_count_rating_per_grocery DESC

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.price").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city", "product_brand").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last3_avg_rating").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_brand", "category").orderBy("last3_sum_rating", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & F.col("supplier_name").isNull())
    .withColumn("supplier_name_slug", F.regexp_replace("supplier_name", " ", ""))
    .withColumn("country_supplier_name_key", F.concat_ws("-", "country", "supplier_name"))
)

with_latest = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.category"), F.col("c.brand").alias("product_brand"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_latest
    .filter(F.col("product_brand") == "Initech")
    .withColumn("last3_count_rating", F.count("rating").over(w2))
    .withColumn("last3_avg_rating", F.avg("rating").over(w2))
    .withColumn("last3_sum_rating", F.sum("rating").over(w2))
    .withColumn("last3_min_rating", F.min("rating").over(w2))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name_slug",
        "country_supplier_name_key",
        "category",
        "last3_count_rating",
        "last3_avg_rating",
        "last3_min_rating",
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.lag("last3_avg_rating", 1).over(w5).alias("prev_last3_avg_rating"),
        F.round((F.col("last3_avg_rating") / F.sum("last3_avg_rating").over(w6)), 4).alias("last3_avg_rating_share"),
    )
)

with_latest_suppliers = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.cost").alias("product_cost"),
        F.col("c.launch_date").alias("product_launch_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_latest_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("product_cost") >= 670, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("product_cost_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("category")).alias("num_categories"),
        F.count_if(F.col("category") == "Fashion").alias("fashion_events"),
        F.round(F.sum("last3_count_rating") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("category") == "Grocery", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("last3_count_rating_per_grocery"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("fashion_events") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("last3_count_rating_per_grocery").desc())
)

SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 17100 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS credit_limit_tier,
    CASE WHEN age >= 65 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS age_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(credit_limit, 0.9) AS credit_limit_p90,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries,
    BIT_AND(age) AS age_bit_and,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM customers
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 17100 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN age >= 65 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 17100 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END))
ORDER BY age_tier;

    df_customers
    .withColumn("credit_limit_tier", F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 17100, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("age_tier", F.when(F.col("age") >= 65, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["credit_limit_tier", "age_tier"], ["credit_limit_tier"]],
        "credit_limit_tier",

    .agg(

        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),

        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),

)

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        SUBSTRING(carrier, 1, 3) AS carrier_prefix,
        CONCAT(status, ', ', carrier) AS status_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IS DISTINCT FROM 'Kerry'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.status AS order_status,
        p.channel
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON s.order_id = p.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        status,
        carrier_prefix,
        channel,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS event_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(order_status) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_hist AS first_known_order_status
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY delivered_date, id), w_hist AS (ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY event_seq DESC) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS prev_row_seq,
        LEAD(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS next_row_seq,
        LEAD(seq_no) OVER w_grp AS next_seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq_2,
        FIRST_VALUE(event_seq, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY row_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_event_seq
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY event_seq, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
latest_shipments AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY row_num DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    carrier_prefix,
    channel,
    row_seq,
    event_seq,
    row_num,
    prev_row_seq,
    next_row_seq
FROM latest_shipments
ORDER BY event_seq DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("row_num").desc(), "id")

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(revenue, 0) AS revenue_rounded
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > TO_DATE('2023-05-22')
      AND store_id = 2
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        revenue_rounded,
        LAG(revenue, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS prev_revenue,
        LEAD(units, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY units, id) AS next_units
    FROM cleaned
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.opened_date,
        p.city,
        p.store_name
    FROM with_windows a
    INNER JOIN stores p
        ON a.store_id = p.id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        revenue_rounded,
        next_units,
        opened_date
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY revenue_rounded DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS row_seq,
        SUM(next_units) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue_rounded, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_next_units,
        LEAD(next_units, 1) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_rounded, id) AS next_next_units
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_recent AS (ORDER BY next_units DESC, id)
)
SELECT
    d.brand,
    d.category,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(a.next_units), 2) AS total_next_units,
    MAX(a.revenue_rounded) AS max_revenue_rounded,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM scored a
INNER JOIN products d ON a.product_id = d.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.brand, d.category), (d.brand))
ORDER BY brand NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("revenue", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("units", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue_rounded").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_units").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("revenue_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("revenue_rounded", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-22"))) & (F.col("store_id") == 2))
    .withColumn("revenue_rounded", F.round("revenue", 0))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "revenue_rounded",
        F.lag("revenue", 1, 0).over(w).alias("prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("units", 1).over(w2).alias("next_units"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.opened_date"), F.col("p.city"), F.col("p.store_name"))

    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "product_id", "revenue_rounded", "next_units", "opened_date")
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("next_units").over(w5).alias("cumulative_next_units"),
        F.lead("next_units", 1).over(w6).alias("next_next_units"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["brand", "category"], ["brand"]],
        F.col("d.brand").alias("brand"),
        F.col("d.category").alias("category"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum(F.col("a.next_units")), 2).alias("total_next_units"),
        F.max(F.col("a.revenue_rounded")).alias("max_revenue_rounded"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("brand").asc_nulls_first())
)

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device,
        browser,
        country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) seq_no
    FROM sessions
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        seq_no,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sum_seq_no,
        MIN(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_min_seq_no,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_avg_seq_no,
        MAX(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_max_seq_no,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY seq_no) seq_no_cume_dist
    FROM enriched
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_type != 'page_view'
        )
),
with_latest AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.browser,
        s.seq_no,
        s.running_sum_seq_no,
        s.running_avg_seq_no,
        latest.page
    FROM eligible s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.page
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
eligible_sessions AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_latest s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.page = '/product'
        )
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.browser,
        s.running_sum_seq_no,
        s.page,
        latest.web_event_event_time
    FROM eligible_sessions s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_time AS web_event_event_time
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.event_time DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        web_event_event_time
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY browser, page ORDER BY running_sum_seq_no NULLS LAST) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_last
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    browser,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', web_event_event_time) AS year_start,
    MIN(web_event_event_time) AS first_web_event_event_time,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(web_event_event_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(web_event_event_time))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_rows
FROM latest
GROUP BY browser, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', web_event_event_time)
ORDER BY browser DESC

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS key, attr_value
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS LAST) latency_ms_percent_rank,
        AVG(latency_ms) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) latency_ms_avg_2h
    FROM flattened
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        log_ts,
        key,
        latency_ms_avg_2h,
        latency_ms_percent_rank * latency_ms latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms
    FROM metrics
    WHERE log_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 13:00:00')
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        log_ts,
        key,
        latency_ms_avg_2h,
        latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms,
        AVG(latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms) OVER w_ordered key_avg_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms,
        AVG(latency_ms_avg_2h) OVER w_ordered key_avg_latency_ms_avg_2h,
        AVG(latency_ms_avg_2h) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY key)
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        log_ts,
        latency_ms_avg_2h,
        latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms,
        key_avg_latency_ms_avg_2h,
        latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h,
        COALESCE(latency_ms_avg_2h, 0) latency_ms_avg_2h_filled,
        GREATEST(latency_ms_avg_2h, latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms) greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms
    FROM enriched
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
      AND HOUR(log_ts) BETWEEN 9 AND 13
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms_sum_15m
    FROM valid
    WHERE greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms >= 67
)
SELECT
    latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h,
    latency_ms_avg_2h_filled,
    greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms,
    greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms_sum_15m
FROM scored
ORDER BY greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms_sum_15m, latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h DESC;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("key")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latency_ms_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_avg_2h", F.avg("latency_ms").over(w2))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-06-01 13:00:00")))
    .select(
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "latency_ms_avg_2h",
        (F.col("latency_ms_percent_rank") * F.col("latency_ms")).alias("latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "latency_ms_avg_2h",
        "latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms",
        F.avg("latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms").over(w_ordered).alias("key_avg_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms"),
        F.avg("latency_ms_avg_2h").over(w_ordered).alias("key_avg_latency_ms_avg_2h"),
        F.avg("latency_ms_avg_2h").over(w4).alias("latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull() & F.hour("log_ts").between(9, 13))
    .select(
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms_avg_2h",
        "latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms",
        "key_avg_latency_ms_avg_2h",
        "latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h",
        F.coalesce("latency_ms_avg_2h", F.lit(0)).alias("latency_ms_avg_2h_filled"),
        F.greatest("latency_ms_avg_2h", "latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms").alias("greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms") >= 67)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms").over(w5).alias("greatest_latency_ms_avg_2h_latency_ms_percent_rank_times_latency_ms_sum_15m"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "latency_ms_avg_2h_avg_1h",

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        DATE_FORMAT(starts_on, 'yyyy-MM-dd') starts_on_label,
        CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.29 THEN 'High' WHEN discount_pct >= 0.1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END discount_pct_band,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') channel_clean
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS DISTINCT FROM 'mobile'
),
cleaned_promotions AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        starts_on_label,
        discount_pct_band,
        DATE_ADD(ends_on, 54) ends_on_plus_54d,
        LENGTH(promo_code) promo_code_length
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'partner'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        starts_on_label,
        discount_pct_band,
        ends_on_plus_54d,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY ends_on_plus_54d, id) row_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(channel, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY starts_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_channel
    FROM cleaned_promotions
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY ends_on_plus_54d DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
deduped_promotions AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        discount_pct,
        discount_pct_band,
        ends_on_plus_54d,
        dedup_rank
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY starts_on DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    channel,
    promo_code,
    discount_pct,
    discount_pct_band,
    dedup_rank,
    CASE WHEN promo_code RLIKE '^(VIP|BUNDLE)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS promo_code_zone
FROM deduped_promotions
ORDER BY promo_code DESC NULLS LAST, dedup_rank DESC;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on_plus_54d", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("starts_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(~F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("mobile")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.date_format("starts_on", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("starts_on_label"),
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.29, "High").when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.1, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("discount_pct_band"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_clean"),
    )
)

cleaned_promotions = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("partner")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "starts_on_label",
        "discount_pct_band",
        F.date_add("ends_on", 54).alias("ends_on_plus_54d"),
        F.length("promo_code").alias("promo_code_length"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned_promotions
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "starts_on_label",
        "discount_pct_band",
        "ends_on_plus_54d",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.first("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("first_known_channel"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

deduped_promotions = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "discount_pct",
        "discount_pct_band",
        "ends_on_plus_54d",

    QUARTER(c.signup_date) AS signup_quarter,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    ROUND(STDDEV(o.discount), 2) AS stddev_discount
FROM orders o
INNER JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
INNER JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.id
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(c.signup_date, 'yyyy-MM'), QUARTER(c.signup_date)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 2 DESC, signup_month ASC

with with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(budget) over w_ordered as last3_avg_budget,
        max(budget) over w_ordered as last3_max_budget,
        count(budget) over w_ordered as last3_count_budget,
        sum(budget) over w_ordered as last3_sum_budget,
        lag(budget, 2, 0) over (partition by dept_name order by budget, id) as prev_budget
    from departments
    where budget >= 1518000
    window w_ordered as (partition by dept_name, location order by budget, id rows between 2 preceding and current row)
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    location,
    case when last3_avg_budget >= 3111000 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as last3_avg_budget_tier,
    count(*) filter (where dept_name = 'HR') as hr_rows,
    percentile_approx(last3_max_budget, 0.95) as last3_max_budget_p95,
    percentile_approx(last3_sum_budget, 0.9) as last3_sum_budget_p90
from with_windows
group by rollup (location, case when last3_avg_budget >= 3111000 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end)
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")

with_windows = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget") >= 1518000)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("budget").over(w_ordered).alias("last3_avg_budget"),
        F.max("budget").over(w_ordered).alias("last3_max_budget"),
        F.count("budget").over(w_ordered).alias("last3_count_budget"),
        F.sum("budget").over(w_ordered).alias("last3_sum_budget"),
        F.lag("budget", 2, 0).over(w2).alias("prev_budget"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .rollup(
        "location",
        F.when(F.col("last3_avg_budget") >= 3111000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("last3_avg_budget_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", 1)).alias("hr_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("last3_max_budget", 0.95).alias("last3_max_budget_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("last3_sum_budget", 0.9).alias("last3_sum_budget_p90"),
    )
)
