WITH matched AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM orders a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.order_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.order_date < sub.end_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, status ORDER BY discount DESC, id, subscription_id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM matched
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM shipments c
            WHERE c.order_id = s.id
              AND c.order_id IS NULL
        )
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_part AS seq_no
    FROM kept
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY discount, id, subscription_id), w_part AS (ORDER BY order_date DESC, id, subscription_id)
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN subscription_id >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS subscription_id_tier,
    subscription_id,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS status_list_2,
    ROUND(SUM(discount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'premium' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS discount_per_premium,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM metrics
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN subscription_id >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, subscription_id)
HAVING ROUND(SUM(discount) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'premium' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) < 1000000
ORDER BY subscription_id_tier NULLS LAST;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc(), "id", "subscription_id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("discount", "id", "subscription_id")
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc(), "id", "subscription_id")

matched = (
    df_orders
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.order_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.order_date") < F.col("sub.end_date") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    matched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

kept = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_shipments.alias("c"), (F.col("c.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.order_id").isNull()), "left_semi")
)

metrics = (
    kept
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_running))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_part))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("subscription_id_tier", F.when(F.col("subscription_id") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("subscription_id_tier", "subscription_id")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min("amount").alias("min_amount"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list_2"),
        F.round(F.sum("discount") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("discount_per_premium"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("discount_per_premium") < 1000000)

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        HOUR(started_at) AS started_at_hour,
        LENGTH(country) AS country_length
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at > TO_DATE('2023-03-19')
      AND country = 'DE'
),
matched AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND s.started_at >= sub.start_date
       AND s.started_at <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 10)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT device, customer_id
    FROM matched
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT device, customer_id
    FROM sessions
    WHERE device NOT IN ('mobile', 'tablet')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.device = k.device AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT browser, customer_id
    FROM verified
    EXCEPT
    SELECT browser, customer_id
    FROM sessions
    WHERE customer_id = 10
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.browser = k.browser AND s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.name,
        p.age,
        p.credit_limit
    FROM kept_rows a
    INNER JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id = p.id
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT e.*, b.country AS customer_country
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON e.customer_id = b.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN credit_limit >= 13100 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS credit_limit_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', started_at) AS quarter_start,
    country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT country) AS distinct_countries,
    ROUND(SUM(monthly_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'SG' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS monthly_fee_per_sg,
    MIN(subscription_id) AS min_subscription_id
FROM enriched_sessions
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY min_subscription_id DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter((F.col("started_at") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-19"))) & (F.col("country") == "DE"))
    .withColumn("started_at_hour", F.hour("started_at"))
    .withColumn("country_length", F.length("country"))
)

matched = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.started_at") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("s.started_at") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    matched
    .select("device", "customer_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_sessions
        .filter(~F.col("device").isin(["mobile", "tablet"]))
        .select("device", "customer_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    matched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device") == F.col("k.device")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept_keys = (
    verified
    .select("browser", "customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 10)
        .select("browser", "customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.browser") == F.col("k.browser")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.name"), F.col("p.age"), F.col("p.credit_limit"))
)

enriched_sessions = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.country").alias("customer_country"))
)

result = (
    enriched_sessions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 13100, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("credit_limit_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "started_at").alias("quarter_start"),
        "country",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("country").alias("distinct_countries"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_per_sg"),
        F.min("subscription_id").alias("min_subscription_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("min_subscription_id").desc())
)

WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        unit_price,
        LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS prev_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS next_quantity,
        LAG(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS prev_unit_price,
        LEAD(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS next_unit_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS row_seq
    FROM order_items
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        next_quantity,
        prev_unit_price,
        LAG(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS prev_row_seq,
        LEAD(row_seq) OVER w_grp AS next_row_seq,
        LAG(unit_price) OVER w_grp AS prev_unit_price_2,
        LEAD(unit_price) OVER w_grp AS next_unit_price_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY unit_price, id)
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_ordered AS event_seq_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_part AS prev_row_seq_bucket,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS event_seq_bucket_2
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (ORDER BY event_seq DESC, id), w_part AS (ORDER BY prev_row_seq, id)
),
metrics_order_items AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        next_quantity,
        next_row_seq,
        prev_unit_price_2,
        next_unit_price_2,
        event_seq_bucket,
        prev_row_seq_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_row_seq DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY next_quantity, id) AS event_seq_2
    FROM scored
    WHERE event_seq_bucket >= 4
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM metrics_order_items
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (4, 17)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics_order_items s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN next_unit_price_2 >= 330 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS next_unit_price_2_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_row_seq_bucket, 0.5) AS prev_row_seq_bucket_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(next_quantity), 2) AS avg_next_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN next_unit_price_2 >= 330 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w_grp = Window.orderBy("unit_price", "id")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc(), "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy("prev_row_seq", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_row_seq").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("next_quantity", "id")

with_windows = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "unit_price",
        F.lag("quantity").over(w).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.lead("quantity").over(w).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.lag("unit_price").over(w).alias("prev_unit_price"),
        F.lead("unit_price").over(w).alias("next_unit_price"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_quantity",
        "prev_unit_price",
        F.lag("row_seq").over(w_grp).alias("prev_row_seq"),
        F.lead("row_seq").over(w_grp).alias("next_row_seq"),
        F.lag("unit_price").over(w_grp).alias("prev_unit_price_2"),
        F.lead("unit_price").over(w_grp).alias("next_unit_price_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("event_seq_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("prev_row_seq_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w_part))
    .withColumn("event_seq_bucket_2", F.ntile(4).over(w5))
)

metrics_order_items = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_bucket") >= 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_quantity",
        "next_row_seq",
        "prev_unit_price_2",
        "next_unit_price_2",
        "event_seq_bucket",
        "prev_row_seq_bucket",
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics_order_items
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([4, 17]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
